title: Network-Adjusted GMM Estimation under Network Uncertainty
abstract: This paper proposes a network-adjusted generalized method of moments (NA-GMM) estimator for social interaction models when the observed network may differ from the true interaction network. NA-GMM is a novel penalized GMM approach that allows the elements of the observed interaction matrix to be modified to improve the fit of the moment conditions. To avoid unrestricted network adjustments, the NA-GMM criterion introduces a penalty on the amount of adjustment. Since NA-GMM does not aim to estimate the true interaction network itself, the estimator generally converges to a pseudo-true parameter. For a linear spatial autoregressive model, we prove that the NA-GMM estimator is consistent for the pseudo-true parameter and is asymptotically normally distributed under general moment misspecification. We also prove that a fixed-weight version of the NA-GMM estimator has a desirable bias reduction property relative to conventional GMM without network adjustment. An empirical application to U.S. county-level COVID-19 infection data demonstrates the usefulness of the proposed method.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种网络调整广义矩估计方法，用于在观测网络可能偏离真实交互网络时估计社交互动模型，并通过美国县级COVID-19感染数据验证了其有效性。
abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种针对社交互动模型的网络调整广义矩方法（NA-GMM）估计量，适用于观测网络可能与真实互动网络存在差异的情形。NA-GMM是一种新颖的惩罚广义矩方法，允许对观测互动矩阵中的元素进行调整，以改善矩条件的拟合效果。为避免无限制的网络调整，NA-GMM准则引入了对调整幅度的惩罚项。由于NA-GMM并不旨在估计真实的互动网络本身，该估计量通常收敛于一个伪真实参数。针对线性空间自回归模型，我们证明NA-GMM估计量对伪真实参数具有一致性，并且在一般矩误设条件下渐近服从正态分布。我们还证明，与未进行网络调整的传统GMM相比，NA-GMM估计量的固定权重版本具有理想的偏差缩减性质。对美国县级COVID-19感染数据的实证应用展示了所提方法的实用性。

title: It Takes Two to Tango, but More to Assess Systemic Risk: Credit Networks Through the Lens of Hypergraphs
abstract: This paper provides the first analysis of credit relationships between financial institutions and firms through the lens of hypergraphs. Unlike traditional network approaches, which rely on pairwise connections, this framework explicitly represents the shared exposure of multiple financial institutions to the same firm as a simultaneous multilateral relationship. The approach is applied empirically to Credit Registry data from the Central Bank of Argentina, covering the period from August 2023 to December 2025 and focusing on commercial loans between banks and firms. Traditional centrality metrics are compared with hypergraph-specific measures to identify systemically relevant institutions. The paper also proposes an adjusted version of H-eigenvector centrality that nonlinearly weights both the centrality of neighboring institutions and each creditor's lending amount, in order to assess the relevance of a bank within the network. The systemic impact of shocking the top-ranked institutions according to each centrality metric is then estimated through an adaptation of the DebtRank algorithm. The results show that the proposed framework identifies institutions with greater shock-amplification capacity, providing a complementary tool for financial supervision and regulation.
tldr: 该论文首次使用超图框架分析银行与企业间的信贷关系，通过阿根廷央行信贷登记数据识别系统性重要机构，并发现超图中心性指标能更好地识别具有冲击放大能力的机构，为金融监管提供补充工具。
abstract_cn: 本文首次通过超图视角分析金融机构与企业之间的信贷关系。不同于依赖成对连接的传统网络方法，该框架将多家金融机构对同一企业的共同敞口明确表示为一种同时发生的多边关系。该方法被实证应用于阿根廷中央银行信贷登记数据，覆盖2023年8月至2025年12月期间，重点关注银行与企业之间的商业贷款。本文将传统中心性指标与超图特定指标进行比较，以识别具有系统重要性的机构。本文还提出了一种调整后的H-特征向量中心性（H-eigenvector centrality）方法，该方法对相邻机构的中心性及每个债权人的贷款金额进行非线性加权，从而评估银行在网络中的相关性。随后，通过改进的DebtRank算法，估算根据各中心性指标排名靠前的机构受到冲击后的系统性影响。结果表明，所提出的框架能够识别出具有更强冲击放大能力的机构，为金融监管提供了补充工具。

title: Dynamically Consistent Statistical Decisions
abstract: A large literature in econometrics proposes decision rules with optimality guarantees based on ex ante criteria, such as minimax regret. We develop a framework for analyzing the dynamic consistency of such rules and show that, in many empirically relevant settings, the researcher may wish to deviate from the interim prescription of ex ante optimal rules after observing the data realization. To address this problem, we propose and axiomatize two classes of optimality criteria that yield dynamically consistent decision rules.
tldr: 该论文提出并公理化了两类产生动态一致决策规则的最优性准则，解决了先验最优规则在数据实现后可能被偏离的问题。
abstract_cn: 计量经济学中大量文献基于事前准则（如最小化最大遗憾）提出了具有最优性保证的决策规则。我们构建了一个分析此类规则动态一致性的框架，并证明在许多实证相关情境中，研究者在观测到数据实现后可能希望偏离事前最优规则的中间阶段规定。为解决这一问题，我们提出并公理化了两类能够产生动态一致性决策规则的最优性准则。

title: Local Asymptotic Power of Honest Confidence Intervals
abstract: Confidence intervals that are conservative against an untestable bias, called bias-aware or honest, are now standard in DiD, IV, RD, and factor-model settings. This paper characterises the local power of the tests they induce. Power is governed by the rate of the bias bound relative to the sampling rate, giving three regimes: when the bound vanishes faster than the standard error, conservatism is asymptotically free; when the two are of the same order it costs a bounded, explicit amount; and when the bound dominates, the typical case at the parametric rate, the honest test has zero local power, failing to reject local alternatives with probability approaching one. A minimax argument shows this loss is intrinsic to honesty itself, not a property of any particular construction. No honest procedure recovers it, and the standard bias-aware interval is rate-optimal. Broadly, any confidence interval whose width fails to shrink fast enough has no local power in the interior of the set it traces out, and at best one-sided power at the boundary. Partial identification is the limiting case of this argument. Simulations and two empirical applications illustrate the three regimes. The practical recommendation is to report the half-width of the power "dead zone" alongside bias-aware intervals.
tldr: 该论文研究了在存在不可检验偏差时，诚实置信区间（bias-aware）的局部渐近检验势，发现当偏差界以参数速率衰减时，诚实检验的局部势为零，且这一损失是诚实性固有的。
abstract_cn: 在双重差分、工具变量、断点回归及因子模型设定中，考虑不可检验偏误的保守置信区间（称为偏误感知或诚实置信区间）已成为标准做法。本文刻画了由此类区间所诱导检验的局部功效特征。功效由偏误边界相对于抽样速率的衰减速率决定，由此产生三种情形：当偏误边界比标准误衰减更快时，保守性渐近无成本；当二者同阶时，需付出有限且显式的代价；当偏误边界占主导地位（即参数速率下的典型情形）时，诚实检验的局部功效为零，无法拒绝局部备择假设的概率趋近于1。极小化极大论证表明，这种损失是诚实性本身固有的属性，而非任何特定构造的特性。没有任何诚实程序能恢复该功效，且标准偏误感知区间在速率上已达到最优。广义而言，任何宽度未能足够快速收缩的置信区间，在其所勾勒集合的内部均无局部功效，至多在边界处具有单侧功效。部分识别是该论证的极限情形。模拟与两项实证应用展示了上述三种情形。实践建议是：在报告偏误感知区间的同时，应同时报告功效“死区”的半宽度。

title: Bayesian Robustness Values for Modern Causal Panel Estimators via Riesz Representations
abstract: We develop a sensitivity-analysis workflow for causal panel estimators, covering synthetic difference-in-differences, matrix completion, fixed-effect imputation, and group-time average treatment effects. The workflow combines Riesz-representation omitted-variable-bias bounds with partial-$R^2$ robustness values and separates two reporting routes. Route A gives a direct sensitivity profile for additive or projected confounding summarized by outcome-side and Riesz-side partial $R^2$ values. Route B treats observed-covariate benchmarks as auxiliary data only when benchmark-count, alpha-side alignment, model-check, dependence, and dominance diagnostics are credible; otherwise its main role is demotion. We derive estimator-specific Riesz diagnostics and clarify which are fixed-weight, target-level, or first-stage-conditional rather than full derivatives of regularized training maps. Monte Carlo stress tests distinguish calibrated benchmark settings from dominance failure, coarse alpha-side benchmarks, benchmark dependence, noisy covariates, and concentrated SDID weights. In the California tobacco-control panel, the SDID estimate is $-15.60$ packs per capita; corrected finite-donor placebo inference gives standard error 9.49 and add-one $p=0.051$. A refit-weight finite-difference audit changes the Route A nullification robustness value from 0.054 to 0.045, leaving the low-single-digit conclusion unchanged. A county-level minimum-wage application applies the same profile to a multi-cohort staggered panel.

title: Inference for Fixed Effects Estimators when Panels are Unbalanced
abstract: We derive the asymptotic properties of two-way fixed effects M-estimators with missing observations in an asymptotic framework in which the numbers of cross-sectional units and time periods grow jointly. We allow the selection process to be deterministic (conditional on the unobserved effects and initial conditions), stochastic, or mixed, and we impose only a conditional mean restriction. The uncorrected estimators are asymptotically normal but not centered at zero, suffering from incidental parameter and feedback biases. Feedback bias can be induced by predetermined regressors in the outcome equation and by a predetermined selection process. We propose debiased estimators that handle both sources without requiring knowledge of which regressors or selection components are predetermined.
tldr: 该论文推导了非平衡面板数据中双向固定效应M估计量的渐近性质，并提出了纠偏估计量以处理偶然参数偏差和反馈偏差。

title: The Projection Solution to the Incidental Parameter Problem
abstract: This paper introduces a new approach to econometric analysis of nonlinear panel data models when the number of observations per observational unit is small. In such models the presence of variables that are constant within, while varying across, units results in an incidental parameter problem. The approach taken in this paper removes these incidental parameters via projection, which produces a correspondence specifying all combinations of observed variables and within-unit-varying unobserved heterogeneity that are achievable by choice of some value of the unit-specific incidental parameters. With unit-specific variables removed, there is no need for assumptions concerning their joint distribution with other variables. The result is an incomplete model which is typically partially identifying. Identified sets are characterized via moment inequalities using tools of random set theory. Examples of application to static and dynamic models with discrete or continuous outcomes using distribution-free restrictions on within-unit-varying unobserved heterogeneity are presented.

title: Robust Welfare Decentralization under Population Entry
abstract: We ask when an incumbent economy with indivisible goods can accommodate an arbitrary new participant while retaining an efficient allocation supported by anonymous item prices. We call this property universal entry robustness. An economy is universally entry-robust if and only if its aggregate welfare valuation is additive. Although the requirement quantifies over all entrant valuations, it can be tested using one canonical entrant whose value for a bundle equals the loss in maximal incumbent welfare caused by removing that bundle. When the characterization holds, one uniquely determined price vector decentralizes the incumbent optimum and every one-agent extension. The proof is direct and uses only demand optimality and welfare comparisons, making transparent why arbitrary-entry robustness eliminates all bundle interactions in aggregate welfare. We finally relate this argument to the robust-integrality interpretation obtained from the linear-programming characterization of Bikhchandani and Mamer (1997). Individual incumbent valuations may be nonadditive and need not satisfy gross substitutes.
tldr: 该论文研究了当经济体中新增参与者时，如何通过匿名价格维持有效配置，并证明当且仅当总福利估值可加时，经济具有普遍进入稳健性。
abstract_cn: 我们探讨了当存在不可分割商品时，现有经济体如何在保持匿名物品价格支撑的有效配置的前提下，容纳任意新参与者。我们将这一性质称为“普适进入稳健性”。一个经济体具有普适进入稳健性当且仅当其总福利估值是可加的。尽管该性质需要对所有进入者的估值进行量化，但可以通过一个典型进入者进行检验，该进入者对某个捆绑商品的估值等于因移除该捆绑商品而导致的现有最大福利损失。当这一刻画成立时，存在唯一确定的价格向量，该价格向量同时分散化了现有最优配置及每一个单参与者扩展。证明过程直接，仅使用了需求最优性和福利比较，从而清晰地揭示了为何任意进入稳健性消除了总福利中所有捆绑商品之间的交互作用。最后，我们将这一论证与Bikhchandani和Mamer（1997）通过线性规划刻画所获得的“稳健整数性”解释联系起来。个体现有参与者的估值可以是非可加的，且无需满足总替代性质。

title: Network games with three types of players
abstract: In this paper, we analyze a multi-strategy network game with three types of players, conformists, rebels, and stubborn agents. Conformists adopt the strategy that is most common among their neighbors, rebels adopt the least common, and stubborn agents adhere to a fixed strategy. We study the existence and structure of pure strategy Nash equilibrium (PNE). On arbitrary networks, we establish sufficient conditions for PNE existence, and we prove that in large random networks PNE almost surely fails to exist. For several specific network architectures, such as complete network, lines, rings, trees, and stars, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for PNE existence and fully characterize the equilibrium strategy frequencies. Collectively, these results offer a unified perspective that PNE is likely to exist when every conformist has more conformist and stubborn neighbors, and fails when the network game has numerous conformist-rebel edges.
tldr: 该论文研究了三类玩家（从众者、反叛者、固执者）在网络博弈中的纯策略纳什均衡存在性，发现均衡存在依赖于网络结构和玩家类型分布。
abstract_cn: 本文分析了一个包含三类参与者——从众者、反叛者与固执者——的多策略网络博弈。从众者采用其邻居中最常见的策略，反叛者采用最不常见的策略，而固执者则坚持固定策略。我们研究了纯策略纳什均衡（PNE）的存在性及其结构。在任意网络中，我们建立了PNE存在的充分条件，并证明在大型随机网络中PNE几乎必然不存在。针对若干特定网络结构，如完全网络、线型网络、环型网络、树型网络与星型网络，我们推导出PNE存在的充要条件，并完整刻画了均衡策略的频率分布。综合来看，这些结果提供了一个统一视角：当每个从众者拥有更多从众者与固执者邻居时，PNE倾向于存在；而当网络博弈中存在大量从众者-反叛者边时，PNE则不存在。

title: From PBS to ePBS: the Microstructure of Block Building
abstract:
Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade introduces enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS), replacing relay-centric PBS with direct builder bids to proposers. We study how this shift changes the block-building microstructure through a general imperfect-information two-stage auction with verifiable messages, where an early bid serves as both a price offer and a signal. PBS and ePBS are modeled as restrictions of the same block-building game: PBS fixes stopping and disclosure exogenously, while ePBS lets the proposer choose stopping and disclosure ex post. Latency heterogeneity is captured by asymmetric information updates: fast builders observe disclosed early information before rebidding, while slow builders do not. We combine exact perfect Bayesian equilibrium characterizations in tractable cases with calibrated no-regret learning in finite games. For PBS, we show that separating equilibria preserve the standard first-price-auction payoff benchmark and provide conditions for their existence. For ePBS, we demonstrate a ratchet effect: because the proposer can defer block proposal and use early bid information in the second stage, builders anticipate ex-post extraction and shade or pool early bids, generating allocation inefficiency and revenue-efficiency valleys.
  We interpret this ratchet distortion as a commitment failure. Under full commitment, the optimal policy collapses to the static Myerson auction and removes the ratchet channel. To realize part of this commitment advantage in a feasible mechanism, we propose a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) sidecar that enforces limited commitment. We formulate the revenue-maximizing TEE mechanism as a bilinear optimization problem. In conservative finite benchmarks, the TEE design increases the proposer revenue relative to the first-price benchmark by approximately \(25\%\).
tldr: 该论文研究以太坊升级中从PBS到ePBS的转变如何改变区块构建的微观结构，发现ePBS存在棘轮效应导致分配无效率和收入效率低谷，并提出TEE侧车机制来改善收入。
abstract_cn: 以太坊的Glamsterdam升级引入了内置的提议者-构建者分离（ePBS），用构建者直接向提议者投标的方式取代了以中继为中心的PBS。我们研究了这一转变如何通过一个具有可验证消息的一般不完全信息两阶段拍卖来改变区块构建的微观结构，其中早期投标既作为价格报价又作为信号。PBS和ePBS被建模为同一区块构建博弈的约束：PBS外生地固定了停止和披露时机，而ePBS则允许提议者事后选择停止和披露时机。延迟异质性通过非对称信息更新来捕捉：快速构建者在重新投标前观察到已披露的早期信息，而慢速构建者则无法观察到。我们将可处理情形下的精确完美贝叶斯均衡刻画与有限博弈中的校准无遗憾学习相结合。对于PBS，我们证明了分离均衡保留了标准第一价格拍卖的收益基准，并给出了其存在条件。对于ePBS，我们展示了一种棘轮效应：由于提议者可以推迟区块提议并在第二阶段使用早期投标信息，构建者预期到事后提取行为，从而压低或混同早期投标，导致配置无效率和收益-效率低谷。我们将这种棘轮扭曲解释为承诺失败。在完全承诺下，最优策略退化为静态的迈尔森拍卖，并消除了棘轮渠道。为了在可行的机制中实现部分承诺优势，我们提出了一种可信执行环境（TEE）侧车，用于执行有限承诺。我们将收益最大化的TEE机制建模为一个双线性优化问题。在保守的有限基准测试中，TEE设计使提议者收益相对于第一价格基准提高了约25%。

title: Diffusion of tacit knowledge in a company: a mathematical model based on diffusion on graphs
abstract: This article is devoted to the process of diffusing tacit knowledge. This intangible asset has proven crucial for achieving a competitive advantage among market-oriented companies. A novel model of tacit knowledge diffusion is presented, employing the concept of heat diffusion from physics. Furthermore, graph theory and the dynamics it defines are utilized. We defined a Tacit Knowledge Transfer Graph that encodes data from questionnaires. It enables us to identify employees' learning needs, allowing for the planning of classes within the same period, such as a day, to schedule them optimally. Moreover, the model can be used to identify employees with high knowledge demands. The application is not limited to companies; a simple example of planning classes in a school/university is provided. The presented model can help with optimal scheduling, enhance operational efficiency, and improve talent management within the company. It can also identify risks associated with critical sources of knowledge and help improve organizational culture and knowledge management policy.

abstract_cn: 本文致力于探讨隐性知识的扩散过程。这一无形资产已被证明对于以市场为导向的企业获取竞争优势至关重要。本文提出了一种新颖的隐性知识扩散模型，该模型借鉴了物理学中的热扩散概念，并进一步运用了图论及其所定义的动力学。我们定义了一个隐性知识转移图（Tacit Knowledge Transfer Graph），该图对问卷数据进行编码，使我们能够识别员工的学习需求，从而在同一时间段（例如一天内）规划课程，以实现最优排课。此外，该模型还可用于识别知识需求较高的员工。其应用并不局限于企业，本文还提供了一个在学校/大学中规划课程的简单示例。该模型有助于实现最优排程、提升运营效率，并改善企业内部的人才管理。同时，它还能识别与关键知识源相关的风险，并有助于改进组织文化与知识管理政策。

title: Efficient Online Proportional Sampling with Applications to Smoothed Online Learning
abstract: We study the problem of efficient online proportional sampling from a high-dimensional domain under a $σ$-smoothed adversary, where the sampling distribution is induced by a dynamically evolving weight function defined over a sequence of piecewise-structured partitions. This setting captures a broad range of applications, including principal-agent games (e.g., pricing and contract design), and algorithm configuration and parameter tuning. The central challenge is maintaining an efficient data structure as the induced partition grows increasingly complex over time -- naively, the number of subregions can grow as $O(t^d)$ by round $t$ in $d$ dimensions. We design a data structure that supports efficient updates and proportional sampling while avoiding the cost of explicitly maintaining this exponential growth, where the discontinuities are structured from axis-parallel hyperplanes. Under a $σ$-smoothed adaptive adversary, we prove a tight $O(\sqrt{σT})$ bound on the depth of our data structure, and an $O(\log T)$ bound under a random-order adversary -- to our knowledge, the first such results for this class of problems. We apply this framework to online learning with piecewise-structured rewards, obtaining efficient no-regret algorithms under both full-information and bandit feedback, with provable sublinear regret guarantees.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种高效的数据结构，用于在平滑对手下进行在线比例采样，避免了显式维护指数增长的分区，并应用于在线学习获得次线性遗憾界。
abstract_cn: 我们研究在σ-平滑对抗者（σ-smoothed adversary）条件下，从高维域中进行高效在线比例采样的问题，其中采样分布由定义在一系列分段结构划分（piecewise-structured partitions）上的动态演化权重函数所诱导。该设定涵盖广泛的应用场景，包括委托-代理博弈（principal-agent games，如定价与合约设计）以及算法配置与参数调优。核心挑战在于，随着诱导划分随时间日益复杂，需要维护一个高效的数据结构——在d维空间中，到第t轮时，子区域数量可能朴素地增长至O(t^d)。我们设计了一种数据结构，能够支持高效的更新与比例采样，同时避免显式维护这种指数增长的开销，其中不连续点由轴平行超平面（axis-parallel hyperplanes）结构化构成。在σ-平滑自适应对抗者条件下，我们证明了该数据结构深度的紧界为O(√σT)，而在随机顺序对抗者（random-order adversary）条件下，深度界为O(log T)——据我们所知，这是针对此类问题的首批结果。我们将该框架应用于分段结构奖励（piecewise-structured rewards）的在线学习，在完全信息反馈（full-information）与赌博机反馈（bandit feedback）两种设置下均获得了高效的无遗憾算法，并具有可证明的次线性遗憾界（sublinear regret guarantees）。

title: Top Trading Cycles in Large Markets: The Asymptotic Irrelevance of Priorities
abstract: Top Trading Cycles (TTC) is Pareto efficient and strategy-proof and explicitly uses agents' priorities. Although TTC favors higher-priority agents in each round, we show that this priority advantage vanishes as the market grows large under a canonical random model of preferences and priorities. In the limit, TTC produces assignments with virtually the same incidence of justified envy as Random Serial Dictatorship (RSD) -- a mechanism entirely blind to priorities. This stark asymptotic equivalence implies that TTC effectively fails to satisfy standard fairness criteria in large markets, casting significant doubt on its practical appeal for balancing efficiency and fairness.
tldr: 该论文证明在大型市场中，Top Trading Cycles机制在公平性方面与完全忽略优先级的Random Serial Dictatorship渐近等价，质疑了TTC在平衡效率与公平方面的实际价值。
abstract_cn: 顶层交易循环（Top Trading Cycles, TTC）机制具有帕累托效率与策略防护性，并明确运用了参与者的优先级。尽管TTC在每轮交易中优先考虑高优先级参与者，但本研究表明，在偏好与优先级的经典随机模型下，随着市场规模扩大，这种优先级优势将逐渐消失。在极限情况下，TTC机制产生的分配结果与完全忽视优先级的随机独裁机制（Random Serial Dictatorship, RSD）在合理嫉妒发生率上几乎无异。这种显著的渐近等价性意味着，TTC机制在大规模市场中实际上无法满足标准的公平性准则，这对其在平衡效率与公平方面的实际应用价值提出了重大质疑。

title: Doctor-Optimal Stability in Unitary Many-to-Many Markets
abstract: We study bilaterally unitary many-to-many doctor--hospital matching with contracts, taking choice functions as primitives. Doctor choices are substitutable and satisfy irrelevance of rejected contracts, while hospital choices are unilaterally substitutable and satisfy the same condition. Every trajectory of the doctor-proposing cumulative offer process terminates at the greatest stable allocation under the doctor Blair order. We also introduce weakly hospital-quasi-stable allocations and show that they form a finite lattice whose greatest element is stable. Hence, the cumulative-offer outcome, the greatest weakly hospital-quasi-stable allocation, and the doctor-optimal stable allocation coincide. The common allocation is hospital-pessimal in the revealed-choice sense. Under the law of aggregate demand, every agent signs the same number of contracts at all stable allocations.
tldr: 该论文在双边多对多匹配市场中，证明了医生提议累积报价过程的轨迹终止于医生布莱尔序下的最大稳定分配，并引入了弱医院准稳定分配的概念，证明了其与医生最优稳定分配的一致性。
abstract_cn: 我们研究带有合同的双边统一多对多医生-医院匹配问题，以选择函数作为基本要素。医生选择具有可替代性并满足拒绝合同无关性，而医院选择具有单边可替代性并满足相同条件。医生提议的累积报价过程的每条轨迹均终止于布莱尔序下最大的稳定配置。我们还引入了弱医院拟稳定配置，并证明它们构成一个有限格，其最大元是稳定的。因此，累积报价结果、最大弱医院拟稳定配置与医生最优稳定配置三者一致。该共同配置在显示偏好意义上是医院最劣的。在总需求定律下，所有稳定配置中每个代理人签署的合同数量相同。

title: Information Comparison of Order Statistics, with Applications to Auctions and Voting
abstract: We compare the informativeness of order statistics in a sample of conditionally independent draws from a distribution \(F(x\midθ)\) as the sample size n increases. The k-th highest of n+1 draws is more accurate than the k-th highest of n if and only if the cumulative reverse hazard -\log F(x\midθ) is log-supermodular. Symmetrically, the k-th lowest is more accurate if and only if the cumulative hazard -\log(1-F(x\midθ)) is log-supermodular. Reversals are exceptional, occurring only for experiments that are, up to increasing transformations, exponential location experiments. In large samples, middle order statistics are asymptotically fully informative, while bounded lower and upper ranks require unbounded informativeness tail conditions. When full learning fails, bounded ranks converge to location experiments, and more central ranks are Blackwell more informative. Extending the analysis from scalar order statistics to blocks of selected data, we obtain multidimensional comparisons under log-supermodularity of hazard rates. The results unify and extend information-aggregation results in auctions and provide a new order-statistic approach to strategic voting.
tldr: 该论文比较了条件独立样本中顺序统计量的信息量，发现其准确性取决于累积逆风险或累积风险的log-超模性，并将结果应用于拍卖和投票中的信息聚合。
abstract_cn: 我们比较了来自分布 \(F(x\midθ)\) 的条件独立样本中次序统计量（order statistics）的信息量随样本量 \(n\) 增加的变化情况。当且仅当累积逆风险函数（cumulative reverse hazard）\(-\log F(x\midθ)\) 为对数超模（log-supermodular）时，\(n+1\) 次抽取中的第 \(k\) 大值比 \(n\) 次抽取中的第 \(k\) 大值更精确。对称地，当且仅当累积风险函数（cumulative hazard）\(-\log(1-F(x\midθ))\) 为对数超模时，第 \(k\) 小值更精确。反转情况极为罕见，仅出现在那些经过递增变换后成为指数位置实验（exponential location experiments）的实验中。在大样本中，中间次序统计量渐近地具有完全信息性，而有限的下层和上层秩次则需要无界的信息性尾部条件。当完全学习失败时，有界秩次收敛于位置实验，且更中心的秩次在Blackwell意义上更具信息性。将分析从标量次序统计量扩展到选定数据块，我们得到了在风险率（hazard rates）对数超模条件下的多维比较。这些结果统一并扩展了拍卖中的信息聚合结果，并为策略性投票提供了一种新的次序统计量方法。

title: Whom Should a Platform Amplify? Truth, Engagement, and Networked Polarization
abstract: Social-media platforms allocate reach, deciding whose content becomes widely visible. We study this as feed/reference design in a networked coordination game where users track an unknown state, coordinate with others, and hold biased ideal actions. Amplification changes both who receives information and who becomes a salient coordination reference. Making a private signal commonly observed adds a second common signal and removes the usual non-monotonicity of truth-tracking accuracy in public-signal precision; under a broadcast budget, accuracy depends only on total amplified precision. For any finite network and biases, a network intervention's effect on accuracy splits exactly into an information gain and a quadratic bias cost governed by a Katz--Bonacich influence-overlap matrix, yielding an exact source-ranking rule and a closed-form amplification threshold. A reduced-form engagement objective instead favors validating, same-type links, producing more segregated networks and lower accuracy. Amplification's value depends jointly on information, bias propagation, and the platform's objective.
tldr: 该论文研究社交媒体平台如何通过放大某些用户的内容来影响信息传播、协调和极化，发现放大策略的效果取决于平台目标（真相或参与度），且真相目标下准确度仅取决于总放大精度，而参与度目标导致更隔离的网络和更低准确度。
abstract_cn: 社交媒体平台分配内容触达范围，决定哪些用户的内容能被广泛可见。我们将其视为一个网络协调博弈中的推送/参照设计问题：在该博弈中，用户追踪未知状态、与他人协调行动，并持有偏颇的理想行动。放大机制既改变了谁接收信息，也改变了谁成为显著的协调参照。将私人信号变为共同可观测，会引入第二个共同信号，并消除公共信号精度在真实追踪准确性中通常存在的非单调性；在广播预算约束下，准确性仅取决于总放大精度。对于任意有限网络和偏颇立场，网络干预对准确性的影响可精确分解为信息增益和由Katz-Bonacich影响重叠矩阵决定的二次偏颇成本，从而得出精确的来源排序规则和闭式放大阈值。而简化的参与度目标则倾向于验证同类型连接，导致网络更加隔离、准确性更低。放大的价值取决于信息、偏颇传播以及平台目标的共同作用。

title: Bifurcation mechanism at a sustain point of a long narrow economy
abstract: We investigate population agglomeration in a long narrow economy, in which an odd number of places are evenly distributed over a line segment. The bifurcation analysis of this economy elucidates the mechanism of the emergence of twin cities around the central city. The validity and usefulness of this analysis are confirmed using several well-known economic geography models that display various kinds of bifurcation behaviors. By this analysis, we investigate the historical change in the population distribution in a chain of cities on Japan's Main Island.
tldr: 该论文通过分岔分析研究长窄经济体中人口集聚的机制，揭示了中心城市周围双城出现的规律，并利用日本本岛城市链的历史数据验证了模型。
abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个狭长经济体中的人口集聚现象，在该经济体中，奇数个地点均匀分布在线段上。对该经济体的分岔分析阐明了中心城市周围双城（twin cities）涌现的机制。通过使用若干展现不同类型分岔行为的知名经济地理学模型，验证了该分析的有效性与实用性。借助这一分析，我们探讨了日本本州岛城市链中人口分布的历史变迁。

title: Scoring Rules as Least-Squares Estimators
abstract: Kawada (2018) proved that every scoring rule is equivalent to the corresponding cosine similarity rule. The original proof relies on a direct analysis of the cosine similarity optimization problem. In this note, we present an alternative, simpler proof based on a basic least-squares characterization. Our argument shows that the arithmetic mean of the score vectors is the unique minimizer of the total squared Euclidean distance and that the cosine similarity formulation is an immediate consequence of this optimization property. This result provides a transparent geometric interpretation of scoring rules and clarifies why the cosine similarity rule necessarily coincides with the corresponding scoring rule.
tldr: 该论文证明了评分规则等价于余弦相似度规则，并提供了一个基于最小二乘估计的简化证明。
abstract_cn: Kawada (2018) 证明了每个评分规则都等价于相应的余弦相似度规则。原始证明依赖于对余弦相似度优化问题的直接分析。在本注释中，我们提出了一种基于基本最小二乘特征的替代性更简洁的证明。我们的论证表明，得分向量的算术平均值是总欧氏距离平方的唯一最小化元，而余弦相似度公式正是这一优化性质的直接推论。该结果为评分规则提供了清晰的几何解释，并阐明了为何余弦相似度规则必然与相应的评分规则相一致。

title: Fair Division with Binary Valuations: Characterizations
abstract: We consider the fair allocation of indivisible goods with binary valuations. In this setting, the maximum Nash welfare rule, the leximin rule, and all additive welfarist rules with a strictly concave function coincide. We show that for any number of agents, this rule is the only rule that satisfies envy-freeness up to one good, strategyproofness, neutrality, minimal completeness, and invariance under disapproving unassigned goods (IDU). Moreover, we present an alternative characterization for two agents, where we replace IDU with non-redundancy and resource-monotonicity. In both characterizations, all axioms are necessary.
tldr: 该论文研究了在二元估值下公平分配不可分割物品的公理特征，证明了最大纳什福利规则、leximin规则和所有严格凹的加性福利主义规则等价，并给出了该规则的唯一性刻画。
abstract_cn: 我们考虑具有二元估值的不可分割物品的公平分配问题。在该设定下，最大纳什福利准则（maximum Nash welfare rule）、词典序最小准则（leximin rule）以及所有具有严格凹函数的加总福利主义准则（additive welfarist rules）均相互一致。我们证明，对于任意数量的智能体，该准则是唯一满足以下性质的规则：至多一个物品的嫉妒无嫉妒性（envy-freeness up to one good）、策略证明性（strategyproofness）、中立性（neutrality）、最小完备性（minimal completeness）以及对未分配物品不认可的不变性（invariance under disapproving unassigned goods, IDU）。此外，我们针对两个智能体的情形提出了另一种刻画，其中用非冗余性（non-redundancy）与资源单调性（resource-monotonicity）替代了IDU。在这两种刻画中，所有公理都是必要的。

title: Diachronic Sample Integration: Robust Tail-Risk Estimation with Generative Models
abstract: Deep generative models are increasingly used as simulators for downstream decision-making under data scarcity, but in risk-sensitive applications their usefulness depends on rare adverse scenarios rather than typical samples. Standard generative objectives prioritize bulk distributional fidelity, leaving low-probability tails vulnerable to localized optimization noise and making tail-dependent functionals unstable under finite simulation budgets. We introduce Diachronic Sample Integration (DSI), a test-time inference framework that ensembles generated samples across checkpoints from a stochastic training trajectory. DSI targets a checkpoint-mixture distribution that averages checkpoint-specific tail fluctuations rather than relying on a single brittle endpoint. We formalize this mechanism through a finite-budget bias-variance theory. Empirically, across multivariate synthetic processes and high-frequency trading data, DSI substantially reduces tail-estimation error compared to single-checkpoint baselines under fixed simulation budgets, outperforming standard diffusion and state-of-the-art tail-aware baselines without modifying the generative objective.
tldr: 该论文提出Diachronic Sample Integration方法，通过集成训练轨迹中多个检查点的生成样本来改进尾部风险估计，显著降低估计误差。
abstract_cn: 深度生成模型越来越多地被用作数据稀缺条件下下游决策的模拟器，但在风险敏感应用中，其效用取决于罕见的不利场景而非典型样本。标准的生成目标优先考虑整体分布保真度，导致低概率尾部易受局部优化噪声影响，并使得依赖于尾部的泛函在有限模拟预算下变得不稳定。我们提出历时样本集成（Diachronic Sample Integration, DSI），这是一种测试时推理框架，通过从随机训练轨迹中的多个检查点集成生成样本。DSI针对一种检查点混合分布，该分布平均了各检查点特有的尾部波动，而非依赖单一脆弱的端点。我们通过有限预算的偏差-方差理论对该机制进行了形式化。在多元合成过程和高频交易数据的实证中，与固定模拟预算下的单检查点基线相比，DSI显著降低了尾部估计误差，在不修改生成目标的情况下，优于标准扩散模型及最先进的尾部感知基线。

title: An Extreme Value Perspective on Learning Stress Laws
abstract: We introduce Self-Similar Generative Estimation (SS-GEN), a method for simulating multivariate tail events and estimating rare-event probabilities in both heavy and light-tailed settings. SS-GEN exploits asymptotic tail structure to decompose the tail distribution into an explicit radial component and a nonparametric angular component, reducing tail learning to a compact-domain problem that can be handled by off-the-shelf deep generative models. The resulting sampler generates representative extreme scenarios and supports probability estimation far beyond the observed data. Under mild nonparametric tail assumptions, we show that the SS-GEN density is asymptotically exact in the tail, with vanishing uniform relative error for regularly varying distributions and vanishing uniform log-relative error for Weibull-type distributions. Unlike existing approaches that rely on specialized architectures or parametric tail specifications, SS-GEN leverages asymptotic tail structure to enable standard generative models to generate representative extreme samples and estimate rare-event probabilities beyond the observed data.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种自相似生成估计方法（SS-GEN），利用渐近尾部结构分解尾部分布，结合深度生成模型高效模拟极端事件并估计罕见事件概率。
abstract_cn: 我们提出了自相似生成估计（Self-Similar Generative Estimation, SS-GEN），一种用于模拟多元尾部事件并在重尾和轻尾场景下估计罕见事件概率的方法。SS-GEN利用渐近尾部结构，将尾部分布分解为显式的径向分量和非参数的角度分量，从而将尾部学习简化为一个紧凑域问题，可通过现成的深度生成模型处理。由此得到的采样器能够生成具有代表性的极端场景，并支持远超观测数据的概率估计。在温和的非参数尾部假设下，我们证明SS-GEN的密度在尾部是渐近精确的：对于正则变化分布，其均匀相对误差趋于零；对于韦布尔型分布，其均匀对数相对误差趋于零。与现有依赖专门架构或参数化尾部规范的方法不同，SS-GEN利用渐近尾部结构，使标准生成模型能够生成具有代表性的极端样本，并估计超出观测数据的罕见事件概率。

title: Arbitrage-Free Multi-Maturity Risk-Neutral Marginals
abstract: Many quantitative finance methods and applications are formulated in terms of option-implied risk-neutral marginals rather than directly in terms of option prices. Representative examples include martingale optimal transport, Bass local-volatility calibration, scenario analysis, and option-implied tail-risk measurement. The desired risk-neutral marginals should define a genuine probability law on the entire support, reproduce the input arbitrage-free option prices exactly, be free of butterfly and calendar arbitrage, and admit efficient evaluation of the density, distribution function, and quantiles, as well as Monte Carlo sampling. Existing methods typically optimize only a subset of these properties, depending on their intended purpose. This leaves a gap between upstream arbitrage-free option prices and the readily usable risk-neutral marginals required by downstream applications. We propose an explicit construction of risk-neutral marginals from discrete arbitrage-free option prices. On the observed strike range, probability mass is assigned interval by interval to exactly reproduce the input option prices. Outside the observed range, closed-form power-law tails complete the distribution by satisfying price and slope boundary conditions and allocating the remaining probability mass. Butterfly- and calendar-arbitrage-freeness are guaranteed by construction. The construction is feasible by design and computationally efficient. The resulting marginal laws admit closed-form densities, distribution functions, quantiles, and efficient Monte Carlo sampling. Numerical experiments on synthetic SSVI data and S\&P~500 market data demonstrate that the proposed construction efficiently and robustly produces marginals satisfying all of these properties in practice.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种从无套利期权价格显式构建风险中性边际分布的方法，确保无蝶式套利和日历套利，并具有闭式密度、分布函数和高效蒙特卡洛采样。
abstract_cn: 许多量化金融方法与应用是基于期权隐含的风险中性边际分布（option-implied risk-neutral marginals）而非直接基于期权价格进行表述的。代表性例子包括鞅最优传输（martingale optimal transport）、Bass局部波动率校准（Bass local-volatility calibration）、情景分析（scenario analysis）以及期权隐含尾部风险度量（option-implied tail-risk measurement）。理想的风险中性边际分布应在整个支撑集上定义真实的概率法则，精确复现输入的无套利期权价格，消除蝶式套利（butterfly arbitrage）与日历套利（calendar arbitrage），并支持密度函数、分布函数、分位数的高效计算以及蒙特卡洛抽样（Monte Carlo sampling）。现有方法通常仅针对其预期用途优化上述部分性质，导致上游无套利期权价格与下游应用所需可直接使用的风险中性边际分布之间存在缺口。本文提出一种基于离散无套利期权价格显式构建风险中性边际分布的方法。在观测到的行权价区间内，概率质量按区间逐一分配以精确复现输入的期权价格；在观测区间外，闭式幂律尾部（power-law tails）通过满足价格与斜率边界条件并分配剩余概率质量来完成分布。蝶式套利与日历套利的无套利性由构造过程保证。该构造方法具有设计上的可行性且计算高效。所得边际分布具有闭式密度函数、分布函数、分位数，并支持高效蒙特卡洛抽样。基于合成SSVI数据与标普500市场数据的数值实验表明，所提出的构造方法能够高效且稳健地生成实际中满足上述所有性质的边际分布。

title: MORTGAGE LENDING AS A TOOL FOR REGULATING THE RESIDENTIAL REAL ESTATE MARKET
abstract: The article examines mortgage lending as a tool for regulating the real estate market under conditions of macroeconomic instability, using the Krasnodar Territory as a case study. Special attention is paid to the period 2020–2025, characterized by economic shocks, shifts in monetary policy, and active government intervention in the mortgage market. Based on statistical data, the study analyzes the dynamics of mortgage lending volumes in the region, its share in the national structure, as well as the relationship between mortgage market development and price trends in the primary and secondary housing markets. It is substantiated that mortgage lending during the period under review played a dual role: on the one hand, it supported effective demand and stimulated construction activity; on the other, it contributed to accelerated price growth and the accumulation of structural risks. Regional features that amplify the impact of mortgages on the real estate market of the Krasnodar Territory are identified. The authors conclude that a transition to a more balanced regulatory model is necessary – one that takes into account both national trends and local supply and demand conditions.

abstract_cn: 本文以克拉斯诺达尔边疆区为例，探讨了在宏观经济不稳定条件下，抵押贷款作为房地产市场调控工具的作用。研究特别关注2020–2025年这一时期，其特点是经济冲击、货币政策调整以及政府对抵押贷款市场的积极干预。基于统计数据，本研究分析了该地区抵押贷款发放量的动态变化、其在国家结构中的占比，以及抵押贷款市场发展与一级和二级住房市场价格趋势之间的关系。研究证实，在所考察的时期内，抵押贷款发挥了双重作用：一方面，它支撑了有效需求并刺激了建筑活动；另一方面，它也推动了价格加速上涨并导致结构性风险的积累。研究还识别出放大抵押贷款对克拉斯诺达尔边疆区房地产市场影响的区域特征。作者得出结论，有必要转向一种更为平衡的监管模式——该模式需同时考虑全国性趋势与地方供需条件。

abstract: الهدف الرئيسي لهذه الورقة هو استقصاء تأثير أدوات السياسة النقدية التقليدية على الاستثمار الخاص في العراق للفترة (2005-2023) باستخدام نموذج الانحدار الذاتي ذو الفجوات الزمنية الموزعة (ARDL Model). وكانت النتائج تشير الى وجود علاقة توازنية طويلة المدى بين الاستثمار الخاص ومتغيرات السياسة النقدية في العراق. وعند تقدير المعلمات كان متغير المعروض النقدي بالمعنى الواسع M2 هو المتغير النقدي الوحيد الذي الذي يمتلك تأثيراً فاعلاً على الاستثمار بالأجل الطويل، أما في الأجل القصير فكانت المتغيرات النقدية الفاعلة في التأثير على الاستثمار الخاص هي كل من المعروض النقدي بالمعنى الواسع والاحتياطي النقدي القانوني ومعدل الفائدة (سعر السياسة)، إلا أن باقي المتغيرات النقدية الأخرى الداخلة في النموذج لم يكن لها أي تأثير معنوي على الاستثمار الخاص في العراق سواء بالأجل الطويل أو بالأجل القصير. واوصى الباحث بتحسين وتطوير إدارة ادوات السياسة النقدية لتفعيل دورها في تنشيط الاستثمار الخاص في العراق والارتقاء بمستوى السياسة النقدية في ادارة الجهاز المصرفي العراقي، فضلاً عن اعطاءه دوراً في تعاملاته الدولية والاقليمية في زيادة كفاءته في تشجيع الاستثمار.

abstract_cn: 本文的主要目的是利用自回归分布滞后模型（ARDL Model），考察2005-2023年期间传统货币政策工具对伊拉克私人投资的影响。结果表明，伊拉克私人投资与货币政策变量之间存在长期均衡关系。在参数估计中，广义货币供应量M2是唯一在长期内对投资产生显著影响的货币变量；而在短期内，对私人投资产生显著影响的货币变量包括广义货币供应量、法定准备金率和利率（政策利率）。然而，模型中包含的其他货币变量无论长期还是短期，均未对伊拉克私人投资产生显著影响。研究者建议改进并优化货币政策工具的管理，以增强其在激活伊拉克私人投资中的作用，并提升伊拉克银行体系管理层面的货币政策水平，同时赋予其在国际和区域业务中发挥更大作用，以提高其促进投资效率的能力。

title: Does UPI Adoption Reduce Demand for Physical Currency in India? An Asymmetric Analysis Using NARDL
abstract: India’s Unified Payments Interface (UPI) has become one of the largest real-time payment systems in the world, yet currency with the public (CwP), defined as physical notes and coins held outside the banking system, has risen persistently alongside it. This article examines whether UPI transaction growth exerts an asymmetric effect on CwP using monthly data from August 2016 to March 2026 (116 observations) and the nonlinear autoregressive distributed lag (NARDL) model. The analysis is grounded in the transaction cost theory of payment instrument choice following Whitesell (1989), extended by the dynamic cash inventory model of Alvarez and Lippi (2009), which predicts that contractions in digital payment availability trigger precautionary currency accumulation disproportionately larger than the marginal reduction during normal expansion. The Consumer Price Index and the RBI policy repo rate are included as controls, and additive dummies address structural breaks from demonetization (November 2016) and COVID-19 (March 2020). The bounds test confirms cointegration ( F = 7.507), and the Wald test confirms significant long-run asymmetry ( F = 11.629, p = .001). Positive UPI shocks are associated with rising CwP in the long run, consistent with payment instrument complementarity rather than substitution, whereas negative shocks have a larger opposing effect, reflecting the precautionary motive. The error-correction coefficient of –0.374 indicates an approximately 37% monthly adjustment towards equilibrium. The findings have direct implications for the Reserve Bank of India’s monetary policy framework and India’s physical currency management agenda. JEL Classification: E41, E52, O33, G21, E47

abstract_cn: 印度统一支付接口（UPI）已成为全球最大的实时支付系统之一，然而，流通中货币（CwP），即银行体系外持有的实物纸币与硬币，却与之同步持续增长。本文利用2016年8月至2026年3月的月度数据（共116个观测值），采用非线性自回归分布滞后（NARDL）模型，考察UPI交易增长是否对CwP产生非对称效应。该分析基于Whitesell（1989）提出的支付工具选择交易成本理论，并拓展了Alvarez和Lippi（2009）的动态现金库存模型，该模型预测，数字支付可用性的收缩所引发的预防性货币积累，其幅度将不成比例地大于正常扩张期间的边际减少。消费者价格指数（CPI）与印度储备银行政策回购利率作为控制变量纳入模型，同时引入加法虚拟变量以处理废钞令（2016年11月）与新冠疫情（2020年3月）带来的结构性断点。边界检验确认了协整关系（F=7.507），Wald检验则证实了显著的长期非对称性（F=11.629，p=0.001）。长期来看，UPI的正向冲击与CwP的上升相关联，这与支付工具互补性而非替代性一致；而负向冲击则具有更大的反向效应，反映了预防性动机。误差修正系数为-0.374，表明每月向均衡状态调整约37%。该研究结果对印度储备银行的货币政策框架及印度的实物现金管理议程具有直接启示意义。JEL分类号：E41, E52, O33, G21, E47

title: Measurement failure and farm gate income loss in Tanzania: A practitioner based study of legal metrology enforcement
abstract: Measurement inaccuracies in informal and semi formal markets pose a persistent but poorly documented threat to consumer welfare across Sub Saharan Africa. Although legal metrology frameworks exist in many countries in the region, enforcement capacity remains uneven, and the economic impact of measurement failure on vulnerable market participants has rarely been systematically assessed. This paper examines how measurement inaccuracies affect consumer welfare in Tanzanian retail and agricultural commodity markets, and evaluates the regulatory mechanisms through which the Weights and Measures Agency (WMA) of Tanzania seeks to mitigate measurement related trade disputes. Using a convergent mixed methods design, the study integrates fifteen years of practitioner generated field inspection data from urban retail markets, fuel dispensing points, and agricultural buying centres in the Lake Zone (Kagera Region) with structured observation of trader and buyer behaviour and documentary analysis of WMA enforcement records, OIML technical standards, and East African Community (EAC) regulatory instruments. The evidence identifies four principal pathways through which measurement failure harms market participants: scale drift and deliberate tampering in retail settings, non standard volumetric measures in rural commodity trade, underdispensing at fuel points through electronic manipulation and foam inflation, and digital transaction discrepancies in mobile money and prepackaged goods systems. Smallholder farmers selling cotton and maize at Lake Zone buying centres emerge as among the most exposed groups, with compounded errors in weighing, tare deduction, and moisture assessment estimated to reduce effective farm gate income by 3 to 8 percent per transaction cycle. The findings indicate that effective consumer protection through measurement governance requires stronger field inspection capacity, harmonised metrological standards at the EAC and SADC level, and formal integration of legal metrology into agricultural value chain oversight, offering practical lessons for national metrology authorities across Sub Saharan Africa.

abstract_cn: 在非正规与半正规市场中，测量不准确对撒哈拉以南非洲地区的消费者福利构成了持续但鲜有记录的威胁。尽管该地区许多国家已建立法定计量学框架，但执法能力仍参差不齐，且测量失误对弱势市场参与者的经济影响很少得到系统评估。本文研究了测量不准确如何影响坦桑尼亚零售及农产品市场中的消费者福利，并评估了坦桑尼亚度量衡局（Weights and Measures Agency, WMA）旨在缓解测量相关贸易纠纷的监管机制。采用收敛混合方法设计，本研究将来自城市零售市场、燃油加注点及湖区（卡盖拉地区）农产品采购中心长达十五年的从业者现场检查数据，与对交易者及购买者行为的结构化观察、WMA执法记录、国际法制计量组织（OIML）技术标准以及东非共同体（East African Community, EAC）监管文件的文献分析相结合。证据识别出测量失误损害市场参与者的四条主要路径：零售环境中的秤漂移与蓄意篡改、农村商品贸易中的非标准体积计量、通过电子操控与泡沫充注导致的燃油加注点短量，以及移动支付与预包装商品系统中的数字交易差异。在湖区采购中心出售棉花和玉米的小农户成为受影响最严重的群体之一，称重、皮重扣除及水分评估中的复合误差估计使每笔交易周期的有效农场门口收入减少3%至8%。研究结果表明，通过测量治理实现有效的消费者保护需要加强现场检查能力、协调EAC与南共体（SADC）层面的计量标准，并将法定计量学正式纳入农业价值链监管，这为撒哈拉以南非洲各国的国家计量机构提供了实践启示。

title: Conformal Dissipation Dynamics in the Inflationary Epoch: A First-Principles Approach to Extreme Geometric Friction and Gauge Field Phase Transitions
abstract: This paper extends the concept of the Conformal Maintenance Power (Pconf=32ℏH2Pconf=23ℏH2), derived from the unification of general relativity and quantum thermodynamics, to the extreme environment of the inflationary epoch in the early universe. Building upon the foundational theoretical framework established in our previous works—(1) "Energy Dissipation and Scale Maintenance of Micro-Bound Systems in Expanding Spacetime: An Extended Maxwellian Approach" \cite{kurokawa2026a}, which introduced the fundamental concept of continuous energy dissipation required for microscopic bound systems to maintain their static scales against the Hubble flow; (2) "Three Paths to the Universal Dissipation Limit of Microscopic Bound Systems in Expanding Spacetime" \cite{kurokawa2026b}, which established the universal thermodynamic bounds on dissipation rates for quantum systems in cosmic expansion; (3) "The Thermodynamic Origin of Gravity: Conformal Maintenance of Quantum Bound Systems in Expanding Spacetime" \cite{kurokawa2026c}, which demonstrated the deep connection between conformal maintenance and the emergence of gravitational effects; and (4) "Geometric Energy Injection via Conformal Maintenance Current in Gravitational Collapse: A Novel Approach to the Core-Collapse Supernova Shock Revival Problem" \cite{kurokawa2026d}, which applied the conformal maintenance formalism to extreme astrophysical environments—this study formulates from first principles the thermodynamic dissipation dynamics that the geometric deformation of spacetime imposes on local gauge fields. During the inflationary epoch, when the Hubble parameter HH assumes enormous positive values (Hinf∼1014Hinf∼1014 GeV), geometric expansion functions as an ``intense friction'' (energy dissipation into the vacuum) for local systems. This study mathematically proves that by considering the thermodynamic constraint of a system attempting to maintain its conformal scale, extreme Hubble expansion functions as an active environment imposing runaway geometric friction on local systems. The paper demonstrates how, under this extreme geometric friction, the conformal invariance of gauge fields is inevitably broken and how phase transition dynamics are transformed. The theoretical framework presents unified and natural solutions, without adding any ad hoc assumptions, to multiple critical problems faced by modern cosmology: (1) The first-principles generation of primordial magnetic fields through the Conformal Maintenance Current JconfJconf that inevitably breaks conformal invariance and freezes magnetic fields in space via geometric overdamping; (2) The suppression of topological defects (monopoles, cosmic strings) through a geometric quench effect'' that dramatically delays phase transitions and suppresses defect generation rates; and (3) The first-principles explanation of reheating and entropy generation through cosmological Joule heating, where the geometric frictional heat resulting from matter's struggle to maintain its scale in expanding spacetime serves as the fundamental heat source for the hot Big Bang. The paper concludes that inflation was an extremecosmological heat engine'' and discusses future observational prospects for detecting geometric dissipation signatures in the cosmic microwave background B-mode polarization and primordial gravitational wave spectra.

tldr: 该论文从第一性原理出发，研究暴胀时期时空几何变形对规范场的热力学耗散动力学，提出共形维持电流导致原始磁场产生、拓扑缺陷抑制和再加热机制。
abstract_cn: 本文将共形维持功率（\(P_{\text{conf}} = \frac{3}{2}\hbar H^2\)）的概念——该概念源自广义相对论与量子热力学的统一——拓展至早期宇宙暴胀时期的极端环境。基于我们前期工作所建立的基础理论框架：（1）《膨胀时空中的微束缚系统能量耗散与尺度维持：一种扩展的麦克斯韦方法》\cite{kurokawa2026a}，该文引入了微束缚系统为抵抗哈勃流（Hubble flow）以维持其静态尺度所需的连续能量耗散这一基本概念；（2）《膨胀时空中微束缚系统普适耗散极限的三条路径》\cite{kurokawa2026b}，该文确立了宇宙膨胀中量子系统耗散率的普适热力学界限；（3）《引力的热力学起源：膨胀时空中量子束缚系统的共形维持》\cite{kurokawa2026c}，该文论证了共形维持与引力效应涌现之间的深层联系；以及（4）《引力坍缩中共形维持电流的几何能量注入：解决核坍缩超新星激波复活问题的新途径》\cite{kurokawa2026d}，该文将共形维持形式应用于极端天体物理环境——本研究从第一性原理出发，系统阐述了时空几何形变对局域规范场施加的热力学耗散动力学。在暴胀时期，当哈勃参数\(H\)取极大正值（\(H_{\text{inf}} \sim 10^{14}\) GeV）时，几何膨胀对局域系统起到“强摩擦”（能量耗散至真空）的作用。本文数学证明，通过考虑系统试图维持其共形尺度的热力学约束，极端哈勃膨胀充当了一个主动环境，对局域系统施加失控的几何摩擦。本文展示了在这种极端几何摩擦下，规范场的共形不变性如何不可避免地破缺，以及相变动力学如何被改变。该理论框架在不引入任何特设假设的前提下，为现代宇宙学面临的多个关键问题提供了统一且自然的解答：（1）通过共形维持电流（Conformal Maintenance Current, \(J_{\text{conf}}\)）从第一性原理产生原初磁场，该电流不可避免地破缺共形不变性，并通过几何过阻尼将磁场冻结于空间；（2）通过“几何淬灭效应”（geometric quench effect）抑制拓扑缺陷（磁单极、宇宙弦），该效应显著延迟相变并抑制缺陷产生率；以及（3）通过宇宙焦耳加热（cosmological Joule heating）从第一性原理解释再加热与熵产生，其中物质在膨胀时空中为维持自身尺度而承受的几何摩擦热，构成了热大爆炸的基本热源。本文得出结论，暴胀是一个极端的“宇宙热机”，并讨论了在宇宙微波背景B模式偏振与原初引力波谱中探测几何耗散信号的前景。

title: The Curvature Relaxation Model: A Four-Paper Program for Geometric Cosmology Without the Dark Sector
abstract: A four-paper series presenting the Curvature Relaxation Model (CRM), a geometric framework that derives dark-matter phenomenology from scalar-curvature dynamics without postulating new particles. CORE-PAPERS Paper I: Game-Theoretic Foundation — Establishes the CRM through thermodynamic game theory (Jacobson tradition), deriving curvature saturation from Nash equilibrium between expansion and gravity. Paper II: MOND Emergence — Shows that Modified Newtonian Dynamics emerges as an effective background coupling from the running curvature parameter β ≈ 2.0, fitted to Pantheon+ and CMB data. Paper III: Lagrangian Formulation — Provides the covariant Lagrangian with Pöschl–Teller scalar potential, MCMC-fitted f(R) parameters, CMB Cℓ spectra, and S₈ predictions. Paper IV: Vector Sector and Galactic Dynamics — Extends the scalar sector by a massive Proca-type vector field (Daughter 2), derives the a₀ ≈ cH₀/(2π) relation, and tests against 175 SPARC galaxies. EXTENSIONS Related: Paper V — The Saturation Theorem (10.5281/zenodo.19036188) Developed later, building on the CRM framework and advances in functional stability theory, this companion paper proves that the tanh saturation profile of Papers I–IV is not a model choice but a mathematical necessity: any quantum gravity theory satisfying four minimal axioms must produce the tanh form. All major QG programs (LQG, asymptotic safety, strings, causal sets, noncommutative geometry) are shown to satisfy the axioms. Related: Paper VI — QG-CRM: Ultraviolet Completion (10.5281/zenodo.19352448, DRAFT). This companion paper answers the open question from Paper V: “which UV completion selects k and Φ0?” By identifying the γR² sector of the CRM Lagrangian with asymptotically free quantum quadratic gravity (QQG), inflation is generated dynamically via RG running without an inflaton field. The Saturation Theorem provides the unique UV-IR interface. Predictions: ns ∼ 1 − 4/(3N) ≈ 0.976, r ≥ 0.01, testable with Stage IV CMB experiments. CHANGELOG: PAPERS I-IV Version 7.0 changes (2026-03-26): Literature verification and corrections: FLAMINGO author corrected (Schaye → McCarthy, Paper III), Chou year corrected (2017 → 2016, Paper III DE), Prigogine reference corrected (Nicolis & Prigogine, Paper IV), Cardoso → Nakamoto & Oshita (Paper III DE). Fixes: affiliation standardized to “Bernau, Germany” across all papers, copy-paste duplicate removed (Paper II EN), German section comments in EN papers cleaned (Papers II+III). Title corrected: “Dark Matter” → “Dark Sector” (more accurate scope). Changes in Version 8.0 (July 2026) This version adds the first symbolic analysis of the linear sector of the Route-3 successor architecture, completes the healing packages of Papers III and IV, and finishes the German/English structural synchronisation of the whole series. Paper IV -- new section "Linear sector of the Route-3 action: two gates and one pass": the FLRW background algebra (conserved shift charge, energy density and pressure, algebraic Lagrange multiplier) is derived; the massive vector--scalar mode reproduces the published AeST Minkowski dispersion exactly; a canonical (Dirac/Faddeev--Jackiw) reduction shows the quadratic Hamiltonian is unbounded below for k < k_star with k_star^2 = K_QQ Qbar^2 G / (beta F_Y) -- Route 3 therefore inherits the AeST low-k Hamiltonian problem, now recorded as an explicit quantitative gate; and the tensor sector gives c_T = 1, alpha_T = 0 identically, so GW170817 is satisfied by construction. The quasistatic response is reported only as a calibrated local diagnostic (candidate pole at the same k_star), not as an established result. Paper IV -- withdrawals: a previously considered quasistatic slip formula and a parameter constraint F_Y >> beta are withdrawn; no continuation of the candidate response through the pole or onto the Hamiltonian-unbounded branch is claimed. Paper III: the f(R) normalisation convention (epsilon = 16 pi G gamma) is now stated explicitly in both language versions, with all mass/Compton/screening formulas expressed in it; the hi_class transparency note is updated to the post-validation state (stability tests pass for the proxy branch; large scalar sound speeds remain an open interpretation gate). Papers I--II: maintenance from the source and citation checks; no claim changes. DE/EN synchronisation: the German versions of Papers I--IV now carry the same structure as the English ones (identical label sets); the Paper-II DE gap that blocked the previous upload candidate is closed. Status: the model remains a candidate program. Lensing, PPN, CMB, structure formation and a common SPARC fit are open; a_0 = c H_0/(2 pi) remains a calibrated anchor, not a derivation. Version 6.0 changes (2026-03-13): Backward-impact revision (11 REV points across all papers), literature update (8 LIT-CRM points including Brodie 2026, DES Y6, Famaey & McGaugh 2012, mimetic gravity, Jacobson non-Riemannian 2026), soliton-ensemble UV completion candidate (Paper III), full EN/DE synchronization, duplicate bibitem fix (Paper I).

abstract_cn: 以下是一组四篇系列论文，提出曲率弛豫模型（Curvature Relaxation Model, CRM），这是一个无需假设新粒子、仅从标量-曲率动力学推导暗物质现象的几何框架。核心论文 论文一：博弈论基础——通过热力学博弈论（雅各布森传统）建立CRM，从膨胀与引力之间的纳什均衡推导出曲率饱和。论文二：MOND的涌现——表明修正牛顿动力学（Modified 相关论文五：饱和定理（10.5281/zenodo.19036188）——该伴随论文后续发展，基于CRM框架与泛函稳定性理论的进展，证明论文一至四中的tanh饱和轮廓并非模型选择，而是数学必然性：任何满足四个最小公理条件的量子引力理论都必须产生tanh形式。所有主要量子引力（QG）方案（圈量子引力、渐近安全、弦论、因果集、非交换几何）均被证明满足这些公理。相关论文六：QG-CRM：紫外完备化（10.5281/zenodo.19352448，草稿）——该伴随论文回答了论文五中的开放问题：“哪个紫外完备化选择了k和Φ₀？”通过将CRM拉格朗日量中的γR²扇区识别为渐近自由量子二次引力（Quantum < k_star（其中k_star² = K_QQ Qbar² G / (beta F_Y)），二次哈密顿量无下界——因此路线三继承了AeST的低k哈密顿量问题，现记录为明确的定量门限；张量扇区给出c_T = 1，α_T = 0恒成立，因此GW170817由构造自动满足。准静态响应仅作为校准后的局域诊断报告（在相同k_star处存在候选极点），而非确定结果。论文四——撤回：先前考虑的准静态滑移公式及参数约束F_Y >> beta被撤回；不声称候选响应在极点处或进入哈密顿量无界分支的延续。论文三：f(R)归一化约定（ε = 16 π G γ）现已在两种语言版本中明确陈述，所有质量/康普顿/屏蔽公式均以此表示；hi_class透明度说明更新至验证后状态（代理分支通过稳定性测试；大标量声速仍为开放解释门限）。论文一至二：来源维护与引文检查；无主张变更。德/英同步：论文一至四的德文版本现与英文版本具有相同结构（相同标签集）；此前阻碍上传的论文二DE缺口已填补。状态：该模型仍为候选方案。透镜、参数化后牛顿形式（PPN）、CMB、结构形成以及统一的SPARC拟合仍为开放问题；a₀ = c H₀/(2π)仍为校准锚点，而非推导结果。版本6.0变更（2026-03-13）：回溯影响修订（所有论文共11个REV点），文献更新（8个LIT-CRM点，包括Brodie 2026、DES Y6、Famaey & McGaugh 2012、模仿引力、Jacobson非黎曼2026），孤子系综紫外完备化候选方案（论文三），完整英/德同步，重复bibitem修复（论文一）。

abstract: この改良では 1: 分数 d'Alembert 演算子 \(\Box ^{\beta /2}\) のエネルギー運動量保存則 (共変微分) の厳密な証明を行います。非局所的な Weyl 不変テンソル分解を導入することで、保存則を満たす方程式を強化し、アインシュタイン-カルタン幾何学の Bianchi 恒等式と完全に調和させ、時空フラクタル記憶カーネルの位相的変化が整合的であることを示します。2. 分数宇宙論的摂動におけるゲージ不変性の定式化分数ゲージ不変宇宙論的摂動方程式を明示的に定式化し、\(n_{s}\) と \(r\) の相関関数が純粋にフラクタルゆらぎから導出され、座標の自由度 (ゲージ依存性) が完全に排除される論理を確立します。3. 再加熱段階における「自発的 CPT 破れ」の非平衡熱力学的境界条件の明示的な決定 分数階カルディン・ウメザワ(ケルディッシュ・シュウィンガー)形式を導入することにより、非平衡熱グリーン関数における記憶効果が、幾何学的必然性としてサハロフの第3条件(熱非平衡)を自動的に達成することを示す数学的公式を明示的に示します。

title: Epistemic Inventory and Taxonomy of Claims
abstract: Here we present two companion documents for the program corpus listed below. The Taxonomy of Claims lists the theory's claims and assigns each one a status. The claims are grouped in three tiers: Framework (the laws and constants, which the theory does not derive), Pre-history (derived properties that are the same in any realization), and History (properties specific to our universe). A set of notes covers the counting conventions, the derivation of the failure probability p = ln 2/(2π²), several associations recorded without claim status, and a closing statement of the one assumption the theory requires. What the Theory Claims to Know contains the same material organized by question. About thirty questions -- why the cosmological constant is small, why w = −1, where the spectral tilt comes from, what preceded the first moment, why these constants -- are each given the theory's answer in plain language and a status: derived, identified, dissolved, partial, or not claimed. The final section lists the questions the theory does not claim to answer. The falsification conditions for the corpus are collected separately in the predictions letter and are not repeated in these documents. Both documents will be maintained: new versions will record changes in the status of claims, including withdrawals. title: The Paradigm Synthesis of Conformal Maintenance Dynamics in Expanding Spacetime and Resolutions to Fundamental Theoretical Challenges
abstract: This paper synthesizes the Pconf(Conformal Maintenance Power) paradigm, a novel theoretical framework that redefines the structural stability of microscopic bound systems in an expanding universe as an active, continuous thermodynamic process rather than a passive geometric state. The framework establishes a universal dissipation limit Pconf=32ℏH2Pconf=23ℏH2—the fundamental thermodynamic cost required for quantum systems to maintain their physical scales against cosmic expansion. The paper reviews seven foundational and applied studies spanning extended electrodynamics, quantum thermodynamics, emergent gravity, core-collapse supernovae, dark energy emergence, fine-structure constant evolution, and inflationary gauge field dynamics. Four critical theoretical challenges are rigorously addressed: (1) the paradox of emergent gravity in a static universe, (2) the contradiction of effective Hubble screening, (3) the scale-dependence of defining bound systems, and (4) the potential over-damping of primordial fluctuations during inflation. Through the application of local vacuum flow dynamics, hierarchical gauge separation, the renormalization group approach, and the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, these apparent paradoxes are shown to be mathematically consistent gateways to a deeper unification of general relativity and quantum mechanics. The paradigm provides first-principles resolutions to long-standing cosmological tensions including the cosmological constant problem, the cosmic coincidence problem, the Hubble tension, the spatial dipole of the fine-structure constant, the primordial magnetic field generation problem, and the supernova shock revival problem, establishing a comprehensive, falsifiable foundation for next-generation physics.

title: Perception Sets the Matrix: Spectral Match as the Generative Layer of Stochastic Brand-Choice Propensities
abstract: The stochastic brand-choice tradition — Markov switching models and the NBD-Dirichlet — earns its descriptive success by taking brand-choice propensities as exogenous givens: the models locate the equilibrium the propensities imply and are silent on what sets them. This paper supplies and tests the missing generative layer. At cohort level, spectral match — a similarity statistic between an observer cohort's eight-dimensional perception profile and a brand's profile — is proposed as a monotone predictor of the cohort's stated choice propensity within its category consideration set. A propensity vector induces the zero-order Dirichlet switching matrix in closed form. The perceptual layer therefore sets the matrix the tradition starts from: the double-jeopardy diagonal is inherited, the intermediate-propensity band becomes model-derived, and perceptually metameric brand pairs must receive statistically indistinguishable propensity vectors — a prediction no utility-based or congruity-based account makes. In a pre-registered LLM-cohort campaign under strict instrument separation with four kill conditions, the link held experimentally (τ_b= .323, p < .001; a random-profile placebo destroys it), replicated in quick-service coffee, failed in athletic footwear, and showed no common-method inflation (Δτ= -.002); metameric brand pairs violated propensity equality, bounding the perceptual layer's sufficiency exactly where real brand profiles converge. Includes zharnikov-2026bf-perception-sets-matrix.yaml (Paper Spec v0.1.0) – a machine-readable specification of the paper's claims, assumptions, and dependencies. The paper's full machine-first bundle (the SPINE claim/dependency graph and the ONTOLOGY term module) lives in the public repository; see https://github.com/spectralbranding/paper-spec for the standard. abstract_cn: 随机品牌选择传统——马尔可夫切换模型与NBD-Dirichlet模型——通过将品牌选择倾向视为外生给定因素而取得了描述性成功：这些模型定位了倾向所隐含的均衡，但对倾向的成因保持沉默。本文提供并检验了缺失的生成层。在队列层面，光谱匹配（spectral match）——即观察者队列的八维感知轮廓与品牌轮廓之间的相似性统计量——被提出作为该队列在其品类考虑集内所陈述选择倾向的单调预测因子。一个倾向向量以封闭形式诱导出零阶Dirichlet切换矩阵。因此，感知层设定了该传统所出发的矩阵：双重困境对角线（double-jeopardy diagonal）被继承，中间倾向带成为模型推导的结果，而感知上同分异构（perceptually metameric）的品牌对必须获得统计上不可区分的倾向向量——这是任何基于效用或基于一致性（congruity）的论述都无法做出的预测。在一项预先注册的、在严格工具分离条件下进行、包含四个淘汰条件（kill conditions）的LLM队列实验中，该关联在实验层面成立（τ_b = .323, p < .001；一个随机轮廓的安慰剂破坏了这一关联），在快餐咖啡品类中得到复制，在运动鞋品类中失败，且未显示共同方法膨胀（common-method inflation，Δτ = -.002）；同分异构品牌对违反了倾向相等性，恰好将感知层的充分性限定在真实品牌轮廓趋于收敛之处。包含zharnikov-2026bf-perception-sets-matrix.yaml（论文规范v0.1.0）——一份机器可读的论文主张、假设与依赖关系规范。论文的完整机器优先包（SPINE主张/依赖关系图与ONTOLOGY术语模块）存放于公共仓库中；标准参见https://github.com/spectralbranding/paper-spec。本PDF是在研究即仓库（research-as-repository）模型下，从该机器优先源程序化生成的。

title: 《太极矩阵宇宙学(Taiji Matrix Cosmology)》
abstract: 摘要:本文以太极几何为数学工具,建立在八维太极矩阵上的完整宇宙学理论——太极矩阵宇宙学。宇宙的终极实在是一个八维太极矩阵,由两个互为对偶的四元数构成:阳矩阵承载正向时间与空间三维,阴矩阵承载反向时间与频域三维。频域三维——频率维度(幅值)、手征维度(谱偏斜)、宇间维度(层级迭代因子)——满足李代数关系[i, j] = 2k,宇间维度k因而是频率与手征非交换性的数学必然。空间三维性是四元数虚部空间本身的维数。暴胀与松弛是太极矩阵阴阳消长的一次完整呼吸——暴胀对应阴矩阵频率拉升,松弛对应阴矩阵频率回落,宇宙加速膨胀不是暗能量在推动,而是阴矩阵频域回落的几何表现。量子涨落是阴矩阵频域在高频端的基态振荡,量子纠缠是太极矩阵阴阳两个四元数同步投影的必然表现。粒子物理守恒律全部是博弈公理的代数必然。星系中心天体不是黑洞,而是太极矩阵在临界频率附近的永恒博弈结构——太极核,暗物质是阴矩阵反向闭环在阳矩阵空间中的引力投影。太极矩阵宇宙学为宇宙提供了不依赖任何外部假设的数学图景,并给出六个可证伪的定量预言。 Abstract: This paper establishes a complete cosmological theory on the eight-dimensional Taiji matrix, using Taiji Geometry as the mathematical tool—Taiji Matrix Cosmology. The ultimate reality of the universe is an eight-dimensional Taiji matrix, composed of two mutually dual quaternions: the Yang matrix carries forward time and three spatial dimensions, while the Yin matrix carries reverse time and three frequency-domain dimensions. The three frequency-domain dimensions—frequency dimension (amplitude), chirality dimension (spectral skew), and intercosmic dimension (hierarchical iteration factor)—satisfy the Lie algebra relation [i, j] = 2k; the intercosmic dimension k is thus a mathematical necessity arising from the non-commutativity of frequency and chirality. The three-dimensionality of space is the dimensionality of the quaternionic imaginary part space itself. Inflation and relaxation constitute a single complete breath of the waxing and waning of yin and yang in the Taiji matrix—inflation corresponds to the upward surge of Yin-matrix frequency, and relaxation corresponds to the downward fall of Yin-matrix frequency. The accelerating expansion of the universe is not driven by dark energy, but is the geometric manifestation of the downward fall of the Yin-matrix frequency domain. Quantum fluctuation is the ground-state oscillation of the Yin-matrix frequency domain at the high-frequency end, and quantum entanglement is the inevitable manifestation of the synchronous projection of the two quaternions, yin and yang, of the Taiji matrix. All conservation laws in particle physics are algebraic necessities of the interplay axiom. The central objects of galaxies are not black holes, but rather the eternal interplay structure of the Taiji matrix near the critical frequency—the Taiji Core. Dark matter is the gravitational projection of the Yin-matrix reverse closed loop in the Yang-matrix space. Taiji Matrix Cosmology provides a mathematical picture of the universe that does not rely on any external assumptions, and presents six falsifiable quantitative predictions.

abstract_cn: 循环巨宇宙（Loop Mega Universe, LMU）是一种世界观层面的综合体系——明确地说，是一种视角，而非一种新的预测性理论——它将已有且被引证的物理学整合进一个循环黑洞宇宙学中。一个宇宙纪元以寒冷、稀薄且团块状的状态终结；结构通过一个黑洞尺寸阶梯（L4 气体/恒星 → L3 星系级黑洞 → L2 最亮星系团黑洞 → L1 最后幸存者）向下漏斗式传递；幸存者停止自转（佩奇过程）并蒸发——必然地（霍金过程）——其终末闪光触发早已位于α吸引子高原上的ω-暴胀子：一次确定性的重置，无亚稳态势垒，无隧穿过程（科尔曼-德卢西亚气泡作为计算上的替代方案被保留）。一次闪光 = 一次点火 = 一个宇宙纪元：新的炽热、平滑、致密的开端在内部切片上同时发生，密度通过高原真空能量的原位转换而抵达。重新打开的熵缺口（弗劳奇过程）——即该宇宙纪元的新增负熵预算——重新武装了热力学时间箭头；向无界基底中的稀释使得总账目保持第二定律安全。仅有两个公理（基底 + Λ）。每一个承载性论断都带有八种状态标签之一（[事实]、[事实-理论]、[假说]、[推测]、[设计]、[开放]、[死路]、[审计]）；每一个机制都归因于其所属文献；死路被保留在失败日志中。预注册的证伪线（不可变，OSF DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/CN3B4）：F1 暗能量（标准缓行，无幻影穿越；DESI-Y5 ~2027），F2 黑洞自旋（BHEX时代），F4 张量波段（r ≈ 0.0037，脊柱区间 0.0018–0.009，对比当前 r < 0.034；由 LiteBIRD/CMB-S4 决定），F5 预测的 CCC 式霍金点缺失（2023–24年再分析：一致），F6 微正德西特终局（若未来确认发生向反德西特的转变则被证伪）。V3.29 版本新增两个研究层面。（1）闭合回路第1–4轮，经对抗性验证：将 ω 等同于前一宇宙纪元的共形因子等同于暴胀子的识别，无法通过任何已尝试的局域、动力学、熵或几何原理提升至[事实]状态——剩余自由度为共形微分同胚零模（规范）加上一个合法自由的约克初始数据加上场全域振幅输入；高原解读受自然性偏好并由测量决定。（2）τ_宇宙纪元 熵时钟层面 [假说，仅限闭合回路]：宇宙纪元的内部时间被等同于其自身账目中累积的粗粒熵流——在微小的德西特尾部爬行，可积地发散进入确定性的终末闪光，在暴胀期间停滞，在再加热时重新武装——具有闭合的爆炸前形式，且恒等式“不稀释 ⇔ 无时间”（w = −1）将冷→热转变压缩为单一陈述。经过两轮文献归属审查（约90篇论文）发现，该组合在宇宙学模型中尚无先例；其操作实验室先例为 Barontini（《物理评论研究》8, L022047, 2026），并致谢了宇宙学单历史邻近模型（Weberszpil & Sotolongo-Costa 2026；Martyushev 2016；Hauret–Magain 2017；Bojowald–Tavakol 2008）。一项14代理压力测试（连续性/逻辑/单位）以全部36项发现被修复并验证而告终。实证清单（2026年7月实时验证）包括 DESI DR2、包含 ALMA 动力学质量的六遗迹汇编（Cohn 等人，2025）、JWST 超大质量黑洞（A2744-QSO1）、GW231123（LVK 2025），以及涵盖五个脉冲星计时阵列（包括 MeerKAT MPTA，Miles 等人，2025）的纳赫兹引力波背景。普朗克脊柱被保留为参考；普朗克之后的结果作为带标签的漂移记录被纳入。关键词：循环宇宙学，黑洞宇宙学，暗能量，精质，DESI，霍金蒸发，佩奇曲线，熵时间，关系时间，α吸引子，熵，负熵，时间箭头，宇宙纪元，超大质量黑洞，遗迹星系，GW231123，脉冲星计时阵列，德西特稳定性，测度问题，循环巨宇宙，LMU。

title: Macroeconomic Variation Factors Influencing Indian Rupee Volatility: A Multiple Regression Approach to Exchange Rate Dynamics
abstract: The Indian rupee experienced heightened volatility during 2023–2024 amid global monetary tightening and post-pandemic macroeconomic adjustments. This study examines how selected domestic macroeconomic indicators influenced short-term exchange rate movements during this period. Monthly data from January 2023 to December 2024 are analysed using a multiple regression framework to capture high-frequency dynamics. The analysis focuses on inflation, policy interest rate changes, current account balance, and public debt as potential drivers of exchange rate variation. The results indicate that inflationary pressures and external imbalances exerted the strongest influence on rupee depreciation during the tightening cycle. Policy interest rate adjustments and rising public debt display weaker but positive associations with exchange rate movements. The model explains a substantial share of monthly exchange rate variation and satisfies standard diagnostic conditions. The findings highlight the importance of inflation control and external sector stability for managing currency pressures in periods of global financial stress. By employing recent monthly data from the tightening phase, the study provides timely evidence relevant for macroeconomic policy design and currency risk assessment.

tldr: 该论文通过多元回归分析2023-2024年月度数据，发现通胀和外部失衡是印度卢比贬值的主要驱动因素，利率和公共债务影响较弱。
abstract_cn: 印度卢比在2023–2024年间，因全球货币紧缩及疫情后宏观经济调整而经历了加剧的波动。本研究探讨了在此期间，选定的国内宏观经济指标如何影响短期汇率变动。采用多元回归框架对2023年1月至2024年12月的月度数据进行分析，以捕捉高频动态。分析聚焦于通货膨胀、政策利率变动、经常账户余额及公共债务作为汇率变动的潜在驱动因素。结果表明，在紧缩周期中，通胀压力与外部失衡对卢比贬值的影响最为显著。政策利率调整与公共债务上升与汇率变动呈较弱但正向的关联。该模型解释了月度汇率变动的较大部分，并满足标准诊断条件。研究结果凸显了在全球金融压力时期，控制通胀与稳定外部部门对于管理货币压力的重要性。通过采用紧缩阶段的最新月度数据，本研究为宏观经济政策设计与货币风险评估提供了及时的证据。

title: The Complete GTE Framework: Standard Model, Gravity, Quantum Mechanics, and Cosmology from Phi_MDL
abstract: The Standard Model of particle physics contains approximately twenty-five numerical parameters --- gauge couplings, fermion masses, mixing angles, the Higgs sector, the cosmological constant --- treated as measured inputs with no theoretical origin. This monograph presents the complete Generative Triple Evolution (GTE) framework: a derivation of all Standard Model parameters, spacetime structure, quantum mechanics, and cosmology from a single foundational principle with zero free parameters. Perfect Self-Containment (PSC) --- the requirement that a universe have no external selector for its laws --- forces law selection by the Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle. MDL uniquely selects a 19-bit polynomial p(L,C,R) = C+R-CR-LCR over GF(7) as the sole MDL-minimal structure consistent with physical self-containment, with every Z_N x Z_M alternative eliminated by exhaustive Lean 4 proof. The architecture is two-level. At Level 1, p defines the Chiral Minkowski Cellular Automaton (CMCA): not the physical substrate, but a discrete algebraic certificate --- an arithmetic proof system certifying which structures the field theory must contain. Machine-certified Algebraic Lifting and Descent theorems connect this certificate to the continuum. At Level 2, the physical substrate is Phi_MDL: a single Z_7-symmetric Klein-Gordon gauge field on R^(3,1) with internal symmetry group F_21 = Z_7 x Z_3, governed by L_Phi_MDL = (1/2)(partial_mu Phi)^2 - (m^2/49)(1 - cos 7Phi) + L_gauge + L_chi. All matter, forces, spacetime, and quantum mechanics emerge from this one equation. Elementary particles are BPS topological kink solitons of Phi_MDL, carrying Z_7 winding numbers that map exactly to Standard Model quantum numbers. Spacetime geometry is not fundamental but emergent: the Einstein equations are derived from MDL-Lovelock variational principles, and 3+1 dimensions are forced by the Dimensional Protocol Principle (machine-certified). Over 170 quantitative results across 15 prediction sectors are derived and compared against PDG, NuFIT 6.0, and Planck 2018: nine charged-fermion masses at 0.295% RMS; the fine-structure constant 1/alpha = 137 as a pure arithmetic identity; the Weinberg angle at +0.038 sigma after two-loop corrections; the CMB spectral tilt n_s = 0.96488 at -0.005 sigma; and the baryon asymmetry eta_B = 6.109e-10 at +0.15 sigma. Cross-sector predictions --- cosmological observables derived from the same arithmetic that produces particle masses, with no inter-sector parameter tuning --- distinguish GTE from numerology. The Born rule is derived, not postulated; the quantum measurement problem is dissolved --- reframed in terms of PSC-forced transputation, conditional on the D4 universality assumption. The cosmological constant problem is substantially addressed: Lambda = 0 classically and the observed Omega_Lambda is bracketed; the full quantum hierarchy remains an open problem. The strong CP problem is resolved without an axion. All four standard inflation motivations are discharged from first principles without an inflationary epoch. GTE makes falsifiable predictions beyond the Standard Model: a dark-sector particle at 211.9 MeV (Belle II); r=0 (LiteBIRD); w=-1 exactly (Euclid); and theta_QCD=0 requiring no axion. All central results are machine-certified in Lean 4 across nearly 400 modules of the ugp-lean library. The Standard Model is not a coincidence. It is a theorem.

tldr: 该论文提出一个从最小描述长度原理推导出所有标准模型参数、时空和量子力学的统一理论框架，声称零自由参数并做出可验证预测。
abstract_cn: 粒子物理标准模型包含约二十五个数值参数——规范耦合常数、费米子质量、混合角、希格斯扇区、宇宙学常数——这些参数被当作测量输入，缺乏理论起源。本专著提出完整的生成性三重演化（GTE）框架：从单一基础原理出发，在零自由参数条件下推导出所有标准模型参数、时空结构、量子力学及宇宙学。完美自包含性（PSC）——要求宇宙不存在用于选择其法则的外部选择器——迫使法则选择遵循最小描述长度（MDL）原理。MDL唯一地选取一个19比特多项式p(L,C,R) = C+R-CR-LCR（定义于域GF(7)上）作为与物理自包含性一致的唯一MDL最小结构，所有Z_N x Z_M替代方案均通过Lean 4形式化证明被排除。该架构分为两层。第一层中，p定义了手性闵可夫斯基元胞自动机（CMCA）：它并非物理基底，而是一个离散代数证书——一种算术证明系统，用于认证场论必须包含哪些结构。经机器认证的代数提升与下降定理将该证书与连续统联系起来。第二层中，物理基底为Phi_MDL：一个定义于R^(3,1)上、具有内部对称群F_21 = Z_7 x Z_3的单一Z_7对称Klein-Gordon规范场，其动力学由L_Phi_MDL = (1/2)(partial_mu Phi)^2 - (m^2/49)(1 - cos 7Phi) + L_gauge + L_chi支配。所有物质、力、时空及量子力学均源于这一方程。基本粒子是Phi_MDL的BPS拓扑扭结孤子，携带的Z_7缠绕数精确映射为标准模型量子数。时空几何并非基本，而是涌现的：爱因斯坦方程由MDL-Lovelock变分原理导出，而3+1维时空由维度协议原理（经机器认证）强制决定。在15个预测领域中推导出超过170项定量结果，并与粒子数据组（PDG）、中微子拟合6.0（NuFIT 6.0）及普朗克2018（Planck 2018）数据进行了对比：九种带电费米子质量的均方根误差为0.295%；精细结构常数1/alpha = 137作为纯算术恒等式成立；温伯格角经双圈修正后与标准模型偏差+0.038西格玛；宇宙微波背景谱倾斜指数n_s = 0.96488，偏差-0.005西格玛；重子不对称性eta_B = 6.109e-10，偏差+0.15西格玛。跨领域预测——由产生粒子质量的同一算术推导出的宇宙学可观测量，且无需跨领域参数调节——使GTE区别于数字命理学。玻恩规则被推导而非假定；量子测量问题被消解——基于PSC强制转译过程重新表述，且以D4普适性假设为条件。宇宙学常数问题得到实质性解决：经典水平上Lambda = 0，观测到的Omega_Lambda被限定范围；完整的量子层级问题仍待解决。强CP问题无需轴子即可解决。所有四项标准暴胀动机均从第一原理出发被消解，无需暴胀时期。GTE做出了超越标准模型的可证伪预测：暗扇区粒子质量为211.9 MeV（贝拉II实验）；张量标量比r=0（LiteBIRD实验）；暗能量状态方程w=-1精确成立（欧几里得任务）；theta_QCD=0无需轴子。所有核心结果均通过ugp-lean库近400个模块在Lean 4中完成机器认证。标准模型并非巧合。它是一个定理。

title: Fiscal Cyclicality and Debt Sustainability: Evidence From Over a Century of Data
abstract: ABSTRACT Using a historical fiscal dataset for a group of 11 economies over the period 1880–2022, we examine debt sustainability and fiscal policy cyclicality and assess the factors influencing fiscal behaviour. We find that positive and statistically significant responses of primary balances to debt emerge in specific historical episodes and particular macroeconomic regime conditions, including the interwar era and the period from the 1990s up to the global financial crisis, while several regime settings such as low real interest rate environments, high inflation episodes and below the average growth regimes exhibit weak, insignificant, or even negative response to rising debt. We also document a transition from acyclical to countercyclical fiscal policy in the post‐war era. These findings are robust to alternative estimation techniques and to specifications that incorporate the interest–growth differential. A country‐level analysis reveals substantial heterogeneity, with economically meaningful deviations concentrated in specific historical episodes rather than reflecting persistent patterns. Finally, we identify economic development, democratic institutions, country size, bankruptcies, and interest rate fluctuations as key determinants of fiscal policy outcomes.
tldr: 该研究利用11个经济体1880-2022年的历史数据，发现债务可持续性取决于特定历史时期和宏观条件，财政政策在战后从非周期性转向逆周期性，且经济、制度等因素影响财政行为。
abstract_cn: 摘要 利用涵盖1880–2022年间11个经济体的历史财政数据集，我们考察了债务可持续性与财政政策周期性，并评估了影响财政行为的因素。研究发现，在特定历史时期和特定宏观经济体制条件下（包括两次世界大战之间、20世纪90年代至全球金融危机期间），基本财政收支对债务呈现出统计上显著的正向响应；而低实际利率环境、高通胀时期以及低于平均增长率的体制设定下，基本财政收支对债务上升的响应则表现为微弱、不显著甚至为负。我们还记录了战后时期财政政策从非周期性向逆周期性的转变。这些发现在采用替代性估计技术以及纳入利率-增长差异的模型设定中均保持稳健。国别层面分析揭示了显著的异质性，其中具有经济意义的偏离集中于特定历史时期，而非反映持续性模式。最后，我们识别出经济发展水平、民主制度、国家规模、破产事件及利率波动是财政政策结果的关键决定因素。

analysis.chinese_title: 财政周期性与债务可持续性：来自一个多世纪数据的证据

title: Determinants Influencing Small Farmers Credit Accessibility and utilization in Tanzania: A Case of Dodoma Region
abstract: The agricultural industry employs more than 65% of Tanzanian workers and has a major economic impact. This study assesses the variables affecting small farmers' access to and utilisation of loans in Tanzania's Dodoma region. Additionally, the study uses a mixed research approach to integrate or combine qualitative and quantitative data. The research used a cross-sectional survey research methodology. The total number of grape growers in the sample was 342. For the inquiry, primary data was selected. The research discovered that Tanzanian farmers' utilization to funding is affected by bank interest rates, terms of payment, age, and education. The study recommends that development banks collaborate with the government, take the time to fully comprehend the macroeconomics of the nation in which they operate, control operating costs, and establish a stable source of income in order to successfully extend credit to underfinanced areas or sectors where other commercial banks would not.

title: Fiscal Reaction Functions, Snowball Effects and Structural Constraints in Japan, 1980–2023
abstract: This article re-examines sovereign debt sustainability within a modern macro-financial framework that distinguishes mechanical debt arithmetic from policy-driven fiscal behaviour. While a negative interest–growth differential ( r – g < 0) is a necessary condition for debt stabilization in the canonical debt identity, it is not sufficient when the fiscal policy operates under structurally persistent deficits. Using Japan over 1980–2023 as a long-horizon benchmark, the study combines conceptual insights with an accounting decomposition separating snowball effects from primary-balance contributions. Despite persistently favourable r – g differentials, Japan’s debt ratio rose steadily due to sustained primary deficits and crisis-related expansions. A Bohn-type fiscal reaction function shows a stabilizing but modest primary surplus response to rising debt, insufficient to halt long-run accumulation. The article also documents declining fiscal effectiveness as cyclical slack narrowed and supply constraints intensified. Overall, the findings emphasize institutional structure and macro-financial regimes over purely arithmetic interpretations of debt sustainability. JEL Classification: E44, E62, H62, H63, O47
journal: South Asian Journal of Macroeconomics and Public Finance
tldr: 该论文通过分析日本1980-2023年的数据，发现尽管利率-增长差为负，但持续的财政赤字和结构性约束导致债务比率上升，强调制度结构和宏观金融框架对债务可持续性的重要性。
abstract_cn: 本文在现代宏观金融框架下重新审视主权债务可持续性问题，该框架区分了机械性债务算术与政策驱动的财政行为。尽管负利率-增长差（r – g < 0）是经典债务恒等式中债务稳定的必要条件，但当财政政策在结构性持续赤字下运行时，这一条件并不充分。本研究以日本1980–2023年作为长期基准，结合概念性洞见与会计分解，将雪球效应与基本收支贡献分离。尽管存在持续有利的r – g差，但由于持续的基本赤字及危机相关的扩张，日本的债务比率仍稳步上升。一种Bohn型财政反应函数显示，基本收支盈余对债务上升具有稳定但温和的响应，不足以阻止长期累积。本文还记录了随着周期性缺口收窄和供给约束加剧，财政有效性下降的趋势。总体而言，研究结果强调制度结构与宏观金融体制，而非对债务可持续性的纯粹算术解释。JEL分类：E44, E62, H62, H63, O47

title: An economic analysis of public government expenditure and its role in attracting foreign direct investment in Iraq during the Period 2004–2022
abstract: This research aims to analyze the economic contribution of public spending to attracting foreign direct investment in Iraq during the period 2003–2023. Government spending is considered a key tool of fiscal policy that can improve the investment climate and boost economic activity. Public spending, particularly investment spending on developing the country's infrastructure, contributes to creating a suitable economic environment for attracting foreign capital. The research employed a descriptive-analytical approach to analyze the relationship between public expenditures and foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows in Iraq during the study period, using annual data from official bodies and international organizations. The study concluded that a relationship exists between public expenditures and FDI, as increased government spending contributes to improving infrastructure and economic services in Iraq. This enhances foreign investor confidence and encourages investment flows into the Iraqi economy. The findings also demonstrated that weak political and economic stability, coupled with heavy reliance on the oil sector, are among the most significant challenges hindering Iraq's ability to attract further foreign investment. The study recommended redirecting public spending towards productive sectors and infrastructure, improving the investment climate, strengthening economic and legislative stability, and enhancing administrative procedures and modernizing investment laws to increase foreign direct investment inflows and support economic development in Iraq.

tldr: 该论文分析了伊拉克2004-2022年政府公共支出对吸引外国直接投资的作用，发现政府支出通过改善基础设施和投资环境促进外资流入，但政治经济不稳定和石油依赖是主要障碍。
abstract_cn: 本研究旨在分析2003-2023年期间伊拉克公共支出对吸引外国直接投资的经济贡献。政府支出被视为财政政策的关键工具，能够改善投资环境并促进经济活动。公共支出，特别是用于国家基础设施发展的投资性支出，有助于为吸引外国资本创造适宜的经济环境。本研究采用描述性分析方法，利用官方机构及国际组织的年度数据，分析了研究期间伊拉克公共支出与外国直接投资（FDI）流入之间的关系。研究结论表明，公共支出与外国直接投资之间存在关联，政府支出的增加有助于改善伊拉克的基础设施和经济服务，从而增强外国投资者的信心，并鼓励投资流入伊拉克经济。研究结果还显示，政治与经济稳定性薄弱，以及对石油部门的高度依赖，是阻碍伊拉克吸引更多外国投资的最主要挑战。本研究建议将公共支出重新导向生产性部门和基础设施领域，改善投资环境，加强经济与立法稳定性，并优化行政程序及更新投资法律，以增加外国直接投资流入，支持伊拉克的经济发展。

title: Climate regulation, firm emissions, and green takeovers
abstract: We show that an unexpected tightening of the EU Emissions Trading System led high-emission-intensity firms to cut emissions relative to low-intensity peers within the same industry, without reducing output, thereby improving emission efficiency. Effects are stronger for power producers than for manufacturing firms. Examining mergers and acquisitions (M&As), we find that high-intensity manufacturing firms acquire more green targets after the tightening than low-intensity firms, with no change in the overall number of acquisitions, indicating a shift in focus rather than activity. Finally, we show that these green M&As contributed to the observed emission reductions over the study period.
tldr: 该论文发现欧盟排放交易体系收紧促使高排放企业通过绿色并购提高排放效率，但对银行和货币政策无直接关联。
abstract_cn: 我们证明，欧盟排放交易体系（EU Emissions Trading System）的一次意外收紧，导致同一行业内高排放强度企业相较于低排放强度同行削减了排放，且未减少产出，从而提升了排放效率。该效应对电力生产商的影响强于制造业企业。通过考察并购活动（Mergers and Acquisitions, M&As），我们发现，在政策收紧后，高排放强度制造业企业比低排放强度企业收购了更多绿色目标，而整体收购数量未发生变化，这表明其关注点发生了转移而非活动总量改变。最后，我们证明这些绿色并购（green M&As）在研究期间内对观测到的减排效果有所贡献。
