title: Identification and Inference with Machine-Learned Instruments
abstract: Instrumental-variables estimation increasingly pools many or high-dimensional instruments into a single machine-learned first stage, with rich controls partialled out. The resulting estimand, the partialled-out IV coefficient built from any signal of the instruments, is a signal-weighted average of the heterogeneous effects, which gives an opaque first stage a precise structural meaning. The average is convex whenever a covariance-monotonicity condition holds, and we provide a microfoundation for that condition based on vector monotonicity. With a learned signal, however, the usual debiased moment is not Neyman-orthogonal, and its first-order bias is a drift toward the learner's own signal-weighted average, so naive inference remains valid only for that learner-dependent target. We construct a heterogeneity-robust orthogonal score that restores $\sqrt{N}$ inference on the fixed, learner-invariant target at no efficiency cost, and provide a Hausman-type diagnostic and identification-robust confidence sets.
tldr: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的工具变量估计方法，解决信号加权平均效应的识别和推断问题，并构造异质性稳健的得分函数。
abstract_cn: 工具变量估计日益将多个或高维工具变量整合到一个机器学习的第一阶段中，同时剔除丰富的控制变量。由此得到的估计量——即基于工具变量任何信号构建的剔除后的工具变量系数——是异质性效应的信号加权平均值，这为不透明的第一阶段赋予了精确的结构性含义。当协方差单调性条件成立时，该平均值是凸的，我们基于向量单调性为该条件提供了微观基础。然而，在使用学习得到的信号时，通常的去偏矩并非奈曼正交，其一阶偏差会向学习者自身的信号加权平均值漂移，因此朴素推断仅对该依赖于学习者的目标有效。我们构建了一个对异质性稳健的正交得分，在无效率损失的情况下恢复了针对固定且不依赖于学习者的目标的$\sqrt{N}$推断，并提供了豪斯曼型诊断工具以及识别稳健的置信集。

title: A Variance-Based Test for Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
abstract: This paper proposes a robust nonparametric hypothesis test for the existence of heterogeneous treatment effects. We focus on the variance of the Conditional Average Treatment Effect (CATE) as a natural omnibus parameter, where a non-zero variance implies the presence of relevant heterogeneity. Standard inference for this parameter faces a fundamental theoretical challenge. On one hand, evaluating variance components on the same sample leads to null degeneracy, where the asymptotic variance collapses to zero under the null hypothesis of homogeneity, invalidating standard Gaussian inference. On the other hand, decoupling the empirical processes via standard sample-splitting breaks the Neyman orthogonality of the doubly robust scores due to their nonlinear squared loss, which prevents the cancellation of first-order regularization biases. To resolve this challenge, we propose a novel Intra-Fold Sample-Splitting algorithm. By evaluating variance components on mutually disjoint subsamples while coupling them to identical out-of-fold nuisance estimators, our procedure achieves algebraic cancellation of the nuisance biases. We prove this restores consistency and asymptotic normality, and ensures Type I error control. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that the proposed test achieves superior size control relative to existing tests while maintaining high power. In an empirical application to the NSW job training program, the test detects significant heterogeneity that traditional nonparametric tests fail to uncover.
tldr: 提出一种非参数假设检验方法，用于检测条件平均处理效应的异质性，通过新颖的样本分割算法解决推断难题，并应用于就业培训项目评估。
abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种用于检验异质性处理效应是否存在稳健非参数假设检验方法。我们将条件平均处理效应（Conditional Average Treatment Effect, CATE）的方差作为自然的综合参数，其非零方差意味着存在相关异质性。针对该参数的统计推断面临一个根本性理论挑战：一方面，在同一份样本上评估方差成分会导致零退化问题，即在同质性原假设下渐近方差趋近于零，从而使标准高斯推断失效；另一方面，通过标准样本分割解耦经验过程会破坏双重稳健得分的奈曼正交性——由于其非线性平方损失函数，一阶正则化偏差无法相互抵消。为解决这一难题，我们提出了一种新颖的折内样本分割算法。通过在互不相交的子样本上评估方差成分，同时将其与相同的折外干扰估计量耦合，该算法实现了干扰偏差的代数抵消。我们证明该方法能恢复估计的一致性与渐近正态性，并确保第一类错误率得到控制。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，与现有检验方法相比，所提检验在维持较高统计功效的同时实现了更优的尺寸控制。在对新泽西州职业培训项目的实证应用中，该检验检测到了传统非参数检验未能发现的显著异质性。

title: Econometrics with Pre-Trained Embeddings for Unstructured Data
abstract: Unstructured data, such as images and text, are increasingly used in empirical economics. Since training machine-learning models on unstructured data is costly, economists often use off-the-shelf pre-trained deep learning models developed by computer scientists to extract embeddings, which are then used as covariates in target economic analyses. Despite the popularity of this practice, its theoretical foundations remain limited. There are two main difficulties. First, the pre-trained model is usually trained on a different dataset and for a different task. Consequently, it is unclear when such a model can be used reliably for the target task. Second, the embedding function is subject to an identification problem, which makes it difficult to analyze the estimation error of the embedding function and its effect on the target task. In this paper, we provide sufficient conditions to overcome these difficulties and derive the convergence rate of machine learning models with pre-trained embeddings. We illustrate the theory through double machine learning applications for estimating parameters of interest, such as partially linear regression with unstructured controls, price elasticity in demand estimation considering the product quality measured by images and text, missing data imputation with unstructured data, and the average treatment effect with unstructured confounders.
tldr: 本文为使用预训练深度学习模型提取的嵌入作为协变量进行经济分析提供了理论基础，推导了收敛速度，并通过双重机器学习应用进行说明。
abstract_cn: 非结构化数据（如图像和文本）在实证经济学中的应用日益广泛。由于在非结构化数据上训练机器学习模型成本高昂，经济学家通常使用计算机科学家开发的现成预训练深度学习模型来提取嵌入（embeddings），并将其作为协变量用于目标经济分析。尽管这种做法十分普遍，但其理论基础仍较为有限，主要存在两大难点：其一，预训练模型通常基于不同的数据集和任务进行训练，因此难以确定此类模型能否可靠地应用于目标任务；其二，嵌入函数面临识别问题（identification problem），这使得分析嵌入函数的估计误差及其对目标任务的影响变得困难。本文针对上述难点提供了充分条件，并推导了使用预训练嵌入的机器学习模型的收敛速度。我们通过双重机器学习（double machine learning）应用实例来阐释该理论，这些实例涉及参数估计，例如包含非结构化控制变量的部分线性回归、考虑图像和文本所衡量产品质量的需求估计中的价格弹性、基于非结构化数据的缺失值插补，以及存在非结构化混杂变量的平均处理效应估计。

title: Two Gaussians, Too Many: A bootstrap-based approach to assess identifiability in non-Gaussian structural Vector Autoregressions
abstract: Standard pre-tests of normality on reduced-form innovations are insufficient to detect two or more Gaussian shocks and hence, the failure of identification in non-Gaussian SVARs. We instead propose a bootstrap-based approach to evaluate the asymptotic validity of this condition by measuring the divergence between the conditional bootstrap distribution of a maximum likelihood estimator and its limiting distribution under valid identification. We show that, under valid identification and certain regularity conditions, the conditional bootstrap distribution of the impact matrix is asymptotically normal, so the diagnostic reduces to a test of normality of the bootstrap replications. The diagnostic remains valid in the single-Gaussian case, where the shape parameter of the Gaussian shock lies on the boundary, and the full-parameter information is singular; this establishes its validity across the entire null. Under the null of valid identification, the diagnostic induces no pre-testing bias as bootstrap replications and sample size diverge jointly at an appropriate rate. The joint divergence ensures that the test statistic, conditional on the data, is asymptotically pivotal, so conditioning on the diagnostic does not distort subsequent inference. Monte Carlo simulations with Normal-Inverse Gaussian shocks show that the diagnostic attains near-exact nominal size under valid identification and detects the failure due to multiple Gaussian shocks with power increasing in the sample size. Under weak identification with a near-Gaussian shock, conditioning on the bootstrap diagnostic, unlike on residual-based normality pre-tests, preserves the probability coverage of the estimates. Based on estimates of a SVAR model in the macroeconomic and financial uncertainty literature, we demonstrate its potential as a practical, robust tool for validating non-Gaussian identification without pre-testing bias.
tldr: 提出一种bootstrap方法检验非高斯SVAR中多个高斯冲击导致的可识别性问题，通过条件bootstrap分布的正态性检验来诊断，避免预检验偏误。
abstract_cn: 对简化型新息的正态性标准预检验不足以检测两个或多个高斯冲击，因此也无法识别非高斯结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型中的识别失效问题。为此，我们提出一种基于自助法的方法，通过测量最大似然估计量的条件自助分布与其在有效识别下的极限分布之间的差异，来评估该条件的渐近有效性。我们证明，在有效识别及某些正则条件下，冲击矩阵的条件自助分布是渐近正态的，因此该诊断方法可简化为对自助复制结果的正态性检验。该诊断方法在单高斯冲击情形下仍然有效，此时高斯冲击的形状参数位于边界，且全参数信息是奇异的；这确立了该方法在整个原假设下的有效性。在有效识别的原假设下，当自助复制次数与样本量以适当速率联合发散时，该诊断方法不会引入预检验偏误。这种联合发散确保了基于数据的检验统计量是渐近枢轴的，因此以该诊断方法为条件不会扭曲后续推断。基于正态逆高斯冲击的蒙特卡洛模拟表明，在有效识别下，该诊断方法能达到近乎精确的名义水平，并能检测出因多个高斯冲击导致的识别失效，且检验功效随样本量增加而增强。在弱识别且冲击接近高斯分布的情况下，与基于残差的正态性预检验不同，以自助法诊断结果为条件能够保持估计量的概率覆盖。基于宏观经济与金融不确定性文献中SVAR模型的估计结果，我们展示了该方法作为稳健实用工具在验证非高斯识别方面的潜力，且不会引入预检验偏误。

title: Compositional Synthetic Controls
abstract: This paper develops a synthetic control estimator for compositional outcomes, vectors of shares generated by an underlying categorical process. Derived from a random utility model with interactive fixed effects on relative systematic utilities, the estimator maps compositions to log-odds, where the standard convex hull condition identifies the counterfactual as a convex combination of donor log-odds. Equivalently, it recovers the Fréchet barycenter under the Aitchison metric, the canonical geometry of the simplex (the non-linear space of shares) using a single set of weights across all categories. I also developed a placebo inference procedure based on the Aitchison distance. An application to Pennsylvania's electricity generation mix following the Alternative Energy Portfolio Standard uncovers a large and persistent compositional shift: natural gas exceeds its counterfactual by nearly 60 percentage points by 2022, while renewables lose relative ground.
tldr: 本文开发了组合合成控制方法，用于估计政策对份额向量的因果效应，并以宾夕法尼亚州电力结构为例，发现天然气份额大幅上升。
abstract_cn: 本文针对成分型结果（即由底层分类过程生成的份额向量）开发了一种合成控制估计量。该估计量源自一个具有交互固定效应的随机效用模型（作用于相对系统效用），将成分映射为对数几率，其中标准凸包条件将反事实识别为捐赠者对数几率的凸组合。等价地，该估计量在艾奇逊度量（单纯形——即份额的非线性空间——的典型几何结构）下恢复弗雷歇重心，且对所有类别使用单一权重集。我还基于艾奇逊距离开发了一种安慰剂推断程序。将该方法应用于宾夕法尼亚州在《替代能源组合标准》实施后的发电结构，发现了一个显著且持续的成分转变：截至2022年，天然气超出其反事实水平近60个百分点，而可再生能源的相对占比则有所下降。

title: When and How to Pilot: Design Rules for Two-Wave Experiments
abstract: Experimenters often run pilots, but how much a small pilot should shape the main-wave design has no settled answer. This paper shows how noisy pilot evidence should guide treatment assignment probabilities in two-wave experiments. Two canonical rules mark the extremes. Balanced assignment guards against worst cases but ignores evidence that one arm is noisier. Feasible Neyman allocation adapts, but with a finite pilot it can overreact to noise, producing arbitrarily large precision losses. We propose a Conditional Minimax Regret (CMR) rule that minimizes worst-case regret over a finite-sample confidence set for the treatment and control variances. CMR retains balance's worst-case protection with high probability, converges to the Neyman allocation as the pilot grows, and attains the minimax-regret rate up to constants. It extends to multi-arm and stratified designs, and simulations calibrated to four field experiments show it avoids feasible Neyman's severe small-pilot losses while capturing most of its large-pilot gains.
tldr: 本文提出条件最小最大遗憾（CMR）规则，用于指导两波实验中基于有限样本的分配概率设计，平衡了平衡分配和Neyman分配的优缺点。
abstract_cn: 实验者经常进行预实验，但小规模预实验应在多大程度上影响主实验设计尚无定论。本文展示了在两波实验中，有噪声的预实验证据应如何指导处理分配概率。两种经典规则代表了极端情况。平衡分配可防范最坏情况，但忽略了某一实验组噪声更大的证据。可行的内曼分配具有适应性，但在预实验样本有限时可能对噪声反应过度，导致任意大的精度损失。我们提出一种条件极小化极大遗憾（Conditional Minimax Regret, CMR）规则，该规则在针对处理组和对照组方差构建的有限样本置信集上最小化最坏情况遗憾。CMR以高概率保留平衡分配的最坏情况保护能力，随着预实验规模增大而收敛至内曼分配，并以常数倍达到极小化极大遗憾率。该方法可扩展至多臂和分层设计，基于四项实地实验校准的模拟表明，它避免了可行内曼分配在预实验规模较小时产生的严重损失，同时捕获了其在预实验规模较大时的大部分收益。

title: Kernel Minimum Distance Estimation and Testing with Conditional Moment Restrictions: A Unified Framework
abstract: We propose a unified Kernel Minimum Distance (KMD) framework for estimating and testing models defined by conditional moment restrictions. By embedding conditional moments into a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS), we construct a closed-form $V$-statistic objective function that quantifies the distance from the restrictions. We establish the $\sqrt{n}$-consistency and asymptotic normality of the associated minimum distance estimator. Within this framework, the minimized objective function naturally yields a consistent omnibus specification test. Unlike projection-based methods that require auxiliary nonparametric estimation for Neyman orthogonalization, our test inherently captures the estimation effect via a projected kernel structure. We derive asymptotic properties of the test statistics under the null hypothesis, the alternative hypothesis, and a sequence of local alternatives converging to the null at the parametric rate $n^{-1/2}$. The validity of a computationally simple multiplier bootstrap is established to facilitate inference. Simulation results demonstrate robust finite-sample performance, and the framework is illustrated by analyzing Engel curves using UK Family Expenditure Survey data.
tldr: 提出统一的核最小距离框架，用于条件矩限制模型的估计和检验，并建立渐近性质。

title: 1-out-of-5 Maximin-Share Allocations Always Exist for Four Agents
abstract: For four agents with nonnegative additive valuations, a complete 1-out-of-5 maximin-share allocation always exists, improving the previous 1-out-of-6 guarantee. Together with known exact-MMS counterexamples, this completely characterizes the four-agent case: the guarantee holds exactly for $d\geq5$. The main technical contribution is a balanced-residual partition lemma: removing rejected bundles with one of the four highest-ranked goods apiece leaves a remainder that still admits the required number of unit-valued balanced bundles. In its central $2+2$ case, three unit bundles repair two pairs of colliding high-valued goods. The theorem is machine-checked in Lean 4.
tldr: 本文证明对于四个具有可加性非负估值的代理人，总是存在一个1-out-of-5最大最小份额分配，改进了之前的1-out-of-6保证，并通过Lean 4进行了机器验证。

title: Equilibrium Play Without Mutual Knowledge of Rationality
abstract: Equilibrium play in two-player zero-sum games is usually justified via epistemic assumptions, such as mutual knowledge of rationality and beliefs, that go far beyond the rationality of the players. We propose a justification that dispenses with these assumptions. To this end, we consider solution concepts that assign to every subgame of a given game a set of plausible actions for each player, and we impose two conditions. Rationality requires that the plausible sets are supports of undominated strategies or, equivalently, that all plausible actions are best responses to a common belief about the opponent. Inheritance requires that plausible actions remain plausible when implausible actions are discarded. In two-player games, the two conditions characterize the solution concepts that consistently select supports of Nash equilibria. Zero-sum payoffs ensure that Nash equilibria -- and hence the selection -- are generically unique. Equilibrium play thus emerges from individual rationality and the mutual understanding that plausibility judgments persist when implausible actions are discarded.
tldr: 该论文从博弈论角度证明，在两人零和博弈中，仅凭个体理性和对合理性判断持续性的共识即可产生均衡行为，无需共同知识假设。
abstract_cn: 两人零和博弈中的均衡行为通常通过认知假设（如理性与信念的共同知识）来论证，这些假设远远超出了博弈参与者的理性范畴。我们提出了一种无需依赖这些假设的论证方式。为此，我们考虑将给定博弈的每个子博弈分配给每个参与者一组合理行动的解概念，并施加两个条件。理性要求合理集合是无占优策略的支持集，或等价地，所有合理行动都是对关于对手的共同信念的最优反应。继承性要求当不合理行动被剔除时，合理行动仍保持合理性。在两人博弈中，这两个条件刻画了一致选择纳什均衡支持集的解概念。零和收益确保了纳什均衡——进而该选择——在一般情形下具有唯一性。因此，均衡行为源于个体理性以及如下相互理解：当不合理行动被剔除时，合理性判断仍持续存在。

title: Observable Consequences of Mental Accounting
abstract: We derive necessary and sufficient nonparametric conditions for several models of mental accounting. The paper characterises pure mental accounting, separable accounts, and labelled income, and compares these boundedly rational models with two rational multi-stage budgeting benchmarks. The resulting Afriat-style conditions make the observable implications of mental accounting explicit and refutable. In this sense, mental accounting is treated not as a loose description of behaviour, but as a formally refutable hypothesis about the organisation of consumption.
tldr: 论文推导心理账户模型的可观测非参数条件，将心理账户作为可反驳的消费组织假说进行检验。
abstract_cn: 本文推导了心理账户（mental accounting）若干模型的必要且充分的非参数条件。论文刻画了纯心理账户（pure mental accounting）、可分离账户（separable accounts）以及标签收入（labelled income），并将这些有限理性模型与两个理性的多阶段预算基准（multi-stage budgeting benchmarks）进行了比较。由此得到的阿弗里亚特式（Afriat-style）条件使得心理账户的可观测含义变得明确且可证伪。在此意义上，心理账户不再被视为对行为的松散描述，而是作为一种关于消费组织的、形式上可证伪的假说。

title: Belief Identification in Populations
abstract: We study the identification of belief distributions in a population of Bayesian agents from anonymous aggregate belief data. While a single Bayesian agent's full belief can be recovered from beliefs over a suitable collection of binary events, this principle need not extend to populations: event-by-event distributions of beliefs may fail to identify the underlying distribution of priors. We study when this failure is generic and when it is exceptional. Identification is governed by the graph-theoretic structure induced by the observed family of events on the state space. Among $n$-agent distributions, identification is generic if the induced graph is nonseparable, while non-identification is generic if the graph is separable. The results establish both limits and design principles for recovering belief heterogeneity from aggregate belief data.
tldr: 本文研究从匿名聚合信念数据中识别贝叶斯主体信念分布的条件，利用图论分析识别的一般性与特殊性。
abstract_cn: 我们研究如何从匿名的总体信念数据中识别贝叶斯主体群体中的信念分布。尽管单个贝叶斯主体的完整信念可以通过其对一组适当的二元事件（binary events）的信念来恢复，但这一原理未必适用于群体：逐事件的信念分布可能无法识别潜在的先验分布。我们研究了这种失效是普遍存在还是仅在特殊情况下发生。识别能力取决于所观测的事件族在状态空间上诱导的图论结构。在$n$个主体的分布中，若诱导图是不可分离的（nonseparable），则识别是普遍的；若图是可分离的（separable），则非识别是普遍的。这些结果既确立了从总体信念数据中恢复信念异质性的局限性，也提供了相应的设计原则。

title: Rationalizing Boltzmann Rationality: An Axiomatic Characterization of Entropy-Regularized Policies
abstract: The softmax policy $π(a \mid s) \propto \exp(βQ(s,a))$ is the default model of stochastic choice in reinforcement learning (RL). Various justifications based on robustness, exploration, and optimization have been offered in the RL literature, but none uniquely derives the softmax form from first principles. This leaves a basic tension unresolved: the entropy bonus in the soft Bellman equation violates the Independence axiom that underwrites the Markov decision process (MDP) reward structure. We dissolve this tension by distinguishing two kinds of randomness: chance and choice. By restricting von Neumann-Morgenstern (VNM) Independence to environmental lotteries over base prospects, we show that imposing independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA) and monotonicity on the policy and value functions at choice nodes uniquely determines the Boltzmann policy, the entropy-regularized representation, and the soft Bellman equation. The choice between the soft and hard Bellman equations thus reduces to a design decision: whether the agent values its own ability to choose. We develop RL-specific consequences, including return monotonicity and convergence under generalized discounting, and synthesize the independent lines from economics and information theory that arrive at the same structure, offering a normative assessment of when IIA is appropriate for agent design.
tldr: 论文从公理角度推导出强化学习中的软max策略（Boltzmann策略）和熵正则化表示，区分环境随机性与选择随机性，并讨论IIA公理在智能体设计中的适用性。
abstract_cn: 软最大化策略$π(a \mid s) \propto \exp(βQ(s,a))$是强化学习（RL）中随机选择的默认模型。RL文献中基于鲁棒性、探索和优化等方面提出了多种论证，但均未从第一性原理唯一推导出软最大化形式。这留下了一个基本矛盾：软贝尔曼方程中的熵奖励项违反了支撑马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）奖励结构的独立性公理。我们通过区分两种随机性——偶然性与选择性——来消解这一矛盾。通过将冯·诺依曼-摩根斯坦（VNM）独立性公理限制在基础前景的环境抽奖上，我们证明，在选择节点处对策略函数与价值函数施加无关选项独立性（IIA）和单调性，可唯一确定玻尔兹曼策略、熵正则化表示以及软贝尔曼方程。因此，软贝尔曼方程与硬贝尔曼方程之间的选择可归结为一个设计决策：智能体是否珍视自身的选择能力。我们推导了RL特有的推论，包括广义折扣下的收益单调性与收敛性，并综合了经济学与信息论中得出相同结构的独立研究路线，从而为IIA何时适用于智能体设计提供了规范性评估。

title: Organization Design for Complex Worlds
abstract: I study the role of \emph{horizontal complexity} -- defined as the variation in actions that similar tasks require -- in organization design. A continuum of workers each choose an action to adapt to a local state that follows a Gaussian process across locations. Headquarters can group workers into \emph{teams}, simplifying the attention problem it faces in coordinating across the organization, at the cost of inhibiting adaptation. Tools from spectral theory identify how horizontal complexity affects team size: roughly speaking, variation left unresolved by headquarters expands teams, while variation concentrated along dimensions that headquarters absorbs through attention shrinks them.
tldr: 研究水平复杂性如何影响组织设计中的团队规模，利用谱理论分析。
abstract_cn: 本文研究“横向复杂性”（horizontal complexity）——即相似任务所需行动的变化——在组织设计中的作用。一个连续统的工人各自选择行动以适应遵循高斯过程（Gaussian process）的局部状态。总部可以将工人分组为“团队”（teams），从而简化其在协调整个组织时所面临的注意力问题，但代价是抑制了适应性。利用谱理论（spectral theory）的工具，本文揭示了横向复杂性如何影响团队规模：大致而言，总部未解决的变化会扩大团队规模，而总部通过注意力吸收的、集中于某些维度的变化则会缩小团队规模。

title: When Pricing Agents Meet Buying Agents: Personalized Pricing and Verifiable Trust
abstract: Same fairness rule, different posterior, no trade. We study personalized pricing when seller and buyer principals delegate to agents that receive different value signals and execute machine-enforced mandates. Equal nominal surplus rules can be incompatible because each is applied to its agent's posterior. In one common environment, we solve nested pricing, inspection, mandate-selection, and repeated-relationship subgames. Signal attestation and execution attestation have different effects: evidence of a high seller signal can legitimate a high price, whereas evidence of a restrained rule can prevent unauthorized extraction. Verification can recover trade and soften both principals' policies only when it covers the disputed proposition. In repeated transactions, attributable offers above a buyer's reference cap depreciate relationship capital, producing a state-dependent Markov policy and a reference-respecting region. Verification is privately underprovided when the seller does not internalize avoided buyer inspection and relationship spillovers, but can be overprovided when it facilitates extraction. The model links AI measurement, algorithmic extraction, and verifiable restraint without treating trust as software emotion or verified execution as proof of true value.
tldr: 研究卖方和买方代理人基于不同信号执行个性化定价时的信任与验证问题，通过博弈论分析信号认证、执行认证及重复交易中的参考价格效应。
abstract_cn: 相同的公平规则，不同的后验信念，无交易。我们研究了当卖方和买方委托人将决策权委托给接收不同价值信号并执行机器强制执行指令的代理人时的个性化定价问题。等额名义剩余规则可能不相容，因为每条规则都适用于其代理人的后验信念。在一个常见环境中，我们求解了嵌套定价、检查、指令选择以及重复关系子博弈。信号认证与执行认证具有不同效果：卖方高信号的证据可以使高价格合法化，而受约束规则的证据则可以防止未经授权的攫取。只有当验证涵盖争议命题时，它才能恢复交易并缓和双方委托人的策略。在重复交易中，超出买方参考上限的可归因报价会损耗关系资本，从而产生状态依赖的马尔可夫策略以及一个尊重参考的区域。当卖方未内化买方避免的检查成本及关系溢出效应时，验证在私人层面供给不足；但当验证有助于攫取时，则可能供给过度。该模型将人工智能测量、算法攫取与可验证约束联系起来，而无需将信任视为软件情感，或将已验证的执行视为真实价值的证明。

title: Determining Insolvency Regions in Banks: A Stochastic Dynamic Approach Integrating Liquidity and Credit Risk
abstract: We develop a continuous-time structural dynamic model to determine the exact insolvency regions of banks arising from the non-linear interaction between liquidity and credit risk. While existing literature predominantly treats these risks in isolation or via reduced-form specifications, we explicitly model the feedback loop where funding shocks and regulatory constraints force balance-sheet adjustments that can lead to endogenous insolvency. By incorporating Basel III regulatory requirements (LCR and NSFR) into a stochastic optimal control framework, we solve for the exact insolvency boundary using the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation. To bridge the gap between theoretical complexity and supervisory practice, we derive and validate a surrogate analytical approximation function that allows for real-time monitoring. Calibrated using granular balance-sheet data from the Iranian banking sector, our model reveals significant non-linear threshold effects: the joint occurrence of liquidity stress and credit portfolio defaults disproportionately accelerates the transition toward insolvency compared to their individual effects. The proposed surrogate function offers supervisors a computationally efficient tool for stress testing and early warning systems. Our findings provide novel insights into financial frictions in emerging markets and offer a rigorous framework for integrated risk management.
tldr: 构建连续时间结构模型，通过HJB方程求解银行破产边界，并推导近似函数用于实时监控，校准于伊朗银行业数据，揭示流动性风险与信用风险的非线性交互效应。
abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个连续时间结构动态模型，以确定由流动性与信用风险之间非线性相互作用所引发的银行确切破产区域。现有文献主要将这些风险孤立处理或采用简化形式进行刻画，而我们则明确建模了融资冲击与监管约束迫使资产负债表调整、进而导致内生性破产的反馈循环。通过将巴塞尔III监管要求（流动性覆盖率LCR和净稳定资金比率NSFR）纳入随机最优控制框架，我们利用汉密尔顿-雅可比-贝尔曼（HJB）方程求解出确切的破产边界。为弥合理论复杂性与监管实践之间的差距，我们推导并验证了一个替代性解析近似函数，该函数可实现实时监测。利用伊朗银行业部门的细颗粒度资产负债表数据进行校准后，我们的模型揭示了显著的非线性阈值效应：相较于流动性压力与信贷组合违约的单独影响，两者的共同发生会不成比例地加速向破产状态的转变。所提出的替代函数为监管机构开展压力测试与构建早期预警系统提供了一种计算高效的实用工具。我们的研究结果为理解新兴市场的金融摩擦提供了新见解，并为整合风险管理构建了一个严谨的分析框架。

analysis.chinese_title: 确定银行破产区域：整合流动性与信用风险的随机动态方法
analysis.summary: 本文构建了一个连续时间结构动态模型，以确定由流动性与信用风险非线性相互作用导致的银行破产区域。现有文献通常孤立或通过简化形式处理这两种风险，而本文明确建模了反馈循环：融资冲击和监管约束迫使资产负债表调整，进而导致内生性破产。通过将巴塞尔III监管要求（LCR和NSFR）纳入随机最优控制框架，利用Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程求解精确破产边界。为弥合理论复杂性与监管实践之间的差距，推导并验证了一个替代解析近似函数，可实现实时监控。使用伊朗银行业的面板数据进行校准，模型揭示了显著的非线性阈值效应：流动性压力与信用组合违约的联合发生相比单独效应会不成比例地加速破产进程。该替代函数为监管者提供了压力测试和早期预警系统的计算高效工具。
innovations: 构建了微观基础的连续时间结构模型，内生化了巴塞尔III约束下流动性与信用风险的相互作用。
推导了精确的状态依赖破产边界，证明银行失败阈值不是固定资本比率，而是流动性和信用风险状态的动态函数。
提出了替代解析近似函数，弥合了复杂随机控制理论与实际监管之间的差距，支持实时压力测试。
将模型校准至伊朗银行业（2022-2023年）的独特制度背景，验证了模型对高不良贷款和流动性波动期间银行韧性或失败的解释力。
analysis.methodology: 采用连续时间随机控制框架，将银行管理问题建模为受巴塞尔III约束（LCR和NSFR）的最优控制问题。状态变量（流动性风险λ和信用风险d）遵循相关几何布朗运动，并引入内生反馈机制（资产清算影响信用风险）。通过HJB方程求解值函数，利用对数效用函数和猜想解简化，得到非线性偏微分方程。数值求解精确破产边界，并通过非线性最小二乘法估计替代函数参数。
key_results: 破产边界在(λ, d)平面上是凸的，表明联合风险比单独风险之和更危险。
替代函数f(λ, d)的AUC为0.972，假阴性率低于1.5%，适合作为早期预警系统。
敏感性分析表明，流动性-信用相关性ρ_LC增加会使边界更凸并向内移动，流动性波动σ_λ扩大边界。
压力测试显示，联合冲击（如制裁冲击和流动性挤兑）比单独冲击更危险，且NSFR约束触发内生资产抛售是破产的关键机制。
strengths: 理论创新：首次在连续时间结构模型中内生整合流动性与信用风险，并考虑巴塞尔III约束。
实践价值：提供了替代解析函数，便于监管实时应用。
实证校准：使用伊朗银行业数据，验证了模型在新兴市场的适用性。
稳健性：对关键参数（相关性、波动性、效用函数）进行了敏感性分析，结果稳定。
limitations: 实证分析依赖CODAL系统报告数据，可能存在报告滞后或会计差异导致的测量误差。
模型考虑单一代表性银行，忽略了银行间关联和传染效应。
流动性冲击被建模为外生过程，未内生化解户提款行为。
模型假设完全合规，未考虑监管套利或临时违规行为。

title: Robust Control for Marked Point Processes under Transition-Rate Uncertainty
abstract: We consider a novel robust utility maximisation problem under bounded cumulative transition rate uncertainty within the class of non-Markovian marked point processes on a finite state-space. Utility is maximised over the class of admissible controls, while Nature chooses a worst-case biometric scenario from the class of admissible, path-dependent cumulative transition rates restricted by path-dependent upper and lower bounds. We prove a martingale optimality principle and a novel existence and uniqueness result for a non-standard worst-case backwards stochastic differential equation, which allows us to establish existence and uniqueness of worst-case and best-case prospective reserves of life and health insurance contracts with reserve-dependent payments. Finally, we find an explicit solution of a novel robust consumption-insurance problem with power utility preferences.
tldr: 论文提出在非马尔可夫标记点过程下，考虑转移率不确定性的鲁棒效用最大化问题，并应用于保险合同的储备金计算。
abstract_cn: 我们考虑在有限状态空间上的非马尔可夫标记点过程类中，受有界累积转移率不确定性约束的一类新型鲁棒效用最大化问题。效用函数在可容许控制类上最大化，而自然（Nature）则从受路径依赖上下界约束的可容许路径依赖累积转移率类中选择最坏情况的生物统计情景。我们证明了一个鞅最优性原理，以及一类非标准最坏情况倒向随机微分方程的存在唯一性新结果，这使得我们能够建立具有准备金依赖支付的人寿与健康保险合同的最坏情况与最佳情况预期准备金的存在唯一性。最后，我们找到了具有幂效用偏好的一类新型鲁棒消费-保险问题的显式解。

title: The conditional higher moment risk measure: second-order asymptotics with FGM contagion
abstract: This paper investigates second-order asymptotic expansions for the conditional higher moment (CoHM) coherent risk measure under a Farlie-Gumbel-Morgenstern (FGM) dependence structure, capturing a weak contagion between a primary loss risk and a reference risk. Assuming that the primary risk belongs to the Fréchet, Weibull, or Gumbel maximum domain of attraction, we systematically derive second-order asymptotic expansions using extreme value theory and second-order regular variation theory. Compared with existing first-order results, our refined approximations capture higher-order tail behavior and dependence effects more accurately. Numerical simulations confirm that the second-order asymptotics substantially reduce approximation errors, especially at extreme confidence levels. Empirical applications to insurance claim data further illustrate the practical superiority of the second-order approach.
tldr: 本文推导了FGM相依结构下条件高阶矩风险测度的二阶渐近展开，通过极值理论提高尾部风险估计精度，并应用于保险索赔数据。
abstract_cn: 本文研究了在Farlie-Gumbel-Morgenstern（FGM）相依结构下条件高阶矩（CoHM）一致性风险测度的二阶渐近展开，该结构捕捉了主要损失风险与参考风险之间的弱传染效应。假设主要风险属于Fréchet、Weibull或Gumbel最大吸引域，我们利用极值理论和二阶正则变化理论系统推导了其二阶渐近展开。与现有的一阶结果相比，本文的精细化近似能够更准确地捕捉高阶尾部行为及相依效应。数值模拟证实，二阶渐近方法显著降低了近似误差，尤其在极端置信水平下。基于保险索赔数据的实证应用进一步展示了二阶方法在实际中的优越性。

title: A Practical Guide to Simulating Correlated Binary Outcomes
abstract: Simulating dependent Bernoulli outcomes with prescribed means and pairwise Pearson correlations is a common task in risk modeling. A familiar approach is the Gaussian-threshold workflow for binary outcomes, often viewed as a Bernoulli analogue of the Gaussian copula construction. We show that setting latent Gaussian correlations equal to target Bernoulli correlations is generally incorrect after thresholding, and that pairwise tetrachoric calibration is exact only when the calibrated latent matrix is positive semidefinite. We therefore formulate the problem directly over the joint Bernoulli probability mass function. Given target means and pairwise correlations, we impose normalization, nonnegativity, mean constraints, and pairwise cross-moment constraints as a linear program over the $2^N$ atomic probabilities. The resulting PMF formulation either returns an exact law matching the requested first and second moments or certifies infeasibility. A convex-hull characterization further shows that every feasible target admits a law supported on at most $1+N+\binom{N}{2}$ states, while every infeasible target admits a separating quadratic certificate. We then develop a truncated-moment completion scheme that fits a reduced cross-moment table and generates samples by sequential conditioning, together with a sparse-support working-set refinement that can reduce memory usage on structured instances, although the worst-case complexity remains exponential. Together, these constructions provide an exact PMF-based framework for feasibility and simulation at moderate dimension and structured alternatives when the full atomic representation is impractical, while clarifying the limits of Gaussian-threshold constructions.
tldr: 提出一种基于线性规划和截断矩的框架，用于模拟具有指定均值和Pearson相关性的二元结果，并证明高斯阈值方法的局限性。
abstract_cn: 模拟具有指定均值和两两Pearson相关性的相依伯努利结果是风险建模中的常见任务。一种常见的方法是针对二元结果的高斯阈值工作流程，通常被视为高斯连接函数构造的伯努利类比。我们证明，在阈值化后，将潜在高斯相关性设定为目标伯努利相关性通常是不正确的，并且两两四分相关校准仅在校准后的潜在矩阵为半正定时才是精确的。因此，我们直接在联合伯努利概率质量函数上表述该问题。给定目标均值和两两相关性，我们将归一化、非负性、均值约束以及两两交叉矩约束作为一个线性规划施加于$2^N$个原子概率上。由此得到的PMF公式要么返回一个与所要求的一阶和二阶矩精确匹配的分布律，要么证明其不可行。进一步地，一个凸包刻画表明，每个可行的目标都存在一个最多支持$1+N+\binom{N}{2}$个状态的分布律，而每个不可行的目标都存在一个分离的二次证书。随后，我们开发了一种截断矩补全方案，该方案拟合一个缩减的交叉矩表并通过序贯条件生成样本，同时结合一种稀疏支持工作集细化方法，可在结构化实例上减少内存使用，尽管最坏情况下的复杂度仍为指数级。综合来看，这些构造提供了一个基于PMF的精确框架，用于在中等维度和全原子表示不可行时的结构化替代方案中进行可行性判断与模拟，同时阐明了高斯阈值构造的局限性。

title: Credit Risk Identification and Loan Portfolio Quality in Uganda’s Commercial Banking Sector: The Moderating Effect of Adverse Selection
abstract: The study examines the moderating effect of credit risk identification and profiling on loan portfolio quality in Uganda’s Commercial Banking Sector by focusing on a survey of selected banks. Guided by a pragmatic philosophy blending both qualitative and quantitative approaches, the study adopted a cross-sectional survey design on a sample of 207 participants drawn from a population of 427 across 12 departments within 7 commercial banks. Quantitative data were sought using a self–administered questionnaire from 204 participants, while qualitative data were collected using an interview guide from 3 key informants. Quantitative data were processed using SPSS (Version 25) and exported to JASP version 0.19.30 software to perform factor analysis and run Structural Equation Models (SEM). Data analysis was done using SEM regression for the direct relations, while Hierarchical Moderated Multiple Regression analysis was employed to examine the moderating effect of adverse selection on credit risk identification and loan portfolio quality. Study findings indicate that Credit risk identification significantly predicted loan portfolio quality before and after moderation with adverse selection. In particular, CRI showed a prediction power of β = 0.271, p<0.05 before moderation with adverse selection. Upon moderation, results indicate that adverse selection significantly moderated the effect of Credit risk identification and profiling on loan portfolio quality in commercial banks with interaction terms of CRI×ADS = -0.353, p<0.01. The study concludes that Credit risk identification and profiling significantly predicted loan portfolio quality and that adverse selection significantly moderates the effect of credit risk identification on loan portfolio quality. The study recommends that commercial banks should intensify efforts and tactics employed in underwriting loans, especially at the inception of the loan process.

tldr: 该研究通过调查乌干达商业银行，使用结构方程模型和层次调节回归，发现信用风险识别显著预测贷款组合质量，且逆向选择负向调节该关系。
abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了信用风险识别与画像对乌干达商业银行部门贷款组合质量的调节效应，重点关注对特定银行的调查。研究遵循融合定性与定量方法的实用主义哲学，采用横截面调查设计，样本涵盖7家商业银行12个部门共427名总体中的207名参与者。定量数据通过自填问卷从204名参与者处获取，定性数据则采用访谈提纲从3名关键知情人处收集。定量数据使用SPSS（版本25）进行处理，并导入JASP 0.19.30软件进行因子分析及结构方程模型（SEM）运算。数据分析中，直接关系采用SEM回归分析，而逆向选择对信用风险识别与贷款组合质量的调节效应则通过分层调节多元回归分析进行检验。研究结果表明：在逆向选择调节前后，信用风险识别均能显著预测贷款组合质量。具体而言，在逆向选择调节前，信用风险识别（CRI）的预测力为β=0.271，p<0.05；调节后，结果显示逆向选择显著调节了信用风险识别与画像对商业银行贷款组合质量的影响，其交互项CRI×ADS的系数为-0.353，p<0.01。研究结论认为，信用风险识别与画像能显著预测贷款组合质量，且逆向选择显著调节信用风险识别对贷款组合质量的影响。研究建议商业银行应强化贷款承销环节的策略与措施，尤其是在贷款流程的初始阶段。

title: Cheap Energy Might Not Be Enough : A Trade Model of AI Compute Services
abstract: Can energy-rich developing countries convert cheap electricity into AI compute exports? This paper develops a capacity-constrained trade model of AI compute services with bilateral frictions in delivery, regulation, and trust. Calibrating the model across 85 countries shows that several developing economies can produce compute at low cost, but this advantage rarely becomes export competitiveness. Because hardware dominates unit costs and is globally priced, cross-country production costs differ by only 12–20 percent. Modest regulatory, financing, and trust frictions can therefore erase the gains from cheap power. The binding constraint is institutional credibility rather than electricity prices, including enforceable data governance, stable regulation, credible power contracts, access to finance, and geopolitical alignment with buyers.
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
tldr: 构建了一个容量受限的AI计算服务贸易模型，发现能源成本优势不足以转化为出口竞争力，因为硬件成本主导且全球定价，而监管和信任摩擦是关键约束。
abstract_cn: 能源丰富的发展中国家能否将廉价电力转化为人工智能算力出口？本文构建了一个包含交付、监管和信任双边摩擦的人工智能算力服务产能约束贸易模型。通过对85个国家的模型校准发现，多个发展中经济体能够以低成本生产算力，但这种优势很少能转化为出口竞争力。由于硬件成本占单位成本主导地位且实行全球统一定价，各国生产成本差异仅为12%-20%。因此，适度的监管、融资和信任摩擦足以抵消廉价电力带来的收益。制约发展的关键约束在于制度可信度而非电价，具体包括：可执行的数据治理、稳定的监管环境、可信的电力合同、融资渠道以及与购买方的地缘政治一致性。

title: Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture : Public Debt and Central Banks — The World Bank Group ABCDE Conference
abstract: This paper, based on the Stanley Fischer Memorial Lecture that the author delivered at the Annual Bank Conference on Development Economics (ABCDE) 2026, examines two structural impediments to broad-based economic development: dysfunctional central bank currency systems and inadequately resolved sovereign debt burdens. On currency, the paper argues that floating exchange rate regimes and multiple exchange rate systems—as practiced in countries such as Ethiopia, Nigeria, and Egypt—systematically transfer wealth from low-income wage earners to a narrow-privileged class, deepening poverty rather than alleviating it. Using Ethiopia as a central case study, the paper documents how successive devaluations have raised the national poverty rate from 33 percent in 2016 to a projected 43 percent by 2025, while eroding the real value of development assistance disbursed in local currency. The paper proposes that currency stabilization, low-cost digital payment infrastructure, and unsterilized central bank intervention offer a more direct path to rising median incomes than current IMF-endorsed exchange rate flexibility. On sovereign debt, the paper evaluates the performance of the G20 Common Framework and the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable against the benchmark of the 1989 Brady Plan, finding that contemporary frameworks have generated intensive creditor engagement but minimal net present value reduction for debtor countries. Key failures identified include the absence of a single comparable discount rate for measuring debt relief, incomplete participation by China and commercial creditors, growing opacity in collateralized sovereign transactions, and the risks posed by value recovery instruments to the durability of restructuring agreements. The paper concludes that neither the Common Framework nor the Global Sovereign Debt Roundtable, in their current forms, are fit for purpose, and calls for replacement frameworks that prioritize measurable median income gains over creditor accommodation. Absent reforms on both fronts, per capita income growth in low-income developing economies is projected to remain at approximately 2 percent annually, leaving 5.6 billion people with incomes less than one-tenth of those in advanced economies and widening the global development gap.
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
tldr: 论文基于Stanley Fischer纪念讲座，分析阻碍经济发展的两个结构性障碍：功能失调的中央银行货币体系（如浮动汇率导致财富转移）和未充分解决的主权债务负担（评估现有债务重组框架的不足），并提出改革建议。
abstract_cn: 本文基于作者在2026年发展经济学年度银行会议（ABCDE）上发表的斯坦利·费希尔纪念演讲，探讨了阻碍广泛经济发展的两大结构性障碍：功能失调的中央银行货币体系以及未得到充分解决的主权债务负担。在货币方面，本文认为，浮动汇率制度以及多重汇率体系——如埃塞俄比亚、尼日利亚和埃及等国所实行的做法——系统性地将财富从低收入工薪阶层转移至狭小的特权阶层，从而加深而非缓解贫困。本文以埃塞俄比亚为核心案例，记录了连续贬值如何使该国贫困率从2016年的33%上升至2025年预计的43%，同时侵蚀了以本币支付的发展援助的实际价值。本文提出，相较于当前国际货币基金组织（IMF）所认可的汇率灵活性，货币稳定、低成本数字支付基础设施以及未冲销的中央银行干预措施，为实现收入中位数增长提供了更为直接的路径。在主权债务方面，本文以1989年布雷迪计划为基准，评估了二十国集团（G20）共同框架和全球主权债务圆桌会议的表现，发现当代框架虽然促成了密集的债权人参与，但对债务国带来的净现值减少微乎其微。所识别出的关键失败包括：缺乏衡量债务减免的统一可比贴现率、中国及商业债权人的参与不完整、有担保的主权交易日益不透明，以及价值回收工具对重组协议持久性构成的威胁。本文的结论是，无论是共同框架还是全球主权债务圆桌会议，其当前形式均无法达到预期目标，并呼吁建立以可衡量的收入中位数增长而非债权人让步为核心的替代框架。若在这两方面均不进行改革，低收入发展中经济体的人均收入增长预计将维持在每年约2%的水平，导致56亿人口的收入不足发达经济体的十分之一，从而进一步扩大全球发展差距。

analysis.chinese_title: 斯坦利·费希尔纪念讲座：公共债务与中央银行——世界银行集团ABCDE会议
analysis.summary: 本文基于作者在2026年世界银行ABCDE会议上发表的斯坦利·费希尔纪念讲座，探讨了阻碍广泛经济发展的两个结构性障碍：功能失调的中央银行货币体系和不充分的主权债务负担解决。在货币方面，论文认为浮动汇率制和多重汇率制度（如埃塞俄比亚、尼日利亚和埃及所实行的）系统性地将财富从低收入工薪阶层转移到少数特权阶层，加深了贫困。以埃塞俄比亚为例，论文记录了连续贬值如何使全国贫困率从2016年的33%上升到2025年的预计43%，同时侵蚀了以本币支付的发展援助的实际价值。论文提出，货币稳定、低成本数字支付基础设施和非冲销的中央银行干预比IMF支持的汇率灵活性更能直接提高中位收入。在主權债务方面，论文评估了G20共同框架和全球主权债务圆桌会议的表现，与1989年布雷迪计划相比，发现当代框架产生了密集的债权人参与，但对债务国的净现值减少微乎其微。主要失败包括缺乏单一可比贴现率来衡量债务减免、中国和商业债权人参与不完整、抵押主权交易日益不透明以及价值回收工具对重组协议持久性的风险。论文得出结论，共同框架和全球主权债务圆桌会议目前的形式都不适合其目的，并呼吁建立优先考虑可衡量的中位收入增长而非债权人便利的替代框架。
innovations: 提出浮动汇率和多重汇率制度系统性地将财富从低收入群体转移到特权阶层，加深贫困。
以埃塞俄比亚为案例，详细量化了货币贬值对贫困率和援助实际价值的负面影响。
建议采用非冲销的中央银行干预来打破贬值循环，并以马来西亚1998年稳定计划为例。
批评G20共同框架和全球主权债务圆桌会议缺乏净现值减少效果，提出以单一贴现率衡量债务减免。
指出价值回收工具可能逆转债务减免效果，并呼吁终止现有框架，建立新机制。
analysis.methodology: 本文采用定性分析和案例研究方法，通过埃塞俄比亚、尼日利亚、埃及等国的具体案例，结合历史比较（如布雷迪计划与共同框架的对比），分析货币政策和债务重组框架对贫困和中位收入的影响。论文基于作者在世界银行任职期间的观察和政策经验，引用世界银行、IMF等机构的数据和报告。

title: Regularization and the Formation of Social Capital : Evidence from Forced Migrants in Colombia
abstract: This paper estimates the medium-run effects, 4.5 years after launch, of a regularization program that granted temporary legal status, freedom of movement, work authorization, and access to social programs to nearly half a million Venezuelan forced migrants in Colombia with no criminal record. Because the program was announced unexpectedly and applied retroactively to migrants who had registered in a census before a sharp eligibility cutoff, the paper identifies its effects using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design and a unique two-wave panel survey. The largest medium-run gains were in social capital. At the cutoff, eligible migrants scored 0.95 standard deviation higher than ineligible peers on a social integration index capturing belonging, friendships with Colombians, community participation, and attachment to Colombia, and 0.97 standard deviation higher on a prosocial behavior index measuring generalized trust and trust toward both Colombians and Venezuelans. Neither effect is detectable in the short run, and both emerge only over time. Economic gains, by contrast, arose immediately and largely persisted. Eligible migrants earned 69 percent higher monthly labor income, scored 2.6 standard deviations higher on a service access index, and made substantial investments in housing, with housing quality increasing from 0.60 to 1.27 standard deviations between survey waves. The implied fiscal savings to Colombia also increased over time, rising from roughly 40 to 70 percent of the fiscal cost associated with irregular households as beneficiaries moved toward fiscal balance. These findings suggest that the largest social capital and fiscal returns to regularization accrued gradually through sustained legal inclusion and repeated positive interactions with institutions and host communities rather than through the act of legalization itself.
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
tldr: 利用模糊断点回归估计哥伦比亚合法化项目对委内瑞拉强制移民社会资本和经济结果的长期影响，发现社会资本和财政节约随时间累积。
abstract_cn: 本文评估了一项正规化计划在启动4.5年后的中期效应。该计划向哥伦比亚近50万无犯罪记录的委内瑞拉被迫移民授予了临时法律身份、行动自由、工作许可及社会项目准入权。由于该计划系突然宣布，并追溯适用于在严格资格截止日期前完成人口普查登记的移民，本文采用模糊断点回归设计及独特的两轮面板调查数据识别其效应。中期最大收益体现在社会资本方面。在断点处，符合资格的移民在社会融合指数（衡量归属感、与哥伦比亚人的友谊、社区参与及对哥伦比亚的依恋）上得分比不符合资格的同行高出0.95个标准差，在亲社会行为指数（衡量普遍信任及对哥伦比亚人与委内瑞拉人的信任）上得分高出0.97个标准差。这两种效应在短期内均不可观测，且均随时间推移才显现。相比之下，经济收益立即产生并基本持续存在。符合资格的移民月劳动收入高出69%，在服务获取指数上得分高出2.6个标准差，并在住房方面进行了大量投资，住房质量在两轮调查间从0.60个标准差提升至1.27个标准差。随着受益者趋向财政平衡，哥伦比亚隐含的财政节约也随时间增加，从约占非正规家庭财政成本的40%上升至70%。这些发现表明，正规化带来的最大社会资本与财政回报并非通过合法化行为本身，而是通过持续的法律包容及与制度及东道社区的反复积极互动逐步累积的。

title: Measuring AI innovation with trademark data
abstract: Researchers, managers and policymakers are exploring different approaches and data sources to map the development and the diffusion of Artificial Intelligence (AI). In this research note, we illustrate the opportunities offered by trademark data. We argue that AI trademarks can complement AI patents to capture different dimensions of AI innovation. AI trademarks can reveal the extent and ways in which companies exploit AI technologies to develop new goods and services. Importantly, trademark data offer a timely and globally available data source that covers all economic sectors. We present insights from using AI trademarks in an empirical exploration of Italian firms. In our discussion, we reflect on how AI trademarks can be used at different levels of analysis to tackle emerging questions about the development and diffusion of AI.
tldr: 本文探讨利用商标数据衡量AI创新，并以意大利企业为例进行实证分析。
abstract_cn: 研究人员、管理者及政策制定者正在探索不同的方法与数据源，以描绘人工智能（AI）的发展与扩散。在本研究简报中，我们阐述了商标数据所提供的机遇。我们认为，AI商标能够补充AI专利，从而捕捉AI创新的不同维度。AI商标可以揭示企业利用AI技术开发新商品与服务的程度及方式。重要的是，商标数据作为一种及时且全球可用的数据源，覆盖了所有经济部门。我们展示了在对意大利企业的实证研究中运用AI商标所获得的见解。在讨论中，我们反思了如何在不同分析层面利用AI商标，以应对关于AI发展与扩散的新兴问题。

title: The Price of Quietness: How a Pandemic Affects City Dwellers' Response to Road Traffic Noise
abstract: Using the outbreak of COVID-19 in Singapore as a quasi-natural experiment, we investigate tenants' changing responses to road traffic noise in the rental housing market, using 46,980 transaction records between 2006 and 2022. Our difference-in-differences estimates show that road traffic noise decreases housing rents by 3.8% immediately after the pandemic outbreak and further declines by 12.7% in the subsequent year-equivalent to 186.7 US dollars per month. The results are robust to parallel trend analysis, permutation placebo tests, and tests using alternative distance thresholds or distance to the nearest main road. Then, we adopt a machine learning text analysis of 10,425 rental housing advertisements, showing that tenants' preference for quietness increases by approximately 10% from 2019 into 2020. The new work-from-home business model and rising traffic from delivery services can explain for this pattern. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first paper using a large volume of transaction records to quantify city dwellers' willingness to pay for quietness in the COVID-19 context. Our results have policy implications for other nations and post-pandemic era on the interaction among urban planning, transport networks, and human settlements, and shed light on the pathway to achieve sustainable development goals.
tldr: 利用新加坡COVID-19作为准自然实验，通过DID和机器学习文本分析，研究疫情对租房市场交通噪音租金折价的影响，发现噪音导致租金下降且偏好安静程度上升。
abstract_cn: 以新加坡新冠疫情暴发作为准自然实验，我们利用2006年至2022年间的46,980条交易记录，研究了租户对租赁住房市场中道路交通噪声反应的动态变化。双重差分估计结果显示，疫情暴发后道路交通噪声立即导致住房租金下降3.8%，并在随后一年内进一步下降12.7%——相当于每月减少186.7美元。该结果在平行趋势分析、置换安慰剂检验以及采用不同距离阈值或距最近主干道距离的稳健性检验中均保持稳健。进一步，我们通过对10,425条租赁住房广告进行机器学习文本分析发现，从2019年到2020年，租户对安静环境的偏好提升了约10%。居家办公新模式的兴起与快递服务带来的交通流量增长可以解释这一现象。据我们所知，这是首篇利用大规模交易记录量化新冠疫情背景下城市居民安静环境支付意愿的论文。我们的研究结果对其他国家及后疫情时代在城市规划、交通网络与人类住区之间的互动关系方面具有政策启示，并为实现可持续发展目标提供了路径参考。

title: Noise Pollution and Household Sustainability: An Economic Approach
abstract: Examining the economic impact of noise pollution from a lens of household is a burgeoning field in the study of environmental sustainability. Economics studies cover the source, measure, consequence of noise pollution, as well as the econometric methods used to identify the causal impact of noise pollution on socioeconomic welfare. There are broadly four major noise origins along with the industrial growth and urban development, which are airport, railway, urban traffic, and neighborhood. Four general kinds of measures or data sources are used in economics studies to capture the noise variations, namely, proximity to noise origins, real-time noise monitor records, household surveys, and administrative records on noise complaints. The socioeconomic consequences of noise pollution span from physical or mental health to happiness, violence and suicide, housing market capitalization, and inequality. In economics studies, generally three types of econometric methods are used to identify causal impact of noise pollution on the household's welfare, which are instrumental variable estimation, difference-in-difference estimation, randomized and quasi-natural experiments. The causal impact of noise pollution on household's socioeconomic welfare derived from economics studies can help guide policy efforts in allocating resources for noise elimination and conduct cost-benefit analysis. The economics research contributes to the general noise research from both conceptual and methodological perspectives: It expands the scope of research from sound-poof technology or site layout planning to human welfare, and endeavors to isolate the causal impact of noise pollution from other confounding factors. Future studies are warranted along the lines of environmental injustice of noise pollution and socioeconomic consequences in less developed countries when the data become more available.
tldr: 本文综述了噪声污染的经济影响，包括来源、测量、社会经济后果及因果识别方法，强调其对家庭福利的因果效应和政策含义。
abstract_cn: 从家庭视角审视噪声污染的经济影响，是环境可持续性研究中的一个新兴领域。经济学研究涵盖噪声污染的来源、测度、后果，以及用于识别噪声污染对社会经济福利因果影响的计量经济学方法。随着工业增长与城市发展，噪声源大致可分为四类：机场、铁路、城市交通及邻里社区。经济学研究中通常采用四类测度或数据来源来捕捉噪声变化，即：与噪声源的邻近程度、实时噪声监测记录、家庭调查以及噪声投诉行政记录。噪声污染的社会经济后果涵盖从身心健康到幸福感、暴力与自杀、住房市场资本化及不平等现象。在经济学研究中，通常运用三类计量经济学方法来识别噪声污染对家庭福利的因果影响，即工具变量估计、双重差分估计以及随机与准自然实验。基于经济学研究得出的噪声污染对家庭社会经济福利的因果影响，有助于指导政策制定中噪声消除资源的分配，并进行成本效益分析。经济学研究从概念与方法论两个层面为一般性噪声研究做出贡献：它将研究范围从隔音技术或场地布局规划拓展至人类福祉，并致力于从其他混杂因素中分离出噪声污染的因果影响。未来，随着数据可得性的提高，有必要围绕噪声污染的环境不公正问题及其在欠发达国家中的社会经济后果展开进一步研究。

title: Dead Reckoning: Counting Your Customers Who Never Say Goodbye
abstract: Firms in non-contractual commerce face the challenge of knowing how many customers they actually have because customers can stop buying without ever saying they have left. Buy-Till-You-Die models address this by estimating each customer's probability of being alive, a quantity called P(alive) and used in every major software tool for dashboards, churn, customer equity, and enterprise valuation. We show this practice confounds two distinct quantities. Within the beta-geometric family, P(alive) is the infinite-horizon limit of an observable family of finite-horizon repeat-purchase probabilities. Every finite-horizon estimate, such as the probability of repeat purchase within 12 months, is a forecast of a verifiable event. The infinite-time limit can only be reached by extrapolation, a customer count obtained by dead reckoning. The implied count is therefore only partially identified: realized returners are the lower bound, and estimation conventions determine the reported point estimate above that. On a seven-year panel of 31,683 customers, specifications with nearly identical observable forecasts estimate the number of alive customers anywhere from 3,654 to 27,734, a factor of 7.6; a default software weighting parameter alone swings the count 42 percent; and five years of later purchases falsify the maximum-likelihood count from below. The patterns replicate on the CDNOW benchmark, with a 2.4x spread. Most of what practice calls miscalibration is instead a category error: summed P(alive) overshoots realized eighteen-month returners by 2.25x, while the same model's own eighteen-month forecast errs by just 1.18x. The remedy is to report an auditable horizon count, estimate return probabilities at a stated horizon, audit them across scoring dates and horizons, recalibrate as cohorts drift, and report the total count, if at all, as an interval rather than a point.
tldr: 论文指出非契约商业中常用的P(alive)指标混淆了有限期和无限期概念，导致客户数量估计偏差，提出应报告可审计的有限期计数。
abstract_cn: 非契约型商业中的企业面临一个挑战：它们难以知晓实际拥有的客户数量，因为客户可能在不告知的情况下停止购买。“购买至死”模型通过估算每位客户存活的概率（即P(alive)）来应对这一问题，该指标被用于所有主流的仪表盘、客户流失分析、客户资产及企业估值软件工具中。我们证明，这种做法混淆了两个不同的概念。在贝塔-几何分布族中，P(alive)是一个可观测的有限期重复购买概率族在无限期极限下的值。每一个有限期估计值，例如12个月内重复购买的概率，都是对可验证事件的预测。而无限期极限只能通过外推法达到，这是一种通过推测得到的客户数量。因此，隐含的客户数量仅能被部分识别：实际回头的客户构成下限，而估计惯例决定了高于该下限的报告点估计值。在一项包含31,683名客户的七年面板数据中，具有几乎相同可观测预测值的不同模型规格，对存活客户数量的估计范围从3,654到27,734不等，相差7.6倍；仅默认软件权重参数的变化就使该数量波动42%；而随后五年的购买数据从下方证伪了最大似然估计值。这一模式在CDNOW基准数据上得到复现，差异倍数为2.4倍。实践中所谓的“校准不良”大多属于类别错误：加总的P(alive)高估了实际18个月回头客数量2.25倍，而同一模型自身的18个月预测误差仅为1.18倍。解决方法是报告可审计的有限期客户数量，在指定时间范围内估计回头概率，跨评分日期和时间范围进行审计，随客户群体漂移重新校准，并在必要时以区间而非点值形式报告总客户数量。

title: Optimizing Regret
abstract: Building on the identity that expected regret equals the covariance between costs and decisions, this paper develops the complete derivative theory of the covariance regret functional. We derive the Gâteaux derivative, showing that the universal steepest-descent direction is the contrarian policy $-(c-\bar{c})$, while ascent yields momentum. For linear policies $\hatπ(c) = Ac+b$, the gradient is the cost covariance matrix $Σ_c$, with a zero Hessian implying boundary-optimal solutions such as the minimum-variance portfolio. We extend to constrained optimization, sign-gradient duality between regret minimization and alpha maximization, finite-sample convergence bounds paralleling Thompson Sampling, and gradient-descent algorithms requiring only input observations, with applications to portfolio tilting and LLM-based allocation strategies.
tldr: 论文从协方差后悔泛函出发，推导其导数理论，提出梯度下降算法，应用于投资组合和LLM分配策略。
abstract_cn: 基于预期遗憾等于成本与决策之间协方差这一恒等式，本文发展了协方差遗憾泛函的完整导数理论。我们推导了Gâteaux导数，表明通用最速下降方向为逆势策略$-(c-\bar{c})$，而上升方向则产生动量。对于线性策略$\hatπ(c) = Ac+b$，其梯度为成本协方差矩阵$Σ_c$，零Hessian矩阵意味着边界最优解（如最小方差投资组合）。我们将研究扩展至约束优化、遗憾最小化与alpha最大化之间的符号梯度对偶性、与Thompson Sampling（汤普森采样）相媲美的有限样本收敛界，以及仅需输入观测值的梯度下降算法，并将其应用于投资组合倾斜与基于LLM（大语言模型）的配置策略。

title: Market tallies: minimal information for efficient trade
abstract: This paper studies how much public information is needed to implement efficient trade in dynamic markets with privately informed sellers and buyers. An institution compares a certified statistic of market composition with the statistic implied by agents' reports. Truthful reporting is supported when the statistic changes after every unilateral change in reported type. When all market compositions are possible, the least number of public announcements is {K,L}, where K is the number of seller qualities and L the number of buyer types. The certificate must rely on information outside the reports it checks. The paper also shows that information sufficient to discipline reports need not coordinate buyers across limited capacity. Posted-price implementation may require certified capacities and a clearing rule.
tldr: 研究在动态市场中，为促进有效交易所需的最小公共信息量，提出基于市场组成统计量的认证机制。
abstract_cn: 本文研究在存在私人信息的卖方与买方的动态市场中，实现有效交易所需公开信息的数量。市场机构将市场构成的认证统计量（certified statistic）与代理人报告所隐含的统计量进行比较。当报告类型的每一次单边改变都会导致该统计量发生变化时，真实报告（truthful reporting）得以维持。当所有市场构成均可能发生时，所需的最少公开公告次数为{K, L}，其中K为卖方质量（seller qualities）的数量，L为买方类型（buyer types）的数量。该认证必须依赖于其所核查报告之外的信息。本文还表明，足以约束报告的信息未必能协调有限容量下的买方。标价实施（posted-price implementation）可能需要认证容量（certified capacities）及清算规则（clearing rule）。

title: A Coordination Theory of NHS Whistleblowing Failure
abstract: Persistent whistleblowing failure in hierarchical healthcare organisations is typically attributed to insufficient legal protection for reporters or inadequate managerial incentives to investigate. This diagnosis is argued to be structurally incomplete. A repeated three-player game among a whistleblower, Trust management, and a colleague group is solved via global games techniques to obtain a unique equilibrium, identifying three mechanisms existing policy neither recognises nor addresses.
tldr: 通过三阶段博弈模型解释医疗组织举报失败的结构性原因，指出现有政策未识别的三种机制。
abstract_cn: 层级制医疗机构中举报行为持续失效的现象，通常被归因于举报人法律保护不足或管理层调查激励缺失。本文认为这一诊断在结构上存在不完整性。通过全局博弈（global games）技术求解举报人、信托管理层（Trust management）与同事群体间的重复三方博弈，可得到唯一均衡解，并识别出三项现有政策既未认知亦未应对的机制。

title: Curriculum design in the age of AI
abstract: I develop a model of learning-by-doing and curriculum design, and use it to study the impact of artificial intelligence (AI). A myopic student faces a sequence of tasks that he can work on or delegate to AI. Work requires costly effort but builds skill; delegation requires no effort but builds no skill. A teacher designs a task sequence ("curriculum") that maximizes the student's skill development given his choices to work or delegate. Without AI, the teacher makes earlier tasks more effort-intensive and later tasks more skill-intensive. With AI, the teacher must distort the curriculum to incentivize effort, leading to less skill development. If AI complements effort, then improvements in AI quality make high-skill students learn faster but low-skill students learn slower.
tldr: 通过一个学习-干中学模型，研究AI如何影响教师设计的课程序列以及学生技能发展。
abstract_cn: 我构建了一个关于“干中学”与课程设计的模型，并利用该模型研究人工智能（AI）的影响。一个短视的学生面临一系列任务，他可以选择亲自完成或委托给AI。亲自工作需要付出高昂的努力，但能够积累技能；委托工作无需付出努力，但无法积累技能。教师设计一个任务序列（即“课程”），以在学生选择亲自工作或委托的前提下，最大化其技能发展。在没有AI的情况下，教师会将早期任务设计为更努力密集型，后期任务设计为更技能密集型。有了AI后，教师必须扭曲课程以激励学生付出努力，从而导致技能发展减少。如果AI与努力互补，那么AI质量的提升会使高技能学生学习更快，但低技能学生学习更慢。

title: Cloud failure and cyber insurance: calibration of stress scenarios and diversification
abstract: The expansion of the cyber insurance market remains exposed to the threat of accumulation events that could simultaneously affect a large number of policyholders. Although few such catastrophes have been observed so far, apart from worldwide cyberattacks such as WannaCry and NotPetya in 2017, the nature of cyber risk makes their occurrence plausible. Stress-testing tools are therefore needed to assess whether an insurance portfolio can withstand such crises. In this perspective, the European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA) has identified cloud outage as one of the key scenarios to consider in cyber insurance stress-testing frameworks. In this paper, we propose a framework to model and calibrate cloud-outage scenarios and to measure the diversification of a cyber insurance portfolio. We also show how this diversification can protect against accumulation risk and provide underwriting guidelines to reduce the vulnerability of a portfolio to cloud-outage scenarios.
tldr: 该文提出一个框架来建模和校准云中断场景，并衡量网络保险组合的分散化效果，以应对累积风险。

title: When Trade Produces Knowledge: Dynamic Pricing, Bilateral Learning, and Trust
abstract: A transaction can allocate a product and create information unavailable before consumption. We study dynamic pricing when a pricing agent and a buying agent hold different estimates of match value, traded outcomes update a public belief, and attributed extraction depreciates relationship capital. Public learning polarizes exchange: greater precision drives compatible delegated policies toward trade and incompatible policies toward rejection. The seller's exact expected profit must account for the fact that acceptance selects its posterior margin. Its optimal policy therefore tracks the public margin, trust distance, and posterior precision. Higher extraction reduces both current acceptance and the arrival of future outcome signals, producing a reference-respecting region and an extraction-learning trap. With unequal signal precision, the trading rule additionally selects common quality; a selection-naive learner can become more confident and less accurate. Transactions create an information externality for later participants, while a shared misspecified model can make the agents agree without becoming correct. The analysis distinguishes data production, Bayesian knowledge, relationship capital, and verified computation, and identifies the state and protocol records required to test the mechanisms.
tldr: 研究交易中买卖双方通过动态定价进行双边学习，公共信念更新影响交易决策，并分析信息外部性和模型误设的影响。
abstract_cn: 一笔交易可以分配产品并创造消费前无法获得的信息。我们研究了当定价代理与购买代理对匹配价值持有不同估计、交易结果更新公共信念、以及归因提取会损耗关系资本时的动态定价问题。公共学习会极化交易：更高的精确度促使兼容的委托政策趋向交易，而不兼容的政策则趋向拒绝。卖方的精确期望利润必须考虑接受行为会选择其后验边际这一事实。因此，其最优政策需追踪公共边际、信任距离和后验精确度。更高的提取率既会降低当前接受率，也会减少未来结果信号的到达，从而产生一个参考尊重区域和一个提取学习陷阱。当信号精确度不相等时，交易规则还会额外选择共同质量；一个对选择过程天真的学习者可能变得更为自信但准确性更低。交易会为后续参与者创造信息外部性，而共享的错误设定模型可能使代理达成一致却并未变得正确。该分析区分了数据生成、贝叶斯知识、关系资本与可验证计算，并识别了检验这些机制所需的状态与协议记录。

title: Prediction of bank transaction fraud using TabNet an adaptive deep learning architecture
abstract: The development of online banking has brought about an increase in fraudulent operations, which is a major problem for banks. This study delves into the urgent requirement for interpretable, scalable, and top-notch fraud detection systems by using TabNet, an adaptable deep learning framework, on a Kaggle dataset consisting of actual bank transactions in India. Maximizing operational risk management by improving the accuracy of transaction anomaly detection and ensuring regulatory compliance through transparent models is the goal. We utilize a supervised learning pipeline that incorporates the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) to ensure that classes are balanced. Subsequently, we conduct thorough exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify patterns of fraud, both during specific times and across behaviors. On this dataset, five different deep learning architectures are tested: DNN, GRU, LSTM, CNN1D, and TabNet. Assessment of predictive performance was carried out using a 3-fold cross-validation framework. With a ROC-AUC of 0.9739 and an accuracy of 97.39 %, TabNet considerably outperformed the competition. The method of sparse feature selection used improved interpretability, generalized better on tabular data, and produced fewer false positives and negatives. Critical insights for operational fraud detection systems and a contribution to the broader literature on explainable AI (XAI) in financial decision-making are offered by the findings. Goals 8 and 16 of the Sustainable Development Agenda are supported by this study, which promotes inclusive economic growth and institutional transparency. Supporting strong, policy-compliant, and interpretable decision-support systems, it also offers practical use for real-time implementation in banking infrastructure.
tldr: 使用TabNet深度学习架构预测银行交易欺诈，在Kaggle数据集上达到97.39%准确率，提升操作风险管理与合规性。
abstract_cn: 网上银行的发展导致欺诈操作增加，这对银行而言是一个重大问题。本研究深入探讨了对可解释、可扩展且顶级欺诈检测系统的迫切需求，通过使用TabNet（一种适应性深度学习框架），在包含印度实际银行交易的Kaggle数据集上展开研究。目标是通过提高交易异常检测的准确性来最大化操作风险管理，并通过透明模型确保监管合规性。我们采用了一个监督学习流程，其中包含合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）以确保类别平衡。随后，我们进行了彻底的探索性数据分析（EDA），以识别特定时间及跨行为模式下的欺诈特征。在该数据集上，测试了五种不同的深度学习架构：深度神经网络（DNN）、门控循环单元（GRU）、长短期记忆网络（LSTM）、一维卷积神经网络（CNN1D）和TabNet。预测性能评估采用三折交叉验证框架进行。TabNet的ROC-AUC达到0.9739，准确率为97.39%，显著优于其他模型。所使用的稀疏特征选择方法提高了可解释性，在表格数据上泛化能力更强，并减少了假阳性和假阴性结果。研究结果为操作欺诈检测系统提供了关键见解，并对金融决策中可解释人工智能（XAI）的广泛文献做出了贡献。本研究支持可持续发展议程的目标8和目标16，促进了包容性经济增长和机构透明度。它还支持强大、符合政策且可解释的决策支持系统，并为银行基础设施中的实时实施提供了实际应用。

title: Licensing and Innovation Regimes in Pharmaceutical R&D
abstract: We study how licensing affects the allocation of innovation in pharmaceutical R&D. We develop a model in which projects differ in both quality and innovation regime, distinguishing between incremental and novel innovations. Information precision is higher for incremental projects and lower for novel ones, generating different equilibrium dynamics in the market for technology. The model predicts that licensing sustains positive selection and competitive return equalization for incremental innovation, while novel projects may exhibit weaker screening consistent with lemons-type frictions. Using product-level data and Double Machine Learning methods, we test these predictions across success probabilities and monetary returns. We find that licensing increases success probability overall, but return equalization holds primarily for incremental projects. For novel innovation, licensing does not exhibit the same equilibrium adjustment, suggesting residual market imperfections. Instrumenting for licensing using exogenous pipeline shocks confirms this pattern causally: the competitive risk-return trade-off is preserved for incremental 'rushed' licenses, but it breaks down for novel ones. Our results reconcile evidence on both competitive efficiency and information frictions in markets for technologies, showing that market performance depends systematically on the type of innovation being transacted.
tldr: 研究许可如何影响制药研发中增量与新颖创新的分配，使用双机器学习方法发现许可对增量创新有正向选择作用，但对新颖创新存在信息摩擦。

title: Catastrophic disruption cascades driven by the nonlinearity of systemic risk
abstract: Whether the COVID-19 pandemic or the Iran war, recent events have highlighted the systemic fragility of supply chains. Due to highly specific and mutual buyer-supplier dependencies, even the failure of a single firm can cause system-wide economic disruptions in the form of cascading failures up and down the supply chain network. Only recently has it become possible to quantify the systemic impact of the failure of individual firms on the total supply chain. Here, we demonstrate that the systemic risk contributions of combinations of firm failures can be drastically larger than the sum of the damage caused by the firms individually. Using a unique data set that allows us to reconstruct the national supply chain network of Ecuador at the firm-level, we find that combined failures can produce systemic risk amplifications of up to a factor of 257. However, only a tiny fraction of 0.14\% of pairs exhibit a more than 4-fold amplification of systemic risk. We develop a simple method to identify firm combinations that lead to large systemic risk amplifications. The origin of these amplifications is a breakdown of the substitutability of defaulted suppliers. We discuss the implications of the existence of rare but strong systemic risk amplification for situations that simultaneously affect multiple firms, such as natural disasters and wars.

title: Identifying Treatment and Spillover Effects with Control-Based and Forecast-Based Counterfactuals
abstract: Spillovers and interference pose fundamental challenges for causal inference, as treatment assigned to one unit may affect the outcome of others, violating the no-interference assumption underlying most empirical strategies. Existing approaches, based on partial interference, exposure mapping, spatial, network, or structural frameworks, typically rely on strong assumptions about interaction structures or require the existence of uncontaminated control units to estimate relevant causal parameters. We revisit this identification challenge within the potential outcomes framework and compare the conditions under which causal effects can be identified using two broad classes of counterfactual methods: control-based counterfactual methods (CBCMs), such as matching and difference-in-differences designs, and forecast-based counterfactual methods (FBCMs), including interrupted time-series and machine learning control methods. We show under which circumstances CBCMs and FBCMs identify average direct and spillover effects. Through simulations and an empirical application, we illustrate the main advantages and limitations of each approach. We show that, in the presence of pervasive or ill-defined spillover effects, CBCMs either cannot be used or entail severe identification concerns, whereas FBCMs can more credibly identify some of the causal parameters of interest, at least in the short term.
tldr: 论文在潜在结果框架下比较控制组反事实和预测反事实方法识别平均直接效应和溢出效应的条件，通过模拟和实证应用展示各自优缺点。
abstract_cn: 溢出效应与干扰对因果推断构成了根本性挑战，因为对某一单元的处理可能影响其他单元的结果，从而违背了大多数实证策略所依赖的无干扰假设。现有方法基于部分干扰、暴露映射、空间、网络或结构框架，通常依赖于对交互结构的强假设，或需要存在未受污染的对照单元来估计相关因果参数。我们在潜在结果框架内重新审视这一识别挑战，并比较了使用两类反事实方法识别因果效应的条件：基于对照的反事实方法（CBCMs），如匹配法和双重差分设计；以及基于预测的反事实方法（FBCMs），包括中断时间序列法和机器学习控制法。我们展示了在何种情况下CBCMs和FBCMs能够识别平均直接效应与溢出效应。通过模拟实验和一项实证应用，我们阐明了每种方法的主要优势与局限性。研究表明，在存在普遍或定义不清的溢出效应时，CBCMs要么无法使用，要么会引发严重的识别问题，而FBCMs则能够更可信地识别部分感兴趣的因果参数，至少在短期内如此。

title: Efficient difference-in-differences estimation under partial interference with incremental propensity score policies
abstract: This paper develops efficient difference-in-differences (DID) estimation under partial interference with a cluster incremental propensity score (CIPS) policy. We define direct and spillover average treatment effects on the treated, establish their identification, and derive their efficient influence functions, from which we construct a cross-fitted estimator. Simulations confirm its finite-sample validity, and an application to China's New Rural Pension Scheme uncovers a significantly negative within-household spillover of pension participation on co-residents' labour income.
tldr: 本文提出部分干扰下双重差分的高效估计方法，应用于中国新农保政策，发现养老金参与对同住居民劳动收入有显著负向溢出效应。
abstract_cn: 本文在部分干扰条件下，基于聚类增量倾向得分（CIPS）政策，发展了高效的倍差法（DID）估计。我们定义了处理组的直接与溢出平均处理效应，确立了其可识别性，并推导出其有效影响函数，进而构建了交叉拟合估计量。模拟结果验证了其在有限样本中的有效性，而对中国新型农村社会养老保险的实际应用揭示，养老金参与对同住居民劳动收入存在显著为负的家庭内部溢出效应。

title: Treatment Geometry and Causal Identification with Earth Observation Data
abstract: A central task in conducting impact evaluations is determining who or what was exposed to a treatment, when, and to what degree. These questions can be especially complex in geospatial settings, where many reasonable definitions of exposure may exist. This chapter introduces treatment geometry as a core concept in geospatial impact evaluation (GIE): the spatial and temporal footprint of a treatment as represented in data. How this footprint is defined shapes identification strategies and the credibility of causal inference. Drawing on cases spanning the air pollution, wildfire, forest policy, infrastructure, pest, and food security literature, the chapter provides practical guidance on navigating key tradeoffs (including spatial resolution, temporal alignment, spillovers, and boundary uncertainty) that arise when translating real-world interventions into analyzable data. Rather than prescribing a single best approach, the chapter equips researchers with a framework for diagnosing which geometry decisions may matter most in their context, closing with synthesis questions to help readers navigate these decisions.
tldr: 论文提出处理几何作为地理空间影响评估的核心概念，通过多领域案例提供处理定义中空间分辨率、时间对齐、溢出效应和边界不确定性的权衡指导。
abstract_cn: 开展影响评估的核心任务在于确定谁或什么受到了干预措施的影响、何时受到影响以及影响程度如何。在地理空间情境下，这些问题可能尤为复杂，因为可能存在多种合理的暴露定义。本章引入“处理几何”（treatment geometry）作为地理空间影响评估（Geospatial Impact Evaluation, GIE）的核心概念：即数据所表征的干预措施在空间与时间上的足迹。这一足迹的定义方式将塑造识别策略及因果推断的可信度。通过借鉴涵盖空气污染、野火、森林政策、基础设施、病虫害及粮食安全等领域的文献案例，本章就如何在将现实世界干预转化为可分析数据时应对关键权衡（包括空间分辨率、时间对齐、溢出效应及边界不确定性）提供了实践指导。本章并非推荐单一最佳方法，而是为研究者提供一套诊断框架，帮助其判断在自身研究情境中哪些几何决策最为关键，并最终通过总结性问题引导读者应对这些决策。

title: A Fixed-Effects Causal Forest for Staggered Adoption, with an Application to Medicaid Expansion
abstract: Difference-in-differences with staggered adoption identifies group-time average treatment effects ATT(g,t) by comparing each cohort to units not yet treated, which avoids the "forbidden comparisons" that bias two-way fixed-effects estimators when effects are heterogeneous. This paper studies the covariate-conditional version of that object, tau_{g,t}(x), and estimates it with a fixed-effects causal forest. Within each (g,t) comparison block, the outcome and treatment are residualized on unit and period fixed effects inside each tree node, and honest causal trees split on treatment-effect heterogeneity in the covariates. The estimand is not new: Hatamyar, Kreif, Rocha and Huber (2023) introduced it using a doubly-robust R-learner, and Imai, Qin and Yanagi (2023) study it for a single continuous covariate. What we add is a different way to estimate it. Where those methods remove confounding by modeling nuisance functions, we remove it by differencing out unit and period effects within each tree node, following the fixed-effects residualization of Kattenberg, Scheer and Thiel (2023) and Gavrilova, Langorgen and Zoutman (2025) and carrying it into the Callaway-Sant'Anna group-time structure. In Monte Carlo experiments the estimator is the only forest-based method that stays unbiased and correctly covered for the overall effect under staggered timing with cohort-varying effects; two-way fixed effects and a pooled causal forest inherit large forbidden-comparison bias. We apply the method to the Callaway-Sant'Anna minimum-wage panel as a validation and to the staggered county-level rollout of the ACA Medicaid expansion, where it recovers an average 2.25 percentage-point fall in the uninsured rate and a conditional surface on which poorer and lower-income counties gained substantially more coverage -- heterogeneity measured along socioeconomic covariates that are not lags of the outcome.
tldr: 提出一种固定效应因果森林方法估计交错采用设计中的条件平均处理效应，并以Medicaid扩展为例验证。
abstract_cn: 交错采用的双重差分法通过将每个队列与尚未接受处理的单位进行比较，识别出群体-时间平均处理效应ATT(g,t)，从而避免了当效应存在异质性时导致双向固定效应估计量产生偏误的“禁忌比较”。本文研究该对象的协变量条件版本tau_{g,t}(x)，并采用固定效应因果森林进行估计。在每个(g,t)比较区块内，结果变量和处理变量在每棵树的节点内对个体固定效应和时间固定效应进行残差化处理，诚实因果树则依据协变量中的处理效应异质性进行分裂。该估计量并非全新概念：Hatamyar、Kreif、Rocha与Huber（2023）采用双重稳健R学习器引入该估计量，而Imai、Qin与Yanagi（2023）则针对单一连续协变量进行了研究。我们的贡献在于提供了一种不同的估计方法。上述方法通过建模干扰函数来消除混杂效应，而我们则遵循Kattenberg、Scheer与Thiel（2023）以及Gavrilova、Langorgen与Zoutman（2025）的固定效应残差化方法，在每个树节点内通过差分消除个体效应与时间效应，并将其纳入Callaway-Sant'Anna群体-时间结构。蒙特卡洛实验表明，在队列效应随交错时间变化的情境下，该估计量是唯一能保持总体效应无偏且覆盖正确的基于森林的方法；而双向固定效应与混合因果森林则继承了较大的禁忌比较偏误。我们将该方法应用于Callaway-Sant'Anna最低工资面板数据进行验证，并进一步应用于ACA医疗补助扩展的县级交错推行场景。结果显示，未参保率平均下降2.25个百分点，且条件效应曲面表明，较贫困及收入较低的县获得了显著更高的覆盖率——这种异质性通过社会经济协变量（非结果变量的滞后项）进行度量。

title: Estimating Network Spillovers under Dense Measurement Error
abstract: This paper analyzes spillover effects in spatial (network) models when the neighborhood (adjacency) matrix is contaminated by measurement error from reporting, aggregation, or disclosure imperfections, leading to inconsistent estimation of network effects. We introduce a regularization framework for the latent network that allows for sparse and/or low-rank structure and accommodates potential correlation between measurement errors and outcomes. We propose two estimators: (i) a two-stage procedure that first denoises the adjacency matrix and then incorporates the purified network into a regression analysis, and (ii) a Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) estimator that jointly estimates regression parameters and refines the network structure. We then establish strictly improved consistency rates for the spillover effect estimator relative to naive estimation ignoring measurement error. Simulations demonstrate that, in the presence of noisy networks, our approach reduces the root mean squared error of spillover estimates relative to conventional methods by approximately $50-80\%$. We apply our framework to examine the international spillover of economic growth, and the tax competition across U.S. states, illustrating that denoising might restore Leontief stability and yields improved estimates of spillovers.
tldr: 本文提出在空间网络模型中处理邻接矩阵测量误差的估计方法，通过正则化去噪改进溢出效应估计，并应用于经济增长和税收竞争。
abstract_cn: 本文分析了当邻接（邻近）矩阵因报告、聚合或披露缺陷而受到测量误差污染时，空间（网络）模型中的溢出效应，这种污染会导致网络效应的估计不一致。我们为潜在网络引入了一个正则化框架，该框架允许稀疏和/或低秩结构，并能够容纳测量误差与结果之间的潜在相关性。我们提出了两种估计量：（i）一种两阶段方法，首先对邻接矩阵进行去噪，然后将净化后的网络纳入回归分析；（ii）一种广义矩估计（GMM）估计量，该估计量联合估计回归参数并优化网络结构。随后，我们证明了相对于忽略测量误差的朴素估计，溢出效应估计量的一致性速率得到了严格提升。模拟结果表明，在存在噪声网络的情况下，我们的方法相对于传统方法可将溢出估计的均方根误差降低约50-80%。我们将该框架应用于检验经济增长的国际溢出效应以及美国各州间的税收竞争，结果表明去噪可能恢复列昂惕夫稳定性，并改进溢出效应的估计。

title: Profiling and Endogenous Valuation
abstract: We study a monopolist facing a buyer whose valuation is determined by pre-trade investment. Before setting price, the seller observes a signal about the buyer's private investment cost (buyer profiling). Information that helps the seller extract surplus can also undermine the buyer's incentive to create it. We characterize the buyer-seller payoffs attainable across all possible profiling. On the Pareto frontier, if investment increases, hold-up risk always raises the payoff that the seller captures faster than the surplus that the investment creates. Protecting buyer welfare therefore requires discouraging investment, even though investment is socially efficient.

title: Aggregate models of liquidity-profit dynamics
abstract: We discuss the problem of limit cycles in an aggregate-type models of liquidity growth proposed and studied both theoretically and numerically by W. Semmler and M. Sieveking in \cite{SemmlerSieveking}. Their model is locally of predator-prey type with cannibalism in predator (profit) and logistic bound on prey's population (liquidity). We modify the model to include the weak Allee effect in liquidity and to study the local bifurcations of equilibria and limit cycles by means of the Hopf-Andronov theory. The main motivation for this study follows the economic theory of the so-called corridors of stability introduced by Leijonhuvud in \cite{Leijonh}. Similar importance of these effects is, however, found also in the originally developed dynamical models in biology, especially in mathematical ecology.
tldr: 论文通过修改Semmler和Sieveking的流动性增长模型，引入弱Allee效应，利用Hopf-Andronov理论研究平衡点和极限环的分岔，主要贡献在数学动力学领域。

title: Model Risk via Signature-Induced Optimal Transport
abstract: We propose a signature-induced, optimal transport framework for path-space model risk, in which ambiguity between stochastic path laws is factorized through optimal transport costs on signature coordinates under a common coupling. Via an ambient feature-space relaxation, we derive for affine signature scores and affine half-space events explicit robust expectation and probability bounds that depend only on the baseline model. In both cases, the correction is governed by the same effective budget, which depends only on the affine score and the budget vector of the ambiguity set. Moreover, the same quantity leads to a budget-aware sparse signature surrogate method for more general, possibly implicit, or data-driven, path functionals. We illustrate the resulting methodology through controlled stress tests and benchmark model-misspecification problems in finance and insurance.
tldr: 提出签名诱导最优传输框架量化路径空间模型风险，推导鲁棒界限并应用于金融压力测试。
abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种基于特征诱导的最优传输框架，用于路径空间模型风险，其中随机路径律之间的模糊性通过共同耦合下特征坐标上的最优传输成本进行分解。通过环境特征空间松弛，我们针对仿射特征评分与仿射半空间事件，推导出仅依赖于基线模型的显式鲁棒期望与概率界限。在这两种情形下，修正项均由同一有效预算控制，该预算仅取决于仿射评分与模糊集的预算向量。此外，同一量值还引出了一类预算感知的稀疏特征替代方法，适用于更一般、可能隐含或数据驱动的路径泛函。我们通过金融与保险领域的受控压力测试及基准模型误设问题，对所提出的方法进行了验证。

title: Retail Trader's Ruin: An Anatomy of Popular Signal Failure
abstract: We test whether five widely promoted retail signal families - trend, oscillator, candlestick, volume, and calendar rules - deliver a positive, economically meaningful, net-of-cost, and survivable edge. Practical viability is the conjunction of three predeclared gates: statistical edge after multiplicity correction, economic viability after trading costs, and finite-bankroll survival under leverage. Exposure-matched benchmarks, stationary-bootstrap confidence intervals, hierarchical Benjamini-Yekutieli control, one-sided claim-exclusion tests, and equivalence tests distinguish positive evidence, statistically refuted materiality, and unresolved cases. Four of six candidates - oscillator, volume, calendar, and candlestick - are REFUTED, ruled out on statistical and/or economic materiality grounds; trend and a momentum calibration benchmark are INCONCLUSIVE, with confidence intervals too wide at this sample size to resolve the claim; none is SUPPORTED. Cross-sectional tests use point-in-time membership and delisting corrections. The momentum benchmark itself does not clear the statistical gate and is classified INCONCLUSIVE, not REFUTED - the critical validity signature that a genuinely uncertain positive control is never falsely falsified by this design. Under FINRA- and ESMA-anchored leverage and margin scenarios, survival is not the binding constraint for any tested family at the US headline scenario, though it becomes discriminating for trend and oscillator under the higher-leverage EU CFD scenario. The results reject specific promoted deployability claims where confidence bounds rule out the declared effect threshold and classify the remaining cases as unresolved rather than treating non-significance as proof.
tldr: 论文检验五种零售交易信号在统计、经济及生存性上的可行性，发现多数被否定，无信号获得支持。
abstract_cn: 我们检验了五种广泛推广的交易信号族——趋势、震荡、K线、成交量与日历规则——是否能够提供正向、具有经济意义、扣除成本后且可存续的优势。实际可行性由三个预先设定的门槛共同决定：多重性校正后的统计优势、扣除交易成本后的经济可行性，以及杠杆条件下有限资金的存续能力。通过暴露匹配基准、平稳自助法置信区间、分层Benjamini-Yekutieli控制、单侧排除性检验与等价性检验，我们将结果区分为正向证据、统计上被证伪的实质性证据，以及未决案例。六个候选信号族中的四个——震荡、成交量、日历与K线——被证伪（REFUTED），基于统计和/或经济实质性依据被排除；趋势与一个动量校准基准为不确定（INCONCLUSIVE），在当前样本量下置信区间过宽，无法判定其主张；无任何信号族获得支持（SUPPORTED）。截面检验采用了时点成员资格与退市校正。动量基准本身未能通过统计门槛，被归类为不确定（INCONCLUSIVE）而非证伪（REFUTED）——这一关键有效性特征表明，一个真正不确定的阳性对照从未被该设计错误地证伪。在基于FINRA与ESMA的杠杆与保证金情景下，对于美国基准情景，存续性并非任何被检验信号族的约束条件，但在杠杆更高的欧盟差价合约（CFD）情景下，趋势与震荡信号族则面临存续性区分。结果否定了特定被推广的可部署性主张，其中置信区间排除了所声明的效应阈值，并将剩余案例归类为未决，而非将不显著视为证据。
