title: Observable Matrix Dynamics of Stocks
abstract: The Observable Matrix Dynamics (OMD) approach monitors the time development of complex non-linear systems through the trajectory of a fixed-size distance matrix and its spectrum. We apply it to the S\&P 500 cross section over three crisis decades, the 2001 dot-com bust, the 2007--2008 financial crisis, and the 2020 Covid crash, with three fixed-size observables on a fixed universe. The arccos distance matrix of the rolling return correlations reads the correlation geometry: its effective dimension collapses at the 2008 and 2020 crises, while the 2001 bust is a dispersed unwind. Read against machine-learning distance matrices, its spectrum stays in the un-relaxed, pre-learning regime with no low-dimensional manifold, so the market never learns its correlation structure or relaxes to a stationary geometry. Subtracting the market factor exposes a coherent sector rotation, whose name-level attribution identifies which stocks drive each crisis and in what order. At a short lookback these signals resolve precursors and forecast the endogenous 2008 crisis, though not the exogenous 2020 shock. The other two observables model the daily return and volatility rankings as Markov chains on their ranking spaces. The return chain has persistent, defensive-led bellwethers and near-reversible dynamics. The volatility chain is far more persistent, led by the financial sector, and is the only one to carry a weak, episodic arrow of time, flaring at market stress and matching volatility clustering and the Zumbach effect. All three matrices show coherent changes during market crashes.
tldr: 提出可观测矩阵动力学方法，通过距离矩阵谱分析S&P 500在三次危机中的相关性结构，发现市场从未学习到平稳几何结构，并识别危机驱动因素。
abstract_cn: 可观测矩阵动力学（Observable Matrix Dynamics, OMD）方法通过固定大小距离矩阵及其谱的轨迹来监测复杂非线性系统的时间演化。我们将其应用于三个危机十年期间的标普500指数（S&P 500）截面数据，即2001年互联网泡沫破裂、2007—2008年金融危机以及2020年新冠疫情崩盘，并在固定宇宙上选取三个固定大小的可观测变量。滚动收益率反余弦距离矩阵（arccos distance matrix）解读了相关几何结构：其有效维度在2008年和2020年危机期间发生坍缩，而2001年泡沫破裂则表现为分散式平仓。与机器学习距离矩阵对比，其谱始终处于未松弛的预学习状态，不存在低维流形，因此市场从未学习其相关结构或松弛至平稳几何形态。扣除市场因子后，可揭示出连贯的板块轮动，其名称级归因能够识别哪些股票驱动了每次危机及其驱动顺序。在短回溯窗口下，这些信号可解析出前兆并预测内生的2008年危机，但无法预测外生的2020年冲击。另外两个可观测变量将日收益率和波动率排名建模为其排名空间上的马尔可夫链（Markov chain）。收益率链具有由防御性板块主导的持续领头羊及近乎可逆的动力学特征。波动率链的持续性远强于前者，由金融板块主导，且是唯一携带微弱、偶发性时间箭头（arrow of time）的变量，该时间箭头在市场压力期爆发，与波动率聚集效应及Zumbach效应（Zumbach effect）相匹配。所有三个矩阵在市场崩盘期间均呈现出一致的变化。

title: Credit Risk Assessment and Loan Portfolio Quality in Uganda’s Commercial Banking Sector: The Moderating Effect of Adverse Selection
abstract: The study examines the moderating effect of Adverse Selection (ADS) on both credit risk assessment (CRA) and loan portfolio quality in Uganda’s Commercial Banking Sector by focusing on a survey of selected banks. Guided by a pragmatic philosophy blending both qualitative and quantitative approaches, the study adopted a cross-sectional survey design on a sample of 207 participants drawn from a population of 427 across twelve (12) departments within seven (7) commercial banks. Quantitative data were sought using a self–administered questionnaire from 204 participants, while qualitative data were collected using an interview guide from three (3) key informants. Quantitative data were processed using SPSS (Version 25) and exported to JASP version 0.19.30 software to perform factor analysis and run Structural Equation Models (SEM). Data analysis was done using SEM regression for the direct relationships, while Hierarchical Moderated Multiple Regression analysis was employed to examine the moderating effect of adverse selection on credit risk assessment and loan portfolio quality. Study findings indicate that Credit risk assessment insignificantly predicted loan portfolio quality before moderation with adverse selection, although the effect became statistically significant when moderated with adverse selection. In particular, CRA showed a prediction power of β = 0.314, p = 0.429<0.05 before moderation. Upon moderation, results indicate that adverse selection significantly moderated the effect of Credit risk assessment on loan portfolio quality in commercial banks with interaction terms of CRA×ADS =-0.334,p<0.001. The study concludes that credit risk assessment does not directly predict loan portfolio quality and that it requires moderation with adverse selection to create a positive significant effect on loan portfolio quality. The study recommends that commercial banks should work towards eliminating managerial override during credit assessment that forces managers and bank officers to conflict with the available credit policies due to the pressure emanating from performance targets on volumes disbursed in a period. Commercial banks should equally guard against abuse or sidelining of credit limits, limit reliance on mainly quantified facts during assessment, as well as appreciating the influence of macroeconomic forces like inflation, interest rates, and forex volatility that together erode the capacity of the borrowers to make timely repayments.

tldr: 研究乌干达商业银行中逆向选择对信用风险评估与贷款组合质量关系的调节效应，采用混合方法，发现逆向选择显著调节该关系。
abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了逆向选择（Adverse Selection, ADS）对乌干达商业银行部门信用风险评估（Credit Risk Assessment, CRA）及贷款组合质量的调节效应，并以特定银行的调查为重点。研究以融合定性与定量方法的实用主义哲学为指导，采用横截面调查设计，样本涵盖来自7家商业银行12个部门的427名总体中的207名参与者。定量数据通过自填问卷从204名参与者处获取，定性数据则通过访谈指南从3名关键信息提供者处收集。定量数据采用SPSS（第25版）进行处理，并导出至JASP 0.19.30软件进行因子分析及结构方程模型（Structural Equation Models, SEM）的构建。数据分析中，直接关系采用SEM回归分析，而逆向选择对信用风险评估与贷款组合质量的调节效应则通过层次调节多元回归分析（Hierarchical Moderated Multiple Regression analysis）进行检验。研究结果表明，在未引入逆向选择作为调节变量前，信用风险评估对贷款组合质量的预测作用不显著；然而，当引入逆向选择作为调节变量后，该效应变得统计显著。具体而言，调节前CRA的预测力为β=0.314，p=0.429<0.05；调节后结果显示，逆向选择显著调节了信用风险评估对商业银行贷款组合质量的影响，交互项CRA×ADS=-0.334，p<0.001。研究结论认为，信用风险评估并不直接预测贷款组合质量，需通过逆向选择的调节作用才能对贷款组合质量产生显著正向影响。研究建议，商业银行应致力于消除信贷评估过程中的管理层干预——这种干预因期间放贷量绩效目标的压力，导致管理层与银行职员与现有信贷政策产生冲突。商业银行同样应防范信贷限额的滥用或忽视，限制评估中对量化事实的过度依赖，并重视通货膨胀、利率及外汇波动等宏观经济力量的影响，这些因素共同削弱了借款人的及时还款能力。

title: From Training to Service-Quality Behavior: The Moderating Role of Employee Engagement in Frontline Banking
abstract: Commercial banks operate in competitive and customer-driven environments where frontline employees shape service-quality perceptions during daily interactions. Despite substantial investments in competency building in terms of employee training, many banks continue to face complaints relating to responsiveness, communication, complaint handling, and service consistency. This study examines the relationship between competency building in terms of training and service-quality behavior among frontline employees in commercial banking and investigates the moderating role of employee engagement. Drawing on Human Capital Theory, the Job Demands-Resources model, and Social Exchange Theory, the study adopted a longitudinal survey design involving frontline employees of a leading commercial bank in Sri Lanka. Data were initially collected from 150 frontline employees using pre-training and post-training surveys. A two-day specially designed competency-building intervention was developed using Subject Matter Expert input and evaluated through pre-training and post-training surveys administered one month apart, consistent with Kirkpatrick’s learning and behavioral evaluation perspectives. Competency building was operationalized through product knowledge, multitasking, problem solving, timeliness in serving, social etiquette, and personal appearance. Employee engagement was measured using the Utrecht Work Engagement Scale (17), while service-quality behavior was measured using an adapted SERVQUAL-based behavioral instrument supported by critical incident scenarios reflecting actual banking situations. SPSS was used for descriptive statistics and paired sample t-tests, while SmartPLS was used for PLS-SEM analysis. The findings revealed that product knowledge, multitasking, problem solving, and social etiquette significantly influenced service-quality behavior. Employee engagement strengthened several competency-behavior relationships, particularly those involving product knowledge, problem solving, timeliness, and social etiquette. The study contributes to training-transfer, engagement, and service-quality literature by showing that competency development alone is insufficient unless employees are psychologically engaged to apply acquired competencies in demanding service environments.

tldr: 本研究通过纵向调查，探讨商业银行前线员工培训（能力建设）对服务质量行为的影响，并发现员工敬业度调节部分关系。
abstract_cn: 商业银行在竞争激烈且以客户为导向的环境中运营，一线员工在日常互动中塑造着服务质量感知。尽管银行在员工培训方面的能力建设投入巨大，但许多银行仍面临与响应性、沟通、投诉处理及服务一致性相关的投诉。本研究探讨了商业银行一线员工培训能力建设与服务品质行为之间的关系，并考察了员工敬业度的调节作用。基于人力资本理论、工作需求-资源模型及社会交换理论，本研究采用纵向调查设计，以斯里兰卡一家领先商业银行的一线员工为研究对象。最初通过培训前与培训后调查收集了150名一线员工的数据。在主题专家（Subject Matter Expert, SME）的参与下，设计了一项为期两天的专项能力建设干预措施，并依据柯克帕特里克（Kirkpatrick）的学习与行为评估视角，通过间隔一个月的培训前与培训后调查进行评估。能力建设通过产品知识、多任务处理、问题解决、服务及时性、社交礼仪及个人仪表等维度进行操作化。员工敬业度采用乌得勒支工作投入量表（Utrecht Work Engagement Scale, UWES-17）进行测量，而服务品质行为则采用基于SERVQUAL模型改编的行为测量工具，并辅以反映实际银行情境的关键事件场景。描述性统计与配对样本t检验使用SPSS软件，偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析则使用SmartPLS软件。研究结果显示，产品知识、多任务处理、问题解决及社交礼仪显著影响服务品质行为。员工敬业度强化了若干能力-行为关系，尤其是涉及产品知识、问题解决、服务及时性及社交礼仪的关系。本研究对培训迁移、敬业度及服务品质相关文献的贡献在于，揭示了在要求严苛的服务环境中，若员工未能在心理上投入以应用所获能力，仅靠能力开发本身是不够的。

title: Globalisation as a catalyst or constraint: evaluating the effectiveness of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing strategies in Sri Lanka
abstract: Strategies for combating illicit financial flows have evolved with globalisation, presenting serious challenges for developing countries navigating international compliance norms. This study provides an evaluation of how globalisation moderates Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and strategies for Countering the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) in Sri Lanka’s licensed commercial banking sector. Utilising responses from 150 risk management specialists, the research uses principal component analysis and multiple regression to yield insights into the legislative, technical, and institutional challenges posed by global integration. Findings reveal that banking professionals perceive strong institutional commitment to AML/CFT compliance and hold positive views on existing frameworks. Transaction Monitoring Systems and Training/Awareness emerge as critical factors in reducing money laundering and terrorism financing risks. The study underscores the necessity of strengthening risk-based approaches, enhancing due diligence, fostering global collaboration, and investing in continuous capacity building to ensure resilient financial crime prevention systems in a globalised environment.

abstract_cn: 应对非法资金流动的策略随着全球化的发展而演变，这给发展中国家在遵循国际合规规范方面带来了严峻挑战。本研究评估了全球化如何调节斯里兰卡持牌商业银行部门的反洗钱（Anti-Money Laundering, AML）与打击恐怖主义融资（Countering the Financing of Terrorism, CFT）策略。通过收集150名风险管理专家的调查反馈，研究采用主成分分析和多元回归方法，深入分析了全球一体化所带来的立法、技术和制度性挑战。研究结果显示，银行业专业人士认为机构对反洗钱/打击恐怖主义融资（AML/CFT）合规具有坚定承诺，并对现有框架持积极态度。交易监控系统与培训/意识被确认为降低洗钱和恐怖主义融资风险的关键因素。本研究强调了加强基于风险的方法、强化尽职调查、促进全球合作以及持续投资于能力建设的重要性，以确保在全球化环境下构建具有韧性的金融犯罪预防体系。

title: Rational Inattention in Government Bond Auctions: Evidence from Yield Spreads in Armenian Treasury Auctions
abstract: Investors’ behavior in the auctions for government bonds is closely associated with the processing and valuing of information. This study explores investors’ behavior in relation to information in the context of the sovereign debt market in Armenia in August 2017 to December 2025. Armenia has a small financial market, which is relatively deep and involves only a small number of investors. This particular situation allows for testing the applicability of the rational inattention theory. While information in a small open economy can be abundant, it does not follow that information is valued in the same way. Investors in a small open economy focus their attention on monitoring some salient policy variables, including the central bank policy interest rate and headline inflation but ignore some more specific signals such as demand dynamics. We suggest that the spread between the cut-off yield and the weighted average yield in the auction can be used as a measure of information inattention. According to the rational inattention theory, investors allocate their attention strategically and focus on those signals that can be obtained easily and publicly. Therefore, our hypothesis is that the auction spread is consistent with partial information processing, whereby demand signals are underweighted relative to the policy rate. Indeed, the analysis suggests that the cut-off yield remains correlated with the policy rate, whereas the spread does not increase. This is consistent with the hypothesis that yield spreads reflect bounded rationality in attention allocation. During the periods of increased need for government borrowing, auctions become the key sources of signaling and thus need to be studied.

tldr: 利用亚美尼亚国债拍卖数据，检验理性疏忽理论，发现投资者主要关注政策利率和通胀，忽略需求信号，导致拍卖利差反映有限信息处理。
abstract_cn: 投资者在国债拍卖中的行为与信息的处理及估值密切相关。本研究探讨了2017年8月至2025年12月亚美尼亚主权债务市场背景下投资者与信息相关的行为。亚美尼亚的金融市场规模较小，但相对较深，且仅涉及少数投资者。这一特殊情况为检验理性疏忽理论（rational inattention theory）的适用性提供了条件。尽管小型开放经济中的信息可能十分丰富，但这并不意味着信息的估值方式相同。小型开放经济中的投资者将注意力集中于监测一些显著的政策变量，包括中央银行政策利率（central bank policy interest rate）和总体通胀率（headline inflation），但忽略了诸如需求动态等更为具体的信号。我们提出，拍卖中的截止收益率（cut-off yield）与加权平均收益率（weighted average yield）之间的利差可作为信息疏忽（information inattention）的衡量指标。根据理性疏忽理论，投资者会策略性地分配注意力，并聚焦于那些易于获取且公开的信号。因此，我们的假设是，拍卖利差与部分信息处理（partial information processing）相一致，即需求信号相对于政策利率被低估。事实上，分析表明，截止收益率仍与政策利率相关，而利差并未扩大。这与收益率利差反映注意力分配中的有限理性（bounded rationality）的假设一致。在政府借贷需求增加的时期，拍卖成为信号传递的关键来源，因此有必要对其进行研究。

title: Group boarding for airplanes: benchmarking static policies and optimizing dynamic assignment with deep reinforcement learning
abstract:
Improving boarding efficiency reduces airplane turnaround time and improves passenger experience. Airlines typically assign passengers to a few sequential boarding groups using static seat-based rules. Yet arrivals, seat choices, and luggage are sequential and random, and a static rule ignores the seats earlier passengers have already taken. We propose the first dynamic formulation of boarding group assignment. As each passenger checks in, we observe earlier passengers' seats and groups, the current passenger's seat, and optional luggage information, then assign a group while keeping companions together. We formulate dynamic group assignment as a Markov decision process and solve it with reinforcement learning (RL). The policy uses a convolutional neural network to encode the checked-in seat-assignment state and is trained by proximal policy optimization. The reward balances total boarding time and average individual boarding time.
  We benchmark the proposed RL policy against three companion-compatible static policies (back-to-front, modified Steffen, and alternating block) in an in-house simulator covering six single- and double-aisle layouts. Back-to-front with optimized group sizes achieves the shortest total boarding time and average individual boarding time among the static benchmarks across all layouts. The dynamic RL policy further outperforms it on both metrics in every layout. On a representative case, the RL policy outperforms the optimal back-to-front by up to 9.8\% in total boarding time and 22.8\% in average individual time. Sweeping the reward weight yields an approximate Pareto frontier for operator choice. Trained policies remain robust under out-of-distribution operating conditions, including varying load factors, companion sizes, and luggage loads.
tldr: 本文提出基于深度强化学习的动态登机分组策略，以最小化总登机时间和平均个人登机时间，并在模拟中优于静态策略。
abstract_cn:
提高登机效率可缩短飞机周转时间并改善乘客体验。航空公司通常采用基于座位的静态规则，将乘客分配到若干顺序登机组。然而，乘客到达时间、座位选择及行李携带情况具有顺序性与随机性，静态规则无法考虑先登机乘客已就座的实际情况。我们首次提出登机组分配的动态规划方法。当每位乘客办理值机时，我们观察先前乘客的座位与组别、当前乘客的座位及可选行李信息，随后在保持同行乘客同组的前提下分配登机组。我们将动态组分配建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并通过强化学习（RL）进行求解。该策略采用卷积神经网络对已值机座位分配状态进行编码，并利用近端策略优化进行训练。奖励函数平衡总登机时间与平均个体登机时间。

我们在涵盖六种单通道与双通道布局的内部模拟器中，将所提出的强化学习策略与三种兼容同行的静态策略（后向前、改进型Steffen及交替区块）进行基准对比。在所有布局的静态基准中，采用优化组规模的后向前策略实现了最短的总登机时间与平均个体登机时间。而动态强化学习策略在每种布局的这两项指标上均进一步超越该基准。在代表性案例中，强化学习策略的总登机时间比最优后向前策略最多降低9.8%，平均个体时间最多降低22.8%。通过遍历奖励权重可得到近似帕累托前沿供运营者选择。训练后的策略在分布外运行条件下仍保持稳健，包括变化的载客率、同行人数及行李负载。

title: The Evolution of Digital Search: From Blue Links to Delegated Decision-Making
abstract: Digital search is undergoing a fundamental transformation from a human-driven process of discovery to an agent-mediated system of delegated decision-making. In the traditional model of digital search, users translate intent into keyword-based queries, evaluate ranked lists of links, and execute decisions outside the search interface. In an AI-native world, users express goals in natural language, agents interpret these intentions, and outcomes are returned as recommendations or executed decisions. This shift moves search from a link-based user interface to an embedded system component, with implications for transparency, competition, and monetization. The resulting system design problem raises key questions about information quality and access, trust, incentive alignment, and market structure. Early evidence from experimental agent-mediated marketplaces and economic theory suggests that small design choices, such as how stakeholders access information, how options are surfaced, and how actions are executed, have first-order effects on efficiency, competition, and the welfare of consumers and firms. We propose that the future of search will be determined not by incremental improvements in ranking algorithms and natural-language interfaces, but by the design of open, transparent, and competitive agentic systems that govern how decisions are made and how markets operate, highlighting a set of grand challenges at the intersection of AI, economics, and system design.
tldr: 论文探讨数字搜索从人工驱动到AI代理决策的转变，分析其对透明度、竞争和福利的影响，提出开放透明的代理系统设计挑战。
abstract_cn: 数字搜索正经历从人类驱动的发现过程向代理中介的委托决策系统的根本性转变。在传统数字搜索模式中，用户将意图转化为基于关键词的查询，评估排序后的链接列表，并在搜索界面之外执行决策。在人工智能原生时代，用户以自然语言表达目标，代理（agent）解读这些意图，并返回推荐结果或直接执行决策。这一转变将搜索从基于链接的用户界面转变为嵌入式系统组件，对透明度、竞争和货币化产生深远影响。由此产生的系统设计问题引发了关于信息质量与可及性、信任、激励一致性及市场结构的关键议题。来自实验性代理中介市场及经济理论的早期证据表明，细微的设计选择——例如利益相关者如何获取信息、选项如何呈现以及行动如何执行——会对效率、竞争以及消费者与企业的福利产生一阶效应。我们认为，搜索的未来将不取决于排序算法与自然语言界面的渐进式改进，而取决于开放、透明且具有竞争性的代理系统（agentic system）的设计——这些系统将主导决策的制定方式与市场的运行机制，从而凸显出人工智能、经济学与系统设计交叉领域的一系列重大挑战。

title: Electricity demand has not become more price-responsive despite ninety years of technological change
abstract: Energy planners have long assumed that electricity demand will grow more price-responsive as metering, automation, and storage spread, an assumption now embedded in decarbonization plans. We test it against the empirical record: 4,720 own-price elasticity estimates from 462 studies, with data spanning 1934-2024, ranked on a single ladder of identification quality from naive regressions to randomized experiments. Three findings emerge. First, the best-identified studies find smaller responses than naive ones: the publication-bias-corrected short-run elasticity is about -0.16 (a 10% rise in the electricity price cuts consumption by under 2%), and only -0.09 among the best-identified studies, whose adjusted value is statistically indistinguishable from zero. Second, responsiveness grows with time to adjust, roughly doubling from -0.16 in the short run to -0.38 in the long run as the capital stock turns over, but this pattern has itself been stable for decades. Third, and most important, responsiveness shows no upward trend across nine decades of data; if anything, the most technology-rich settings, including time-of-use pricing, are the least price-responsive in total consumption. Prices alone have not made total electricity consumption more responsive; broader demand flexibility will have to be engineered and paid for, through enabling technology, contracts, and program design.
tldr: 通过元分析发现，尽管技术发展，电力需求的价格弹性在过去九十年中并未增加，短期弹性约为-0.16，长期约为-0.38，且无上升趋势。
abstract_cn: 长期以来，能源规划者一直假设，随着计量、自动化和储能技术的普及，电力需求的价格响应性将增强——这一假设如今已被纳入脱碳规划。我们基于实证记录对此进行检验：涵盖462项研究中的4,720个自价格弹性估计值，数据时间跨度为1934年至2024年，并按照从朴素回归到随机实验的识别质量阶梯进行排序。研究得出三项发现。第一，识别质量最佳的研究所发现的响应程度低于朴素研究：经出版偏倚校正后的短期弹性约为-0.16（电价上涨10%仅使消费量下降不足2%），而在识别质量最佳的研究中该值仅为-0.09，其调整后的数值在统计上与零无显著差异。第二，响应程度随调整时间延长而增强，随着资本存量更替，短期弹性约从-0.16翻倍至长期弹性-0.38，但这一模式本身在过去数十年间保持稳定。第三，也是最重要的一点，在跨越九十年的数据中，响应程度并未呈现上升趋势；恰恰相反，技术最丰富的环境（包括分时定价）在总消费量上的价格响应性反而最低。仅靠价格本身并未使总电力消费更具响应性；更广泛的灵活性需求必须通过赋能技术、合同及项目设计来人为构建并为之付费。

title: pAI-Econ-claude: A Gated Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Architecture for AI-Assisted Economic Theory Development
abstract: In many social-science research tasks, such as economics, LLM-based agents must produce outputs for which no cheap, task-complete, machine-readable correctness signal exists. This creates a distinctive reliability problem for multi-agent systems: how should generation, critique, coordination, and human judgment be organized when no component can certify the final result? We address this problem through pAI-Econ-claude, a gated, human-in-the-loop multi-agent architecture for AI-assisted economic theory development. Agents coordinate through a shared workspace of inspectable intermediate records; specialized gates diagnose targeted failure modes and recommend loopbacks without certifying correctness; and human checkpoints retain authority over decisions that are costly to reverse. We evaluate the architecture on five matched economic-theory tasks against an ungated baseline. Two evaluators blinded to configuration agreed on all five pairwise rankings, preferring the gated architecture in four tasks and the baseline in one. Mean failure severity fell from 1.58 to 1.16, while overall usefulness rose from 2.60 to 3.10. The largest observed gain occurred when a reality check rejected a false market-structure premise and a proof review prompted revision of a false welfare claim. The negative case shows that scaffolding can also compress an economically important mechanism too aggressively. The results support a bounded claim: gated oversight improves the auditability of AI-assisted economic theory without substituting for formal verification, and the allocation of irreversible human judgment is a more informative design variable than pure agent autonomy. The workflow is publicly available at https://github.com/maxwell2732/pAI-Econ-claude.
tldr: 提出一种带门控机制和人机协作的多智能体架构pAI-Econ-claude，用于AI辅助经济理论开发，通过实验验证其优于无门控基线。
abstract_cn: 在许多社会科学研究任务（如经济学）中，基于大语言模型的智能体必须生成那些不存在廉价、任务完整且机器可读的正确性信号的输出。这为多智能体系统带来了一个独特的可靠性问题：当没有任何组件能够验证最终结果时，应如何组织生成、批判、协调与人类判断？我们通过pAI-Econ-claude来解决这一问题，这是一种带门控机制、人类参与循环的多智能体架构，用于人工智能辅助的经济学理论发展。智能体通过一个包含可检查中间记录（inspectable intermediate records）的共享工作空间进行协调；专门的“门控”（gates）用于诊断特定故障模式并建议回退（loopbacks），而不对正确性进行认证；人类检查点（human checkpoints）则保留对逆转成本高昂的决策的最终权威。我们在五个匹配的经济学理论任务上，将该架构与一个无门控的基线进行了评估。两位对配置不知情的评估者在所有五组成对排序上达成一致，在四个任务中偏好带门控的架构，在一个任务中偏好基线。平均故障严重性从1.58降至1.16，而整体有用性从2.60升至3.10。观察到的最大增益出现在一次现实检验（reality check）拒绝了错误的市场结构前提，以及一次证明审查（proof review）促使对错误福利主张进行修订时。负面案例则表明，脚手架（scaffolding）也可能过度压缩一个具有经济学重要性的机制。结果支持一个有限的主张：带门控的监督提升了人工智能辅助经济学理论的可审计性（auditability），但并未替代形式化验证；而不可逆人类判断的分配，相比纯粹的智能体自主性，是一个更具信息量的设计变量。该工作流程可在https://github.com/maxwell2732/pAI-Econ-claude公开获取。

title: Accelerating fossil gas independence in Europe
abstract: Recent price shocks have prompted calls to curb Europe's dependence on fossil gas imports, but the cost of this goal, and the consumer protection it affords, remain uncertain. Here we address this gap by imposing constraints on fossil gas supply in a European energy system model that co-optimises abatement across all gas uses at high spatio-temporal resolution. Cutting import reliance proves economically compelling: through savings in power generation and low-temperature heat in industry and buildings, Europe can halve its natural gas consumption for 16bnEUR/a, aligning demand with the continent's production capacity of 200 bcm. This extra system cost is comparable to what consumers spend today on a 2 EUR/MWh rise in gas import prices. However, this sovereignty alone does not shield consumers from global gas price volatility: we find that, even at a small share of the mix, gas remains dominant in shaping the marginal electricity price, leaving consumers exposed without additional policy measures.
tldr: 通过高时空分辨率欧洲能源系统模型，分析限制化石天然气供应以降低进口依赖的经济成本，发现减半消费仅需160亿欧元/年，但无法完全保护消费者免受价格波动影响。
abstract_cn: 近期价格冲击引发了关于遏制欧洲对化石天然气进口依赖的呼声，但这一目标的成本及其所能提供的消费者保护仍不确定。本文通过在欧洲能源系统模型中对化石天然气供应施加约束来填补这一研究空白，该模型以高时空分辨率对所有天然气用途的减排进行协同优化。减少进口依赖在经济上具有吸引力：通过发电以及工业和建筑领域的低温热力节约，欧洲可以将其天然气消费量减半，每年节省160亿欧元，使需求与欧洲大陆2000亿立方米的产能相匹配。这一额外系统成本与消费者目前因天然气进口价格上涨2欧元/兆瓦时所产生的支出相当。然而，仅凭这种自主性并不能保护消费者免受全球天然气价格波动的影响：我们发现，即使天然气在能源结构中的占比很小，它仍在决定边际电价方面占据主导地位，这使得消费者在没有额外政策措施的情况下仍然面临风险。

title: Execution and Evaluation: A New Occupational Measure and Long-Run Employment Gradients
abstract: Artificial intelligence automates execution more readily than evaluation: producing output is cheap, judging whether it is correct is not. Exposure measures rank tasks by whether AI can perform them, not by which function the human supplies. I score all $19{,}265$ O*NET task statements under fixed rubrics to build occupation-level execution and AI-capability shares. The execution share is reproducible across model coders and O*NET vintages and distinct from AI capability and routine-task intensity; it is a model-based measure, not human-validated ground truth, and adds only modest power beyond O*NET's evaluation activities. In a harmonized panel, employment growth is lower in execution-heavy white-collar occupations in every window since 2012, and equality of slopes cannot be rejected: the gradient is a secular trend rather than an AI-era event, largely between occupational families. The vintage-valid capability gradient steepens after 2022, a change that is dated but not causally attributable. The evidence establishes a measure and a chronology, not an AI-caused effect.
tldr: 论文构建了职业层面的执行份额和AI能力份额度量，发现执行密集型白领职业就业增长较低，且该趋势在2012年后持续存在，并非AI时代特有。

title: The Human-AI Substitution Principle: When will you be replaced by AI in your organization?
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming organizations, raising a fundamental organizational and economic question: when will a human employee be replaced by AI? We present an analytical model for studying Human--AI Task Allocation (HAT) in hierarchical organizations. A central feature of the HAT model is that it formally encodes the economic asymmetry between human skill acquisition and AI capability scaling. The HAT model allows us to derive how risk-adjusted costs, skills, organizational depth, deployment scale, strategic adaptation, and risk jointly determine when, where, why, and under what structural conditions human--AI replacement occurs. A key result is the Human--AI Substitution Principle, which provides a precise condition --- grounded in the formal asymmetry assumption --- under which AI replaces human labor. Building on this result, we show that AI adoption can produce abrupt workforce transitions, hybrid human--AI organizations, including cases where risk heterogeneity sustains human and AI roles without requiring a minimum-human-fraction constraint, and flatter managerial hierarchies with wider spans of control. The HAT model identifies structural conditions under which middle-management roles exhibit elevated vulnerability to automation, and shows that the vulnerability of highly skilled workers depends on a skill threshold shaped by organizational depth, baseline costs, and risk differentials. More broadly, the paper connects automation economics, organizational design, AI governance, and workforce planning into a unified theory of AI-driven organizational transformation.
tldr: 提出人类-AI替代原则，通过分析层级组织中风险调整成本、技能和部署规模，预测AI替代人类劳动力的条件与结构影响。

title: Good Guys With Guns? The Relationship Between Legal Firearm Ownership and Firearm Deaths and Crime in Canada
abstract: Civilian firearm ownership is politically contentious, yet most evidence linking guns to crime and death comes from the U.S. Canada offers a unique case: strict national regulations alongside widespread legal ownership. Using new administrative data from 2013-2019, we examine associations between gun prevalence and homicides, suicides, and firearms-related crime. During this period, we find that handgun ownership rose 50\% and restricted licenses by 70\%. Recent legislation proposes a handgun freeze and rifle buyback. We assess whether these measures are likely to improve safety or whether existing laws already strike a balance. We find little evidence of a strong relationship.

title: Stochastic Potential Choices and Outcomes
abstract: Applied econometricians typically model each individual as having fixed outcomes under treatment and control and, in instrumental-variables (IV) settings, fixed treatment decisions under each value of the instrument. This paper asks what changes when outcomes and treatment allocations or choices are stochastic at the individual level. In the model, each individual has a stable (but possibly stochastic) response type consisting of two objects: a treatment choice probability under each state and a potential outcome distribution under each treatment-state pair. These stochastic potential outcomes change the interpretation of some familiar estimators. For instance, in the deterministic IV model, the estimand identifies treatment effect only for compliers - those whose treatment status switches with the instrument. Under stochastic treatment allocation or choice there is no such subgroup: the estimand averages effects over all individuals, weighting each by how much the instrument, policy, or assignment rule moves their probability of treatment. The paper then gives an information-based foundation for stochastic choice, in which individuals act on expected gains given their information.
tldr: 论文探讨当个体层面的结果和处理分配为随机时，工具变量估计量的解释变化，并给出基于信息的随机选择理论基础。
abstract_cn: 应用计量经济学家通常将每个个体建模为在实验组和对照组中具有固定结果，并在工具变量（IV）设定中，对工具的每个取值具有固定的处理决策。本文探讨当结果以及处理分配或选择在个体层面具有随机性时，会发生何种变化。在该模型中，每个个体具有一个稳定（但可能随机）的反应类型，该类型由两个要素构成：每种状态下的处理选择概率，以及每种处理-状态配对下的潜在结果分布。这些随机潜在结果改变了一些常见估计量的解释。例如，在确定性IV模型中，估计目标仅识别出依从者——即那些处理状态随工具变化而改变的个体——的处理效应。在随机处理分配或选择下，不存在这样的子群体：估计目标对所有个体的效应进行平均，并根据工具、政策或分配规则改变其处理概率的程度对每个个体进行加权。随后，本文为随机选择提供了一个基于信息的基础，在该基础中，个体根据其信息所获得的预期收益采取行动。

title: Using Pre-Trends for Inference in Difference-in-Differences
abstract: Difference-in-differences (DID) are sometimes estimated with many pre-treatment periods. In such settings, the observed pre-treatment outcome evolutions provide direct information about the magnitude of shocks that could also occur after treatment. This paper proposes a simple inference procedure that uses those pre-trends as the reference distribution for the post-treatment DID. The procedure is closely related to existing conformal inference procedures, but its DID-specific predictor leads to a distinct identifying restriction. Existing procedures assume parallel trends, while this paper's procedure does not require parallel trends.
tldr: 提出一种利用预处理趋势作为参考分布进行差分中差分推断的新方法，无需平行趋势假设。

title: Trust by Context, Not by Design? A Quantitative Study of Data Donation Willingness for Open-Source Civic AI in Switzerland
abstract: Civic AI systems increasingly support democratic participation, yet interactions with them may reveal sensitive political views, creating tension between improving AI models and residents' expectations of privacy and consent. This study examines the conditions of transparency and user control under which Swiss residents are willing to donate their anonymized chatbot conversations to train an open-source AI model. A 2x2 between-subjects factorial design evaluated how a Data Nutrition Label and a granular consent dashboard influence donation decisions. The experiment was delivered via a multilingual online survey featuring a custom chatbot powered by the Apertus-70B model. Analysis of the 205 participants revealed that neither transparency nor control significantly affected donation behavior. Rates were uniformly high (91.7% overall), producing a ceiling effect, and Bayesian checks confirmed the absence of treatment effects. The dashboard raised perceived control but not donation, and high-control participants actively restricted their data-use settings. A qualitative analysis of 120 open-ended responses indicates that residents framed donation as a contribution to the public good, motivated by democratic participation, an open-source model, and research, while many regarded their anonymized queries as non-personal and therefore low in risk. Interpreted through the privacy calculus, a high perceived benefit coincided with a low perceived risk under high institutional trust, so both sides of the trade-off aligned and interface design had little leverage. Offering control served less to raise donation than to let residents define the terms of their contribution.
tldr: 通过2x2因子设计实验，研究透明度和用户控制对瑞士居民捐赠匿名聊天数据以训练开源AI意愿的影响，发现捐赠率很高且不受界面设计影响，主要受公共善动机和高制度信任驱动。
abstract_cn: 公民人工智能系统日益支持民主参与，然而与之互动可能暴露敏感的政治观点，从而在改进AI模型与居民对隐私和同意的期望之间产生张力。本研究考察了透明度和用户控制的条件，在此条件下瑞士居民愿意捐赠其匿名化的聊天机器人对话，以训练一个开源AI模型。一项2×2受试者间因子设计评估了数据营养标签（Data Nutrition Label）和细粒度同意控制面板（granular consent dashboard）如何影响捐赠决策。该实验通过一项多语言在线调查进行，其中包含一个由Apertus-70B模型驱动的定制聊天机器人。对205名参与者的分析显示，透明度与控制均未显著影响捐赠行为。捐赠率普遍较高（总体为91.7%），产生了天花板效应，贝叶斯检验确认了处理效应不存在。控制面板提升了感知控制感，但未提高捐赠率，且高控制组参与者主动限制了其数据使用设置。对120份开放式回答的定性分析表明，居民将捐赠视为对公共利益的贡献，其动机源于民主参与、开源模型及研究，同时许多人认为其匿名化查询不具个人属性，因此风险较低。通过隐私计算（privacy calculus）进行解读，在高制度信任下，高感知收益与低感知风险并存，因此权衡双方趋于一致，界面设计的影响力有限。提供控制的作用更多是让居民定义其贡献的条件，而非提高捐赠率。

title: Robust Signal Maximization in Spillover Experiments
abstract: We study the optimal design and analysis of experiments for estimating spillover effects. Assuming a known (e.g., linear) exposure mapping, we characterize the treatment-assignment distribution and regression-based estimator that minimize worst-case asymptotic variance against a broad class of distributions of unobservables. The design problem yields an intuitive solution in which the planner trades off spillover signal strength against diffusion of spillover variation. The analysis problem yields a simple recentered instrumental variable estimator to best leverage this variation. This framework produces natural solutions in several benchmark cases - such as clustered exposure - and suggests computationally tractable approximations for general networks, including bipartite settings. We illustrate these new tools in semi-synthetic experiments based on two applications from development economics. Our approach yields large standard error reductions in both experiments, increasing effective sample sizes by 50-100% or more.
tldr: 论文研究溢出效应实验的最优设计与分析，提出最小化最坏情况渐近方差的处理分配和回归估计量，并在发展经济学应用中展示有效性。
abstract_cn: 我们研究了用于估计溢出效应的实验的最优设计与分析。在已知（例如线性）暴露映射的假设下，我们刻画了能够最小化针对一大类不可观测变量分布的最坏情况渐近方差（worst-case asymptotic variance）的处理分配分布（treatment-assignment distribution）与基于回归的估计量（regression-based estimator）。该设计问题产生了一个直观的解决方案，其中规划者需要在溢出信号强度（spillover signal strength）与溢出变异扩散（diffusion of spillover variation）之间进行权衡。分析问题则产生了一个简单的重新中心化工具变量估计量（recentered instrumental variable estimator），以最佳地利用这种变异。该框架在若干基准情形（如聚类暴露，clustered exposure）中给出了自然的解决方案，并为一般网络（包括二分图设定，bipartite settings）提供了计算上易于处理的近似方法。我们基于发展经济学的两个应用案例，在半合成实验中展示了这些新工具。我们的方法在两个实验中都大幅降低了标准误，使有效样本量增加了50%-100%或更多。

title: Path-Space Model Risk via Signature-Induced Optimal Transport
abstract: We propose a signature-induced, optimal transport framework for path-space model risk, in which ambiguity between stochastic path laws is factorized through optimal transport costs on signature coordinates under a common coupling. Via an ambient feature-space relaxation, we derive for affine signature scores and affine half-space events explicit robust expectation and probability bounds that depend only on the baseline model. In both cases, the correction is governed by the same effective budget, which depends only on the affine score and the budget vector of the ambiguity set. Moreover, the same quantity leads to a budget-aware sparse signature surrogate method for more general, possibly implicit, or data-driven, path functionals. We illustrate the resulting methodology through controlled stress tests and benchmark model-misspecification problems in finance and insurance.
tldr: 提出签名诱导最优传输框架量化路径空间模型风险，通过仿射签名得分和半空间事件推导鲁棒界限，应用于金融保险压力测试。

title: The Long-Run Impacts of Protected Areas on Income, Birds, and Tourism in South Africa
abstract: Protected areas cover 17% of the world’s land surface, yet credible evidence on their long-run economic and ecological impacts remains scarce. This paper estimates the effects of South Africa’s protected areas on household income, bird biodiversity, and tourism consumer surplus. For the income and biodiversity analyses, it develops a machine-learning counterfactual approach that recovers the present-day impacts of protected areas created up to 100 years ago. Short-run impacts of newer protected areas are small and statistically insignificant, while older protected areas generate large gains. Prior research may have severely underestimated the benefits of protected areas by only estimating the short-run effects of newly established protected areas. In aggregate, this paper estimates that protected areas increase annual household income by approximately R300 billion (roughly 10% of 2011 GDP). This yields approximately 7.6 million job-equivalents attributable to South Africa’s protected areas. Different types of protected areas play complementary roles in conserving different categories of threatened birds, demonstrating the value of South Africa’s entire protected area network. A structural travel cost model estimates that South Africa’s national parks generate R7.7 billion per year (2023 rand) in recreational value for domestic and international tourists. These results suggest that in South Africa there is little tradeoff between wildlife conservation and economic development. Realizing the economic and ecological benefits of protected areas, however, requires patience: returns to conservation accumulate over decades, not years.

title: Do Markets Deliver? Competition and Choice in European Healthcare Markets
abstract: In the last two decades European policy makers have sought to increase the use of market mechanisms in the delivery of healthcare. These reforms introduce competition and choice into previously heavily constrained environments. This leads to a set of interesting economic issues that have been addressed in a range of papers, both theoretical and empirical. This paper examines whether this popular reform model has resulted in improvements in outcomes for patients and/or taxpayers. It synthesises the existing economic analyses, highlights what is known and what is not, and signals potential next steps for economic research.

title: A Regressive Shock? The Distributional Consequences of Middle East Conflict-Driven Inflation for German Households
abstract: The escalation of the conflict in the Middle East in late February 2026 led to a sharp upward revision in inflation forecasts for Germany, which we attribute primarily to the conflict itself. Using microsimulation methods adapted to simulate a commodity price change, we translate this forecast revision into upper bounds on household-specific purchasing-power losses via a compensating variation approach, distinguishing the loss recovered through consumption taxes from the full loss including the pre-tax transfer to producers. Both measures are sizeable and regressive: in 2026, the average household loses 0.25% of income through the tax channel and 1.15% under the full measure, with bottom-decile losses of 0.63% and 2.87% against 0.12% and 0.65% for the top decile. The Gini coefficient rises by up to 0.14 points, and elderly households are disproportionately affected. Our results show that a supply-side shock originating outside Europe can have a sizeable and unequal impact on household living standards.

title: Inference Based on Scale, Label, and Economic Restrictions
abstract: The results of nearly 100 prominent studies in empirical macroeconomics have been called into question by Baumeister and Hamilton (2018). We show that their concern about distributional asymmetry for a typical question of interest under a uniform prior with respect to the Haar measure is actually driven by an unacknowledged sign restriction. We also demonstrate that such a prior induces symmetric prior distributions over individual impulse responses conditional on the reduced-form parameters, or more generally when the prior over the reduced-form covariance matrix rules out correlation among the residuals, as in the typical implementation of the Minnesota prior. Furthermore, we provide a theory for avoiding the pitfalls of Baumeister and Hamilton’s critique. Key to our theory is a proposition establishing that any restriction can be decomposed into three types: scale, label, and economic. We use this theory to develop an algorithm for inference based on the unit modulus normalization that tackles a practical problem commonly faced by users of Bayesian SVAR methods.

title: Import tariff transmission in a production network
abstract: We find that whether US import tariffs have supply-side effects or demand-side effects on US manufacturing sectors depends on where the affected sectors are located in the US production network. Using local projections in a panel of US manufacturing sectors, we find that US import tariffs —including the 2018-19 tariff hikes— led to sectoral output contractions via two different channels: (1) Tariff increases act as negative supply shifters for sectors that use goods from tariff-facing sectors as input in production and thus face rising input costs. (2) Tariff increases act as negative demand shifters for sectors whose customer sectors suffer negative supply side effects due to tariffs and reduce their production. We show that these results are consistent with a stylized production network model featuring complementarities in production. Overall, our finding suggests that tariffs markedly reduce US manufacturing production and that the role of input–output linkages is key for understanding the transmission of import tariff shocks to output and producer prices.

title: The devil in the DeTail: assessing state-contingent tail effects of a releasable macroprudential capital buffer using a parsimonious agent-based framework
abstract: This paper develops an agent-based framework (DeTail) to assess the state-contingent tail effects of releasable macroprudential capital buffers. The model features heterogeneous firms, households, and banks, and a single central bank, all interacting in a fully integrated, stock-flow consistent framework which generates endogenous credit cycles. Using this approach, we evaluate how time-varying capital requirements affect the time-varying distributions of credit growth, firm and household default rates, and bank losses along the credit cycle. Policy experiments show that releasing capital buffers during economic downturns preserves credit supply by improving risky (lower-tail) credit outcomes, reduces both household and firm defaults, and supports macro-financial resilience by limiting tail bank losses. At the same time, capital buffer accumulation during upturns imposes minimal costs and does not significantly constrain lending. These findings support the active use of releasable buffers to mitigate systemic risk and smooth credit cycles without weakening the banking system.

title: The Price of Regulatory Risk in Housing Markets: Evidence from Berlin
abstract: We study how regulatory risk affects housing markets in the aftermath of rent control. Our setting is Berlin, where a stringent rent cap introduced in 2020 was repealed in 2021, but was followed by continued political debate over expropriation of housing companies and further intervention. Using micro-level listing data and a hedonic difference-in-differences design comparing Berlin to other major German cities, we show that Berlin’s price-rent ratio remained 10–15 percent below its pre-intervention trend three years after repeal. To interpret this persistence, we develop a simple model in which institutional investors face greater exposure to future regulation. The model predicts lower asset prices, reduced institutional ownership, and partial crowding-in of private investors. Consistent with these predictions, we document a sharp rise in housing policy uncertainty after repeal and show that large housing companies reduced their Berlin portfolios, accepted lower sale prices, and sharply cut construction activity. The results imply that credible threats of future intervention can depress housing valuations and reshape market structure even in the absence of binding regulation.

title: Expert Inflation Preferences and the Evaluation of Monetary Policy
abstract: What inflation rate should central banks target? Using two global surveys, we provide evidence on inflation preferences among economic experts—the group whose models and judgments inform monetary policy. We document that, although experts’ preferred inflation rates are centered on central-bank targets, roughly half of them deviate (symmetrically) from the target. Cross-expert heterogeneity in preferences is driven by (i) beliefs about the costs of disinflation, (ii) normative views on the relative importance of different central bank objectives, and (iii) inflation narratives. Finally, we show that experts’ preferences influence their evaluations of monetary policy decisions, suggesting that experts’ preferences are likely to matter for policymaking.

title: Monetary Policy Challenges in a Volatile World
abstract: Rising macroeconomic volatility and structural transformations—such as deglobalization, climate risks, and rapid AI adoption—are reshaping inflation dynamics and the trade-offs faced by monetary policy. We find that the current framework retains sufficient flexibility to balance inflation and output stabilization, provided inflation expectations remain well anchored, and policy responses appropriately reflect the size and persistence of supply shocks, as well as prevailing economic conditions.

title: Belief Disagreement, Instability, and Uncertainty under Stochastic Recall
abstract: Expectations are typically modeled as functions of an agent’s information set. Using preregistered evidence, we show that beliefs depend instead on the information agents retrieve when forming them. Even after observing identical histories of inflation or stock returns, individuals recall different observations, and their beliefs track what they retrieve. Selective recall therefore generates disagreement, within-person belief instability, and heterogeneity in subjective uncertainty without any new information. We formalize these patterns in a parsimonious model in which agents store observed signals, retrieve each only probabilistically, and update optimally using recalled rather than objectively available information. The model yields sharp predictions for how beliefs vary with the composition of stored information, recall probabilities, and contextual cues. Large-scale experiments that hold information fixed and intervene only after exposure confirm these predictions, while survey evidence on macroeconomic and financial expectations supports their external relevance. Disagreement, instability, and uncertainty are thus structural features of belief formation rather than mere measurement error.

title: Trust but Verify: Benchmarking Gallup World Poll Employment Data Against the EU-Labour Force Survey
abstract: The Gallup World Poll (GWP) links internationally comparable measures of well-being and attitudes to a short labour-market module. We benchmark its employment and hours variables against EU Labour Force Survey (EU LFS) microdata in available European country-years from 2009 to 2023. Under a broad GWP definition that includes both part-time categories, the average country-level GWP-EU LFS employment-rate gap is approximately -1.0 percentage point. The pooled Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition yields a total gap of -0.85 points: observable composition accounts for -0.97 points and the unexplained component is 0.12 points, with a standard error of 1.99 points. This aggregate result masks country and demographic heterogeneity. A narrow definition that excludes part-time work understates employment by roughly 10-20 points. For hours, the GWP mean is 40.18 hours per week, compared with 37.41 in the EU LFS. Demographic reweighting reduces the aggregate difference from 2.77 to 1.99 hours, while group-specific reweighting raises each country-group difference by 0.11 to 0.58 hour. Hours reports generally require more recall and aggregation than binary employment status. The GWP limits this burden by anchoring employment to the preceding seven days and recording total weekly hours in five intervals. The resulting variable provides a common interval-based measure of work intensity; exact mean levels depend on the values assigned to those intervals.

title: Measuring inequality and social stratification with Lorenz curvature
abstract: We construct a continuous family of inequality and social stratification indices based on the curvature of the Lorenz curve. We study the inequality axioms of the family and find that they are satisfied only with the so-called stratification-aversion parameter $α$ set to 0 -- in all other cases, these constraints cannot be satisfied in a strict sense. With $α= 0$, the index has a very simple closed form and its value can be easily approximated. We study the values of the index on World Bank inequality data and see how the rankings across a wide selection of countries change as $α$ is varied. Spearman and Kendall rank-correlation matrices with other common indices are also computed and analyzed. We find the curvature index to deviate consistently from the comparison indices, albeit less so for consumption- than income-based countries.

title: Unfit for stranding assessment: a panel-scale multimodal-LLM audit of building-decarbonisation disclosure (BeDA)
abstract: Buildings account for roughly 34% of global final energy use and 37% of energy- and process-related CO$_2$ emissions. Stranding regulation now being enacted (New York City Local Law 97, the EU Energy Performance of Buildings Directive recast) presupposes that a building portfolio's carbon intensity can be measured per square metre and compared against a science-based pathway. Whether corporate disclosure is actually fit for that comparison has not, to our knowledge, been measured at scale. We introduce BeDA (the Built-environment Decarbonisation-disclosure Auditor), a multimodal large-language-model instrument, and apply it to a global firm panel (2,246 firms, 2003-2023). Its standards-compliance score is reliable across models and model families and convergent with three independent external criteria. Most disclosure is unfit: only about one built-environment firm-report in five discloses operational carbon intensity per $m^2$ (21.5% in a region-stratified sample of 200 firm-reports, Wilson 95% CI [16.4%, 27.7%], inter-extractor $κ$=0.95; 45.5% across 519 real-estate firm-reports, $κ$=0.97). The rate is roughly twice as high in Europe as in the United States (64-74% versus 37% for listed real estate). Among the 215 real-estate firm-reports for which an intensity can be constructed, 39% already exceed the Carbon Risk Real Estate Monitor (CRREM) 1.5 °C pathway's intensity limit. Credibility does not predict stranding readiness once portfolio size is controlled; this is a screening tool, not a forecast. The main obstacle to enforceable building-stranding regulation is therefore a measurable, jurisdiction-specific reporting gap, one that a targeted disclosure mandate can close and that BeDA can monitor.

title: Are cryptocurrencies real financial bubbles? Evidence from quantitative analyses
abstract: The growth of peer-to-peer exchanges and the blockchain technology has led to a proliferation of cryptocurrencies and to a massive increase in the number of investors who actually negotiate digital money. Cryptocurrencies trade at prices mainly driven by investor sentiment, becoming a potential source of financial bubbles and instabilities. In this work, we apply quantitative models to the study of Bitcoin and Ether, two of the most famous cryptocurrencies. Our bubble detection methodology combines the Log Periodic Power Law (LPPL) model, originally created by Johansen, Ledoit and Sornette (JLS), and the statistical model developed by Phillips, Shi, and Yu (PSY). In particular, we employ three different versions of JLS model, i.e. Ordinary Least Square (OLS), Generalised Least Squares (GLS) and Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), and two PSY statistical tests (BSADF and BSADF*). We find that, during the sample period 1st December 2016 - 16th January 2018, Bitcoin shows typical hallmarks of a bubble phase in mid December 2017 and in the first half of January 2018, anticipating the large crashes observed thereafter. Also the Ether price dynamics reveals bubble evidence in mid June 2017, anticipating the crash observed on 12th June, and a weaker signal around 12th January 2018, anticipating the crash observed in the same days. This paper confirms the high risk of speculative bubbles associated with cryptocurrencies, related to investor exuberance pumping market prices far away from their fundamental values, thus creating critical situations subject to possible crashes. Our methodology is general and can be applied to virtually any financial time series, and may support investing and risk management strategies.

title: CausalForge: A Formally Grounded, Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Research in Causal Inference
abstract: Automating theoretical research is constrained not only by the generation of candidate results, but also by their reliable evaluation. A common approach is to close the research loop with a large language model (LLM) reviewer. However, such reviewers remain empirically unreliable: they may accept fabricated papers and detect them at rates close to chance (Bad Scientist, 2025). We present CausalForge, a framework for automated theoretical research in causal inference grounded in the Lean proof assistant. CausalForge combines Causalean, a foundational Lean library for causal inference containing 7,035 machine-checked declarations developed with language-model assistance under human design and review, with CausalSmith, a self-improving agentic pipeline that selects research topics, proposes results, formalizes statements, constructs proofs, and presents the resulting artifacts for human inspection. Because a machine-checked proof establishes only that a formal statement follows from its assumptions, not that the statement faithfully captures the intended scientific claim, the pipeline augments kernel verification with a statement audit that compares each formal theorem against the informal claim it is intended to express. We evaluate the system using artifacts produced by completed autonomous research runs. The source code, formal library, and run records are available at https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/CausalForge.

abstract_cn: 将理论研究自动化不仅受限于候选结果的生成，更受限于对其可靠性的评估。一种常见方法是利用大型语言模型（LLM）评审者来闭合研究循环。然而，此类评审者在经验上仍不可靠：它们可能接受伪造的论文，且检测伪造论文的能力接近随机水平（Bad Scientist, 2025）。我们提出CausalForge，一个基于Lean证明助手的因果推断自动化理论研究框架。CausalForge结合了Causalean（一个基础的因果推断Lean库，包含7,035个机器验证的声明，这些声明在人类设计与评审下借助语言模型辅助开发）与CausalSmith（一个自我改进的智能体流水线，负责选择研究主题、提出结果、形式化陈述、构建证明，并呈现最终产物供人类审查）。由于机器验证的证明仅能确立形式化陈述由其假设推导得出，而无法确保该陈述忠实反映预期的科学主张，该流水线在核心验证之外增设了陈述审计环节，将每个形式化定理与其旨在表达的非正式主张进行比对。我们利用已完成自主研究运行所生成的产物对系统进行评估。源代码、形式化库及运行记录均可在https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/CausalForge获取。

title: To what extent can long-differencing capture climate adaptation?
abstract: Understanding the degree to which we are able to adapt to climate change is central to economic assessments of future climate damages. Economists increasingly use comparisons between long differences and fixed effects estimators to measure climate adaptation. We show that such comparisons can be misleading. Neither estimator is consistent for its intended parameter, as both the long-difference (LD) and fixed effects (FE) estimands are weighted averages of the long- and short-run responses to climate and weather. As a result, the difference between the two understates the true extent of adaptation, and the standard test based on this difference --while controlling size -- tends to be substantially underpowered in the settings researchers typically encounter. An empirically-calibrated simulation shows this difference understates adaptation by about 30--80%, depending on the averaging window.
tldr: 论文通过理论分析和模拟证明，长期差分与固定效应估计量的比较会低估气候适应程度，偏差约30-80%。
abstract_cn: 理解人类适应气候变化的能力程度，是评估未来气候损害的经济学核心问题。经济学家越来越多地使用长期差分（long differences, LD）与固定效应（fixed effects, FE）估计量之间的比较来衡量气候适应能力。我们证明，此类比较可能具有误导性。这两种估计量对其目标参数均不具有一致性，因为长期差分（LD）和固定效应（FE）的估计目标都是对气候与天气的长期及短期响应的加权平均值。因此，两者之间的差异低估了真实的适应程度，而基于该差异的标准检验——在控制检验规模的同时——在研究者通常遇到的情境中往往功效严重不足。一项基于经验校准的模拟显示，根据平均窗口的不同，该差异对适应程度的低估幅度约为30%至80%。

title: Nonlinear Boosting with Multiple Testing in High-Dimensional Generalised Linear Models with Binary Responses
abstract: This paper proposes a nonlinear boosting with multiple testing (BMT) approach to variable selection in high-dimensional generalised linear models with binary responses. At each stage of the BMT procedure, the model is updated by adding only the most significant covariate, conditional on those already selected in previous stages, while taking into account the multiple testing nature of the problem. It is shown that, under the stated conditions, the BMT procedure selects all covariates whose true coefficients are nonzero, and no other covariates, with probability tending to one. Furthermore, the procedure enjoys an oracle property, in the sense that the post-BMT maximum likelihood estimator of the parameters of the model is asymptotically equivalent to an oracle estimator that knows the correct sparse model in advance. Monte Carlo experiments demonstrate that BMT outperforms competing methods, delivering high covariate-selection accuracy and low parameter estimation error. An empirical example illustrates that BMT delivers a predictive model for the probability that U.S. inflation exceeds a given threshold over a 12-month horizon which has very good out-of-sample performance.
tldr: 提出一种非线性Boosting与多重检验结合的变量选择方法，用于高维广义线性模型（二值响应），理论证明其选择一致性及Oracle性质，实证预测美国通胀阈值概率。

title: Interventional Score Geometry for Causal Inference
abstract: Let $p(x)$ be the joint density of variables $X$, and let $ψ(x)=\nabla_x\log p(x)$ be its score field. Geometry constructed from $p$ and $ψ$ alone cannot identify causal direction: structural models with the same observational distribution have the same score geometry. I develop an interventional analogue. A hard intervention $\operatorname{do}(X_k=ξ)$ does not merely reweight the joint law; it restricts the distribution to the submanifold ${x_k=ξ}$. Its score should therefore be defined on the remaining $d-1$ free coordinates. I define causal influence $X_k\rightsquigarrow X_j$ as variation of the interventional marginal distribution of $X_j$ with $ξ$, and show that the corresponding derivative of the marginal interventional score gives a local sufficient condition for influence. Projecting the observational score onto admissible intervention directions does not generally recover causal response: two models may share the same observational score and admissible set yet respond differently. I therefore introduce an interventional response field supplied by structural information. A causal metric is defined as the Fisher information metric on a family of interventions with a common target, avoiding ill-posed comparisons across targets. The framework yields a geometric dictionary for randomized trials, instrumental variables, and conditional-independence designs, clarifying what each does and does not identify. A bivariate Gaussian example gives two models with the same observational score but different interventional score derivatives. The framework organizes relations among designs, interventions, and score fields, but adds no identification beyond the underlying assumptions. In Pearl's Ladder of Causation, observational score geometry belongs to association, intervention-indexed score fields to intervention, and unit-level counterfactual geometry is left for future work.
tldr: 提出干预得分几何框架，通过硬干预下的得分场导数定义因果影响，并比较不同因果推断设计。
abstract_cn: 设 $p(x)$ 为变量 $X$ 的联合密度，并令 $ψ(x)=\nabla_x\log p(x)$ 为其得分场。仅由 $p$ 和 $ψ$ 构建的几何结构无法识别因果方向：具有相同观测分布的结构模型具有相同的得分几何。本文发展了一种干预类比。硬干预 $\operatorname{do}(X_k=ξ)$ 并非仅对联合律进行重新加权；它将分布限制在子流形 ${x_k=ξ}$ 上。因此，其得分应定义在剩余的 $d-1$ 个自由坐标上。我将因果影响 $X_k\rightsquigarrow X_j$ 定义为 $X_j$ 的干预边际分布随 $ξ$ 的变化，并证明边际干预得分的相应导数给出了影响的局部充分条件。将观测得分投影到可允许的干预方向上通常无法恢复因果响应：两个模型可能共享相同的观测得分和可允许集，但响应却不同。因此，我引入了一个由结构信息提供的干预响应场。因果度量被定义为针对具有共同目标的一系列干预的Fisher信息度量，从而避免了跨目标的不恰当比较。该框架为随机试验、工具变量和条件独立性设计提供了一种几何词典，阐明了每种方法能识别和不能识别的内容。一个二元高斯示例给出了两个具有相同观测得分但不同干预得分导数的模型。该框架梳理了设计、干预和得分场之间的关系，但在基本假设之外并未增加任何可识别性。在Pearl的因果阶梯中，观测得分几何属于关联层，干预索引得分场属于干预层，而单位级反事实几何则留待未来研究。

title: Partial Identification with Auxiliary Moment Restrictions
abstract: Partial identification is often set aside in practice because the identification regions it delivers are too wide to be useful, pushing researchers toward strong assumptions that buy point identification at the cost of credibility. We show that a source of information already sitting in most interval-valued datasets can fix this without adding any assumption at all. When an outcome is reported only as an interval---because a data custodian bracketed, top-coded, or formally privatized it to protect respondents---the same custodian typically continues to publish accurate population aggregates of that outcome, precisely because doing so does not compromise any individual record. We develop a framework for exploiting exactly this information: restricting the set of admissible completions of the data to those consistent with a known aggregate, rather than restricting the interval itself, and characterizing the sharp identification region that results for the best linear predictor. The restrictions we study behave in strikingly different ways---some collapse the region by a full dimension, others narrow it while leaving its shape intact. We characterize the geometric effect of each restriction and derive closed-form directional measures of identifying value for the mean and conditional-mean cases. An illustration using interval-valued wages from the Current Population Survey shows that the effect is far from marginal: modest auxiliary information recovers a substantial share of the identifying power usually thought to be lost once an outcome is coarsened.
tldr: 本文提出利用已知总体矩（如均值）作为辅助约束，缩小区间数据下部分识别区域的方法，并推导了最优线性预测的尖锐识别区域。
abstract_cn: 部分识别在实践中常被搁置，因其产生的识别区域过宽而缺乏实用性，迫使研究者采用以可信度为代价换取点识别的强假设。我们证明，大多数区间值数据集中已存在的信息源无需添加任何假设即可解决这一问题。当结果仅以区间形式报告时——因数据保管者出于保护受访者目的而进行分组、顶部编码或正式私有化处理——同一保管者通常会继续发布该结果的准确总体汇总值，这正是因为此举不会危及任何个体记录。我们构建了一个框架以充分利用此类信息：将数据的可行补全集合限制为与已知汇总值一致的子集，而非限制区间本身，并刻画由此产生的最佳线性预测的尖锐识别区域。我们所研究的限制以截然不同的方式发挥作用——部分限制将区域压缩一个完整维度，另一些则在不改变其形状的前提下收窄区域。我们刻画了每种限制的几何效应，并推导出均值与条件均值情形下识别价值的闭式方向性度量。基于当前人口调查中区间值工资数据的实证表明，该效应绝非边际性的：适度的辅助信息即可恢复通常被认为在结果粗化后丧失的相当一部分识别力。

title: Latent Fragility and Clustered Withdrawals in Dynamic Banks Runs
abstract: Using a mean-field game framework, we study a dynamic model of bank runs in which more withdrawals raise the risk of bank failure. Even though depositors receive gradual and idiosyncratic shocks, withdrawals occur in clusters. The main mechanism is latent fragility: run-prone depositors accumulate gradually over time and may prefer to wait individually, but they withdraw together once collective exit becomes self-fulfilling. We establish equilibrium existence and characterize earliest-run and latest-run equilibria. The clustering mechanism arises whether depositor heterogeneity is discrete or continuous. A common aggregate state coordinates withdrawal timing and leads to a unique threshold equilibrium.
tldr: 利用平均场博弈框架研究银行挤兑的动态模型，发现即使存款人受到渐进异质性冲击，提款仍会聚集发生，机制是潜在脆弱性导致挤兑倾向存款人积累并同时退出。

title: A Revelation Principle for Rationalizability
abstract: We establish a revelation principle for interim correlated rationalizability. Revealing only terminal rationalizable action sets fails because it discards information on higher order beliefs that generated them. We therefore use the full hierarchy of surviving action sets. When exact best-response regions are convex, the induced distribution over states and hierarchies implements itself and is characterized by level-by-level obedience constraints. All binary-action payoff structures and a class of ordered payoff structures with interval best-response sets are polyhedral. For arbitrary finite payoff structures, we partition exact best-response regions into finitely many convex cells and tag each hierarchy level by its cell. Tagged hierarchies satisfy analogous obedience constraints and project onto the ordinary rationalizability hierarchy. Thus every finite payoff structure admits a payoff-structure-dependent direct representation with finitely many tags at each level.
tldr: 本文建立了一个关于理性化的启示原理，通过层级幸存行动集和逐级服从约束来刻画可理性化策略。

title: Natural Invariant Measures for Chaotic Game Dynamics: Finding Order in Chaos
abstract: We study the long-term behavior of the Multiplicative Weights Update (MWU) algorithm in game settings where learning dynamics frequently fail to converge to Nash equilibria and instead exhibit Li-Yorke chaos. While such chaos precludes the prediction of specific long-term strategy profiles, it does not imply a lack of statistical structure. We demonstrate that natural invariant measures - a fundamental concept from ergodic theory - provide the rigorous framework necessary to find order within this chaos. Focusing on a two-strategy congestion game, we prove that these measures allow for a comprehensive statistical characterization of the dynamics. Crucially, we show that this framework extends beyond simple strategy frequencies to \emph{general observables}, enabling the precise calculation of long-term time averages for broad classes of economic metrics - including payoffs, social cost, and regret - despite chaos. Our results reveal that this simple learning algorithm captures the full spectrum of behaviors found in one-dimensional dynamical systems, from unique or multiple absolutely continuous invariant measures to complex periodic attractors as well as coexisting chaotic and stable (periodic) behaviors. By bridging game theory and dynamical systems, we show that statistical predictability is attainable even in the absence of pointwise convergence.
tldr: 研究乘法权重更新算法在博弈中的混沌行为，利用自然不变测度从统计角度刻画长期动态，证明即使没有点态收敛，仍可计算经济指标的时间平均。

title: Screening with Product Mismatch
abstract: A monopolist sells a product line whose variants are horizontally differentiated from the buyers' perspective but ordered by production cost. Buyers privately know their ideal product, and willingness to pay may be correlated with horizontal need. The seller screens buyers through product mismatch, and what she must screen determines whether mismatch creates or reduces information rent. When buyers differ only in horizontal need, mismatch creates rent: the seller induces less mismatch, assigning served buyers products closer to their ideals than under the first best. When willingness to pay is correlated with horizontal need, mismatch instead reduces rent: the seller induces more mismatch, sells the basic product to buyers whose efficient products are advanced variants while excluding buyers better matched to it, and stronger horizontal differentiation can expand coverage and raise profit. Because mismatch is type-specific, optimal allocations are determined by individual rationality rather than by incentive compatibility alone.
tldr: 研究垄断厂商如何通过产品错配（水平差异化）来筛选具有私人信息的消费者，分析错配对信息租金的影响，并求解最优分配。
abstract_cn: 一个垄断者销售一条产品线，其变体从买方视角来看是水平差异化的，但按生产成本排序。买方私下知晓自己的理想产品，其支付意愿可能与水平需求相关。卖方通过产品错配来筛选买方，而卖方必须筛选的内容决定了错配是增加还是减少信息租金。当买方仅在水平需求上存在差异时，错配会产生租金：卖方会诱导较少的错配，使所服务的买方获得比第一最优（first best）情况下更接近其理想的产品。当支付意愿与水平需求相关时，错配反而会减少租金：卖方会诱导更多的错配，将基础产品销售给那些有效产品为高级变体的买方，同时排除与之匹配度更高的买方，而更强的水平差异化可以扩大覆盖范围并提高利润。由于错配具有类型特异性，最优配置由个体理性（individual rationality）而非仅由激励相容（incentive compatibility）决定。

title: Optimal Surplus Management for Insurers under Stochastic Interest Rates and Jump-Driven Liabilities
abstract: This paper investigates the optimal surplus management problem of an insurance company operating in a financial market with stochastic interest rates and jump-driven liabilities. The insurer dynamically allocates its surplus between a risky stock and a risk-free zero-coupon bond while facing insurance claims modeled by a compound Poisson process with exponentially distributed claim sizes. The short term interest rate follows a Cox-Ingersoll-Ross (CIR) process, which captures mean-reverting dynamics commonly observed in term structure models. The insurer maximizes the expected exponential utility of terminal surplus. Using stochastic control techniques, we derive the associated Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation. Although the exponential utility structure suggests an exponential affine representation, the interaction between the interest rate hedge and the surplus state generates quadratic surplus terms in the HJB equation. To obtain a tractable formulation, we adopt a normalized surplus projection method, which provides an approximate reduction of the full three-dimensional problem to a nonlinear system of partial differential equations (which is subsequently numerically validated). The optimal investment policy admits an economically meaningful decomposition consisting of a myopic demand component and an interest rate hedging component. Numerical experiments illustrate how the optimal strategy and the surplus distribution depend on interest rate volatility, claim intensity, and risk aversion. The results highlight the importance of jointly modeling stochastic interest rates and insurance liability risk when designing optimal investment policies for insurance companies.
tldr: 本文研究保险公司在随机利率（CIR过程）和复合泊松索赔下的最优投资策略，通过HJB方程和归一化盈余投影方法求解，得到包含对冲需求的策略分解。
abstract_cn: 本文研究了在随机利率与跳跃驱动负债的金融市场中运营的保险公司的最优盈余管理问题。保险公司将其盈余动态配置于风险股票与无风险零息债券之间，同时面临由复合泊松过程（compound Poisson process）建模的保险索赔，其中索赔规模服从指数分布。短期利率遵循Cox-Ingersoll-Ross（CIR）过程，该过程捕捉了期限结构模型中常见的均值回归动态。保险公司以最大化期末盈余的期望指数效用为目标。利用随机控制技术，我们推导了相应的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程。尽管指数效用结构暗示了指数仿射表示，但利率对冲与盈余状态之间的相互作用在HJB方程中产生了二次盈余项。为获得可处理的公式，我们采用了一种归一化盈余投影方法，该方法将完整的三维问题近似简化为一个非线性偏微分方程组（随后通过数值方法验证）。最优投资策略具有经济学意义的分解，包含短视需求成分与利率对冲成分。数值实验展示了最优策略及盈余分布如何依赖于利率波动率、索赔强度与风险厌恶程度。研究结果强调了在为保险公司设计最优投资策略时，联合建模随机利率与保险负债风险的重要性。

title: Settlement Infrastructure, Inside Money Elasticity, and the Network Economics of Distributed Ledger Technology
abstract: We construct the Settlement Modernisation Index, a panel dataset of 809 reform events across 24 advanced economies between 1993 and 2024, decomposed into three economic channels and three adoption phases. We document an S-curve in inside money elasticity with two interior turning points at SMI = 0.27 and 0.93, separating a liberation phase, a post-global-financial-crisis compliance valley, and a mature-infrastructure recovery phase. We show that settlement modernisation generates network-conditional balance sheet efficiencies through a T2S event-study with year-by-year EMIR decomposition (saturation beta = +0.557, p < 0.01) and an out-of-sample synthetic control null on Switzerland's post-2021 SDX deployment. Applied along the BIS three-layer connectivity taxonomy, the framework forecasts +13.4 percent efficiency recovery from the ECB's Pontes initiative over 2027-2032. Conditional UK and US accession to the Appia composability layer (2028) raises the ceiling to +37.5 percent. Balance-sheet efficiencies from atomic settlement are a property of the bilateral pair, not the node.
tldr: 论文构建结算现代化指数，研究DLT对内部货币弹性和资产负债表效率的网络经济学影响，通过事件研究和合成控制法发现结算现代化可提升效率。
abstract_cn: 我们构建了结算现代化指数（Settlement Modernisation Index, SMI），这是一个涵盖1993年至2024年间24个发达经济体809项改革事件的面板数据集，并将其分解为三个经济渠道和三个采纳阶段。我们发现了内部货币弹性的S形曲线，其两个内部转折点分别位于SMI=0.27和0.93，将曲线划分为解放阶段、全球金融危机后的合规低谷阶段以及成熟基础设施的复苏阶段。通过一项T2S事件研究（结合逐年EMIR分解，饱和贝塔系数=+0.557，p<0.01）以及针对瑞士2021年后SDX部署的样本外合成控制零假设检验，我们证明结算现代化能够产生网络条件约束下的资产负债表效率。将该框架应用于国际清算银行（BIS）三层连接分类法，预测欧洲央行（ECB）的Pontes倡议将在2027-2032年间带来+13.4%的效率复苏。若英国和美国有条件地加入Appia可组合层（2028年），效率上限将提升至+37.5%。原子结算带来的资产负债表效率是双边配对的性质，而非单一节点的属性。

title: Monetary policy transmission in Türkiye under complex external conditions: a multi-method assessment (SVAR-ARDL-LP, 2008–2025)
abstract: Abstract This study analyzes the effectiveness of the monetary transmission mechanism in the Turkish economy under complex external conditions and shifting market regimes. Covering the period 2008M10–2025M08, the analysis employs an integrated multi-method framework combining a structural VAR (SVAR) controlled for external shocks, ARDL bounds testing for exchange-rate pass-through, and local projections (LP) to assess regime dependence. The CBRT overnight rate is utilized as the policy instrument, with inflation, bank credit, and the exchange rate serving as primary variables, while global risk factors (VIX, CDS, Brent oil) are incorporated as controls. The findings demonstrate that transmission in Türkiye operates most prominently through the credit channel relative to other pathways, with policy shocks generating a persistent and robust contraction in credit volume. Conversely, the exchange-rate response is immediate but short-lived, while price effects remain weak and delayed. Notably, the study identifies a state-dependent transmission that becomes sharper during post-2018 high-volatility episodes, exhibiting increased sensitivity to external risk premia. Considering these results, the study recommends strengthening the interest-rate-to-deposit pass-through, mitigating external amplification via FX and risk management, and ensuring effective coordination between monetary and macroprudential tools to support price stability.
tldr: 该论文采用SVAR、ARDL和局部投影方法，评估土耳其2008-2025年货币政策传导机制的有效性，发现信贷渠道最显著，汇率渠道短暂，价格效应弱，且传导具有状态依赖性。
abstract_cn: 本研究分析了在复杂外部环境和多变市场体制下土耳其经济中货币政策传导机制的有效性。研究覆盖2008年10月至2025年8月期间，采用了一种整合多种方法的分析框架，包括控制外部冲击的结构性向量自回归（SVAR）模型、用于检验汇率传递效应的自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验，以及用于评估体制依赖性的局部投影（LP）方法。研究以土耳其中央银行（CBRT）隔夜利率作为政策工具，将通胀、银行信贷和汇率作为主要变量，同时纳入全球风险因素（VIX、CDS、布伦特原油）作为控制变量。研究结果表明，土耳其的传导机制中信贷渠道的作用最为显著，政策冲击会导致信贷规模出现持续且强劲的收缩。相比之下，汇率的反应是即时的但持续时间较短，而价格效应则表现疲弱且存在滞后。值得注意的是，本研究识别出一种状态依赖型传导机制，在2018年后的高波动时期，该机制变得更加显著，并表现出对外部风险溢价更高的敏感性。基于上述结果，本研究建议加强利率向存款的传导效应，通过外汇和风险管理缓解外部放大效应，并确保货币政策与宏观审慎工具之间的有效协调，以支持价格稳定。

analysis.chinese_title: 复杂外部条件下土耳其的货币政策传导：多方法评估（SVAR-ARDL-LP，2008–2025）
analysis.summary: 本研究分析了土耳其经济在复杂外部条件和市场机制转变下货币政策传导机制的有效性。覆盖2008年10月至2025年8月，采用结合结构VAR（SVAR）、ARDL边界检验和局部投影（LP）的多方法框架。以央行隔夜利率为政策工具，通胀、银行信贷和汇率为主要变量，并控制全球风险因素（VIX、CDS、布伦特原油）。结果表明，土耳其的传导主要通过信贷渠道发挥作用，政策冲击对信贷量产生持久且强劲的收缩效应；汇率反应即时但短暂；价格效应微弱且滞后。研究还发现，2018年后高波动时期传导更为显著，对外部风险溢价敏感性增加。建议加强利率-存款传导、通过外汇和风险管理缓解外部放大效应，并确保货币与宏观审慎工具的有效协调以支持价格稳定。
innovations: 采用SVAR、ARDL和LP三种互补方法进行交叉验证，统一评估传导机制。
量化了不同政策制度下短期和长期的汇率传递效应（ERPT）。
通过局部投影识别了高通胀和高外汇波动条件下的状态依赖性传导。
将外部金融条件（VIX、CDS、布伦特原油）作为控制变量，隔离国内政策冲击。
analysis.methodology: 研究采用三部分实证策略：首先，估计四变量结构VAR（SVAR）以追踪政策利率冲击对通胀、信贷和汇率的动态影响；其次，使用ARDL边界检验框架评估不同时期的汇率传递效应；最后，采用局部投影（LP）方法，将SVAR识别的政策冲击作为输入，测试状态依赖性传导。变量包括央行隔夜利率、CPI通胀、银行信贷、汇率，以及工业产出、布伦特原油、VIX和CDS作为控制变量。识别采用递归（Cholesky）排序：政策→通胀→信贷→汇率。
key_results: 信贷渠道是土耳其货币政策传导的主要途径，政策冲击对信贷量产生持久且显著的收缩效应。
汇率对政策冲击的反应即时但短暂，约在3-4个月内回归零。
价格（通胀）对政策冲击的反应微弱且滞后，仅在1-2个月有微小下降。
2018年后高波动时期，传导效应更为显著，信贷收缩和汇率反应均增强。
FEVD显示，政策冲击在12个月后解释约10%的信贷方差、5%的汇率方差和3%的价格方差（VAR(2)基线）。
tech_stack: 自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验
strengths: 多方法框架（SVAR、ARDL、LP）交叉验证，增强结果稳健性。
控制外部风险因素（VIX、CDS、布伦特原油），更准确识别国内政策冲击。
明确考虑状态依赖性，区分高波动与低波动时期的传导差异。
样本期长（2008-2025），涵盖多种政策制度和外部冲击。
进行了广泛的稳健性检验（不同滞后阶数、排序、控制变量组合）。
limitations: SVAR识别依赖递归排序假设，可能不完全反映新兴市场的同期反馈。
部分诊断检验（如正态性、自相关）显示模型设定存在一定偏差，但通过bootstrap和HAC标准误缓解。
未直接识别预期/沟通渠道，仅定性讨论。
局部投影中状态依赖的阈值选择（75百分位）具有一定主观性。
数据频率为月度，可能无法捕捉日内或周度高频动态。

title: Behavioral Environmental Economics
abstract: This paper reviews the growing field of behavioral environmental economics: the study of how cognition, beliefs, and social preferences shape sustainable behavior and the effectiveness and political feasibility of environmental policy. We synthesize recent theoretical, experimental, and empirical contributions, with emphasis on sustainable consumption, green investment, firm behavior, and political economy. We highlight design lessons and open questions for policy and research.
tldr: 综述行为环境经济学，研究认知、信念和社会偏好对可持续行为及环境政策的影响，涵盖消费、投资、企业行为和政治经济。
abstract_cn: 本文综述了行为环境经济学这一新兴领域，该领域研究认知、信念与社会偏好如何塑造可持续行为，以及环境政策的有效性与政治可行性。我们综合了近期理论、实验与实证研究的贡献，重点关注可持续消费、绿色投资、企业行为及政治经济学。我们提炼了政策与研究的启示性设计经验与待解问题。

title: Clause and Effect: Theory and Field Experimental Evidence on Noncompete Clauses
abstract: We study worker noncompete clauses in a large field experiment with two finance firms. Across ~14,000 job offers to freelance recruiters on short-term contracts, we randomize wages and the presence, salience, and duration of noncompetes (all contracts also included a nondisclosure agreement). Removing a noncompete increases mobility between competing employers by 36—52% and raises workers' total earnings from the two firms by 12—17%. We find no evidence — rejecting even small effects — that removing noncompetes generates secret leakage. We also find no evidence that workers choose noncompete jobs for higher pay. Many workers appear unaware of noncompetes before firms' post-employment communication. The results align with a model of inattention and uncertainty about enforcement.
tldr: 通过田野实验研究竞业限制条款对工人流动性和收入的影响，发现移除竞业限制显著提高工人流动性和收入，且无证据表明会导致秘密泄露。
abstract_cn: 我们在两家金融公司开展的大规模田野实验中研究了员工竞业限制条款。针对约14,000份面向短期合同自由招聘人员的职位邀约，我们对薪资水平、竞业限制条款的存在性、显著性与持续时间进行了随机化处理（所有合同均包含保密协议）。取消竞业限制使员工在竞争雇主间的流动性提升36%-52%，并使员工从两家公司获得的总收入增加12%-17%。我们未发现任何证据（即使排除微小效应）表明取消竞业限制会导致秘密泄露。同时，也未发现员工为获得更高薪酬而选择附有竞业限制岗位的证据。许多员工在雇主进行雇佣后沟通前似乎对竞业限制条款并不知情。该结果与注意力不足及执行不确定性模型相吻合。

title: How to Disrupt a Market
abstract: Market design research in economics naturally focusses on how to improve market efficiency. Our objective here is exactly the opposite - how to design interventions that make a market less efficient. Our research is inspired by the growth of illicit markets online where reducing their efficiency may reduce societal harm. Using a web-based experiment, we find that a partial disruption to delivery is an effective method to decrease market efficiency. The decrease is borne by sellers who sell fewer goods and have lower earnings. A consequence of a disruption to delivery, however, is an increase in market concentration because it facilitates the emergence of a dominant seller. In contrast, we find that attacks on seller ratings are ineffective at reducing market efficiency. This study paves the way for evidence-based, causally driven investigations to aid policies to disrupt cybercrime and other illicit markets.
tldr: 通过在线实验发现，部分破坏配送能降低市场效率，但增加市场集中度；攻击卖家评分无效。
abstract_cn: 经济学中的市场设计研究自然聚焦于如何提升市场效率。而我们的目标恰恰相反——如何设计干预措施以降低市场效率。本研究受线上非法市场增长的启发，在这些市场中降低效率可能减少社会危害。通过一项基于网络的实验，我们发现对物流配送的部分阻断是降低市场效率的有效方法。这种效率下降体现在卖家销售商品数量减少、收益降低。然而，物流阻断的一个后果是市场集中度上升，因为它促进了主导卖家的出现。相比之下，我们发现对卖家评分的攻击在降低市场效率方面效果甚微。本研究为基于证据、因果驱动的调查铺平了道路，以助力制定打击网络犯罪及其他非法市场的政策。
