title: Randomness in large language models: What researchers need to know (and report)
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate data for research. Typical use cases are classifications, annotations, information extraction, and generation of numerical scores. Unlike conventional measurements, LLM outputs can vary across repeated requests even when the prompt and apparent model settings remain unchanged. This variation arises from deliberate sampling, silent model updates, numerical rounding, or expert routing. Setting a dedicated temperature parameter to zero removes deliberate sampling when that option is available, but it does not eliminate the other sources of randomness. Exact reproduction is therefore generally not possible when using proprietary application programming interfaces. Local execution of open-weight models offers greater control, but reproducibility still depends on the complete hardware and software stack. We illustrate these issues through sentiment classifications of corporate filings and examine their consequences for downstream regression results. We then propose a reporting standard for articles and replication packages, as well as guidance for data editors and authors. Together, these findings and recommendations establish that LLM outputs should be treated as draws from a distribution rather than as fixed measurements.
tldr: 论文探讨LLM输出的随机性来源，提出报告标准，以情感分类为例说明对回归结果的影响。
abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用于生成研究数据。典型的应用场景包括分类、标注、信息提取以及数值评分生成。与传统测量不同，即使提示词和显式模型设置保持不变，LLM的输出在重复请求中也可能发生变化。这种变化源于有意采样、静默模型更新、数值舍入或专家路由。在可用的情况下，将专用温度参数设置为零可消除有意采样，但无法消除其他随机性来源。因此，在使用专有应用程序编程接口（API）时，通常无法实现精确复现。本地执行开放权重模型提供了更强的控制能力，但可复现性仍取决于完整的硬件与软件栈。我们通过公司文件的情绪分类来阐述这些问题，并考察其对下游回归分析结果的影响。随后，我们提出针对论文与复现包的报告标准，以及面向数据编辑与作者的指导建议。综合而言，这些发现与建议确立了以下观点：LLM输出应被视为从某个分布中抽取的样本，而非固定的测量值。

title: A World of Ginis
abstract: The Gini index remains the most important measure of economic inequality worldwide, and accurate estimates of this index are essential for effective public policies. Yet, Gini estimates for the same country and year vary considerably across data sources, a problem that remains largely unresolved. The paper reviews the largest global and regional databases providing Gini estimates, surveys the related literature, and constructs a unified dataset of 122,351 Gini observations spanning 222 countries and territories and 158 years, from 1867 to 2024. The analysis of this new dataset shows that income-based Ginis exceed consumption-based ones by 4.7 points on average globally, and by as much as 10 points in some regions, with these gaps widening over time. The gross--net income distinction and the use of alternative equivalence scales together with several other measurement choices add further systematic differences. Based on these findings, the paper provides correction factors that can be used to harmonise Ginis built on different welfare concepts. We further show that overall divergence across databases has grown only modestly since 1960, and mainly through the proliferation of databases rather than through genuine divergence among long-standing sources. Thus, improving on the existing discrepancies across Ginis globally is possible, but ultimately depends on database administrators disclosing full details of Gini construction and on users selecting Ginis built on comparable measures.
tldr: 论文构建了全球Gini指数统一数据集，分析不同福利概念导致的差异并提供校正因子，属于收入不平等测量方法研究。
abstract_cn: 基尼系数仍是衡量全球经济不平等的最重要指标，而该系数的准确估算对制定有效的公共政策至关重要。然而，针对同一国家与年份的基尼系数估算值在不同数据来源间存在显著差异，这一问题至今尚未得到根本解决。本文梳理了提供基尼系数估算值的全球及区域主要数据库，综述了相关文献，并构建了一个包含122,351个基尼系数观测值的统一数据集，覆盖222个国家和地区、时间跨度从1867年至2024年共158年。对该新数据集的分析表明，基于收入的基尼系数全球平均比基于消费的基尼系数高出4.7个百分点，部分区域甚至高出10个百分点，且这一差距随时间推移持续扩大。总收入与净收入的区分、不同等值规模（equivalence scales）的使用以及其他若干测量选择，进一步增加了系统性差异。基于上述发现，本文提供了可用于协调基于不同福利概念构建的基尼系数的修正因子。我们进一步发现，自1960年以来，各数据库间的总体差异仅温和增长，且主要源于数据库数量的激增，而非长期来源之间的实质性分歧。因此，改善全球基尼系数现有差异是可能的，但最终取决于数据库管理者公开基尼系数构建的完整细节，以及用户选择基于可比性指标构建的基尼系数。

title: AI Strategy: How to Choose What AI Product to Implement
abstract: Firms struggle to choose AI projects that pay off: two projects can look equally promising to smart, motivated stakeholders and yet deserve opposite decisions. At the residential real-estate brokerage Compass, one AI product (Likely-to-Sell recommendations) flagged sales outreach opportunities and went on to account for nine figures in annual gross commission revenue. Another championed AI product (a Time-on-Market pricing tool) was rightly shelved. A simple ROI estimate could not distinguish the two. We present expected ROI (eROI), a framework that decomposes each bet into three components and rates them separately: Value if Successful, Likelihood of Success, and Investment Required. Each maps to a question executives can answer before building: How valuable would it be if it worked? How likely is it to work? And what would it cost to implement? Separating the three breaks a common catch-22: teams cannot estimate ROI until they know whether a project will work, yet cannot know whether it will work without building it. Judging Value if Successful on its own dissolves the loop, letting a team argue that a product would be valuable if it worked while it weighs how likely that is. The framework also asks, before ranking anything, whether there are enough good ideas on the table. After ranking, it guides assembling a portfolio of bets rather than funding only the single top-ranked project. We illustrate eROI on Compass's candidate AI products. Precise ROI estimates are hard to make given the inherent uncertainty of AI projects. Coarse business-level ratings of the three components are enough to tell strong bets from weak ones.
tldr: 提出eROI框架，将AI项目评估分解为价值、成功概率和投资三部分，帮助公司选择高回报AI产品。
abstract_cn: 企业在选择能够带来回报的人工智能项目时面临困境：两个项目在聪明且积极的利益相关者眼中可能同样前景光明，却需要做出截然相反的决策。在住宅房地产经纪公司Compass，一个人工智能产品（潜在售出推荐）识别了销售拓展机会，并最终贡献了九位数的年度总佣金收入。而另一个备受推崇的人工智能产品（上市时长定价工具）则被明智地搁置。简单的投资回报率（ROI）估算无法区分这两者。我们提出了预期投资回报率（eROI）框架，将每个赌注分解为三个组成部分并分别进行评级：成功后的价值、成功概率以及所需投资。每个部分对应高管在构建项目前可以回答的问题：如果项目成功，其价值有多大？成功的可能性有多高？实施成本是多少？将这三个部分分开，打破了一个常见的两难困境：团队在知道项目是否可行之前无法估算ROI，但若不构建项目又无法知道其是否可行。单独评估"成功后的价值"可以打破这一循环，让团队在权衡项目成功概率的同时，论证产品若成功将具有的价值。该框架还要求在排序之前，先确认是否有足够多的好想法可供选择。排序之后，它引导构建一个投资组合，而非仅资助排名第一的项目。我们以Compass的候选人工智能产品为例说明了eROI。鉴于人工智能项目固有的不确定性，精确的ROI估算难以实现。对三个组成部分进行粗略的业务层面评级，足以区分优劣赌注。

title: Do Carbon Price Forecasts Improve Compliance Procurement? Evidence from European Union Allowances
abstract: Firms covered by emissions trading systems need forecasts not only to value allowances, but also to decide when to buy them. This paper asks whether European Union Allowance (EUA) prices contain short-horizon predictability that survives a forecast-origin information design and improves simulated compliance procurement. Using daily data from 2019 to 2025, we produce direct forecasts for one to five trading days ahead. All predictors are observable at the forecast origin, and calibration and model-selection rules are fixed before the final holdout. The released forecast has the lowest point-estimate RMSE at every horizon among fourteen benchmarks, with the strongest loss-difference evidence at horizons three and four. Relative to a random walk, out-of-sample R^2 rises from 1.2% at one day to 15.5% at five days. We then use the forecast path in a constrained procurement problem with execution costs, market impact, capacity limits, and tail risk; sensitivity exercises add demand uncertainty. For a fixed 100,000-EUA order, optimized schedules lower average realized costs by 8.5 to 38.5 basis points relative to uniform execution across horizons h=2 to h=5. The gains come from reallocating purchases within a fixed window, not from reliable next-day directional timing.
tldr: 论文利用2019-2025年日度数据，检验EUA价格的短期可预测性，并模拟优化合规采购策略，发现预测能降低执行成本。
abstract_cn: 受排放交易体系覆盖的企业不仅需要预测来评估配额价值，还需据此决定购买时机。本文探究欧盟配额（EUA）价格是否具有短期可预测性——这种可预测性能够经受基于预测源的信息设计检验，并优化模拟合规采购。基于2019年至2025年的日度数据，我们生成未来1至5个交易日的直接预测。所有预测因子在预测源时点均可观测，且校准与模型选择规则在最终保留样本前已固定。在十四个基准模型中，所发布的预测在每个预测区间均实现最低的点估计均方根误差（RMSE），其中在第三和第四区间呈现最强的损失差异证据。相较于随机游走模型，样本外R²从1日期的1.2%上升至5日期的15.5%。随后，我们将预测路径应用于包含执行成本、市场冲击、容量限制及尾部风险的约束采购问题中；敏感性分析进一步纳入需求不确定性。针对固定10万EUA订单，相较于在h=2至h=5区间内均匀执行，优化调度方案使平均实现成本降低8.5至38.5个基点。收益源于固定窗口内的购买重新分配，而非可靠的次日方向性择时。

title: Wrong and More Confident: A Field Experiment on Language Models Taking a Graduate Economics Exam
abstract: A red herring, an irrelevant passage added to a problem, makes a language model reason incorrectly and answer incorrectly far more often. Yet the model still writes out a full explanation, and the answer it gives remains consistent with the steps it shows. The red herring corrupts the reasoning, while leaving the explanation intact and coherent. I show this on the Graduate Economic Reasoning Benchmark (GERB), sixty graduate-level microeconomics problems, each a detailed setup with a verified answer and a step-by-step reference solution, presented with and without the red herring and answered by thirty-eight language models in a within-task $2\times2$ design. The red herring lowers the probability of a correct answer by 12.3 percentage points, about a quarter of what these models answer correctly, and thirty-seven of the thirty-eight are less accurate under it. Reasoning capability confers no protection. The effect does not differ detectably between models that reason by default and models with no reasoning mode, nor between open-weight and closed-weight models, though open-weight models reach comparable accuracy at a substantially lower cost per correct answer. The damage is largest on the problems the model rates as easy. Worse, if anything the red herring leads a model to rate a problem as easier, not harder, than its clean version, even as it answers that problem wrong more often. The clean problems are already hard, and on average the models answer fewer than three of every five correctly. A wrong answer still comes with a full explanation, is coherent with its own reasoning, and the model stays confident, so the error cannot be caught without checking it against the verified answer.
tldr: 通过现场实验，发现添加无关信息（红鲱鱼）显著降低语言模型在研究生微观经济学考试中的正确率，且模型自信度未降低，推理能力无保护作用。
abstract_cn: 红鲱鱼（red herring）——即添加到问题中的无关段落——会显著导致语言模型推理错误并给出错误答案。然而，模型仍会写出完整的解释，且其给出的答案与所展示的步骤保持一致。红鲱鱼破坏了推理过程，却使解释保持完整且连贯。我在研究生经济推理基准（Graduate Economic Reasoning Benchmark, GERB）上证明了这一点。该基准包含六十道研究生级别的微观经济学问题，每道题都有详细的设定、经过验证的答案以及逐步参考解答，并在有无红鲱鱼的条件下呈现，由三十八个语言模型在任务内$2\times2$设计中作答。红鲱鱼使正确答案的概率降低了12.3个百分点，约占这些模型正确回答量的四分之一，且三十八个模型中有三十七个在红鲱鱼条件下准确率更低。推理能力并不能提供保护。在默认进行推理的模型与无推理模式的模型之间，以及开放权重模型与封闭权重模型之间，该效应均未检测到显著差异，尽管开放权重模型在达到相近准确率时，每个正确答案的成本显著更低。红鲱鱼对模型自认为容易的问题造成的损害最大。更糟糕的是，红鲱鱼反而会使模型认为问题比其纯净版本更容易，而非更难，即便它回答该问题的错误率更高。纯净版本的问题本身已经很难，平均而言，模型每五个问题中正确回答的不到三个。错误的答案仍然附有完整的解释，与其自身推理保持一致，且模型保持自信，因此若不与经过验证的答案进行核对，就无法发现这一错误。

title: Happy Birthday? Age Labels, Search Criteria, and Matching from Dating to Marriage
abstract: Age is a match trait and a prominent label on search platforms. Using confidential records from a large Japanese marriage platform, I study how a birthday age update affects consideration, applications, relationship progression, and engagement. Only displayed age updates at birthdays. Receivers enter some acceptable-age ranges as they exit others, leaving only modest overall eligibility changes. Application counts often increase. Applications shift from younger to older suitors. Proposal counts fall at nine of ten female receiver ages \(31\text{--}40\), with losses concentrated at entry into early dating. In stage-specific accounting for receivers in their thirties, the no-birthday proposal count is \(12.9\) percent above the benchmark for female receivers and \(6.7\) percent below it for male receivers; the younger-man share in the female-receiver channel is \(4.8\) percentage points higher. Age labels and filters are not neutral windows onto preferences: they govern who marries whom and how many marriages form.
tldr: 利用日本婚姻平台数据，研究生日年龄更新如何影响用户考虑、申请、关系进展和婚姻结果，发现年龄标签和筛选并非中性，而是影响谁与谁结婚及婚姻数量。
abstract_cn: 年龄是一种匹配特征，也是婚恋搜索平台上的显著标签。利用日本某大型婚恋平台的保密记录，我研究了生日年龄更新如何影响关注度、申请、关系进展及订婚。仅在生日时显示年龄更新。当接收者退出某些可接受年龄范围时，又进入另一些范围，整体资格变化幅度有限。申请数量通常有所增加。申请对象从较年轻的追求者转向较年长的追求者。在女性接收者年龄为31至40岁的十个年龄段中，有九个年龄段的求婚数量下降，且损失主要集中在进入早期约会阶段。针对30多岁接收者的分阶段核算显示，无生日更新的求婚数量比基准水平高出12.9%（女性接收者），而男性接收者则低于基准水平6.7%；在女性接收者渠道中，年轻男性占比高出4.8个百分点。年龄标签与筛选机制并非对偏好的中性窗口：它们决定了谁与谁结婚以及婚姻数量的形成。

title: Agentic AI Orchestration of Heterogeneous Economic Models for Rapid, Multi-scenario Analysis of Energy Crises
abstract: Rigorous economic models can take months to construct, yet energy crises demand decisions from policymakers within days or even hours. Any disruption in energy markets is not isolated but rapidly disseminates through interlinked global systems. Off-the-shelf models that already exist typically focus only on limited aspects of the system and are distributed across research groups, programming languages, software architectures not designed for model integration, and incompatible formats. Integrating these models manually can take longer than the crisis itself, forcing analysts to rely on whichever models are easiest to connect and leaving consequential scenarios unexplored. Policymakers must make rapid decisions with obstructed and limited information. We show that large language models can perform the critical integration directly. The system constructs internally consistent scenarios, translates assumptions into model-specific inputs, executes existing economic and physical models in dependency order, and synthesizes outputs tailored to policymakers. The language model generates no quantitative results: every reported value is reproduced directly from an underlying model run, remains traceable to its source and is subject to analyst approval at each stage. We develop a LLM framework that coordinates 16 models of oil, natural gas, shipping, water, helium, fertilizer and macroeconomic equilibrium. The framework is applied across five scenarios to assess the 2026 closure of the Strait of Hormuz and refreshed weekly for eight weeks as events on the ground continued to unfold. By linking models that already exist and reading them as a suite rather than in isolation, this architecture mobilizes distributed scientific models rapidly during energy and geopolitical disruptions while keeping any single model's assumptions from driving the conclusion.
tldr: 论文提出一个基于大语言模型的框架，协调16个经济和物理模型，用于快速分析能源危机（如霍尔木兹海峡关闭）的多情景影响，所有定量结果均来自底层模型运行。
abstract_cn: 构建严谨的经济模型通常需要数月时间，然而能源危机要求政策制定者在数天甚至数小时内做出决策。能源市场的任何扰动都不是孤立的，而是通过相互关联的全球系统迅速扩散。现有的现成模型通常仅关注系统的有限方面，且分散于不同研究团队、编程语言、软件架构（这些架构并非为模型集成而设计）以及不兼容的格式中。手动集成这些模型所需的时间可能比危机持续的时间更长，这迫使分析人员只能依赖最容易连接的模型，从而导致许多重要情景未被探索。政策制定者必须在信息受阻且有限的情况下快速做出决策。我们证明，大型语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）能够直接执行关键的集成工作。该系统构建内部一致的情景，将假设转化为特定模型的输入，按依赖顺序执行现有的经济和物理模型，并综合生成针对政策制定者定制的输出结果。语言模型不产生任何定量结果：每个报告值均直接源自底层模型的运行结果，可追溯至其来源，并在每个阶段接受分析人员的审核。我们开发了一个LLM框架，该框架协调了石油、天然气、航运、水、氦气、肥料及宏观经济均衡等16个模型。该框架被应用于五种情景以评估2026年霍尔木兹海峡的关闭，并在事件持续演变的八周内每周更新一次。通过将现有模型连接起来并将其作为一个整体而非孤立地解读，该架构能够在能源和地缘政治扰动期间快速调动分散的科学模型，同时避免任何单一模型的假设主导最终结论。

title: Ranking-based competitive balance measures in Formula One
abstract: Competitiveness in racing sports can be measured by comparing the start and finish rankings within races, as well as the start and finish rankings across races in a season. Since the importance of position changes is non-uniform and variance at the top of the ranking is more interesting than at the bottom of the ranking, we propose using weighted distances for this purpose. Therefore, two weighting schemes are applied and compared to the standard Kemeny distance to analyse the Formula One between 1950 and 2024. The evolution of competitive balance is unexpectedly robust to the weights, but competition is more intense if one focuses on the top positions. Competitive balance has been more unfavourable in the last two decades than ever before. Statistical tests uncover three structural breaks in competitive balance that are closely related to regulatory changes, highlighting the role of decision-makers in the evolution of competitiveness.
tldr: 该论文提出基于加权排名距离的竞争平衡度量方法，分析1950-2024年F1数据，发现竞争平衡在近二十年最差，且结构性断点与规则变化相关。
abstract_cn: 在竞技体育中，竞争力可通过比较同一赛事内的起跑与完赛排名，以及同一赛季中不同赛事的起跑与完赛排名来衡量。由于位置变化的重要性并非均匀分布，且排名顶端的变化比底端更受关注，我们提出采用加权距离（weighted distances）进行分析。为此，我们应用了两种加权方案，并将其与标准凯梅尼距离（Kemeny distance）进行对比，以分析1950年至2024年间的一级方程式赛车（Formula One）数据。令人意外的是，竞争平衡的演变对权重选择具有稳健性，但若聚焦于排名前列，竞争则更为激烈。过去二十年间，竞争平衡状况比以往任何时候都更为不利。统计检验揭示了竞争平衡中存在的三个结构性断点（structural breaks），这些断点与规则变更密切相关，凸显了决策者在竞争力演变过程中的关键作用。

title: Risk Aversion in the Small and in the Large: Beyond Arrow-Pratt A Wiener Chaos Hierarchy of Dynamic Risk Premia
abstract: The Arrow-Pratt approximation is one of the cornerstones of expected utility theory, providing the classical local approximation of certainty equivalents and risk premia in terms of absolute risk aversion. Despite its widespread use, its mathematical scope and relationship to higher-order risk preferences remain only partially understood. This paper develops a new framework for the analysis of certainty equivalents and dynamic risk premia based on Malliavin calculus and Wiener chaos analysis. We first show that the classical Arrow-Pratt approximation is not asymptotically valid for arbitrary sequences of vanishing risks, thereby identifying precise limitations of the traditional theory. Motivated by this observation, we formulate certainty equivalents dynamically by considering the progressive revelation of uncertainty through a Brownian filtration. Combining Itô calculus, the Clark--Ocone representation and the Wiener chaos decomposition, we derive a complete hierarchy of higher-order dynamic risk premia and obtain explicit representations of the corresponding coefficients in terms of Malliavin derivatives. For mixed Wiener chaos expansions, higher-order preference measures, including prudence and temperance, emerge naturally through interactions between chaos components and are characterised using Bell polynomial representations. Explicit results for quadratic Gaussian functionals and the Vasicek interest-rate model illustrate the theory and identify a broad class of regular Wiener functionals for which the classical Arrow-Pratt approximation is recovered as the leading-order term. The results establish a unified framework linking expected utility theory, stochastic analysis and Wiener chaos expansions, opening a new perspective on higher-order certainty equivalents and the dynamic measurement of risk.

abstract_cn: Arrow-Pratt近似是期望效用理论的基石之一，它基于绝对风险厌恶提供了确定性等价与风险溢价经典的局部近似。尽管其应用广泛，但其数学适用范围以及与高阶风险偏好的关系仍仅被部分理解。本文基于Malliavin微积分与Wiener混沌分析，发展了一个分析确定性等价与动态风险溢价的新框架。我们首先证明，对于任意趋于零的风险序列，经典的Arrow-Pratt近似并非渐近有效，从而揭示了传统理论的精确局限性。受此观察启发，我们通过考虑布朗滤子下不确定性的逐步揭示，动态地构建了确定性等价。结合Itô微积分、Clark-Ocone表示与Wiener混沌分解，我们推导出高阶动态风险溢价的完整层级结构，并获得了相应系数关于Malliavin导数的显式表示。对于混合Wiener混沌展开，包括审慎（prudence）与节制（temperance）在内的高阶偏好度量，通过混沌分量之间的相互作用自然产生，并利用Bell多项式表示进行刻画。关于二次高斯泛函与Vasicek利率模型的显式结果阐释了该理论，并识别出一类广泛的规则Wiener泛函，其中经典的Arrow-Pratt近似作为首阶项得以恢复。这些结果建立了一个统一框架，将期望效用理论、随机分析与Wiener混沌展开联系起来，为高阶确定性等价与风险的动态测量开辟了新的视角。

title: Bounded Attention and Attenuated Elasticities
abstract: We study how bounded attention affects the structural estimation of the elasticity of substitution. In a sparse-max model, equilibrium prices and expenditure shares are observationally equivalent to those of a rational market. Its elasticity equals the structural elasticity scaled by the attention weight. The supply-side orthogonality condition of the covariance-based estimator holds at this attenuated elasticity but fails at the truth. Absent outside information, the estimator converges to the attenuated elasticity. Bounded attention leads to an identification failure that finite-sample and weak-instrument corrections cannot resolve. Because attention cannot exceed one, the estimate provides a lower bound on the structural elasticity.

title: The Direct and Indirect Effects of Genetics and Education
abstract: Genes associated with educational attainment causally improve labour market income, but the economic mechanism behind this relationship is not clear. Using quasi-random variation in genetic inheritance across siblings in the UK Biobank, I estimate the causal effect of the Education PolyGenic Index (Ed PGI) on education and income. A one standard deviation increase in the Ed PGI raises completed education by 0.5 years and later-life income by around 5 percent (replicating the main estimates in Carvalho 2025). I then decompose this total genetic income effect into an indirect channel operating through education years and a residual direct effect, using a causal mediation framework. Unlike structural model-based decompositions, this approach is design-based; one remaining source of uncertainty (the causal return to an extra year of education) is handled transparently through a sensitivity analysis. At correlational education returns of around 6 percent, 65 to 75 percent of the total genetic income effect operates through the years of education channel. Quasi-experimental estimates from the economics literature for Britain imply higher returns to education, suggesting that the mediated share is larger and that the majority of the Ed PGI's income effect operates through completed years of education.
tldr: 利用兄弟姐妹间遗传变异的准随机性，估计教育多基因指数对教育和收入的因果效应，并分解为通过教育年限的间接效应和直接效应。

title: Debiased Machine Learning: Identification, Estimation, and Shape Constraints
abstract: We develop a general framework of identification and estimation for automatic debiased machine learning (DML) where the parameter of interest $θ_0$ is identified by a moment condition involving a nuisance $γ_0$ that may be high dimensional. DML leverages machine learning to estimate $γ_0$ while correcting for regularization and overfitting biases that may otherwise transmit to biased estimation of $θ_0$. We establish conditions under which the Riesz representer $α_0$, which is at the core of DML, is identified, and show that the identification occurs precisely when $α_0$ uniquely optimizes a quadratic functional. This characterization enables us to develop a general estimation procedure for $α_0$ that allows for generic $γ_0$ including those defined by models with endogeneity and encompasses both classical sieves and modern architectures such as deep neural networks. To improve estimation precision and mitigate the curse of dimensionality, we incorporate shape constraints on $γ_0$ by embedding them into a possibly nonlinear parameter space. We illustrate our estimation procedure through simulations and empirical applications.
tldr: 开发了自动去偏机器学习的通用框架，通过Riesz表示子的识别和形状约束提高估计精度，适用于高维nuisance参数模型。
abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个用于自动去偏机器学习（DML）的识别与估计的一般框架，其中目标参数 $θ_0$ 通过一个涉及可能高维的 nuisance 参数 $γ_0$ 的矩条件来识别。DML 利用机器学习估计 $γ_0$，同时纠正可能传导至 $θ_0$ 有偏估计的正则化偏差和过拟合偏差。我们建立了 DML 核心的 Riesz 表示子 $α_0$ 被识别的条件，并表明当且仅当 $α_0$ 唯一地优化一个二次泛函时，识别得以实现。这一特征刻画使我们能够为 $α_0$ 开发一个通用的估计程序，该程序允许处理一般的 $γ_0$，包括由内生性模型定义的 $γ_0$，并涵盖经典筛法和深度神经网络等现代架构。为了提高估计精度并缓解维数灾难，我们将对 $γ_0$ 的形状约束嵌入到可能非线性的参数空间中。我们通过模拟和实证应用展示了所提出的估计程序。

title: Inference on counterfactual distributions using martingale posteriors
abstract: Causal inference is often focused on average effects, which can hide important aspects of the effect distributions. Here we consider the entire posterior effects distribution by estimating full counterfactual outcome distributions. We propose a methodology for inference on counterfactual distributions which builds upon the martingale posterior framework of Fong et al. (2023). This provides a highly flexible approach to estimating densities, distribution functions, and derived quantities such as quantiles, which coherently quantifies the epistemic uncertainty on any target estimand of interest. As the predictive recursions are based on an underlying nonparametric model (a Dirichlet process mixture model), our method naturally inherits robustness with respect to restrictive parametric assumptions. In addition, implementation of our method is typically very fast. This approach can be applied to marginal or conditional counterfactual distributions and is easily extended to an instrumental variables setup. Using the concept of almost conditionally identically distributed random variables, we prove convergence of the martingale posterior inference on the counterfactual outcome distributions for the causal models considered in the paper. We illustrate our approach on both simulated and real data. Using the latter, we investigate the effect of zinc lozenges on common cold duration, the impact of vitamin A supplementation on children's survival rates with one-sided non-compliance (analysed in Imbens and Rubin, 1997a) and the effect of job training (LaLonde, 1986).
tldr: 提出一种基于鞅后验的贝叶斯非参数方法，用于推断反事实分布，并通过模拟和实证案例验证其有效性。
abstract_cn: 因果推断通常聚焦于平均效应，但这可能掩盖效应分布中的重要特征。本文通过估计完整的反事实结果分布，研究了整个后验效应分布。我们提出了一种基于Fong等人（2023）鞅后验框架的反事实分布推断方法。该方法提供了一种高度灵活的途径来估计密度函数、分布函数以及分位数等衍生量，能够连贯地量化任何目标估计量的认知不确定性。由于预测递归基于底层非参数模型（狄利克雷过程混合模型），我们的方法自然继承了相对于限制性参数假设的稳健性。此外，该方法通常具有极快的实现速度。该框架可应用于边际或条件反事实分布，并能轻松扩展至工具变量设定。利用几乎条件同分布随机变量的概念，我们证明了本文所考虑因果模型中反事实结果分布的鞅后验推断的收敛性。我们通过模拟数据和真实数据展示了该方法的应用。在真实数据应用中，我们研究了锌含片对普通感冒持续时间的影响、维生素A补充剂对儿童存活率的影响（存在单侧不依从性，分析参见Imbens与Rubin，1997a），以及职业培训的效果（LaLonde，1986）。

title: Robust estimation of the autocorrelation function via forward ratios
abstract: It is obvious to say that an adequate estimation of the autocorrelation function is central in time series analysis. In this paper, we propose three new robust estimators based on ratios of observations, which offer strong resistance against outliers. While the first estimator, which is based on the median, is not efficient, the second is a Quasi Maximum Likelihood (QML) estimator with better efficiency properties. The third estimator is a plug-in estimator, which does not require numerical optimization and, consequently, is extremely simple from a computationally point of view, having similar efficiency to that of the ML estimator. We derive the asymptotic distribution of the first two estimators, when the true autocorrelations are zero. Furthermore, we also show that the asymptotic distribution of the plug-in estimator is rather close to that of the QML estimator, allowing for inference and, in particular, for the construction of point-wise significance bands for the autocorrelations. Using Monte Carlo simulations, we analyse the finite sample properties of the proposed estimators and compare them with those of the sample autocorrelations and alternative extant robust estimators based on ranks. Although the proposed estimators have larger dispersion than the sample autocorrelations in uncontaminated time series, they are highly robust in the presence of outliers. Also, they have better properties than popular alternative robust estimators based on ranks when estimating autocorrelations of order larger than one. The results are illustrated by estimating the correlogram of daily IBEX35 returns, quarterly US economic growth and monthly US inflation.
tldr: 提出三种基于观测值比率的自相关函数稳健估计量，推导渐近分布，通过蒙特卡洛模拟和实证示例展示其抗异常值性能。
abstract_cn: 显然，自相关函数的充分估计在时间序列分析中至关重要。本文提出了三种基于观测值比率的新型稳健估计量，这些估计量对异常值具有强抵抗性。第一种基于中位数的估计量效率较低，第二种是拟极大似然（QML）估计量，具有更好的效率特性。第三种是插件估计量，无需数值优化，因此在计算上极为简便，且效率与极大似然（ML）估计量相近。我们推导了前两种估计量在真实自相关为零时的渐近分布。此外，我们还证明插件估计量的渐近分布与QML估计量相当接近，从而可以进行推断，特别是构建自相关的逐点显著性带。通过蒙特卡洛模拟，我们分析了所提估计量的有限样本性质，并将其与样本自相关及基于秩的现有稳健估计量进行了比较。尽管在无污染的时间序列中，所提估计量的离散程度大于样本自相关，但在存在异常值时它们具有高度稳健性。此外，在估计大于一阶的自相关时，它们比基于秩的常用稳健估计量具有更优的性质。通过估计日度IBEX35收益率、季度美国经济增长率及月度美国通胀率的自相关图，对结果进行了说明。

title: Systemic Methodological Dysfunction in Statistical Research for Clinical Decisions
abstract: I critique a set of entrenched methodological conventions that collectively create systemic dysfunction in statistical research for clinical decisions. These include: (1) the prevalent use of hypothesis tests to compare treatments, (2) remoteness from patient care of the methods used to evaluate the accuracy of predictions of patient outcomes, (3) poor practice of meta-analysis to combine findings across studies, and (4) widespread research with incredible certitude. It appears that the dysfunction is held in place by three factors: (i) rudimentary instruction in statistical methodology received by medical students and residents, (ii) reliance of clinical researchers on consulting biostatisticians, wo act as statistical gatekeepers in evaluation of grant proposals and paper submissions, and (iii) institutional practices of research funding agencies, medical journals, and governmental bodies that regulate medical treatment. I conjecture that systemic changes are necessary to break the existing impasse, moving statistical research to a better equilibrium.
tldr: 论文批判临床统计研究中的系统性方法论缺陷，包括假设检验滥用、预测评估脱离临床、元分析实践不佳和过度自信，并提出制度性原因和改进方向。
abstract_cn: 本文批判了一套根深蒂固的方法论惯例，这些惯例共同导致临床决策统计研究中的系统性功能障碍。具体包括：(1) 普遍使用假设检验来比较治疗方案，(2) 用于评估患者结局预测准确性的方法与患者护理脱节，(3) 荟萃分析（meta-analysis）在整合多项研究结果时的不良实践，以及(4) 以难以置信的确信度进行广泛研究。这种功能障碍似乎由三个因素维持：(i) 医学生和住院医师接受的统计方法论基础教育不足，(ii) 临床研究者依赖咨询生物统计学家（biostatisticians），后者在评估基金申请和论文投稿时充当统计把关人，以及(iii) 研究资助机构、医学期刊及监管医疗实践的政府机构的制度性惯例。我推测，必须进行系统性变革才能打破现有僵局，推动统计研究迈向更优均衡。

title: The One-Period Kyle (1985) Model Has a Unique Equilibrium: A Monotone Gaussian Bayes inverse-rigidity theorem
abstract:
Let $V$ and $U$ be independent standard normal random variables. For any Borel map $φ\colon\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, set $Y_φ=φ(V)+U$, and define $P_φ(y)=\mathbb{E}[V\mid Y_φ=y]$ and $F_φ(x)=\mathbb{E}[P_φ(x+U)]$. We prove that, if for every $v\in\mathbb{R}$, the quantity $φ(v)$ maximises $x(v-F_φ(x))$ over $x\in\mathbb{R}$, then $φ$ is the identity function.
  This is the normalised one-period Kyle (1985) model of insider trading. It follows that Kyle's closed-form affine strategy is the unique equilibrium of the model for arbitrary Gaussian location and scale, and that its canonical competitive pricing rule is necessarily linear. This settles a long-standing question in financial economics.
  Boulatov, Kyle and Livdan (2005, 2013) introduced complex-analytic techniques to the problem. McLennan, Monteiro and Tourky (2017) proved a linear growth bound for $P_φ$, real-entire regularity of $F_φ$, and uniqueness when an equilibrium strategy agrees locally with a uniquely continuable analytic function. The present proof requires no regularity assumption on $φ$ beyond Borel measurability. Its argument is real-variable and probabilistic: the maximisation forces sharp upper and lower bounds for Gaussian-randomised monotone functions to coincide, and the corresponding equality cases admit only the identity function.
tldr: 论文证明了在标准正态假设下，Kyle (1985)单期内幕交易模型存在唯一均衡，且均衡策略为线性，定价规则为线性。
abstract_cn:
设 $V$ 与 $U$ 为相互独立的标准正态随机变量。对任意 Borel 映射 $φ\colon\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$，定义 $Y_φ=φ(V)+U$，并令 $P_φ(y)=\mathbb{E}[V\mid Y_φ=y]$ 及 $F_φ(x)=\mathbb{E}[P_φ(x+U)]$。我们证明：若对每个 $v\in\mathbb{R}$，量 $φ(v)$ 在 $x\in\mathbb{R}$ 上最大化 $x(v-F_φ(x))$，则 $φ$ 为恒等函数。

此即归一化单期 Kyle（1985）内幕交易模型。由此可得，Kyle 的闭式仿射策略是该模型在任意高斯位置与尺度参数下的唯一均衡，且其典范竞争性定价规则必然为线性。这解决了金融经济学中一个长期悬而未决的问题。

Boulatov、Kyle 与 Livdan（2005, 2013）将复分析技术引入该问题。McLennan、Monteiro 与 Tourky（2017）证明了 $P_φ$ 的线性增长界、$F_φ$ 的实整正则性，以及当均衡策略局部与唯一可延拓解析函数一致时的唯一性。本文的证明对 $φ$ 除 Borel 可测性外无需任何正则性假设，其论证基于实变量与概率方法：最大化条件迫使高斯随机化单调函数的严格上、下界趋于一致，而相应的等式情形仅允许恒等函数。

title: Bitcoin Price Direction Prediction via Regime-Aware Multi-Modal Fusion of Social Sentiment and Technical Features
abstract: Bitcoin price prediction on sub-daily timescales is a hard open problem in computational finance. Bitcoin exhibits fat-tailed returns, non-stationary dynamics, and a price discovery process influenced by social discourse on Reddit and Twitter. Conventional approaches fuse OHLCV technical features with sentiment via static concatenation, applying identical fusion weights regardless of market state. This is inconsistent with the behavioural finance literature, which shows that retail sentiment is most predictive during volatile periods and noisy during calm ones. This paper proposes Regime-Aware Multi-Modal Learning (RAML), which conditions fusion of sentiment and price features on a dynamically detected binary market regime. Rolling 24-hour volatility partitions observations into stable and volatile regimes; a learnable sigmoid gate adjusts the weight of the sentiment embedding relative to the price embedding, trusting sentiment more during volatility and price dynamics more during stable phases. The system is evaluated on 3,491 hourly observations (July 2024-September 2025), combining Bitcoin OHLCV data with Reddit /r/Bitcoin FinBERT sentiment. Four models are compared - price-only BiLSTM, sentiment-only classifier, static-concatenation BiLSTM, and RAML - across 3-hour and 6-hour horizons, with an ablation study isolating the sentiment branch, regime detection, and adaptive fusion. RAML achieves macro-F1 of 0.5474 (3h) and 0.5513 (6h), with the highest AUC at 3 hours (0.5084), indicating better calibration. Ablation confirms every component is necessary, and replacing adaptive weighting with concatenation causes recall collapse at 6 hours (F1: 0.14). These results establish regime-conditioned adaptive fusion as a necessary design principle for multi-modal financial forecasting.
tldr: 提出一种基于市场状态感知的多模态融合方法（RAML），结合社交媒体情绪和技术特征预测比特币价格方向，在小时级数据上验证了自适应融合的有效性。
abstract_cn: 在亚日时间尺度上预测比特币价格是计算金融学中一个尚未解决的难题。比特币呈现厚尾收益、非平稳动态特征，且其价格发现过程受到Reddit和Twitter上社会讨论的影响。传统方法通过静态拼接将OHLCV技术特征与情感特征融合，无论市场状态如何均采用相同的融合权重。这与行为金融学文献的结论不一致——后者表明零售情感在波动期最具预测力，而在平静期则充满噪声。本文提出状态感知多模态学习（Regime-Aware Multi-Modal Learning, RAML），该方法基于动态检测的二元市场状态来调节情感与价格特征的融合。滚动24小时波动率将观测样本划分为稳定与波动两种状态；一个可学习的Sigmoid门控机制调整情感嵌入相对于价格嵌入的权重，在波动期更信任情感信号，在稳定期更依赖价格动态。该系统基于3491个逐小时观测样本（2024年7月至2025年9月）进行评估，融合了比特币OHLCV数据与Reddit /r/Bitcoin板块的FinBERT情感指标。在3小时和6小时预测窗口下，对比了四种模型——仅价格BiLSTM、仅情感分类器、静态拼接BiLSTM以及RAML，并开展了针对情感分支、状态检测与自适应融合的消融研究。RAML在3小时和6小时窗口分别达到0.5474和0.5513的宏F1值，并在3小时窗口取得最高AUC（0.5084），表明其校准性能更优。消融实验证实每个组件均不可或缺，若以拼接替代自适应加权，则6小时窗口的召回率急剧下降（F1值：0.14）。这些结果确立了基于状态的自适应融合作为多模态金融预测的必要设计原则。

title: Towards Optimal Estimators for Randomized Control Trials
abstract: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are fundamental tools for causal inference across technology companies, pharmaceutical research, and federal agencies. While the standard difference-in-means estimator provides unbiased treatment effect estimates, it often lacks precision, particularly when treatment effects are heterogeneous or outcomes exhibit heavy-tailed distributions. Although numerous precision-enhancing methods exist---from covariate adjustment techniques to variance reduction strategies---recent research demonstrates that no single estimator performs optimally across all datasets. Rather than seeking the best estimator for individual RCTs, which risks compromising scientific validity through convenient selection, we propose a principled framework for identifying optimal estimators within families of RCTs based on specific analytical goals. Our approach uses sample splitting to estimate the distribution of evaluation metrics (e.g., mean squared error, regret) across RCT families, enabling systematic comparisons between estimators while maintaining asymptotic guarantees. We demonstrate this framework using a sample of Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technology trials and the Strengthening Democracy Challenge dataset (25 interventions). Results reveal that optimal estimators vary significantly by analytical objective: weighted least squares performs best for inference goals, while difference-in-means minimizes regret for decision-making contexts. This work provides actionable guidance for estimator selection while preserving methodological rigor across diverse research applications.
tldr: 提出一个基于样本分割的框架，用于在随机对照试验家族中识别最优估计量，以平衡推断精度和决策遗憾。
abstract_cn: 随机对照试验（Randomized Controlled Trials, RCTs）是科技企业、制药研究及联邦机构进行因果推断的基础工具。尽管标准均值差估计量能提供无偏的处理效应估计，但其精度往往不足，尤其在处理效应存在异质性或结果呈现重尾分布时。虽然已有多种精度提升方法——从协变量调整技术到方差缩减策略——但近期研究表明，没有任何单一估计量能在所有数据集中实现最优表现。与其为单个RCT寻找最佳估计量（这种做法可能因便利性选择而损害科学有效性），我们提出一个原则性框架，基于特定分析目标在RCT族中识别最优估计量。该方法通过样本拆分来估计RCT族中评估指标（如均方误差、遗憾值）的分布，从而在保持渐近保证的前提下实现估计量间的系统比较。我们利用亚马逊供应链优化技术试验样本及"强化民主挑战"数据集（25项干预措施）对该框架进行验证。结果表明，最优估计量因分析目标不同而显著差异：加权最小二乘法在推断目标下表现最佳，而均值差估计量在决策情境中能最小化遗憾值。本研究为估计量选择提供了可操作指南，同时保持了跨不同研究应用场景的方法论严谨性。

title: Do decisions about outliers and influential effects matter? Evidence from 358 behavioral science meta-analyses
abstract: Meta-analysts routinely face estimates that look too large or extreme. Yet, how to handle them is left to the reviewer's judgment. The methods for detecting such estimates are well known. What is missing is an informed assessment of how much alternative handling choices might change a meta-analysis' conclusions. We fill this gap by analyzing the effects of four pre-registered handling treatments across 358 behavioral science meta-analyses with at least ten estimates. Each outlier handling treatment is estimated by two estimators (random effects and unrestricted weighted least squares), and compared to the 'do-nothing' baseline on three outcomes: the pooled effect, statistical significance, and whether the effect reaches the smallest effect size of interest (|d| >= 0.20). Our entire analysis and comparison pipelines were pre-registered. Alternative outlier handling treatments have little effect on the meta-analysis mean as the median absolute change in Cohen's d is at most 0.047 and often much less. Yet, at least one of these four treatments in combination with one of these estimators reverses the statistical significance of 11.5% of meta-analyses and the smallest-effect-of-interest assessment in 15.9%. Winsorizing has the least effect and DFBETAS the most. Categorical changes are found almost entirely among results already close to the decision boundary; strongly significant results essentially never change. These findings give applied meta-analysts, methods specialists, and reviewers a reference point for how much this under-reported choice matters and provide yet another reason for meta-analysts to publicly pre-specify their methods and handling treatments.
tldr: 通过358个行为科学元分析，评估不同异常值处理方法对元分析结论的影响，发现处理方法对统计显著性和效应大小判断有适度影响。
abstract_cn: 元分析研究者经常面临看似过大或极端的估计值。然而，如何处理这些估计值完全取决于评审者的判断。检测此类估计值的方法已广为人知，但缺乏的是对替代处理方案可能如何改变元分析结论的知情评估。我们通过分析四种预注册处理方案在358项行为科学元分析（每项至少包含十个估计值）中的效果来填补这一空白。每种异常值处理方案均通过两种估计量（随机效应模型和无限制加权最小二乘法）进行评估，并与“不处理”基线在三个结果指标上进行比较：合并效应量、统计显著性以及效应量是否达到最小感兴趣效应量（|d| >= 0.20）。我们的整个分析与比较流程均经过预注册。替代性异常值处理方案对元分析均值影响甚微，科恩d值的中位数绝对变化至多为0.047，且通常远低于此。然而，这四种处理方案中至少一种与其中一种估计量组合使用时，会逆转11.5%的元分析的统计显著性，以及15.9%的最小感兴趣效应量评估结果。温森化处理（Winsorizing）的影响最小，而DFBETAS的影响最大。类别变化几乎完全发生在已接近决策边界的结果中；强显著结果基本从未改变。这些发现为应用型元分析研究者、方法学专家及评审者提供了关于这一被低估的选择重要性的参考基准，同时也为元分析研究者公开预指定其方法与处理方案提供了又一理由。

title: Attenuated Heterogeneity in Fixed-Effects Causal Forests, and a Cross-Fitted Correction
abstract: Causal forests that estimate conditional average treatment effects by averaging honest leaf-level effects across trees are widely used in fixed-effects panel settings. We show that this averaging systematically attenuates the estimated heterogeneity: the raw prediction behaves like a + b*tau(x) with slope b < 1, so the spread of the CATEs is compressed toward the average effect, and the additive recentering used to report an unbiased average treatment effect does not fix it. Benchmarking against a similarity-weight generalized random forest on the same within-transformed signal, we find both estimators attenuate but the leaf-averaging construction attenuates materially more. We characterize how b moves with the design, worsening with lower signal-to-noise, smaller panels, and higher dimension; this diagnosis is our main contribution. As a remedy we adapt the best-linear-predictor calibration of Chernozhukov et al., estimating the de-attenuation slope out-of-bag so that it is self-contained within the observational panel and asymptotically inert under a homogeneous effect. In simulations the correction cuts CATE mean-squared error by 25-42% relative to the recentering default; on a standard county minimum-wage panel the attenuation is present but mild and the correction restores the imposed spread. We ship the method in the causalfe Python package.
tldr: 论文发现固定效应因果森林会系统性地压缩条件平均处理效应的异质性，并提出一种交叉拟合校正方法，通过模拟和实证（最低工资面板）验证了有效性。
abstract_cn: 因果森林通过跨树平均无偏叶级效应来估计条件平均处理效应，在固定效应面板设定中被广泛使用。我们证明这种平均化会系统性地削弱估计的异质性：原始预测表现为 a + b*tau(x) 的形式，其中斜率 b < 1，导致条件平均处理效应（CATE）的离散程度被压缩至平均效应附近，而用于报告无偏平均处理效应的加性中心化调整无法解决该问题。与基于相同组内变换信号的相似性加权广义随机森林进行基准比较，我们发现两种估计量均存在衰减，但叶平均构造的衰减程度显著更大。我们刻画了 b 如何随设计变化：信噪比越低、面板规模越小、维度越高，衰减越严重；这一诊断是我们的主要贡献。作为补救措施，我们采用 Chernozhukov 等人的最优线性预测校准方法，通过袋外估计去衰减斜率，使其在观测面板内自洽，并在同质效应下渐近惰性。模拟实验表明，与默认的中心化方法相比，该校正将 CATE 均方误差降低了 25-42%；在标准县级最低工资面板中，衰减虽存在但较轻微，校正恢复了预设的离散程度。我们将该方法封装在 causalfe Python 包中。

title: Fair Division with Strictly Increasing Valuations: A Tight Threshold for Two-Agent EF1 and PO
abstract: We study whether strictly positive marginal values restore the compatibility of envy-freeness up to one good (EF1) and Pareto optimality (PO) for indivisible goods. For two agents, we identify the exact threshold in the number of goods. Every instance with at most seven goods and strictly increasing valuations admits an allocation that is both EF1 and PO, without any submodularity assumption. In contrast, we construct an eight-good instance with normalized, integer-valued, strictly increasing, submodular valuations in which every EF1 allocation is strictly Pareto dominated. Thus, eight goods are necessary and sufficient for a two-agent counterexample. Finally, we strengthen the three-agent NP-hardness result of Chandramouleeswaran and Nimbhorkar (2026): deciding whether an EF1 and PO allocation exists remains NP-hard for normalized, integer-valued, monotone submodular valuations even when zero marginals are confined to eight fixed agent-good pairs, all involving a single agent.
tldr: 研究两个代理人时，严格递增估值下EF1和PO分配存在的商品数量阈值，证明7个商品时存在，8个商品时存在反例。
abstract_cn: 我们研究严格正的边际价值能否恢复不可分割物品中“至多一个物品的嫉妒自由”（EF1）与“帕累托最优”（PO）的兼容性。对于两个智能体，我们确定了物品数量的确切阈值。每个包含至多七个物品且具有严格递增估值的实例，在不需任何子模性假设的情况下，均存在同时满足EF1和PO的分配。相反，我们构造了一个包含八个物品的实例，其估值具有归一化、整数值、严格递增且子模的性质，在该实例中每个EF1分配都严格被帕累托支配。因此，八个物品是构造两个智能体反例的充分必要条件。最后，我们强化了Chandramouleeswaran和Nimbhorkar（2026）关于三个智能体的NP困难性结果：即使当零边际值仅限于涉及单个智能体的八个固定智能体-物品对时，对于归一化、整数值、单调子模估值，判断是否存在EF1和PO分配仍然是NP困难的。

title: What should the encroaching supplier do?: A Stackelberg Game Approach
abstract: Suppliers often encroach downstream by operating in-house production-units while continuing to supply independent production-units. We study the optimal configuration, including optimal pricing, for an encroaching supplier that balances these dual roles through a Stackelberg game. The integrated supplier determines the wholesale price charged to the outsourced production unit and the retail price of its own product, while the outsourced unit responds optimally. Customer demand-response incorporates both price-based substitutions (of the two production-units) and loyalty (towards individual units). With strong customer loyalty and luxury products, at the optimal choice for the coalition, both units co-exist profitably. In contrast, when the products become essential, the optimal strategy depends upon customer-fallback rates (fraction of the exiting production-unit's market that falls-back to other). Under low fallback, the coalition either sustains co-existence at maximum prices or disciplines the out-house to operate at break-even---with high fallback it is optimal to shut-down the in-house or eliminate the out-house---we derive two factors that identify the above. We further develop a numerical procedure to identify the optimal regime for any given set of parameters. Two surprising results are---higher market potential of the out-house can become a reason for it to operate at break-even---and the coalition may find it beneficial to operate its in-house at losses, particularly for products that are neither highly essential nor in the luxury category.
tldr: 研究侵占型供应商在同时供应和竞争下游生产单元时的最优定价与配置策略，通过Stackelberg博弈分析客户忠诚度和产品类型的影响。
abstract_cn: 供应商常通过运营内部生产部门进行下游渗透，同时继续向独立生产部门供货。本文通过斯塔克尔伯格博弈（Stackelberg game）研究此类兼具双重角色的渗透型供应商的最优配置，包括最优定价策略。一体化供应商决定向外包生产部门收取的批发价格及其自有产品的零售价格，而外包部门则做出最优响应。客户需求响应同时包含基于价格的两类生产部门替代效应及对单个部门的忠诚度。当客户忠诚度高且产品为奢侈品时，在联盟的最优选择下，两个部门能够实现盈利共存。相反，当产品成为必需品时，最优策略取决于客户回退率（即退出生产部门流失市场中回退至另一部门的比例）。在低回退率情况下，联盟要么以最高价格维持共存，要么迫使外包部门以盈亏平衡运营；在高回退率情况下，最优策略是关闭内部部门或淘汰外包部门——本文推导出识别上述策略的两个因素。我们进一步开发了数值程序，以识别任意给定参数集下的最优机制。两个令人意外的结果是：外包部门更高的市场潜力可能成为其以盈亏平衡运营的原因；联盟可能发现让内部部门亏损运营是有利的，尤其对于既非高度必需也非奢侈品类别的产品。

title: Online Fair Division with Budget Constraints
abstract: We study an online variant of discrete fair division under generalized assignment budget constraints. Goods arrive one at a time and must be assigned irrevocably to a feasible agent or to charity, which holds all unallocated goods, while fairness is evaluated only against budget-feasible subsets of every recipient's bundle. We first show that, without additional structure, no deterministic online algorithm can guarantee any fixed approximation to feasible envy-freeness, even in highly symmetric instances. We then identify bounded density spread as a structural condition that restores meaningful guarantees, obtaining approximation algorithms for arbitrary item sizes and showing that, under common valuations and sufficiently small goods, these guarantees can be strengthened to an optimal deterministic frontier. We further study resource augmentation, where the online algorithm is allowed slightly larger budgets than the fairness benchmark, and characterize the resulting improvement in the achievable guarantees. Finally, we develop a learning-augmented framework based on predicting joint value-size types, proving consistency under perfect predictions, robustness to prediction error, and showing that separate predictions of value and size marginals are insufficient to recover strong fairness guarantees.
tldr: 研究在线公平分配问题，在广义分配预算约束下，物品顺序到达并不可撤销地分配，提出有界密度扩散条件以保证近似无嫉妒性，并引入学习增强框架。
abstract_cn: 我们研究了广义分配预算约束下离散公平分配的在线变体。商品逐一到达，必须不可撤销地分配给可行代理人或慈善机构（慈善机构持有所有未分配商品），而公平性仅针对每个接收者捆绑中预算可行的子集进行评估。我们首先证明，在没有额外结构的情况下，即使是在高度对称的实例中，任何确定性在线算法都无法保证对可行无嫉妒性的任何固定近似。随后，我们将有界密度分布识别为一种能够恢复有意义保证的结构性条件，针对任意商品规模获得了近似算法，并表明在共同估值且商品足够小的情况下，这些保证可强化至最优确定性边界。我们进一步研究了资源增强，即允许在线算法拥有比公平性基准稍大的预算，并刻画了由此带来的可实现保证的改进。最后，我们开发了一个基于预测联合价值-规模类型的增强学习框架，证明了在完美预测下的一致性、对预测误差的鲁棒性，并表明单独预测价值与规模边际分布不足以恢复强公平性保证。

title: Low-Rank Payoffs and Limit Uniqueness in Global Games
abstract: When does the global game information structure select a unique equilibrium? Limit uniqueness in two-player supermodular games fails exactly when a risk-dominant better response cycle exists (Veiel, 2025). We show that rank-one factor structure on payoffs eliminates such cycles entirely, so every rank-one supermodular game admits a generalized ordinal potential and limit uniqueness follows for any number of actions. The boundary is sharp: an explicit three-action rank-two game carries a length-six cycle, no supermodular game carries a cycle of length four, and every game within a quantified sup-norm margin of a nondegenerate rank-one game is cycle-free. Rank-one structure can also be manufactured: when players compete across many independent markets with common latent payoffs, the stacked observation matrix is rank one plus sparse, and a Robust PCA estimator leaves residual noise that vanishes with the signal scale yet stays positive at any finite sample, even under partial observation.
tldr: 研究全局博弈中低秩收益结构如何消除风险占优循环，从而保证极限唯一性，并给出边界例子和鲁棒PCA估计方法。
abstract_cn: 全球博弈信息结构何时选择唯一均衡？当存在风险占优的更好反应循环时，双人超模博弈的极限唯一性恰好失效（Veiel, 2025）。我们证明，收益的秩一因子结构（rank-one factor structure）能完全消除此类循环，因此每个秩一超模博弈（rank-one supermodular game）都承认一个广义序数势函数（generalized ordinal potential），且对于任意数量的行动，极限唯一性成立。这一边界是精确的：一个显式的三行动秩二博弈（rank-two game）包含长度为六的循环，而任何超模博弈都不包含长度为四的循环，并且每个在非退化秩一博弈的量化上确界范数（sup-norm）范围内的博弈均无循环。秩一结构也可人为构造：当参与者在多个具有共同潜在收益的独立市场中竞争时，堆叠观测矩阵（stacked observation matrix）为秩一加稀疏结构，而鲁棒主成分分析（Robust PCA）估计量留下的残差噪声随信号尺度消失，但在任何有限样本下仍保持正值，即使在部分观测条件下也是如此。

title: Public Goods Game on Complex Networks: the interplay between conformity and topology
abstract: Human cooperation is a phenomenon that has been extensively studied, and to date several explanations have been proposed, from network reciprocity to behavioral mechanisms that incorporate social and cognitive aspects. In this work, we studied the combined effect of conformity and network structure on the evolution of cooperation in the spatial Public Goods Game. By assigning agents different individual sensitivities to payoffs and neighborhood behavior, we explored the cooperative dynamics of this heterogeneous population on both regular and complex topologies. Our results show how the interaction between conformity and the distinctive features of each network can lead to very different outcomes, from the promotion of cooperation in regular topologies to null or negative effects in heterogeneous networks.
tldr: 通过空间公共物品博弈模型，研究从众行为与网络拓扑的交互作用对合作演化的影响，发现规则拓扑促进合作，而异质网络可能产生负面效应。
abstract_cn: 人类合作是一个被广泛研究的现象，迄今为止已提出了多种解释，从网络互惠性到融合社会与认知维度的行为机制。本研究探讨了从众行为与网络结构对空间公共物品博弈中合作演化的联合效应。通过赋予智能体对收益和邻域行为不同的个体敏感度，我们探究了这种异质性群体在规则拓扑与复杂拓扑上的合作动态。结果表明，从众行为与各网络独特特征之间的相互作用可能导致截然不同的结果：在规则拓扑中促进合作，而在异质性网络中则产生无效甚至负面效应。

title: Do Preferences Matter in Balanced Task Allocation?
abstract: I model balanced task allocation where tasks stochastically arrive and must be matched to a fixed set of agents; the novel constraint is that agents must receive allocations that require the same level of average effort. Social work supervisors, call center managers, and courts all rotate allocation across workers to satisfy this constraint, but the Rotation mechanism is not Pareto efficient. I design the Dynamic Pseudomarket (DPM) mechanism, and it satisfies Pareto efficiency and asymptotic balance. I derive an explicit equation characterizing DPM's expected productivity gain over Rotation that can be estimated only from aggregate statistics in firm-level data. Simulation results indicate large average productivity gains. These results indicate that preference-based allocation can Pareto dominate the status quo.
tldr: 本文设计动态伪市场机制（DPM）解决平衡任务分配问题，在满足帕累托效率和渐近平衡的同时，相比轮换机制提高生产率。
abstract_cn: 本文对平衡任务分配进行建模，其中任务随机到达并必须与一组固定代理人匹配；新的约束条件是，代理人必须获得要求相同平均努力水平的分配。社会工作者主管、呼叫中心经理以及法院均通过轮换分配来满足这一约束，但轮换机制并非帕累托最优。我设计了动态伪市场（Dynamic Pseudomarket, DPM）机制，该机制满足帕累托最优性并实现渐近平衡。我推导出一个显式方程，用以刻画DPM相对于轮换机制的预期生产率增益，该方程仅需利用企业层面数据中的汇总统计量即可估计。模拟结果表明，平均生产率增益显著。这些结果表明，基于偏好的分配可以在帕累托意义上优于现状。

title: The Fundamental Structure of Risk: From Characteristics to Covariance
abstract: Estimating the covariance structure of financial assets typically relies on his- torical returns, making risk models dependent on noisy and asset-specific time se- ries. We propose the Characteristic-Driven Dynamic Factor Model (CD-DFM), a non-linear latent factor model that instead constructs a representation of the asset cross-section directly from observable firm characteristics, primarily company funda- mentals. The learned latent space jointly determines interpretable factor exposures and a forward covariance estimator, and is trained end to end on an objective that combines a Stein covariance loss with a factor reconstruction term, targeting the out-of-sample second moments used in risk management. Because the latent repre- sentation, i.e. the encoder depends only on characteristics, previously unseen assets can be embedded at inference time without retraining. Experiments on S&P 500 equities show that CD-DFM produces economically structured latent representa- tions, interpretable factor portfolios, and competitive covariance forecasts despite relying on substantially lower-frequency information than return-based approaches. Among the benchmarked methods, it is the only model that simultaneously combines characteristic-driven representations, factor interpretability, competitive covariance calibration, and zero-shot onboarding of unseen assets.
tldr: 提出特征驱动的动态因子模型（CD-DFM），利用公司基本面特征学习资产协方差结构，实现零样本嵌入和可解释因子组合。
abstract_cn: 估计金融资产协方差结构通常依赖历史收益率，这使得风险模型依赖于含噪声且具有资产特异性的时间序列。我们提出特征驱动动态因子模型（Characteristic-Driven Dynamic Factor Model, CD-DFM），这是一种非线性潜在因子模型，它直接从可观测的公司特征（主要是公司基本面）构建资产横截面的表征。学习到的潜在空间共同决定了可解释的因子暴露和前瞻性协方差估计量，并通过端到端训练，优化目标结合了斯坦因协方差损失（Stein covariance loss）与因子重构项，直接针对风险管理中使用的样本外二阶矩。由于潜在表征（即编码器）仅依赖于特征，在推理时无需重新训练即可嵌入先前未见过的资产。在标普500股票上的实验表明，尽管CD-DFM依赖的信息频率远低于基于收益率的方法，但它能产生具有经济结构的潜在表征、可解释的因子投资组合以及具有竞争力的协方差预测。在所有基准方法中，它是唯一同时结合了特征驱动表征、因子可解释性、具有竞争力的协方差校准以及零样本引入未见资产能力的模型。

title: Strategic Exit and Unilateral Control
abstract:
Repeated-game strategies can impose global payoff relations by balancing controlled rewards across time. The question is what remains when the opponent decides, after observing each round, whether the relationship continues. Against every history-dependent opponent strategy with finite expected duration, a cumulative linear identity is enforceable if and only if its expected stage increment vanishes at every reachable history. Strategic exit therefore converts global control into local control. In a two-action game with a unique local equalizer, the controller must use the same mixed action at every reachable history, without any memory restriction on either player. For the Prisoner's Dilemma with $(T,R,P,S)=(5,3,1,0)$, the surviving identities are
  $(1+p)U_X+(4-p)U_Y+5(p^2-3p-1)E[τ]=0$
  The duration coefficient never vanishes on $[0,1]$. Hence strategic bilateral exit leaves a one-dimensional payoff-duration relation, while ruling out every nontrivial payoff-only cumulative identity.
tldr: 论文研究重复博弈中对手可随时终止关系时的策略控制，推导出累积线性恒等式成立的条件，属于博弈论理论分析。
abstract_cn:
重复博弈策略可以通过跨时间平衡受控奖励来施加全局收益关系。问题在于，当对手在观察每一轮后决定是否继续该关系时，还剩下什么。针对每一个具有有限期望持续时间的、依赖于历史记录的对手策略，一个累积线性恒等式是可执行的，当且仅当其期望阶段增量在每一个可达历史处为零。因此，策略性退出将全局控制转化为局部控制。在一个具有唯一局部均衡器的双行动博弈中，控制者必须在每一个可达历史处使用相同的混合行动，且对任一博弈方均无记忆限制。对于囚徒困境博弈，参数为$(T,R,P,S)=(5,3,1,0)$时，存续的恒等式为：
  $(1+p)U_X+(4-p)U_Y+5(p^2-3p-1)E[τ]=0$
  该持续时间系数在区间$[0,1]$上永不消失。因此，策略性双边退出留下了一个一维的收益-持续时间关系，同时排除了所有非平凡的纯收益累积恒等式。

title: Approximation of stochastic insurer balance-sheet results using signatures of economic scenarios
abstract: In the insurance industry, Asset and Liability Management (ALM) models are key tools for numerous applications, including Solvency Capital Requirement (SCR) computation and asset allocation optimization. However, their use often entails a significant computational cost, especially when a large number of sensitivities or stressed balance-sheet evaluations must be performed. In this work, we propose an approximation framework for the outputs of an ALM model, such as the Value In Force or the Best Estimate, based on the theory of path signatures. More precisely, the proposed approach consists of approximating ALM outputs by a linear combination of signature terms derived from input economic scenarios. We show that the resulting surrogate is easy to calibrate, essentially through regularized linear regression, and exhibits strong predictive performance while drastically reducing computational costs. We further investigate its robustness under changes in the distribution of economic scenarios by considering variations in the parameters of the underlying model of risk factors while the surrogate model is kept fixed. These results make the proposed approach particularly suitable for large-scale sensitivity analyses and fast balance-sheet evaluations in practical actuarial applications.
tldr: 提出基于路径签名的近似框架，用于快速计算保险公司ALM模型输出（如内含价值），通过正则化线性回归校准，显著降低计算成本。
abstract_cn: 在保险行业中，资产与负债管理（ALM）模型是众多应用的关键工具，包括偿付能力资本要求（SCR）计算和资产配置优化。然而，这些模型的使用通常伴随着高昂的计算成本，尤其是在需要执行大量敏感性分析或压力资产负债表评估时。本文基于路径签名理论，提出了一种针对ALM模型输出（如内含价值或最佳估计）的近似框架。具体而言，所提出的方法包括通过输入经济情景导出的签名项的线性组合来近似ALM输出。我们证明，由此得到的替代模型易于校准（主要通过正则化线性回归），在显著降低计算成本的同时展现出强大的预测性能。我们进一步研究了该替代模型在经济情景分布变化下的稳健性，即在保持替代模型固定的情况下，考虑底层风险因子模型参数的变化。这些结果表明，所提出的方法特别适用于实际精算应用中的大规模敏感性分析和快速资产负债表评估。

title: Developing a Competency-Based Risk Management Framework for the Ethiopian Commercial Banking Industry
abstract: Abstract This study, entitled “Developing a Competency-Based Risk Management Framework for the Ethiopian Commercial Banking Industry,” examined the institutional competencies required to strengthen effective risk management in Ethiopian commercial banks. Its main objective was to develop and validate an integrated framework explaining how Human Capital Competency, Risk Governance Competency, Risk Culture and Awareness Competency, Regulatory Compliance Competency, Risk Information and Technological Competency, and Integrated Risk Management Process Competency influence Effective Risk Management. The study adopted a pragmatist, cross-sectional, sequential explanatory mixed-methods design. Quantitative data were obtained from 447 banking professionals drawn from seventeen commercial banks and analysed using descriptive statistics, Pearson correlation, multiple regression, hierarchical regression, and hypothesis testing in SPSS. Qualitative evidence was collected from 312 substantive open-ended responses and twenty-seven key-informant interviews and analysed thematically to explain the statistical findings and refine the proposed framework. The results showed that all six competency dimensions were positively and significantly associated with Effective Risk Management. Collectively, they explained 77.4% of the variance in risk-management effectiveness, R² = .774, adjusted R² = .771, F(6, 440) = 251.255, p < .001. Risk Information and Technological Competency was the strongest predictor and independently explained 69.3% of the variance, although it recorded the lowest mean score. This result identified technology, data quality, analytics, cybersecurity, and system integration as the sector’s most important capability gaps. Human Capital Competency was the second strongest predictor, while governance and integrated risk processes also made significant positive contributions. The qualitative findings confirmed persistent weaknesses in professional certification, employee retention, board engagement, Chief Risk Officer independence, risk incentives, data quality, manual processes, regulatory capacity, and interdepartmental coordination. The study concluded that formal policies, committees, and regulatory compliance alone cannot ensure effective risk management; sustainable effectiveness requires the coordinated development of all six competencies. It recommends that banks prioritize integrated risk-data architecture, automated reporting, cybersecurity, role-specific professional development, stronger board risk expertise, independent risk leadership, and enterprise-wide process integration. The National Bank of Ethiopia should adopt competency-oriented and proportionate supervision supported by institutional maturity assessments and targeted capacity-building for less-developed banks.

tldr: 该研究采用混合方法，开发并验证了一个基于能力的风险管理框架，发现六种能力维度显著影响埃塞俄比亚商业银行的风险管理有效性，其中风险信息与技术能力是最强预测因子。
abstract_cn: 本研究题为“为埃塞俄比亚商业银行行业构建基于能力的风险管理框架”，探讨了加强埃塞俄比亚商业银行有效风险管理所需的机构能力。其主要目标是开发并验证一个整合性框架，用以解释人力资本能力（Human Capital Competency）、风险治理能力（Risk Governance Competency）、风险文化与意识能力（Risk Culture and Awareness Competency）、监管合规能力（Regulatory Compliance Competency）、风险信息与技术能力（Risk Information and Technological Competency）以及整合风险管理流程能力（Integrated Risk Management Process Competency）如何影响有效风险管理（Effective Risk Management）。研究采用了实用主义、横截面、序贯解释性混合方法设计。定量数据来自17家商业银行的447名银行专业人员，并通过描述性统计、皮尔逊相关分析、多元回归、层级回归以及SPSS中的假设检验进行分析。定性证据则收集自312份实质性开放式回答和27位关键知情人访谈，并采用主题分析法以解释统计结果并完善所提出的框架。结果表明，所有六个能力维度均与有效风险管理呈显著正相关。它们共同解释了风险管理有效性中77.4%的变异，R² = .774，调整后R² = .771，F(6, 440) = 251.255，p < .001。风险信息与技术能力是最强的预测因子，独立解释了69.3%的变异，尽管其平均得分最低。这一结果将技术、数据质量、分析能力、网络安全和系统集成确定为该行业最重要的能力差距。人力资本能力是第二强的预测因子，而治理与整合风险流程也做出了显著的正向贡献。定性研究结果证实了在专业认证、员工保留、董事会参与、首席风险官（Chief Risk Officer）独立性、风险激励、数据质量、手工流程、监管能力以及部门间协调方面存在持续性的薄弱环节。研究得出结论，仅凭正式政策、委员会和监管合规无法确保有效的风险管理；可持续的有效性需要所有六项能力的协同发展。研究建议银行优先发展整合风险数据架构、自动化报告、网络安全、针对特定岗位的专业发展、增强董事会风险专业知识、独立的风险领导力以及全企业流程整合。埃塞俄比亚国家银行（National Bank of Ethiopia）应采用以能力为导向且与风险相称的监管方式，并辅以机构成熟度评估，以及对欠发达银行进行有针对性的能力建设。

analysis.chinese_title: 为埃塞俄比亚商业银行行业开发基于能力的风险管理框架
analysis.summary: 本研究旨在为埃塞俄比亚商业银行开发并验证一个基于能力的风险管理框架，探讨人力资本能力、风险治理能力、风险文化与意识能力、监管合规能力、风险信息与技术能力以及综合风险管理过程能力对有效风险管理的影响。采用实用主义、横截面、顺序解释性混合方法设计，定量数据来自17家商业银行的447名银行专业人员，通过描述性统计、皮尔逊相关、多元回归和假设检验进行分析；定性证据来自312份开放式回答和27次关键知情人访谈，采用主题分析解释统计结果并完善框架。结果显示，所有六个能力维度均与有效风险管理显著正相关，共同解释77.4%的方差（R²=0.774，调整R²=0.771，F(6,440)=251.255，p<0.001）。风险信息与技术能力是最强预测因子，独立解释69.3%的方差，但均值最低，表明技术、数据质量、分析、网络安全和系统集成是行业最重要的能力缺口。定性发现证实了专业认证、员工保留、董事会参与、首席风险官独立性、风险激励、数据质量、手工流程、监管能力和跨部门协调方面的持续弱点。研究结论认为，仅靠正式政策、委员会和监管合规无法确保有效的风险管理；可持续的有效性需要所有六种能力的协调发展。建议银行优先发展综合风险数据架构、自动化报告、网络安全、针对特定角色的专业发展、更强的董事会风险专业知识、独立的风险领导力和企业级流程整合。埃塞俄比亚国家银行应采用以能力为导向和相称的监管，辅以机构成熟度评估和对欠发达银行的有针对性的能力建设。

key_results: 所有六个能力维度（人力资本、风险治理、风险文化与意识、监管合规、风险信息与技术、综合风险管理过程）均与有效风险管理显著正相关。

strengths: 采用混合方法设计，结合定量和定性数据，增强了研究结果的深度和可信度。
样本覆盖17家商业银行，具有较好的代表性。
框架基于多种理论（能力理论、资源基础观、代理理论、制度理论、利益相关者理论、ERM理论、动态能力理论），理论基础扎实。
研究结果具有实践意义，为银行和监管机构提供了具体建议。

limitations: 横截面设计无法推断因果关系。

title: The effects of a large energy price shock on bank credit
abstract: This study investigates the effect of the large shock to energy prices following the Russian invasion of Ukraine on bank credit to firms. To isolate the causal effect of the shock, it compares bank lending to high-energy-intensive firms to that of similar low-energy-intensive firms. Following the shock, bank credit to high-energy-intensive firms persistently declined, while their interest rates on new loans rose and other loan terms tightened. Across the distribution, safer firms reduced outstanding credit lines and paid unchanged interest rates on new bank loans, while riskier firms borrowed at higher interest rates.
tldr: 利用俄乌战争后能源价格冲击，通过高能耗与低能耗企业对比，发现银行对高能耗企业信贷下降、利率上升、条件收紧，且风险较高的企业受影响更大。
abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了俄乌冲突后能源价格大幅冲击对企业银行信贷的影响。为隔离该冲击的因果效应，本研究对比了银行对高能耗企业与类似低能耗企业的贷款情况。冲击发生后，银行对高能耗企业的信贷持续下降，同时其新增贷款利率上升，其他贷款条件收紧。从分布来看，风险较低的企业减少了未偿信贷额度，且新增银行贷款利率保持不变，而风险较高的企业则以更高的利率借款。

analysis.chinese_title: 大型能源价格冲击对银行信贷的影响
analysis.summary: 本研究利用俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后能源价格大幅上涨的自然实验，考察能源价格冲击对企业银行信贷的影响。通过比较丹麦制造业中高能耗强度企业与低能耗强度企业的信贷变化，并控制银行-时间和行业-时间固定效应，识别因果效应。研究发现，冲击后高能耗企业的信贷增长率显著低于低能耗企业（约8.75个百分点），且该效应持续至2023年第三季度。信贷下降主要由信用额度使用减少驱动，而新贷款利率上升、期限缩短、抵押要求趋严。异质性分析显示，低风险企业主要减少信贷额度使用且利率不变，高风险企业则面临更高利率。研究揭示了能源价格冲击通过信贷需求和供给渠道影响企业融资的机制。
innovations: 利用俄罗斯入侵乌克兰这一外生冲击，首次识别能源价格冲击对企业银行信贷的因果效应。
结合丹麦信贷登记、企业能源调查和资产负债表数据，构建独特的高频面板数据集。
通过比较同一行业、同一银行内不同能耗强度的企业，有效控制其他混淆冲击。
分解信贷下降来源（信用额度、信用卡等），并区分新贷款与存量贷款，揭示需求侧主导机制。
发现银行对能源风险定价的证据：即使控制企业风险，高能耗企业新贷款利率仍上升。
analysis.methodology: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），以高能耗强度企业为处理组，低能耗强度企业为对照组，比较俄罗斯入侵乌克兰前后信贷增长差异。回归模型包含企业固定效应、行业-时间固定效应和银行-时间固定效应，以控制不可观测的异质性和共同冲击。信贷增长定义为对称百分比变化。稳健性检验包括：使用行业内能耗强度中位数定义处理组、控制企业规模-时间等交互固定效应、利用能源合同重置时间作为额外变异来源。
key_results: 冲击后高能耗企业信贷增长率比低能耗企业低8.75个百分点（2022年第二季度），该差异持续至2023年第三季度。
信贷下降的约70%来自信用额度，其余来自信用卡；主要源于现有信用额度使用减少，而非银行削减额度。
新贷款利率上升约1个百分点，期限缩短，抵押要求提高；即使控制企业风险，利率溢价仍存在。
低风险企业（高现金、低杠杆）信贷下降更显著，且利率不变；高风险企业则面临更高利率。
若高能耗企业信贷增长与低能耗企业相同，制造业总信贷将额外增长约5.5%。
tech_stack: 固定效应模型（企业、行业-时间、银行-时间）
对称百分比增长率公式
双重聚类标准误（行业和季度层面）
信贷增长分解方法（按工具类型和新/旧贷款）
strengths: 利用外生冲击和丰富微观数据，因果识别策略清晰。
同时分析信贷数量（增长率）和价格（利率、期限、抵押），全面刻画冲击影响。
通过多种稳健性检验（不同能耗定义、控制其他特征、合同重置时间）增强结果可信度。
分解信贷下降来源，区分需求和供给渠道，机制分析深入。
政策含义明确：能源价格冲击通过信贷渠道加剧企业融资分化，影响货币政策传导和金融稳定。
limitations: 研究仅基于丹麦制造业，外部有效性需在其他国家和行业验证。
能源强度基于历史数据，可能未完全反映冲击后企业调整行为。
信贷需求与供给的区分依赖间接证据（如信贷类型分解），缺乏直接的企业调查数据。
样本期包含新冠疫情，虽通过固定效应控制，但可能仍有残余干扰。
未量化能源价格冲击对实际经济变量（如投资、就业）的最终影响。
analysis.relevance_to_keywords: 该论文直接研究能源价格冲击对银行信贷的影响，与“银行信贷与风险承担”高度相关；通过分析信贷供给（银行风险定价）和需求（企业预防性储蓄）渠道，涉及“金融中介”和“信用周期”；研究结果对“货币政策传导”和“金融稳定”具有政策含义，尤其关注冲击对不同风险企业的异质性影响。

title: Central banks, debt managers, and specialness in the Bund repo market
abstract: Elevated repo rate specialness for German government bonds in 2016–17, and particularly in 2022-23, has often been linked to the absorption of these securities by the ECB’s asset purchase programmes. We provide the first evidence on how the debt management office mitigates these effects by jointly analyzing daily secondary-market trades and repo operations of the Deutsche Finanzagentur (DFA) alongside Eurosystem transactions in Bunds from 2015–2024. We find two points: first, that Eurosystem purchases depress repo rates about four times more than DFA purchases (0.4 bp vs 0.1 bp per 1% of free float), while DFA repo lending raises repo rates by roughly 0.2 bp per 1% of outstanding volume. Our evidence suggests that DFA interventions helped mitigate scarcity-induced specialness. Second, with elevated hedge fund demand for bonds, the overall alleviating impact was constrained by segmentation in the repo market and by the design of the facilities themselves, which aimed to prevent collateral shortages and fails-to-deliver rather than to provide price support.
tldr: 论文利用2015-2024年高频交易数据，分析欧洲央行资产购买和德国债务管理机构操作对德国国债回购利率特殊性的影响，发现央行购买压低回购利率，而债务管理机构回购借贷缓解稀缺性，但受市场分割和设施设计限制。
abstract_cn: 2016-2017年，尤其是2022-2023年期间，德国政府债券回购利率的特殊性显著上升，这通常与欧洲央行资产购买计划对这些证券的吸收有关。我们首次提供了关于债务管理办公室如何缓解这些影响的证据，通过联合分析德国金融署（DFA）的每日二级市场交易和回购操作，以及2015-2024年间欧元体系在德国国债（Bunds）上的交易。我们得出两点发现：第一，欧元体系的购买对回购利率的压低效应约为DFA购买的四倍（每1%自由流通量分别压低0.4个基点与0.1个基点），而DFA的回购出借则使回购利率每1%未偿规模上升约0.2个基点。我们的证据表明，DFA的干预有助于缓解由稀缺性引发的特殊性。第二，在对冲基金对债券需求高涨的情况下，整体缓解效应受到回购市场分割以及工具本身设计的制约——这些工具旨在防止抵押品短缺和交割失败（fails-to-deliver），而非提供价格支撑。

analysis.chinese_title: 中央银行、债务管理者与德国国债回购市场的特殊性
analysis.summary: 本文研究2015-2024年间，欧洲央行资产购买计划与德国债务管理办公室（DFA）操作对德国国债回购市场特殊性的影响。利用独特的高频交易数据，发现欧洲央行购买使回购利率下降约0.4个基点（占自由流通量1%），而DFA购买仅下降0.1个基点；DFA回购贷款则使利率上升约0.2个基点（占未偿量1%）。DFA操作能缓解稀缺性，但受市场分割和对冲基金需求激增限制，无法完全消除极端特殊性。
innovations: 首次联合分析央行与债务管理办公室在回购市场中的作用，量化两者对特殊性的差异化影响。
利用非重叠交易时间窗口识别现金市场操作的外生性，采用工具变量法处理回购操作的内生性。
揭示DFA操作（回购贷款）比现金销售更有效缓解稀缺性，且DFA会主动响应央行购买。
结合MMSR数据，从市场结构角度解释为何大规模供给干预仍无法消除极端特殊性。
analysis.methodology: 采用面板回归模型，以回购利率日变化为因变量，以Eurosystem和DFA的购买、销售及回购操作量（占自由流通量或未偿量比例）为核心自变量，控制on-the-run和cheapest-to-deliver虚拟变量，并加入ISIN和时间固定效应。针对回购操作的内生性，使用DFA持仓作为工具变量进行两阶段最小二乘估计。
key_results: Eurosystem购买占自由流通量1%使回购利率下降约0.4个基点，DFA购买仅下降0.1个基点。
DFA销售使回购利率上升约0.08个基点（占自由流通量1%），回购贷款使利率上升约0.2个基点（占未偿量1%）。
Eurosystem购买对高特殊性债券影响更大，对低特殊性债券几乎无影响。
DFA在Eurosystem购买后增加回购贷款和销售，以缓解稀缺性。
2022-23年极端特殊性源于对冲基金需求激增和市场分割，供给干预无法完全抵消。
tech_stack: 工具变量法（两阶段最小二乘）
非重叠交易时间窗口识别策略
strengths: 使用独特的高频交易数据，涵盖Eurosystem和DFA的完整操作记录。
识别策略严谨，分别处理现金市场和回购市场的内生性问题。
量化了不同机构操作的差异化影响，并解释了市场结构的作用。
政策含义明确，对央行和债务管理协调有重要启示。
limitations: 工具变量的外生性无法直接检验，依赖经济逻辑论证。
数据仅覆盖德国市场，结论推广性有限。
未考虑其他可能影响回购特殊性的因素，如监管变化。
analysis.relevance_to_keywords: 高度相关。论文直接研究中央银行（Eurosystem）和债务管理者（DFA）操作对回购市场特殊性的影响，涉及量化宽松、债务管理、回购市场、金融中介等关键词，并提供了明确的识别策略和稳健性检验。

title: Selection or More Capital ? Experimental Evidence on High-Growth Entrepreneurs in Kenya
abstract: Business plan competitions aim to identify and spur high-growth entrepreneurs. Two experiments were embedded into in a Kenyan competition to test how intensity of selection and of capital determine entrepreneurial outcomes. Applicants received a US$9,000 grant after a streamlined process or went through multiple selection stages and were randomly assigned US$9,000 or US$36,000. All grants initially generated jobs, but the impacts only persisted over three years under multi-stage selection. The larger grants did not yield greater long-term impacts than the multi-stage US$9,000 grant, suggesting diminishing returns to capital and limited lumpy investment opportunities. Selection, rather than grant size, determines long-run firm growth.
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
tldr: 通过在肯尼亚创业竞赛中嵌入实验，检验筛选强度和资本规模对创业结果的影响，发现多阶段筛选比更大资本更能带来长期增长。
abstract_cn: 商业计划竞赛旨在识别并激励高成长型企业家。两项实验嵌入在肯尼亚的一场竞赛中，以检验选拔强度与资本规模如何决定创业成果。申请者经过简化流程后获得9,000美元赠款，或经历多个选拔阶段并被随机分配9,000美元或36,000美元赠款。所有赠款最初均创造了就业机会，但只有在多阶段选拔条件下，其影响才持续超过三年。相较于多阶段9,000美元赠款，更大规模的赠款并未产生更显著的长期影响，这表明资本边际收益递减且存在有限的块状投资机会。决定企业长期增长的是选拔机制，而非赠款规模。

title: Falling Behind Drives Unsafe Development in an Idealised AI Race Experiment
abstract: Technological races create tension between speed and safety: actors may gain by moving faster than competitors, even when risky development is harmful. This is prominent in debates about artificial intelligence (AI), where competitive pressure is often argued to incentivise riskier, less safety-conscious development. We study this using a framed behavioural experiment based on an idealised AI race, in which paired participants repeatedly chose between Safe and Unsafe development under an uncertain time horizon. Unsafe development gave faster progress and higher immediate payoffs but accumulated private risk up to a treatment-specific maximum of 10\%, 60\%, or 90\%; the race's competitive structure was held constant, and only this maximum risk varied. Neither the pre-registered comparison between risk levels nor the role of elicited risk preferences was supported by the data. Instead, exploratory analyses motivated by the task's repeated structure show that Unsafe behaviour is shaped less by risk preferences than by the evolving strategic state of the race: participants are more likely to choose Unsafe after their opponent does so, being ahead reduces Unsafe play while falling behind increases it, and first-round choices predict later behaviour. To interpret these effects we introduce a reduced evolutionary model with four strategies -- Always Safe, Always Unsafe, Conditionally Safe, and Conditionally Antisocial Safe -- which reproduces the treatment effect and shows how conditional Unsafe behaviour can be favoured by competitive race dynamics. Together, the experiment and model show that unsafe development can emerge from early behavioural momentum, opponent behaviour, and fear of falling behind, rather than from risk preferences alone, suggesting policy should focus on reducing competitive pressure and promoting cooperation in AI development rather than only individual risk.
tldr: 通过行为实验和演化模型研究AI竞赛中不安全开发决策的驱动因素，发现竞争动态和落后恐惧比风险偏好更重要。
abstract_cn: 技术竞赛在速度与安全之间制造了张力：参与者可能通过比竞争对手更快行动而获益，即便这种高风险开发是有害的。这一问题在人工智能（AI）的讨论中尤为突出，竞争压力常被认为会激励更具风险、更缺乏安全意识的发展。我们通过一项基于理想化AI竞赛的框架行为实验对此进行研究，实验中配对参与者在不确定的时间范围内反复在安全开发与不安全开发之间进行选择。不安全开发能带来更快的进展和更高的即时收益，但会累积私人风险，其最大值因实验处理而异，分别为10%、60%或90%；竞赛的竞争结构保持不变，仅改变这一最大风险值。无论是预先登记的跨风险水平比较，还是所诱发的风险偏好的作用，均未得到数据支持。相反，基于任务重复结构进行的探索性分析表明，不安全行为受风险偏好的影响较小，而更多受竞赛中不断演变的战略状态影响：参与者在对手选择不安全后更可能选择不安全，领先会减少不安全行为而落后则会增加，且首轮选择可预测后续行为。为解释这些效应，我们引入了一个包含四种策略（始终安全、始终不安全、条件安全、条件反社会安全）的简化演化模型，该模型再现了实验处理效应，并展示了条件性不安全行为如何受到竞争性竞赛动态的青睐。实验与模型共同表明，不安全开发可能源于早期行为惯性、对手行为以及对落后的恐惧，而非仅源于风险偏好，这提示政策应侧重于降低竞争压力并促进AI开发中的合作，而非仅关注个体风险。

title: Algorithm-Driven Information Similarity and Collective Action: An Experimental Study
abstract: We study how the similarity of individuals' information shapes collective action. When people draw on a common source of information, such as social media, each becomes more confident about what others have seen and will do. This can help them coordinate, but it can also tempt them to free-ride. We show that which force prevails depends on how demanding the collective goal is. In a content-moderation experiment, subjects decide whether to pay a cost to report harmful content, which is removed only if enough reports are received. We vary the similarity of group members' information, holding fixed what each learns on her own, and independently vary the removal threshold. More similar information impedes reporting when few reports suffice and facilitates it when many are required, lowering reporting by 17 percentage points under an easy threshold and raising it by 34 points under a demanding one. This confirms the central comparative static of the theory of information similarity (Basak, Deb and Kuvalekar, 2026). Elicited beliefs trace the reversal to perceived pivotality and document systematic miscalibration of it. Subjects overestimate pivotality across all regimes, and their beliefs respond to similarity in line with actual pivotality only at intermediate thresholds: easy thresholds produce unrecognized pivotality, and near-unanimous thresholds produce illusory pivotality. The two response-miscalibrated patterns coincide with welfare losses; only under aligned pivotality does greater participation translate into greater collective success and higher welfare.
tldr: 通过内容审核实验，研究信息相似性对集体行动（报告有害内容）的影响，发现相似信息在低门槛时阻碍、高门槛时促进报告，并揭示信念偏差。
abstract_cn: 我们研究个体信息的相似性如何塑造集体行动。当人们依赖共同的信息来源（如社交媒体）时，每个人都会对他人所见及所为更加确信。这有助于协调行动，但也可能诱使个体搭便车。我们证明哪种力量占主导取决于集体目标的难度。在一项内容审核实验中，受试者决定是否支付成本举报有害内容，而该内容仅在收到足够数量的举报时才会被移除。我们改变群体成员信息的相似性，同时保持每个人独立获取的信息不变，并独立改变移除阈值。当所需举报数量较少时，信息相似性越高越阻碍举报；当所需举报数量较多时，则促进举报——在低阈值下举报率降低17个百分点，在高阈值下提高34个百分点。这验证了信息相似性理论的核心比较静态分析（Basak, Deb and Kuvalekar, 2026）。通过诱导信念测量，我们追溯了这种反转现象至感知关键性，并记录了其系统性校准偏差。受试者在所有情境下均高估关键性，且其信念对相似性的响应仅在中等阈值下与实际关键性一致：低阈值导致未被识别的关键性，而近乎一致阈值则产生虚幻的关键性。这两种响应校准偏差模式与福利损失相吻合；仅在关键性对齐的情况下，更高的参与率才能转化为更大的集体成功与更高的福利。

title: Generative AI Availability, Grades, and Student Satisfaction at a Large University
abstract: The spread of generative AI (GenAI) in higher education has raised concerns that students offload cognitive effort to AI, earning high grades without learning. If this "GenAI substitution hypothesis" is true, grades should rise disproportionately in GenAI-susceptible courses--those relying more on assessments like take-home problem sets and essays rather than in-class exams. Substitution could also affect student satisfaction, measured here as self-reported understanding and interest in the subject, which prior research links to assessments. We test the substitution hypothesis using syllabus and administrative data from a large U.S. university (2016-2025; 138,386 students; 72,730 course offerings). We measure courses' GenAI susceptibility using a human-validated LLM pipeline to extract assessment types from syllabi, and use a differences-in-differences design comparing outcomes across courses before and after ChatGPT's release, while modeling COVID-19 pandemic effects as either persistent or transient. We find no significant differential effect of GenAI availability on grades overall or among previously lower-performing students. Effects on self-reported understanding are likewise insignificant; effects on interest are significant only assuming transient pandemic effects. Our findings temper concerns that GenAI inflates grades and reduces students' satisfaction.
tldr: 利用差异中的差异设计，分析ChatGPT发布前后不同课程的成绩和满意度变化，发现GenAI并未显著提高成绩或降低满意度。
abstract_cn: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）在高等教育中的普及引发了担忧，即学生将认知努力转嫁给人工智能，从而在不进行学习的情况下获得高分。如果这一“GenAI替代假说”成立，那么在易受GenAI影响的课程中——即那些更依赖课后习题集和论文而非课堂考试等评估方式的课程——成绩应出现不成比例的增长。替代效应还可能影响学生满意度，本文以学生自我报告的对学科的理解程度和兴趣作为衡量指标，而先前研究已表明这些指标与评估方式相关。我们利用美国一所大型大学的教学大纲与行政数据（2016-2025年；138,386名学生；72,730门课程）对替代假说进行检验。我们通过经人工验证的大语言模型（LLM）流程从教学大纲中提取评估类型，以此衡量课程的GenAI易感性，并采用双重差分法比较ChatGPT发布前后不同课程的结果，同时将COVID-19疫情效应建模为持续性或暂时性影响。研究发现，GenAI的可用性对总体成绩或先前表现较差学生的成绩均无显著差异效应。对自我报告的理解程度的影响同样不显著；仅当假设疫情效应为暂时性时，对兴趣的影响才具有显著性。我们的研究结果缓解了关于GenAI抬高成绩并降低学生满意度的担忧。

title: Generative Artificial Intelligence in Scientific Research: Individual Benefits, Collective Risks, and a Framework for Responsible Research with AI
abstract: This paper examines the tension between the benefits of generative artificial intelligence (AI) for scientific research and the unresolved governance questions that accompany its rapid adoption. Drawing on an academic roundtable held at the AI for Science and Innovation Workshop (Scuola IMT Alti Studi Lucca, April 2026) and on a fast-expanding empirical literature, it maps the disagreement within the research community across four stages of the research process: funding, research tasks, publication and peer review, and use and uptake. The empirical case for AI's productivity, augmentation, and democratization effects has strengthened. The picture changes once productivity is disaggregated: AI-assisted work shows measurable gains in publication volume and citation share, while the evidence on novelty, disruption, and breakthrough output remains ambiguous or negative. We argue that the divergence between private and social returns arises through three analytically distinct mechanisms, namely information asymmetry, negative externalities on a shared knowledge base, and depletion of research capacity, and that each calls for a different governance instrument. We propose Responsible Research with AI (RRAI), an extension of the Responsible Research and Innovation tradition organized around four principles that operate at different levels of the research system: disclosure, differentiation, narrative, and proportionality. RRAI builds on existing institutional scaffolding, including the EU AI Act, UNESCO, and the OECD, and aims to preserve AI's productivity gains while addressing systemic risks that individual researchers can neither observe nor manage on their own.
tldr: 论文探讨生成式AI对科研生产力的影响，分析私人收益与社会回报的差异，并提出负责任研究框架。
abstract_cn: 本文探讨了生成式人工智能（AI）为科学研究带来的益处与其快速应用过程中伴随的未解决治理问题之间的张力。基于2026年4月在卢卡IMT高等研究学院举办的“AI促进科学与创新研讨会”上的学术圆桌讨论，以及快速扩展的实证文献，本文梳理了研究共同体在四个研究阶段（资助、研究任务、出版与同行评审、使用与采纳）中的分歧。关于AI在生产力、增强效应和民主化效应方面的实证依据已有所加强。然而，一旦对生产力进行分解，情况便发生变化：AI辅助工作在发表数量和引用份额上显示出可衡量的增长，而在新颖性、颠覆性和突破性产出方面的证据仍不明确或呈负面。本文认为，私人收益与社会收益之间的分歧通过三种分析上截然不同的机制产生，即信息不对称、对共享知识基础的负外部性以及研究能力的耗竭，且每种机制需要不同的治理工具。我们提出了“负责任的AI研究”（RRAI），这是对“负责任研究与创新”传统的延伸，围绕四个在研究系统不同层面运作的原则组织：披露、差异化、叙事和相称性。RRAI建立在现有制度框架之上，包括欧盟《人工智能法案》、联合国教科文组织（UNESCO）和经济合作与发展组织（OECD），旨在保留AI的生产力提升效果，同时应对个体研究者无法自行观察或管理的系统性风险。

title: From dense grids to valid inference: Accounting for regularization bias in nonparametric random coefficient models
abstract: This paper develops an inference procedure for average functionals of random-coefficient distributions, such as mean willingness-to-pay and average elasticities, when the distribution is estimated nonparametrically using the penalized fixed-grid estimator of Heiss, Hetzenecker, and Osterhaus (2022). We establish asymptotic normality of the corresponding penalized plug-in estimator centered at the functional evaluated at the penalized pseudo-true value and propose a confidence interval that accounts for the regularization bias. Our method applies to a broad class of linear and nonlinear functionals and allows researchers to use dense grids to reduce approximation bias while maintaining valid inference. Monte Carlo simulations show that the proposed intervals achieve coverage close to the nominal level while remaining informative in finite samples. An empirical application to travel mode demand illustrates that flexible nonparametric specifications can yield economically meaningful differences relative to standard parametric models.
tldr: 提出一种针对非参数随机系数模型中平均函数量的推断方法，通过惩罚固定网格估计量校正正则化偏差，实现有效置信区间。
abstract_cn: 本文针对随机系数分布的平均泛函（如平均支付意愿和平均弹性）提出了一种推断方法，其中该分布采用Heiss、Hetzenecker和Osterhaus（2022）提出的惩罚固定网格估计量进行非参数估计。我们建立了以惩罚伪真实值处泛函为中心的相应惩罚插入估计量的渐近正态性，并提出了一种考虑正则化偏差的置信区间。该方法适用于一大类线性和非线性泛函，并允许研究者使用密集网格来减少近似偏差，同时保持有效的推断。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的区间在有限样本中既能达到接近名义水平的覆盖率，又能保持信息量。一项针对出行方式需求的经验应用表明，相对于标准参数模型，灵活的非参数设定可以产生具有经济意义的显著差异。
