title: Nonfundamentalness or missing information ? Evidence from causal-noncausal VARs in macro-finance
abstract: This paper studies the presence of noncausal dynamics in standard macro-finance VAR models and asks whether they reflect genuine nonfundamentalness or omitted information available to economic agents but unobserved by the econometrician. To that end, we introduce a factor-filtering mixed causal-noncausal VARX approach designed to account for common macroeconomic information. We assess its performance in simulated settings, while showing also that the generalized covariance (GCov) estimator correctly recovers causal and noncausal dynamics when using several lags. Empirically, we revisit the well-known Stock-Watson monetary policy (S)VAR and show that the noncausal components detected in the baseline specification largely disappear once common factors are filtered out. Finally, we compare impulse responses from the filtered and original data to assess the transmission of monetary policy shocks and show that filtering further removes the price puzzle.
tldr: 本文提出一种因子滤波混合因果-非因果VARX方法，用于区分非因果动态是源于非基本性还是遗漏信息，并应用于Stock-Watson货币政策SVAR，发现滤波后非因果成分消失，且消除了价格之谜。
abstract_cn: 本文研究了标准宏观金融VAR模型中非因果动态的存在性，并探讨其是否反映了真正的非根本性（nonfundamentalness），抑或是经济主体可获得但计量经济学家未观测到的信息遗漏。为此，我们引入了一种因子滤波混合因果-非因果VARX方法，旨在纳入共同的宏观经济信息。我们在模拟环境中评估了其表现，同时表明广义协方差（GCov）估计量在使用多个滞后项时能够正确恢复因果与非因果动态。在实证方面，我们重新审视了著名的斯托克-沃森（Stock-Watson）货币政策结构VAR（SVAR），并发现一旦滤除共同因子，基准设定中检测到的非因果成分大多消失。最后，我们比较了滤波后数据与原始数据的脉冲响应，以评估货币政策冲击的传导，并表明滤波进一步消除了价格之谜。

analysis.chinese_title: 非基础性还是信息缺失？来自宏观金融中因果-非因果VAR的证据
analysis.summary: 本文研究标准宏观金融VAR模型中非因果动态的存在性，并探讨其反映的是真正的非基础性还是经济主体可得但计量经济学家未观测到的遗漏信息。为此，作者引入一种因子滤波的混合因果-非因果VARX方法，以考虑共同的宏观经济信息。通过模拟评估其性能，并证明广义协方差（GCov）估计量在使用多个滞后时能正确恢复因果和非因果动态。实证上，重新审视著名的Stock-Watson货币政策SVAR，发现基线设定中检测到的非因果成分在滤除共同因子后基本消失。最后，比较滤波和原始数据的脉冲响应，以评估货币政策冲击的传导，并显示滤波进一步消除了价格之谜。
innovations: 提出因子滤波的混合因果-非因果VARX模型，用于处理遗漏信息导致的非基础性。
在三维VAR(2)框架下系统评估GCov估计量的有限样本性能，填补了多滞后情形的空白。
通过蒙特卡洛模拟证明，当遗漏共同因子时，GCov会检测到非因果成分，而正确滤波后可恢复因果性。
实证发现Stock-Watson货币政策VAR中的非因果成分在滤除共同因子后消失，表明其源于信息缺失。
比较滤波前后的脉冲响应，显示滤波进一步缓解价格之谜并改变失业率响应。
analysis.methodology: 本文采用混合因果-非因果VAR模型，使用广义协方差（GCov）估计量进行参数估计。通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估估计量在VAR(2)下的性能，并设计因子滤波程序（基于Frisch-Waugh-Lovell定理）以剔除共同因子。实证部分使用FRED-QD数据库提取共同因子，对Stock-Watson模型进行滤波和重新估计，并比较脉冲响应。
key_results: 蒙特卡洛模拟显示，GCov估计量在VAR(2)下能高频率正确识别因果维度，且随样本量增加性能提升。
当遗漏相关因子时，GCov检测到非因果成分的概率增加；当包含全部因子时，正确识别因果维度的频率最高（70.1%），而无因子时仅为52.2%。
在Stock-Watson模型中，基线设定检测到非因果成分，但滤除前两个共同因子后，非因果维度消失。
滤波进一步消除了价格之谜，并改变了失业率对货币政策冲击的响应。
tech_stack: 主成分分析（提取共同因子）
strengths: 提出新颖的VARX框架，将因子滤波与因果-非因果模型结合，为诊断非基础性提供了新工具。
蒙特卡洛模拟设计严谨，考虑了多种DGP和样本量，验证了估计量的可靠性。
实证应用经典模型，结果具有政策含义，且滤波后价格之谜的消除增强了结论的可信度。
方法具有通用性，可应用于其他小规模VAR模型。
limitations: GCov估计量对初始值敏感，可能陷入局部最优，尽管模拟中表现良好，但实际应用中需谨慎。
因子滤波依赖于因子个数的选择，本文未提供明确的选择准则。
模拟中假设误差为t分布，但实际数据可能具有其他非高斯特征，可能影响估计性能。
实证部分仅考虑了两个共同因子，可能未完全捕捉所有相关信息。

title: Single-Network Finite-Sample Inference in Strategic Network Formation Models
abstract: We develop a finite-sample valid inference procedure for strategic network formation models in which linking decisions depend on endogenous network statistics (say, the number of common friends). Only a single network is required to be observed, and we restrict neither its density, nor the dependence structure induced by strategic interaction, nor the equilibrium selection mechanism. We exploit a bounding-by-c technique to construct a set of sandwich inequalities that are valid realization by realization, with the middle term involving only the i.i.d. pairwise error. We then average the sandwich inequalities over cells of exogenous covariates, and obtain identifying restrictions under a nonstandard pathwise limit formulation. For inference, we construct test statistics whose finite-sample uncertainty can be controlled by statistics of the exogenous covariates and errors alone, whose conditional distributions are exactly simulable in both semiparametric and parametric settings. Our proposed inference procedure is also computationally tractable, with no need to solve, simulate, or enumerate equilibrium network structures. In simulations, our procedure easily scales to networks of size 10,000, and yields confidence sets that certifies the sign of the strategic coefficient. In two empirical applications (with network size about 300~9500), we find statistical evidence for positive link interdependence at 95% confidence level.
tldr: 提出一种针对战略网络形成模型的有限样本推断方法，仅需观测单个网络，通过边界不等式和路径极限实现有效推断，并在模拟和实证中验证了正链接相互依赖的存在。
abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种适用于策略性网络形成模型的有限样本有效推断方法，在该模型中，链接决策依赖于内生网络统计量（例如，共同朋友的数量）。仅需观测到一个网络，且我们既不限制其密度，也不限制由策略互动引发的依赖结构，更不限制均衡选择机制。我们利用“边界-通过-c”技术构造了一组逐实现有效的夹逼不等式，其中间项仅涉及独立同分布的成对误差。随后，我们在外生协变量的单元格上对这些夹逼不等式进行平均，并在一种非标准的路径极限设定下获得识别约束。在推断方面，我们构造了检验统计量，其有限样本不确定性可仅由外生协变量和误差的统计量控制，而这些统计量的条件分布在半参数和参数设定下均可精确模拟。我们提出的推断方法在计算上也是可行的，无需求解、模拟或枚举均衡网络结构。在模拟中，我们的方法可轻松扩展至规模为10,000的网络，并生成能够验证策略系数符号的置信集。在两个实证应用中（网络规模约为300至9500），我们在95%的置信水平下发现了正向链接相互依赖的统计证据。

title: Energy Market and Carbon Emission Spillovers in Critical Minerals Investment: A Dynamic Connectedness Approach
abstract: Design/methodology/approach A time-varying parameter vector autoregression (TVP-VAR) model is employed to quantify dynamic connectedness and directional volatility spillovers using daily data from May 1, 2013, to May 2, 2023. The study isolates the impact of extreme events by splitting the data into pre- and post-COVID-19 samples based on the February 2020 stock market crash. Purpose This paper examines the daily financial risk spillovers associated with investing in critical minerals. It examines the dynamic interconnectedness between seven critical mineral Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) portfolios and key economic-wide variables, including the energy market, carbon emissions, market sentiment, and global infrastructure. Findings Portfolios with high Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) scores significantly contribute to shock spillovers. Net directional connectedness analysis reveals that West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil and carbon emission futures consistently act as "net receivers," absorbing volatility from the system. Conversely, Cobalt and Aluminum ETFs primarily act as "net givers," transmitting volatility. The pandemic caused significant structural shifts in these transmission roles. Practical implications The identification of specific net givers and receivers provides actionable insights for investors, facilitating better hedging strategies against time-varying structural breaks and broader economic shocks. Originality This study uniquely utilizes financial ETF data rather than physical mineral prices to capture accessible investment risks. It is among the first to link ESG scores to the directional role (giver vs. receiver) of critical mineral assets within a broader macro-financial network.
tldr: 该论文使用TVP-VAR模型研究关键矿产ETF与能源、碳排放等变量之间的动态溢出效应，发现ESG高分资产是主要风险传递者，而WTI原油和碳排放期货是主要风险接收者。
abstract_cn: 设计/方法/路径 采用时变参数向量自回归（TVP-VAR）模型，利用2013年5月1日至2023年5月2日的日度数据，量化动态连通性及方向性波动溢出效应。研究通过将数据基于2020年2月股市崩盘划分为新冠疫情前后两个子样本，以隔离极端事件的影响。目的 本文考察了投资关键矿产所伴随的日常金融风险溢出效应，研究了七个关键矿产交易所交易基金（ETF）投资组合与能源市场、碳排放、市场情绪及全球基础设施等关键宏观经济变量之间的动态相互关联性。研究发现 具有较高环境、社会和治理（ESG）评分的投资组合显著贡献了冲击溢出。净方向性连通性分析显示，西德克萨斯中质原油（WTI）和碳排放期货始终扮演“净接收者”角色，吸收来自系统的波动；而钴和铝ETF则主要充当“净给予者”，向外传递波动。疫情导致这些传递角色发生了显著的结构性转变。实践意义 对特定净给予者和净接收者的识别为投资者提供了可操作的见解，有助于针对时变结构性断裂及更广泛的经济冲击制定更优的对冲策略。原创性 本研究独辟蹊径，采用金融ETF数据而非实物矿产价格来捕捉可投资的风险敞口，并率先将ESG评分与关键矿产资产在更广泛的宏观金融网络中的方向性角色（给予者与接收者）联系起来。

title: Scaling, Lock-In, and Proxy Compliance: A Political Economy of Responsible AI
abstract: AI accountability at scale is an institutional problem: who can observe, verify, and change deployed systems. We develop a sequential political-economy model in which an AI vendor chooses auditability and substantive mitigation, a deployer monitors after adoption while facing switching costs, and enforcement depends on verifiable evidence. Anticipating the deployer's monitoring response, the vendor may stop at an observable procurement floor while mitigating below the social first best, producing a proxy-compliance equilibrium. We characterize the unique interior equilibrium and the corner in which harm is fully mitigated. Independent audit rights raise enforcement exposure directly; portability restores deployer leverage; incident reporting adds a regulator-visible evidence channel; and outcome-linked liability creates incentives that do not depend on vendor-controlled detection. The results explain why documentation and standardized evaluations can coexist with persistent post-deployment harms, and generate testable implications for monitoring, mitigation, and the gap between formal compliance and operational outcomes.
tldr: 该论文构建了一个AI供应商与部署者之间的序贯政治经济学模型，分析审计权、可移植性、事件报告和结果责任如何影响AI的实质性缓解与合规均衡。
abstract_cn: 大规模AI问责是一个制度性问题：谁能够观察、验证并改变已部署的系统。我们构建了一个序贯政治经济学模型，其中AI供应商选择可审计性与实质性缓解措施，部署方在采用后面临转换成本并进行监督，而执法则依赖于可验证的证据。由于预见到部署方的监督反应，供应商可能停留在可观察的采购底线之上，同时将缓解措施控制在低于社会最优水平的程度，从而形成一种代理合规均衡。我们刻画了唯一的内点均衡以及损害被完全缓解的角点情形。独立审计权直接提高了执法暴露程度；可移植性恢复了部署方的制衡力量；事件报告增加了监管者可见的证据渠道；而与结果挂钩的责任机制则创造了不依赖于供应商控制检测的激励。研究结果解释了为何文档记录与标准化评估能够与持续存在的部署后损害并存，并为监督、缓解以及正式合规与运营结果之间的差距提供了可检验的推论。

title: Reversing Reserve Logic: Optimal Holdback in Local Allocation under Scalable Entry
abstract: Scarce opportunities such as concert tickets and accelerator time may be contested by automated participants that can create accounts and sustain commitments beyond the reach of commitment-limited intended users. When account counts are untrusted, we study anonymous screening rules that ignore them, cap retained burdens, use only an account's commitment and strongest rival, and do not reassign after rejecting the leader. Within this class, we characterize the rule maximizing intended users' expected utility when they commit fully and a scalable entrant stays out. The optimum refunds and allocates at low congestion, retains and allocates at intermediate congestion, and retains while withholding allocation from an otherwise eligible leader when the strongest rival lies in the upper tail. Unlike a conventional reserve, which rejects a low leading bid, this rule treats an unusually strong rival as evidence of entrant imitation. A direct dual certificate proves class optimality; a benchmark shows that upper-tail holdback can raise intended-user surplus before it is necessary to support non-entry. The rule supports an equilibrium with full commitment and entrant non-entry.
tldr: 本文研究在可扩展进入者存在时，匿名筛选规则下最优的保留与扣留策略，以最大化预期用户效用，属于机制设计领域。
abstract_cn: 诸如演唱会门票和加速器时间等稀缺机会，可能会受到自动化参与者的争夺，这些参与者能够创建账户并维持承诺，超出了受承诺限制的目标用户所能达到的范围。在账户数量不可信的情况下，我们研究忽略账户数量的匿名筛选规则，这些规则限制保留负担，仅使用账户的承诺及其最强竞争对手的信息，并且在拒绝领先者后不进行重新分配。在这一类规则中，我们刻画了当目标用户完全承诺且可扩展的进入者选择不进入时，最大化目标用户期望效用的规则。该最优规则在低拥堵时退款并分配，在中度拥堵时保留并分配，而在最强竞争对手位于上尾分布时，保留但暂缓向原本符合条件的领先者进行分配。与拒绝低领先出价的传统保留价不同，该规则将异常强大的竞争对手视为进入者模仿的证据。一个直接的对偶证书证明了该类规则的最优性；一个基准测试表明，在需要支持不进入之前，上尾暂缓策略可以提高目标用户的剩余。该规则支持一个具有完全承诺和进入者不进入的均衡。

title: Racing to Ruin
abstract: We study R&D competition in the shadow of disaster: advancing the technology frontier raises the risk of permanently ending all firms' payoffs. Under perfect monitoring and common knowledge of rationality, the equilibrium frontier is bounded below by the optimal stopping time of a monopolist, and above by that of a representative firm that persistently but mistakenly believes its rival is about to stop. We then analyze how the frontier is shaped by transparency (speed of monitoring) and trust (belief in the rationality of rival firms).
tldr: 研究在技术前沿可能引发灾难性风险时，企业研发竞争的均衡边界，并分析透明度和信任的影响。
abstract_cn: 我们研究灾难阴影下的研发竞争：推进技术前沿会提高永久终止所有企业收益的风险。在完全监督和理性共识的假设下，均衡前沿的下界由垄断者的最优停止时间决定，上界则由一个持续但错误地认为其竞争对手即将停止的代表性企业的停止时间决定。随后，我们分析了透明度（监督速度）和信任（对竞争对手企业理性的信念）如何塑造这一前沿。

title: Reference Dependence and the Structure of the WTA/WTP Gap
abstract: This paper studies the willingness-to-accept/willingness-to-pay (WTA-WTP) gap under objective probabilities. Preferences over finite lotteries satisfy completeness, transitivity, continuity, weak independence, reference partition, and range dependence. Weak independence requires von Neumann-Morgenstern independence only for mixtures that preserve the reference point and do not move outcomes across the induced gain-loss partition. The representation, weak rank-dependent utility (WRDU), evaluates gains and losses by separate subutilities anchored at the reference point and recombines them through a range-dependent Lagrangian penalty coefficient \r{ho} on the loss-side component. The reciprocal index ${λ= 1/ρ}$ reports the WTA-WTP loss-aversion convention. The main result characterizes a normalized admissible transaction class in which the WTA-WTP gap follows from the asymmetric buying and selling indifference equations. In this class, $λ > 1$ suppresses WTP and elevates WTA, while $ρ> 1$ corresponds to gain seeking or loss attenuation. A fixed reciprocal loss-aversion index has no internal mechanism that makes the wedge converge to zero as transaction scale changes; attenuation requires a transaction path on which $ρ> 1$ and $λ$ converge to their common neutral value one. The analysis gives a decision-theoretic account of the endowment-effect wedge based on weakened independence, reference anchoring, semi-affine subutility normalization, and range-dependent penalization. The result is distinct from the Rabin calibration implication and does not rely on constant-relative-risk-aversion utility or probability weighting.
tldr: 该论文提出弱秩依赖效用（WRDU）模型，通过参考依赖和范围依赖惩罚来解释WTA/WTP差距，属于决策理论和行为经济学范畴。
abstract_cn: 本文研究了客观概率下意愿接受价与意愿支付价（WTA-WTP）之间的缺口。对有限彩票的偏好满足完备性、传递性、连续性、弱独立性、参考划分和范围依赖性。弱独立性要求冯·诺依曼-摩根斯坦独立性仅适用于保持参考点且不将结果跨越所诱导的得失划分的混合。该表示形式——弱秩依赖效用（WRDU）——通过锚定于参考点的独立子效用分别评估收益与损失，并通过损失侧分量上的范围依赖拉格朗日惩罚系数ρ将其重新组合。倒数指标λ = 1/ρ反映了WTA-WTP损失厌恶惯例。主要结果刻画了一个归一化的可容许交易类别，在该类别中，WTA-WTP缺口源于不对称的买入与卖出无差异方程。在此类别中，λ > 1会抑制WTP并抬高WTA，而ρ > 1则对应收益寻求或损失衰减。固定的倒数损失厌恶指数缺乏内在机制使缺口随交易规模变化而趋于零；衰减需要一条交易路径，在该路径上ρ > 1且λ收敛于其共同的中性值1。该分析基于弱化独立性、参考锚定、半仿射子效用归一化以及范围依赖惩罚，为禀赋效应缺口提供了决策理论解释。该结果不同于拉宾校准推论，且不依赖于常相对风险厌恶效用或概率加权。

title: The Last Costly Signal: How Generative AI Collapses Competence Signaling and Why Liability Sustains Markets for Expert Services
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence has reduced the cost of producing convincing artifacts of expertise-reports, analyses, proposals-to nearly zero. Signaling theory predicts that signals whose informational content rests on production cost lose that content when production becomes cheap. We formalize this prediction for markets for expert services, a class of credence goods, by modeling generative AI as a compression of the discernible headroom between what machines produce at negligible cost and what buyers can distinguish at all. Below a critical headroom, no separating equilibrium in production-side signals exists; the market pools, high-competence providers earn no premium, and those with outside options exit-Akerlof's lemons dynamic. We show that an outcome-contingent signal-a warranty backed by damages D with ex-post verifiability phi-restores full separation for any level of AI capability whenever phi*D >= v, where v is the value of a solved problem. The expected cost of liability depends on whether the problem is solved, not on document production costs. A corollary shows that provenance certification (e.g., C2PA), whose cost is type-independent, cannot restore separation. Agent-based Monte-Carlo simulations illustrate the dynamics. Two further results endogenize contract institutions: civil procedure costs set a minimum ticket size v_min below which no credible enforcement threat exists; under liability insurance, separation depends on retained risk or risk-rated premiums. We state falsification conditions and propose a preregistered choice-based conjoint experiment with decision-makers in the German-speaking B2B expert-services market.
tldr: 该论文通过信号传递模型和蒙特卡洛模拟，研究生成式AI如何削弱专家服务市场中的能力信号，并提出基于结果的担保（责任）可恢复分离均衡，而来源认证则不能。
abstract_cn: 生成式人工智能已将生产具有专业性的可信产物——报告、分析、提案——的成本降至接近于零。信号理论预测，若信号的信息含量依赖于生产成本，则当生产变得廉价时，该信息含量将随之消失。我们将这一预测形式化于专家服务市场（一类信任品）中，将生成式AI建模为对“机器以极低成本所能生产之物”与“买方在任何情况下所能辨别之物”之间可辨识余量的压缩。当余量低于临界值时，生产方信号不存在分离均衡；市场趋于混同，高能力提供者无法获得溢价，拥有外部选择者退出市场——即阿克洛夫“柠檬市场”动态。我们证明，一种基于结果的信号——以损害赔偿金D为担保并具有事后可验证性φ的保证——在φ·D ≥ v的条件下，能够对任意AI能力水平恢复完全分离，其中v为解决问题所带来的价值。责任的预期成本取决于问题是否被解决，而非文件生产成本。一个推论表明，来源认证（如C2PA）因其成本与类型无关，无法恢复分离均衡。基于主体的蒙特卡洛模拟展示了上述动态。另外两项结果将契约制度内生化：民事诉讼程序成本设定了最低票额规模v_min，低于该规模则不存在可信的执法威胁；在责任保险下，分离取决于自留风险或风险定价保费。我们提出了可证伪条件，并设计了一项预注册的、基于选择的联合实验，以德语区B2B专家服务市场的决策者为对象。

title: A Theory of Reference-Dependent Utility
abstract: This paper characterizes a class of twice continuously differentiable objective-probability preference representations exhibiting endogenous reference dependence under risk. Weak rank-dependent utility (WRDU) preserves objective probabilities, partitions outcomes at an endogenous reference point, and evaluates lotteries through a gainloss representation in which the reference point maximizes a penalized functional. The first-order condition yields a virtual loss-aversion index equal to the ratio of marginal utilities across the loss and gain domains, recovering both the utility-based index of Köbberling and Wakker (2005) and the slope ratio of Tversky and Kahneman (1992) as special cases. The main theorem shows that, within a class satisfying affine admissibility, loss-factorization, dispersion monotonicity, and attenuation, the derivative-ratio form is uniquely admissible. In this class, WRDU generates the modal Allais pattern on an admissible region and blocks the Rabin calibration implication through range-dependent attenuation. The result is conditional and does not claim uniqueness over all behavioral models of risky choice.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种具有内生参考点的弱秩依赖效用理论，并证明了其导数比率形式的唯一性，用于解释阿莱悖论和拉宾校准。
abstract_cn: 本文刻画了一类在风险下表现出内生参照依赖的二阶连续可微目标-概率偏好表示。弱秩依赖效用（WRDU）保留客观概率，在内生参照点处对结果进行划分，并通过一个得失表示来评估彩票，其中参照点最大化一个惩罚泛函。一阶条件产生一个虚拟损失厌恶指数，该指数等于损失域与收益域边际效用之比，将Köbberling和Wakker（2005）的基于效用的指数以及Tversky和Kahneman（1992）的斜率比作为特例加以恢复。主要定理表明，在满足仿射可容许性、损失分解性、离散单调性和衰减性的一类偏好中，导数比形式是唯一可容许的。在该类中，WRDU在可容许区域上生成模态阿莱斯模式，并通过范围依赖的衰减阻断拉宾校准蕴含。该结果是条件性的，并不声称在风险选择的所有行为模型中具有唯一性。

title: Almost stochastic dominance via optimal transport
abstract: We study parametric classes of almost stochastic dominance on general Polish spaces as order relations for probability distributions with a parameter $γ\in [0,1]$. Larger values of $γ$ correspond to weaker order relations: $γ=0$ gives classical stochastic dominance $\le_{st}$, whereas $γ=1$ gives a complete preorder based on comparison of expectations of a fixed increasing function $g$. It is well known that $X \le_{st} Y$ can be characterized by the existence of a solution to an optimal transport problem with $\mathrm{OT}_c(X,Y)=0$ for a suitable cost function $c$. We generalize this idea so that the best possible parameter $γ$ for almost stochastic dominance can be determined from the solution of an optimal transport problem. Using a generalization of the classical Kantorovich--Rubinstein duality theorem to quasi-pseudo-metrics, we derive a dual characterization of the order in terms of expectation comparisons for a parametric class of test functions. Consequently, our relations are always transitive, in contrast to some other recent approaches to almost stochastic dominance based on optimal transport. A natural multivariate approach to almost stochastic dominance, based on classes of test functions with bounds on partial derivatives, was recently introduced by Müller et al. (2025). We show that this approach is a special case of our framework and derive the best possible parameters $γ$ for examples considered there, as well as for other examples from the literature. We also prove a robustness result showing that, under small perturbations of the distributions in a Wasserstein-type metric related to the optimal transport problem, the best possible $γ$ increases only slightly.
tldr: 该论文提出了一类基于最优传输的几乎随机占优序关系，并给出了其对偶刻画和鲁棒性结果。
abstract_cn: 我们研究了一般Polish空间上几乎随机占优的参数类，将其作为概率分布之间的序关系，参数为$γ\in [0,1]$。较大的$γ$值对应较弱的序关系：$γ=0$给出经典随机占优$\le_{st}$，而$γ=1$给出基于固定递增函数$g$的期望比较的完全预序。众所周知，$X \le_{st} Y$可以通过存在一个最优输运问题的解来刻画，其中对于适当的成本函数$c$，有$\mathrm{OT}_c(X,Y)=0$。我们将这一思想推广，使得几乎随机占优的最佳参数$γ$可以通过最优输运问题的解来确定。利用经典Kantorovich–Rubinstein对偶定理到拟伪度量的推广，我们导出了该序关系在参数类测试函数下以期望比较形式给出的对偶刻画。因此，我们的关系总是传递的，这与近期其他基于最优输运的几乎随机占优方法不同。Müller等人（2025）最近提出了一种基于偏导数有界的测试函数类的自然多元几乎随机占优方法。我们证明该方法是我们框架的一个特例，并为其所考虑的示例以及文献中的其他示例导出了最佳参数$γ$。我们还证明了一个稳健性结果：在与最优输运问题相关的Wasserstein型度量下，当分布受到微小扰动时，最佳$γ$仅略有增加。

title: Pricing and Semi-static Hedging of Green Pay-as-produced Power Purchase Agreements
abstract: Pay-as-produced power purchase agreements (PPAs) expose buyers and sellers to the joint risk of power prices and renewable production. This paper develops a theoretical framework for hedging this exposure using a semi-static strategy: liquid futures hedge traded price risk dynamically, while a fixed portfolio of renewable-linked claims targets residual volume and covariance risk. The pricing and hedging decomposition is model-free, whereas the empirical implementation for German wind and solar generation uses a calibrated stochastic model. Conditional on a valuation measure, the fair strike is a production-weighted expected spot price. We show that it decomposes exactly into the baseload forward level, a deterministic production-profile correction, and a stochastic price-volume covariance correction, where the covariance term measures the pricing effect of renewable cannibalisation. The static hedge is selected through a finite-dimensional variance projection onto claims linked to renewable volume, delivery-period average prices, and price-volume covariance. We estimate a Lévy-driven bivariate MCARMA state-space model with state-dependent price spikes using hourly German data for 2023-2024 and apply it to monthly PPAs over the January-December 2025 delivery horizon. The results distinguish deterministic profile risk from stochastic covariance risk and show how sparse static overlays reduce residual exposures that fixed-volume futures cannot hedge. The selected portfolios also indicate which claim types are most effective for hedging residual renewable shape risk.
tldr: 本文提出一种半静态对冲策略，用于管理可再生能源购电协议中电价与产量联合风险，并利用德国数据实证分析定价分解与对冲效果。
abstract_cn: 按产出付费的购电协议（PPA）使买卖双方共同面临电力价格与可再生能源发电量的联合风险。本文构建了一个理论框架，利用半静态策略对冲该风险：流动性期货动态对冲已交易的价格风险，而固定组合的可再生能源关联债权则针对剩余电量及协方差风险。定价与对冲分解无需模型假设，而针对德国风电与光伏发电的实证实施则采用校准后的随机模型。在给定估值测度的条件下，公平执行价等于产量加权的预期现货价格。我们证明，该价格可精确分解为基荷远期水平、确定性发电曲线修正项以及随机价格—电量协方差修正项，其中协方差项度量了可再生能源蚕食效应的定价影响。静态对冲通过有限维方差投影选取，投影对象为与可再生能源发电量、交割期平均价格及价格—电量协方差相关联的债权。我们利用2023—2024年德国小时级数据估计了一个带状态依赖价格尖峰的Lévy驱动双变量MCARMA状态空间模型，并将其应用于2025年1月至12月交割期的月度PPA。研究结果区分了确定性曲线风险与随机协方差风险，并展示了稀疏的静态叠加如何降低固定电量期货无法对冲的剩余风险。所选投资组合还揭示了哪些债权类型对对冲剩余可再生能源形态风险最为有效。

title: AWARE-FX: An Auditable Knowledge-Guided AI System for Measuring Corporate Foreign-Exchange Hedging Disclosure
abstract: Corporate annual reports contain weakly structured evidence about foreign-exchange risk management, derivative use, natural hedging, and explicit non-use. This study develops AWARE-FX, an auditable AI/NLP decision-support system that converts report text into traceable firm-year hedging-disclosure measures. The system combines a professional-source lexicon, negation and accounting-status logic, channel-specific financial encoders, exact evidence gates, conservative aggregation, and an audit ledger. Across 24,909 Hong Kong firm-years from 2008-2025, it retrieves and scores 543,527 snippets. Reliability is evaluated through ablations, a stratified 300-snippet human audit, three-seed FinBERT-ModernBERT comparisons, strict 2023-2025 temporal tests, probability calibration, selective prediction, and fixed-prompt generative-model benchmarks. FinBERT has the higher mean F1 in seven of eight encoder task-split comparisons; its temporal F1 ranges from 0.702 to 0.872. Abstaining on the 20% least-confident temporal observations raises retained-sample F1 by 0.050-0.077. Deterministic Qwen3-8B performs strongly on commodity and negation evidence but poorly on foreign-debt and accounting-context labels, showing that a general-purpose LLM does not uniformly replace domain constraints. The strict FX score is negatively associated with linked baseline and stress-period FX exposure, whereas the generic broad score is not. These associations provide external construct validation, not causal estimates of hedging effectiveness. AWARE-FX contributes a tested decision-support architecture in which retrieval, status logic, classification, uncertainty handling, aggregation, and external validation remain separately auditable.
tldr: 开发AWARE-FX系统，利用AI/NLP从企业年报中提取外汇对冲披露指标，并验证其可靠性及与外汇风险暴露的相关性。
abstract_cn: 企业年度报告包含关于外汇风险管理、衍生品使用、自然对冲及明确不使用的弱结构化证据。本研究开发了AWARE-FX，一个可审计的人工智能/自然语言处理（AI/NLP）决策支持系统，可将报告文本转化为可追溯的公司—年度对冲披露度量。该系统结合了专业来源词库、否定与会计状态逻辑、渠道特定金融编码器、精确证据门控、保守聚合以及审计账本。在2008—2025年间覆盖24,909个香港公司—年度观测值中，系统检索并评分了543,527条文本片段。可靠性通过消融实验、分层300片段人工审计、三种子FinBERT-ModernBERT比较、严格的2023—2025年时间外推测试、概率校准、选择性预测以及固定提示生成模型基准进行评估。在八个编码器任务—分割比较中，FinBERT在七项中具有更高的平均F1分数；其时间外推F1介于0.702至0.872之间。对20%最不自信的时间外推观测值进行弃权，使保留样本的F1分数提高0.050—0.077。确定性Qwen3-8B在商品与否定证据上表现强劲，但在外债与会计语境标签上表现不佳，表明通用大语言模型（LLM）并不能均匀替代领域约束。严格外汇评分与关联的基期及压力期外汇敞口呈负相关，而通用宽泛评分则无此关联。这些关联提供了外部构念效度证据，而非对冲有效性的因果估计。AWARE-FX贡献了一个经过检验的决策支持架构，其中检索、状态逻辑、分类、不确定性处理、聚合及外部验证均可分别审计。

title: Are Three Matrices All You Need To Beat the Market? Observable Matrix Dynamics for Portfolio Optimization
abstract: We present a simple framework for dynamic portfolio management that uses nothing but daily prices, trading volumes, and market capitalizations. Its state is three fixed-size matrices built from the price history: the distance matrix of the return correlations and the transition matrices of two Markov chains that rank the S\&P 500 names monthly by trailing return and by trailing volatility. These three matrices rest on the price history alone, the same information Markowitz mean-variance optimization draws on, but they replace its expected-return vector and covariance matrix. Our method requires no matrix inversion, works on outlier-robust cross-sectional ranks, and is dynamic rather than single-period. Empirically the volatility rank is forecastable one step ahead while the return rank stays close to unforecastable. A portfolio built on the forecasts, a market-neutral momentum long-short blended with an opportunistic long-only sleeve, beats the market on two non-overlapping out-of-sample test sets, January 2022 to December 2024 and January 2025 to July 2026, at Sharpes of $1.06$ and $1.32$ against the market's $0.78$ and $1.14$, respectively, net of a five-basis-point trading cost and marked to market daily. It also outperforms the classical minimum-variance and maximum-diversification portfolios. Diversifying the long sleeve by residual distance adds a further edge on both periods, lifting the Sharpe to $1.08$ and $1.44$ and the annualized return from $18\%$ to $20\%$ and from $44\%$ to $56\%$, respectively. A convex information-leader overlay separately insures the market-neutral sleeve, buying convexity and a shallower drawdown at a small cost in return, the Sharpe unchanged.
tldr: 该论文提出一种仅使用价格、成交量和市值的动态投资组合管理框架，通过构建相关距离矩阵和马尔可夫链转移矩阵进行预测，并构建市场中性多空组合，实证表现优于市场。
abstract_cn: 我们提出一个用于动态投资组合管理的简洁框架，其输入仅需每日价格、交易量和市值。其状态由三个固定大小的矩阵构成，这些矩阵均基于价格历史构建：收益相关性的距离矩阵，以及两个马尔可夫链的转移矩阵，这两个马尔可夫链分别按月对标准普尔500指数成分股按滞后收益和滞后波动率进行排序。这三个矩阵完全依赖于价格历史，与马科维茨均值-方差优化所依赖的信息相同，但用它们替代了后者的期望收益向量和协方差矩阵。我们的方法无需矩阵求逆，基于对异常值稳健的横截面排名运作，并且是动态的而非单期静态的。实证结果表明，波动率排名可提前一期预测，而收益排名则几乎不可预测。基于这些预测构建的投资组合——一个市场中性动量多空组合，叠加一个机会型纯多头部分——在两个不重叠的样本外测试区间（2022年1月至2024年12月，以及2025年1月至2026年7月）中均跑赢市场，其夏普比率分别为1.06和1.32，而同期市场为0.78和1.14，且已扣除五个基点的交易成本并按日盯市。该组合也优于经典的最小方差组合和最大分散化组合。通过残差距离对多头部分进行分散化处理，在两个区间内均进一步提升了表现，将夏普比率提升至1.08和1.44，年化收益率分别从18%提高至20%，以及从44%提高至56%。一个凸性信息领导者叠加层单独为市场中性部分提供保险，以较小的收益代价换取凸性和更浅的回撤，夏普比率保持不变。

title: ZAPs: A Reward Attribution Framework for DeFi Ecosystems with Adversarial-Robust Scoring via Parallel Anomaly Ensemble Detection
abstract:
Incentive programs are central to user acquisition in decentralized finance, but many reward systems rely on raw volume, transaction count, and wallet count, making them vulnerable to bots and sybil operations. We present ZAPs, a reward attribution framework that combines economic contribution scoring with adversarial robustness. A composite activity score uses protocol-specific percentile normalization to limit whale dominance while preserving differentiation among users. A two-layer weighting mechanism combines protocol share within sector and sector share within the ecosystem, which reduces the profitability of farming small protocols. We show that the maximum reward obtainable from any protocol is bounded by that protocol's global volume share.
  ZAPs also introduces a four-layer defense stack consisting of transaction-level integrity checks, a parallel anomaly ensemble, post-distribution behavioral memory, and graph-based sybil clustering. The anomaly ensemble combines a one-class reconstruction model with an isolation forest and applies graduated rather than binary penalties. On 1,073 labeled malicious wallets covering 124,638 transactions, the ensemble achieves 0.923 +/- 0.013 ROC-AUC, compared with 0.891 +/- 0.016 for the reconstruction model alone, when the isolation forest is trained on benign wallets. Training it on the pooled population reverses its polarity and removes the ensemble gain. Controlled simulations reduce adversarial reward capture by 30-90 percent while legitimate-user scenarios change by 1-8 percent. Live campaigns recorded a 56 percent reduction in sybil allocation, a 49 percent increase in quality-wallet participation, and a 50 percent reduction in sell pressure.
tldr: 提出ZAPs框架，通过经济贡献评分和并行异常检测集成，提高DeFi奖励分配的公平性和鲁棒性，减少女巫攻击和机器人操纵。
abstract_cn:
激励计划是去中心化金融中获取用户的核心手段，但许多奖励系统依赖于原始交易量、交易笔数和钱包数量，因而容易受到机器人和女巫攻击（sybil operations）的影响。我们提出了ZAPs，一种将经济贡献评分与对抗鲁棒性相结合的奖励归属框架。复合活动评分采用协议特定的百分位归一化，以限制巨鲸主导效应，同时保留用户之间的区分度。两层加权机制结合了协议在板块内的份额以及板块在生态系统中的份额，从而降低了刷小协议（farming small protocols）的盈利性。我们证明，从任何协议中可获得的最大奖励受限于该协议的全球交易量份额。
  ZAPs还引入了一个四层防御体系，包括交易级完整性检查、并行异常集成、分发后行为记忆以及基于图的Sybil聚类。该异常集成结合了单类重构模型与孤立森林（isolation forest），并采用渐进式而非二值化的惩罚机制。在涵盖124,638笔交易的1,073个已标注恶意钱包上，当孤立森林基于良性钱包训练时，该集成的ROC-AUC达到0.923 ± 0.013，而单独使用重构模型时为0.891 ± 0.016。若在混合总体上进行训练，孤立森林的极性反转，集成增益消失。受控模拟将对抗性奖励获取降低了30%至90%，而合法用户场景的变化仅为1%至8%。实际运行活动显示，Sybil分配减少了56%，高质量钱包参与度增加了49%，卖出压力降低了50%。

title: Subjective earnings and employment dynamics
abstract: We develop a new approach to estimating earnings, job, and employment dynamics using subjective expectations data from the NY Fed Survey of Consumer Expectations. These data provide beliefs about future earnings offers and acceptance probabilities, offering direct information on counterfactual outcomes and enabling identification under weaker assumptions. Our framework avoids biases from selection and unobserved heterogeneity that affect models using realized outcomes. First-step fixed-effects regressions identify risk, persistence, and transition effects; second-step GMM recovers the covariance structure of unobserved heterogeneities such as ability, mobility, and match quality. We find lower risk and persistence of the individual productivity component than in prior work, but greater heterogeneity in ability and match quality. Simulations show that reduced-form estimates overstate persistence and volatility on individual-level productivity due to job transitions and sorting. After accounting for heterogeneity, volatility declines and becomes flat across the earnings distribution. These results underscore the value of expectations data.
tldr: 利用主观预期数据估计收入、就业动态，避免选择偏差和未观测异质性，发现个体生产率波动和持续性低于以往估计。
abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种利用纽约联储消费者预期调查中的主观预期数据来估计收入、工作和就业动态的新方法。这些数据提供了关于未来收入报价和接受概率的信念，直接反映了反事实结果的信息，并能在较弱的假设下实现识别。我们的框架避免了使用已实现结果的模型中所存在的选择偏差和未观测异质性影响。第一步的固定效应回归识别了风险、持续性和转换效应；第二步的广义矩方法（GMM）恢复了未观测异质性（如能力、流动性和匹配质量）的协方差结构。我们发现，个体生产力成分的风险和持续性低于以往研究的结果，但能力和匹配质量的异质性更大。模拟结果表明，简约式估计因工作转换和分类效应而高估了个体层面生产力的持续性和波动性。在考虑异质性后，波动性下降并在收入分布中趋于平坦。这些结果凸显了预期数据的价值。

title: Let the tree decide: FABART. A non-parametric factor model for nonlinear oil shock transmission
abstract: The question of how oil supply news shocks transmit to real activity, financial conditions, and regional labor markets is back at the center of the macroeconomic research agenda. To answer this question, we introduce the Factor Bayesian Additive Regression Tree (FABART) model, a nonlinear factor-augmented vector autoregression model, and apply it to a large U.S. macro-financial dataset with externally identified oil supply news shocks. The framework combines a large macro-financial information set with a flexible nonparametric measurement equation, allowing nonlinear transmission to emerge from the data rather than being imposed through a pre-specified functional form. We find that adverse oil supply news shocks generate stronger and more persistent contractions in real activity than the expansions associated with favorable shocks of comparable magnitude, with especially pronounced differences in industrial production, financial variables, and equity prices. Employment responses are highly heterogeneous across U.S. states, with substantially stronger contractions in manufacturing-intensive regions, while energy-producing states display partially offsetting dynamics following adverse oil supply news shocks. Across shock magnitudes, nonlinearities arise mainly between very small and moderate oil-price movements: small shocks generate weak and imprecisely estimated responses, while moderate shocks already produce economically meaningful effects on industrial production and regional employment. Larger shocks do not systematically generateproportionally stronger responses across variables and shock signs.
tldr: 本文提出FABART模型，用于分析石油供给新闻冲击对宏观经济和金融变量的非线性影响，发现不利冲击的影响更强且存在区域异质性。
abstract_cn: 石油供给新闻冲击如何传导至实际经济活动、金融状况和区域劳动力市场，这一问题重新成为宏观经济研究议程的核心。为回答这一问题，我们引入了因子贝叶斯加性回归树（FABART）模型——一种非线性因子增广向量自回归模型，并将其应用于包含外部识别石油供给新闻冲击的大型美国宏观金融数据集。该框架将大型宏观金融信息集与灵活的非参数测量方程相结合，使得非线性传导能够从数据中自然涌现，而非通过预先设定的函数形式强加。我们发现，不利的石油供给新闻冲击所引发的实际经济活动收缩，比同等规模有利冲击所带来的扩张更为强烈且更具持续性，其中工业生产、金融变量和股票价格方面的差异尤为显著。各州就业反应表现出高度异质性，制造业密集地区的收缩幅度明显更大，而能源生产州在面对不利石油供给新闻冲击时则呈现出部分抵消性动态。就冲击幅度而言，非线性主要出现在极小与中等油价变动之间：小冲击产生的响应较弱且估计精度不高，而中等冲击已能对工业生产和区域就业产生具有经济意义的影响。更大规模的冲击并未在变量和冲击方向上系统性地产生按比例更强的响应。

title: Moral Characters: Social Media and Elections in the US
abstract: We study how politicians' adoption of social media, and the use of moral language, affect electoral returns. We compile a new dataset covering over 4,000 Twitter accounts and almost five million tweets by US House candidates over 2008-2018. We document several descriptive facts: social media use rises and falls with electoral cycles, politicians' use of moral rhetoric increased over the period of study, and moral rhetoric is strongly associated with higher social media engagement. Using a regression discontinuity design on close primary elections, we find that social media use by candidates has a positive but imprecisely estimated effect on vote shares. This effect is strongly heterogeneous depending on the use of moral rhetoric, and is large and statistically significant for candidates with above-median moral language use. A complementary design using only candidates with Twitter also reveals a causal effect of moral language on vote shares. We also document that relative to other social media features (negativity, out-group animosity, toxicity) moral rhetoric drives more positive engagement. Finally, we show that increased coverage from mainstream news media and campaign donations are important mechanisms.
tldr: 该论文利用美国众议院候选人的Twitter数据和准实验设计，发现使用道德语言能显著提高选举得票率，并探讨了新闻媒体覆盖和竞选捐款作为机制。
abstract_cn: 我们研究了政治家采用社交媒体以及使用道德语言如何影响选举回报。我们编制了一个新数据集，涵盖2008年至2018年间美国众议院候选人的4000多个Twitter账户和近500万条推文。我们记录了几个描述性事实：社交媒体的使用随选举周期起伏，政治家在研究期间使用道德修辞的频率有所增加，且道德修辞与更高的社交媒体参与度密切相关。利用紧邻初选中的断点回归设计，我们发现候选人使用社交媒体对选票份额有正向影响，但估计精度不高。这一影响因道德修辞的使用而呈现出强烈的异质性，对于道德语言使用高于中位数的候选人，该影响显著且规模较大。一项仅使用拥有Twitter账户的候选人的补充设计也揭示了道德语言对选票份额的因果效应。我们还记录到，相对于其他社交媒体特征（如负面情绪、外群体敌意、毒性），道德修辞能带来更积极的参与。最后，我们表明主流新闻媒体的更多报道和竞选捐款是重要的机制。

title: Legal Threats and Online Dissent: Evidence from Social Media Regulation in Turkey
abstract: We study how legal threats to social media platforms shape online political communication. We exploit the sharp implementation of a 2020 Turkish law that required social media companies to establish local offices and provide user data to the government on request. Assembling a panel of over 700 Twitter users and 7 million posts, we use a differences-in-differences design to compare dissenters, individuals publicly critical of the reform when announced, to other groups unlikely to be affected, such as celebrities. We find that dissenters and political exiles post 15-20 percent fewer tweets following implementation, and engagement with their content falls sharply. These short-run chilling effects emerge despite limited platform compliance, indicating that anticipated enforcement risk, rather than actual enforcement, drives the effect. In the long run, the chilling effects dissipate. Our findings suggest that states can govern online speech indirectly, by regulating platforms rather than users, but that such effects may be self-limiting in the absence of visible enforcement.
tldr: 利用双重差分法，研究发现土耳其2020年社交媒体法对持不同政见者的在线发帖产生短期寒蝉效应，但长期消散，表明预期执法风险而非实际执法驱动了影响。
abstract_cn: 我们研究了针对社交媒体平台的法律威胁如何塑造在线政治传播。我们利用2020年土耳其一项法律的骤然实施，该法律要求社交媒体公司设立本地办事处，并在政府要求时提供用户数据。通过汇集超过700名推特用户和700万条帖子的面板数据，我们采用双重差分设计，将异议者——即在改革宣布时公开批评该改革的个人——与不太可能受到影响的群体（如名人）进行比较。我们发现，在实施后，异议者和政治流亡者的推文发布数量减少了15%至20%，且其内容的互动量急剧下降。这些短期寒蝉效应在平台合规程度有限的情况下依然出现，表明预期中的执法风险而非实际执法驱动了这一效应。从长期来看，寒蝉效应逐渐消散。我们的研究结果表明，国家可以通过监管平台而非用户来间接治理在线言论，但在缺乏可见执法的情况下，此类效应可能是自我限制的。

title: Monetary Policy Transmission to Household Credit: Evidence from Uganda’s Credit Registry Data
tldr: 利用乌干达信贷登记数据，研究货币政策对家庭信贷的传导，发现货币政策通过银行信贷渠道影响家庭贷款。

analysis.chinese_title: 货币政策向家庭信贷的传导：来自乌干达信贷登记数据的证据
analysis.summary: 本文利用乌干达信贷登记处的贷款级数据，研究了货币政策向家庭信贷的传导机制。样本涵盖2017年至2023年间所有商业银行发放的超过63.2万笔家庭贷款，期间政策利率波动显著。研究发现，政策利率上调与贷款利率上升、贷款规模和期限缩短相关。通过加入时变借款人群体固定效应以吸收平均传导效应，文章识别了银行资产负债表特征对传导的异质性影响。结果显示，流动性较低、资本充足率较低以及持有较多政府证券的银行，其传导效应更强。这些效应在固定利率贷款中比浮动利率贷款更为明显。总体而言，研究支持乌干达存在银行信贷渠道，与发达经济体的发现相似。
innovations: 首次利用信贷登记数据研究发展中国家家庭信贷的货币政策传导。
构建合成借款人群体，以在缺乏多银行借贷关系的情况下控制信贷需求。
考察银行持有政府证券对货币政策传导的影响，揭示财政主导的作用。
分析固定利率与浮动利率贷款的异质性传导效应。
探讨货币政策传导对不同收入群体的分配效应。
analysis.methodology: 本文使用乌干达信贷登记处的贷款级数据，构建合成借款人群体（按地区、收入、就业和性别分组），并采用固定效应模型和局部投影法。基准回归控制借款人、银行或借款人-银行固定效应，并加入宏观变量（GDP增长、通胀）和银行特征。为识别银行信贷渠道，加入借款人-时间固定效应，并交互政策利率与银行特征（流动性、资本、政府证券持有）。
analysis.key_results: 政策利率每上升100个基点，家庭贷款利率在下一季度上升63个基点；贷款规模在5个季度后累计下降15%；贷款期限在5个季度内缩短。银行流动性或资本比率低于中位数时，贷款利率额外上升58和28个基点；政府证券持有高于中位数时，额外上升58个基点。资本较弱的银行在紧缩后贷款规模多减少22%，政府证券持有多的银行多减少10%。固定利率贷款的传导效应更强。
strengths: 使用详细的贷款级数据，覆盖几乎所有家庭贷款。
通过合成借款人方法缓解了信贷需求识别问题。
考虑了银行持有政府证券这一发展中国家特有因素。
进行了多种稳健性检验，如排除疫情时期、控制准备金要求等。
limitations: 货币政策变化可能同时影响信贷供给和需求，基准回归结果仅为描述性。
合成借款人方法依赖可观测特征，可能无法完全控制需求异质性。
样本期包含疫情，可能引入特殊政策干扰。
数据仅覆盖新发放贷款，未考虑存量贷款调整。

title: The Relationship Between LPR, Bank Interest Rate and Real Estate Prices in Shanghai
abstract: The real estate market is a crucial pillar of the national economy. As an international financial center, Shanghai boasts a highly active real estate market with distinct price fluctuations, becoming a key area for regulatory policies. Interest rates, as core macroeconomic regulation tools, including traditional bank lending rates and the Loan Prime Rate (LPR) since its 2019 reform, exert significant impacts on real estate prices through the transmission mechanisms of the IS-LM model and credit rationing theory. The 2019 LPR reform has formed a "dual interest rate system", but the combined impacts, effect differences and synergistic effects of the two rates on Shanghai’s real estate prices have not been systematically explored based on classic economic theories. Based on Shanghai’s time-series data from 2001 to 2024, this work constructs an econometric model combined with relevant theories to empirically analyze the impact mechanism of the dual interest rates on Shanghai’s real estate prices. The results indicate that both rates have significant negative impacts on Shanghai’s housing prices and exhibit synergistic regulatory effects; the LPR has a stronger impact on housing prices with an elasticity coefficient of -3.5, higher than that of traditional bank lending rates (-2.8); the transmission lag of LPR is 2–3 quarters, while that of traditional bank lending rates is 3–4 quarters; purchase restriction policies and land supply can significantly weaken the impact of interest rates on real estate prices. This study fills the research gap in the impact of the "dual interest rate system" on real estate prices in megacities after the LPR reform, provides quantitative references for optimizing the interest rate regulation policy of Shanghai’s real estate market, and offers a reference for real estate regulation in similar cities.

tldr: 基于2001-2024年上海数据，实证分析LPR和传统银行贷款利率对房价的影响，发现两者均有负向作用且LPR影响更强、时滞更短，并存在协同效应。
abstract_cn: 房地产市场是国民经济的重要支柱。上海作为国际金融中心，其房地产市场交投活跃、价格波动显著，是调控政策的重要关注区域。利率作为核心宏观调控工具，包括传统银行贷款利率及2019年改革后的贷款市场报价利率（LPR），通过IS-LM模型和信贷配给理论等传导机制对房地产价格产生重要影响。2019年LPR改革形成了“双利率体系”，但两种利率对上海房地产价格的综合影响、效应差异及协同作用尚未基于经典经济理论进行系统探讨。本文基于2001—2024年上海时间序列数据，结合相关理论构建计量经济模型，实证分析双利率对上海房地产价格的影响机制。研究结果表明：两种利率对上海房价均具有显著的负向影响，且存在协同调控效应；LPR对房价的影响更强，弹性系数为-3.5，高于传统银行贷款利率的-2.8；LPR的传导时滞为2—3个季度，传统银行贷款利率的传导时滞为3—4个季度；限购政策和土地供给能够显著削弱利率对房地产价格的影响。本研究填补了LPR改革后“双利率体系”对超大城市房地产价格影响的研究空白，为优化上海房地产市场利率调控政策提供了量化参考，并为同类城市的房地产调控提供了借鉴。

analysis.chinese_title: LPR、银行利率与上海房地产价格之间的关系
analysis.summary: 本研究基于2001年至2024年上海的时间序列数据，结合IS-LM模型和信贷配给理论，构建计量经济模型，实证分析LPR和传统银行利率对上海房价的影响机制。研究发现，两种利率对上海房价均有显著负向影响，且具有协同调控效应；LPR对房价的影响弹性系数为-3.5，高于传统银行利率的-2.8；LPR的传导滞后为2-3个季度，传统银行利率为3-4个季度；限购政策和土地供应能显著削弱利率对房价的影响。研究填补了LPR改革后“双利率体系”对特大城市房价影响的研究空白，为优化上海房地产市场利率调控政策提供了量化参考。
innovations: 首次系统研究LPR改革后“双利率体系”（LPR与传统银行利率）对上海房价的联合影响，填补了相关研究空白。
基于IS-LM模型和信贷配给理论，从理论和实证两个层面揭示了双利率对房价的传导机制和效应差异。
引入“全国LPR调整幅度”作为工具变量，采用2SLS方法解决内生性问题，提高了估计结果的可靠性。
通过SVAR模型和脉冲响应分析，量化了LPR和传统银行利率对房价的冲击强度和时间滞后差异。
结合上海高杠杆、高需求的市场特点，分析了限购政策和土地供应对利率政策效果的调节作用。
analysis.methodology: 本研究主要采用定量分析方法，结合定性分析和理论支持。具体包括：使用ADF单位根检验判断变量平稳性；Johansen协整检验验证长期均衡关系；Granger因果检验明确因果关系；引入工具变量（全国LPR调整幅度）结合两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）解决内生性；构建VAR模型并扩展为SVAR模型，通过脉冲响应函数和方差分解分析动态影响。数据来源于上海市统计局、中国人民银行等权威机构，并对数据进行预处理（如CPI调整、线性插值填补缺失值等）。
key_results: LPR和传统银行利率对上海房价均有显著负向影响，且具有协同调控效应。
LPR对房价的弹性系数为-3.5，高于传统银行利率的-2.8。
LPR的传导滞后为2-3个季度，传统银行利率为3-4个季度。
限购政策和土地供应能显著削弱利率对房价的影响。
利率是房价波动的单向Granger原因，两者合计贡献了房价波动的38.3%（稳定阶段）。
strengths: 研究选题具有现实意义，聚焦LPR改革后的双利率体系对特大城市房价的影响，填补了研究空白。

方法严谨，采用多种计量方法（如2SLS、SVAR）处理内生性和动态影响，提高了结论的可靠性。
数据来源权威，时间跨度长（2001-2024年），包含政策变量（限购、土地供应），增强了研究的全面性。

limitations: 使用年度数据，样本量较小（24个观测值），可能影响统计检验的效力。

未考虑数字金融、影子银行等新兴因素对利率传导的影响。

title: FEDS Paper: Credit Surfaces and Economic Uncertainty
abstract: John Geanakoplos and David E. Rappoport The Credit Surface along the leverage dimension gives the bond spread as a function of the loan-to-value ratio. Empirically, we show that uncertainty shocks typically increase spreads and steepen the credit surface, profoundly affecting the supply of credit. Theoretically, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the convexity of the credit surface, and for changes in the anticipated distribution of collateral prices that lead to steepening of the credit surface. Finally, we show that the credit surface itself fully reveals the entire distribution of collateral prices, thus providing a new and vivid language with which to describe uncertainty and stochastic orders. Credit surface steepening itself is a new stochastic order that may better capture our intuitive notion of more uncertainty.
tldr: 本文实证和理论分析信贷曲面（信用利差与贷款价值比的关系）如何随不确定性变化，并证明信贷曲面可揭示抵押品价格的分布。
abstract_cn: 约翰·吉纳科普洛斯与大卫·E·拉波波特 杠杆维度上的信用曲面将债券利差表示为贷款价值比的函数。实证上，我们表明不确定性冲击通常会扩大利差并使信用曲面变得更加陡峭，从而深刻影响信贷供给。理论上，我们推导出信用曲面凸性的充分必要条件，以及预期抵押品价格分布变化导致信用曲面陡峭化的条件。最后，我们证明信用曲面本身完全揭示了抵押品价格的整个分布，从而为描述不确定性和随机序提供了一种新的、生动的语言。信用曲面陡峭化本身是一种新的随机序，可能更好地捕捉我们对“更多不确定性”的直观概念。

title: FEDS Paper: Measuring Macroeconomic Stars: A Framework with Scarring Effects
abstract: Manuel Gonzalez-Astudillo , Jean-Philippe Laforte , Antoine Lepetit Potential output and the natural rate of unemployment are commonly estimated through trend-cycle decompositions, where they are identified as underlying trends reflecting slow-moving supply factors. In this paper, we extend this framework to accommodate the possibility that cyclical disturbances affect trends endogenously through "scarring" effects. Two major changes occur relative to standard specifications. First, a significant share of business-cycle fluctuations is absorbed by endogenous movements in the trends rather than shifts in the cycle. Second, the estimated cycle--relieved of explaining the persistence in real variables--tracks inflation developments more closely, including through a steeper Phillips curve. While this steeper slope implies a strong co-movement between inflation and real activity in response to cyclical shocks, such strong co-movement is rarely apparent in the data. Consequently, the estimation shows a shift toward more sizable changes in the purely supply-driven components of the trends, mirrored by smaller innovations in the cycle process. In turn, this rebalancing entails different historical paths for the activity gaps, carrying important implications for the conduct of monetary policy.
tldr: 本文扩展了趋势-周期分解框架，纳入疤痕效应，发现商业周期波动更多由趋势内生变动吸收，导致活动缺口路径改变，对货币政策有重要启示。
abstract_cn: 曼努埃尔·冈萨雷斯-阿斯图迪略、让-菲利普·拉福特与安托万·勒佩蒂特指出，潜在产出（potential output）与自然失业率（natural rate of unemployment）通常通过趋势-周期分解（trend-cycle decompositions）进行估计，其中二者被识别为反映缓慢变动的供给侧因素的潜在趋势。本文将该框架加以扩展，以容纳周期性扰动通过“疤痕效应”（scarring effects）内生地影响趋势的可能性。与标准设定相比，发生了两大变化。第一，商业周期波动中有相当大的一部分被趋势的内生变动所吸收，而非由周期变动所解释。第二，估计得到的周期——不再承担解释实际变量持续性的任务——更紧密地追踪通胀走势，包括通过更陡峭的菲利普斯曲线（Phillips curve）实现这一点。尽管这一更陡峭的斜率意味着周期性冲击下通胀与实际经济活动之间存在强烈的联动关系，但这种强联动在数据中却鲜有显现。因此，估计结果呈现出向趋势中纯供给驱动成分更大幅度变动的转变，同时周期过程中的创新幅度相应缩小。这种再平衡进而导致产出缺口（activity gaps）的历史路径发生改变，对货币政策的实施具有重要含义。

analysis.chinese_title: 衡量宏观经济星号：具有疤痕效应的框架
analysis.summary: 本文扩展了常见的不可观测成分（UC）模型，以容纳周期性扰动通过“疤痕”效应内生影响趋势的可能性。作者基于Lepetit (2026)的新凯恩斯主义模型，将产出和失业分解为纯供给驱动的趋势（星号）和受疤痕影响的成分。使用美国1987-2024年数据，估计了包含价格和工资菲利普斯曲线（含水平和速度项）的UC模型。结果显示，疤痕效应显著，趋势吸收了更多商业周期波动，周期波动性降低，菲利普斯曲线斜率比基准模型陡峭四到五倍。模型将更多波动归因于供给冲击，导致政策相关的产出和失业缺口在历史事件（如2008-2009年金融危机和疫情前）中与基准模型存在显著差异。贝叶斯模型比较和预测评估表明，疤痕模型拟合更好，预测能力更强。
innovations: 将疤痕效应纳入UC模型，允许周期性冲击影响趋势，区别于传统独立趋势假设。
基于新凯恩斯模型推导出包含水平和速度项的菲利普斯曲线，用于识别疤痕程度。
同时估计产出和失业的疤痕效应，并利用价格和工资菲利普斯曲线进行识别。
在UC模型中引入随机波动率和异常值处理，增强稳健性。
通过贝叶斯因子和预测评估，证明疤痕模型优于基准模型。
analysis.methodology: 本文采用贝叶斯估计的不可观测成分（UC）模型。模型包含产出、价格通胀、工资通胀和失业率，并引入随机波动率和异常值处理。使用Gibbs采样器，结合Durbin和Koopman (2002)的模拟平滑器、Kim等(1998)的随机波动率估计和Verdinelli和Wasserman (1991)的异常值方法。通过比较疤痕模型与基准模型（无疤痕）的估计结果，进行模型对比和预测评估。
key_results: 疤痕系数δ^y和δ^u的后验均值分别为0.58和0.47，表明存在显著的疤痕效应。
疤痕模型下，周期过程更不持久，菲利普斯曲线斜率（κ和γ）分别为0.48和-0.67，约为基准模型的4-5倍。
疤痕模型将更多波动归因于供给驱动的趋势，而周期和成本推动冲击的波动性降低。
在2008-2009年，疤痕模型估计的自然失业率升至约7%，而基准模型为5%；在2018-2019年，疤痕模型估计的产出和失业缺口更浅。
贝叶斯因子显示疤痕模型优于基准模型，且疤痕模型的预测能力在真实活动和工资通胀方面更好。
tech_stack: Kim, Shephard和Chib (1998)随机波动率估计
Savage-Dickey密度比计算贝叶斯因子
strengths: 理论框架与实证模型紧密结合，基于新凯恩斯模型推导出可检验的疤痕机制。
同时考虑产出和失业的疤痕效应，并利用价格和工资菲利普斯曲线进行识别，增强了模型的全面性。
模型比较和预测评估提供了有力证据，支持疤痕模型的有效性。
对货币政策具有重要启示，提供了政策相关缺口的替代估计。
limitations: 模型假设参数时不变，可能无法捕捉疤痕程度的结构性变化。
样本期从1987年开始，可能忽略了早期疤痕效应。
模型依赖于菲利普斯曲线的设定，可能受测量误差和模型误设影响。
未考虑其他可能影响趋势的因素，如财政政策或金融冲击。
analysis.relevance_to_keywords: 本文与关键词高度相关。研究聚焦于中央银行政策工具（如利率）和货币政策传导，通过估计潜在产出和自然失业率（宏观经济的“星号”）来指导政策。模型考虑了疤痕效应，即需求冲击对供给侧的持久影响，这与宏观审慎政策和金融稳定相关。此外，研究涉及财政与货币政策协调（通过供给冲击的影响）以及信用周期（通过疤痕机制）。

title: FEDS Paper: How Firms Form Beliefs and the Implications for Inflation
abstract: Robert Minton and Hugo Monnery Using survey data from U.S. firms, we study the primitive beliefs for pricesetting: firms’ forecasts of their own marginal costs. These forecasts are disconnected from CPI expectations, (over)react to current and past costs systematically, and underreact to aggregate shocks until costs move. We show that under empirically realistic cost beliefs the New Keynesian Phillips curve is steeper and less forward-looking. Supply shocks are more inflationary because they hit costs quickly. Demand shocks are less inflationary because firms fail to anticipate future wage pressure. Forward guidance weakens at long horizons but strengthens in the near term.
tldr: 利用美国企业调查数据，研究企业成本预测的形成机制，并分析其对通胀和货币政策传导的影响。
abstract_cn: 罗伯特·明顿与雨果·莫纳里利用美国企业的调查数据，我们研究了价格设定中的原始信念：企业对其自身边际成本的预测。这些预测与CPI预期脱节，对当前及过去的成本变动表现出系统性（过度）反应，并且在成本实际变动之前对总体冲击反应不足。我们表明，在经验上现实的成本信念下，新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线更为陡峭且前瞻性较弱。供给冲击更具通胀性，因为它们迅速作用于成本。需求冲击的通胀效应较弱，因为企业未能预见到未来的工资压力。前瞻指引在长期内效果减弱，但在短期内效果增强。

analysis.chinese_title: 企业如何形成信念及其对通胀的影响
analysis.summary: 本文利用美国企业调查数据，研究企业对其自身边际成本的预测这一价格设定的原始信念。研究发现，企业自身的成本预测与CPI预测脱节，对当前和过去的成本存在系统性过度反应，而对总体冲击反应不足，直到成本变动。作者提出了一个适应性学习模型，该模型嵌套了完全信息理性预期，并允许企业从自身过去的成本中学习。校准结果显示，企业对理性预期预测的权重较小，而更依赖自身成本，且成本持续性被高估。该模型能够解释五个事实，并预测新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线更陡峭、更少前瞻性，供给冲击更具通胀性，需求冲击通胀性较弱，长期前瞻指导效果减弱。
innovations: 首次利用企业调查数据系统研究企业自身成本预测的形成机制，而非仅关注CPI预测。
通过信息处理实验，证明企业CPI预测与自身成本预测存在因果脱节。
提出适应性学习模型，将企业从自身成本中学习的行为纳入新凯恩斯框架，并校准模型参数。
利用企业层面的面板数据，估计企业对宏观冲击的暴露程度，并研究信念反应与成本反应的时间路径。
将模型应用于新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线和货币政策分析，得出与传统模型不同的政策含义。
analysis.methodology: 本文使用亚特兰大联储商业通胀预期调查（BIE）的微观数据，包括企业月度报告的实际和预期成本增长。采用面板回归分析企业成本预测对过去成本的响应，利用信息处理实验检验CPI预测对成本预测的因果影响，并通过局部投影法分析企业对油价冲击的反应。基于这些事实，构建适应性学习模型，并使用模拟矩方法（SMM）或类似方法校准模型参数。
key_results: 事实1：企业CPI预测与自身成本预测脱节，CPI预测变动1个百分点仅引起成本预测变动0.15个百分点。
事实2：企业成本预测对过去成本过度反应，预测误差可由过去成本预测。
事实3：过度反应在不同行业、规模和时期均存在。
事实4：企业成本预测具有惯性，不仅依赖当前成本，还依赖一年前的成本。
事实5：企业对油价冲击反应不足，直到成本变动后才反应。
校准结果显示，企业对理性预期预测的权重较小（约0.15），适应性学习权重较大，成本持续性参数为0.82，后顾性参数为0.64。
模型预测新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线更陡峭、更少前瞻性，供给冲击更具通胀性，需求冲击通胀性较弱，长期前瞻指导效果减弱。

limitations: 调查数据存在测量误差和边界截断问题，可能影响估计结果。
样本主要来自美国东南部，可能不完全代表全国。
模型假设企业信念形成过程是稳定的，但现实中可能随时间变化。
校准方法依赖特定模型设定，可能不唯一。

title: Carbon Crediting When Better Measurement Is Not Enough
abstract: Carbon-crediting methodologies determine how imperfect monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV) evidence is translated into issued credits. When project developers can influence measured outcomes, greater reliance on project-specific data improves targeting but also strengthens incentives to manipulate the signal. We develop a model in which a crediting authority commits to a crediting rule while anticipating the project developer's response. The framework distinguishes statistical accuracy from gaming robustness. The optimal rule generally attenuates the MRV signal: greater accuracy and robustness justify stronger reliance on project-specific evidence, whereas higher credit prices and greater heterogeneity in gaming ability call for a flatter rule. Even when manipulation becomes prohibitively difficult, measurement noise alone implies attenuation. We also characterize how market and project conditions affect the relative value of improving accuracy versus robustness. An illustration using project-level data on cookstove carbon credits shows how independent reassessments can inform the framework and highlights the data requirements for empirical implementation.
tldr: 本文构建模型分析碳信用额度发放规则如何在测量准确性和抗操纵性之间权衡，并利用炉灶碳信用项目数据说明独立评估的作用。
abstract_cn: 碳信用核算方法决定了不完善的监测、报告与核证（MRV）证据如何转化为签发的信用额度。当项目开发者能够影响测量结果时，对项目特定数据的更大依赖虽然有助于提高目标精准度，但也会强化操纵信号的激励。我们构建了一个模型，在该模型中，核算机构在预期项目开发者反应的前提下承诺一种核算规则。该框架区分了统计准确性与博弈稳健性。最优规则通常会对MRV信号进行衰减：更高的准确性和稳健性支持对项目特定证据的更强依赖，而更高的信用价格和更大的操纵能力异质性则要求更平缓的规则。即使操纵变得极其困难，仅测量噪声本身也足以导致衰减。我们还刻画了市场与项目条件如何影响提升准确性相对于提升稳健性的相对价值。一项基于炉灶碳信用项目层面数据的示例表明，独立重新评估如何为该框架提供信息，并凸显了实证实施所需的数据要求。

title: The Economic Impacts of Hurricanes on Fisheries in the United States
abstract: Hurricanes routinely traverse water and land along the Southeastern United States, bringing with them hazardous weather conditions at sea, which presumably hinder fishing operations. Yet, work examining the impact of hurricanes on fisheries has mostly focused on supply chain analyses and post-disaster recovery, without paying attention to the first link in a long chain of events: how hazardous weather affects fisheries production. Here, we quantify the economic toll of hurricanes on commercial fisheries in the Southeastern United States. We construct a novel, high-frequency county-level panel linking daily commercial landings and revenue to hurricane exposure from 2005 to 2022. Our results indicate that county-level wind exposure reduces daily commercial landings and revenue by up to 60 and 70% under major-hurricane-force winds. Monetizing responses indicate cumulative revenue losses of $162.4 million over 2005--2022 due to hurricanes. These findings underscore the persistent vulnerability of coastal fisheries to extreme weather and provide an empirical foundation for targeted disaster preparedness and climate adaptation policy.
tldr: 利用高频县级面板数据，量化飓风对美国商业渔业造成的经济损失，发现飓风显著减少渔获量和收入，累计损失达1.624亿美元。
abstract_cn: 飓风经常穿越美国东南部的水域和陆地，带来海上危险天气条件，这很可能阻碍渔业作业。然而，考察飓风对渔业影响的研究大多集中在供应链分析和灾后恢复上，而没有关注这一长链事件中的第一个环节：危险天气如何影响渔业生产。在此，我们量化了飓风对美国东南部商业渔业造成的经济损失。我们构建了一个新颖的高频县级面板数据，将2005年至2022年每日商业上岸量和收入与飓风暴露情况联系起来。结果表明，在强飓风风力下，县级风力暴露使每日商业上岸量和收入分别减少高达60%和70%。对响应的货币化测算显示，2005年至2022年间，飓风导致的累计收入损失为1.624亿美元。这些发现强调了沿海渔业对极端天气的持续脆弱性，并为有针对性的灾害防备和气候适应政策提供了实证基础。

title: Russia’s Wartime Economy: Measuring Regional Inequalities from Outer Space
abstract: We study Russia's February 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine as a natural experiment to determine how sudden disruptions to international market access reshape sub-national economic inequalities. Using remotely-sensed nighttime lights as a proxy for economic activity, we estimate the economic effects of the war at the national and regional levels. We find that Russia experienced an overall economic slowdown after the start of the full-scale invasion. Regions in Western and North-Western Russia experienced significantly larger economic contractions, while Southern and Southeastern regions exhibit relative improvements in performance. These findings suggest that sanctions, a shift toward non-Western markets, and increased military production, have driven significant regional changes in Russia’s economy and urban structure.
tldr: 利用夜间灯光数据，研究俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后制裁和贸易转移对区域经济不平等的影响，发现西部和西北部地区经济收缩更大，南部和东南部相对改善。
abstract_cn: 我们以俄罗斯2022年2月对乌克兰的全面入侵作为一项自然实验，旨在探究国际市场准入的突然中断如何重塑次国家级经济不平等。利用遥感夜间灯光数据作为经济活动的代理指标，我们在国家和区域层面评估了战争的经济影响。研究发现，全面入侵开始后，俄罗斯整体经济出现放缓。西部和西北部地区的经济收缩幅度显著更大，而南部和东南部地区则表现出相对改善的绩效。这些发现表明，制裁、向非西方市场的转向以及军事生产的增加，已推动俄罗斯经济与城市结构发生显著的区域性变化。

title: Religious Upbringing and Adult Human Development: Longitudinal Evidence from 22 Study Sites
abstract: Does religious upbringing shape adult human development, or do observed differences primarily reflect continued participation later in life? I study this question using three waves of the Global Flourishing Study, covering 202,898 adults across 21 countries and Hong Kong. The data link religious-service attendance around age 12 to detailed measures of childhood conditions, current religious activity, and repeated adult outcomes. Childhood attendance is associated with higher adult flourishing, health, meaning, relationships, character, and selected economic outcomes, although these differences narrow substantially after accounting for family background and parental religiosity. Life-course comparisons sharpen the interpretation. Adults whose frequent participation ended after childhood display no broad advantage, while adults who currently participate frequently have similar profiles whether or not they attended frequently as children. Continued participation from childhood is associated with a modest additional advantage in aggregate nonfinancial flourishing, health, relationships, and some economic outcomes. These activation contrasts retain the same sign across contemporaneous, prospective, and within-person specifications, but they are small relative to the broader gap associated with current participation and cannot be separated from selection into persistence or correlated recall of childhood attendance. Individual fixed-effects estimates further show that income and flourishing move together within person, but childhood religious formation does not systematically moderate this relationship. Thus, religion functions as a continuing life-course institution rather than an independently identified childhood treatment.
tldr: 利用全球繁荣研究数据，发现童年宗教参与与成人发展正相关，但主要由持续参与和家庭背景解释，宗教作为终身制度而非独立童年治疗。
abstract_cn: 宗教教养是否塑造了成年后的人类发展，还是观察到的差异主要反映了个体在生命后期持续参与宗教活动的影响？我利用“全球繁荣研究”的三轮数据来研究这一问题，该数据覆盖了21个国家及中国香港地区的202,898名成年人。这些数据将约12岁时的宗教礼拜出席情况与童年条件的详细测量、当前的宗教活动以及重复测量的成年结果联系起来。童年时期的宗教出席与更高的成年繁荣度、健康水平、意义感、人际关系、品格以及部分经济结果相关联，尽管在控制家庭背景和父母宗教信仰后，这些差异显著缩小。生命历程比较使解释更加清晰。那些童年结束后便不再频繁参与的成年人并未展现出广泛的优势，而当前频繁参与的成年人，无论童年时期是否频繁出席，其表现特征相似。从童年持续参与宗教活动与总体非金融繁荣、健康、人际关系及部分经济结果上的适度额外优势相关。这些“激活对比”在同期、前瞻性及个体内分析中均保持相同的方向，但相对于当前参与所对应的更广泛差距而言，其效应较小，且无法与坚持参与的自我选择性或对童年出席情况的回忆偏差相分离。个体固定效应估计进一步表明，收入与繁荣在个体内部同步变动，但童年宗教形成并未系统性地调节这一关系。因此，宗教作为一种持续的生命历程制度发挥作用，而非一个可独立识别的童年期处理因素。

title: The Tragedy of the Cognitive Commons: How AI Could Disrupt the Regeneration of Professional Expertise
abstract: Artificial intelligence is reshaping cognitive work, but Human Resource Development scholarship has treated this transformation as an organizational training challenge, leaving the collective regeneration of professional expertise unexamined. This conceptual paper introduces the Cognitive Commons framework, integrating commons theory, HRD scholarship, and distributed cognition to explain how rational AI adoption decisions can deplete the shared expertise pool professions require for renewal. The framework distinguishes Internalized Mastery (deep domain knowledge from sustained practice) from Distributed Mastery (orchestrating human-AI systems), and develops the Validation Tether: effective AI oversight depends on the expertise AI adoption may undermine. Early labor market and clinical evidence suggests possible disruption to expertise-regeneration pathways in highly AI-exposed sectors, though adoption is recent and the strongest signals come from leading sectors rather than all professions. Five factors determine occupational vulnerability, and governance arrangements may form across organizational, professional-association, and policy levels. The paper reframes expertise development as collective stewardship rather than organizational optimization, with implications for HRD theory and workforce policy.
tldr: 本文提出认知公地框架，探讨AI采用如何消耗专业专长的集体再生，并区分内化掌握与分布式掌握，提出验证锚概念，为人力资源开发提供新视角。
abstract_cn: 人工智能正在重塑认知工作，但人力资源开发学术研究将这一转型视为组织培训挑战，未对专业专长的集体再生产加以审视。本文提出“认知公域”框架，整合公域理论、人力资源开发学术与分布式认知，以解释理性的人工智能采纳决策如何耗竭职业更新所需的共享专长储备。该框架区分了“内化精通”（通过持续实践获得的深层领域知识）与“分布式精通”（协调人机系统），并发展出“验证锚链”概念：有效的人工智能监督依赖于人工智能采纳可能削弱的那种专长。早期劳动力市场与临床证据表明，在高人工智能暴露行业中，专长再生产路径可能受到干扰，尽管采纳尚属近期现象，且最强信号来自领先行业而非所有职业。五个因素决定职业脆弱性，治理安排可能在组织、专业协会和政策层面形成。本文将专长发展重新界定为集体管理而非组织优化，对人力资源开发理论与劳动力政策具有启示意义。

title: Artificial Intelligence: Supply-Chain Chokepoints and the Reach of Industrial Policy
abstract: Artificial intelligence depends on a stack of inputs, models on compute, compute on chips, and chips on electricity and refined minerals. This paper measures the concentration of each layer on one scale, the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI), from cited and reproducible data. Three findings follow. First, concentration forms a clear gradient. It is modest downstream, where public and regulatory attention is heaviest and model usage and cloud fall below the 1{,}800 mark United States agencies treat as highly concentrated. It rises steeply upstream, where public discourse is sparse. There advanced packaging scores 8{,}100, leading-edge lithography reaches the ceiling of 10{,}000, and one country dominates the production or refining of several critical minerals, gallium near that maximum. Second, these upstream layers are chokepoints and a strategic vulnerability for the whole AI economy. Antitrust cannot reach them, because they lie in foreign or state hands. Contesting them falls to export controls and domestic industrial policy. Third, placing reserves beside refining shows the concentration is built rather than geological, a variable industrial policy can move. A rise in an upstream input's price barely changes the cost of the product built from it, because the input is only a small share of that cost. A chokepoint's threat is therefore the loss of the input itself rather than a higher price.
tldr: 该论文衡量AI供应链各环节的集中度，发现上游关键投入品高度集中，构成战略脆弱点，并讨论出口管制和产业政策的作用。
abstract_cn: 人工智能依赖于一整套投入要素的堆叠：模型依赖算力，算力依赖芯片，芯片依赖电力和精炼矿物。本文基于可引用且可复现的数据，以赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI）为尺度，衡量每一层的集中度。研究发现有三点。第一，集中度呈现出清晰的梯度。在下游，集中度较为温和，公共与监管关注最为密集，模型使用和云服务的集中度低于美国监管机构视为“高度集中”的1，800分界线。在上游，集中度急剧上升，而公共讨论却寥寥无几。其中，先进封装得分8，100，领先光刻技术达到10，000的上限，且一个国家主导了若干关键矿物的生产或精炼，镓的集中度接近该上限。第二，这些上游环节是瓶颈，也是整个人工智能经济的战略脆弱点。反垄断法无法触及这些环节，因为它们掌握在外国或国家手中。应对这些瓶颈，只能依靠出口管制和国内产业政策。第三，将储备与精炼并列考察可以看出，这种集中是人为构建的，而非地质条件决定的，是产业政策可以改变的变量。上游投入品价格上涨几乎不会改变由其制成的最终产品的成本，因为该投入品仅占成本的一小部分。因此，瓶颈的威胁在于投入品本身的丧失，而非其价格上涨。

title: Unintended Consequences of Sanitation Investment: Negative Externalities on Water Quality and Health in India
abstract: Developing countries have increased sanitation investment to improve child health. However, scaling up latrine construction can cause water pollution externalities owing to insufficient infrastructure for the treatment of fecal sludge, offsetting the direct health benefits. I estimate the negative externalities of an Indian sanitation policy that subsidized the construction of over 100 million latrines. Exploiting geographical variations in soil characteristics that affect the feasibility of latrine construction, I find that this policy increases fecal contamination of rivers by 72%. Although the policy reduces diarrheal child mortality overall, this positive health effect is eliminated when upstream areas lack adequate wastewater infrastructure.
tldr: 利用印度厕所建设补贴政策的地理变异，估计卫生设施投资导致的水污染负外部性，并发现其抵消了部分健康收益。
abstract_cn: 发展中国家已增加卫生设施投资以改善儿童健康。然而，由于缺乏足够的大便污泥处理基础设施，大规模建设厕所可能引发水污染外部性，从而抵消直接的健康效益。我评估了一项印度卫生政策的外部性，该政策补贴建设了超过1亿个厕所。利用影响厕所建设可行性的土壤特征地理差异，我发现该政策使河流粪便污染增加了72%。尽管该政策总体上降低了儿童腹泻死亡率，但当上游地区缺乏足够的废水处理基础设施时，这一积极健康效应被完全抵消。

title: The Collapse of Human Capital Ladders in Recessions
abstract: Using administrative data, we document that workers acquire more human capital at more productive firms. Recessions distort workers-firm sorting, flatten the job ladder and impact human capital accumulation, as workers match on average to worse firms. To quantify the aggregate relevance of these effects, we build a directed search model with aggregate risk and worker-firm heterogeneity, in which human capital accumulation depends on firm quality. We estimate the model and show that recessions have persistent negative effects on the productivity of worker-firm matches, with distortions in sorting and human capital accumulation accounting for approximately 35% of cumulative output losses.
tldr: 利用行政数据，本文发现衰退扭曲了工人与企业的匹配，导致人力资本积累受损，并量化了其对产出损失的贡献。
abstract_cn: 利用行政数据，我们记录了工人在生产率更高的企业中会积累更多的人力资本。经济衰退扭曲了工人与企业的匹配，使职业阶梯变得平坦，并影响人力资本积累，因为工人平均而言会匹配到较差的企业。为了量化这些效应的总体重要性，我们构建了一个带有总体风险和工人-企业异质性的定向搜索模型，在该模型中，人力资本积累取决于企业质量。我们估计了该模型，并表明衰退对工人-企业匹配的生产率具有持续的负面影响，其中匹配扭曲和人力资本积累的失调约占累计产出损失的35%。

title: University as a Melting Pot: Long-term Effects of Internationalization
abstract: This paper provides the first evidence on the impact of exposure to international students on the long-term outcomes of native students. I combine unique survey and administrative data from the Netherlands covering one million students across three decades and employ an across-cohort design. I find that exposure to international students leads natives to (i) form social ties with non-natives, (ii) hold more positive attitudes towards migration and learning about other cultures, and (iii) seek opportunities abroad. Notably, I find precisely estimated zero effects on employment, income, entrepreneurship, and the share of international co-workers up to 25 years after university entry.
tldr: 利用荷兰跨队列数据，研究发现接触国际学生促使本土学生形成跨国社会联系、更积极态度和海外机会寻求，但对就业、收入等经济结果无显著影响。
abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于接触国际学生对本土学生长期影响的首个证据。我结合了荷兰的独特调查和行政数据，涵盖了过去三十年间的一百万名学生，并采用了跨队列设计。研究发现，接触国际学生使本土学生（一）与非本土学生建立社会联系，（二）对移民和学习其他文化持更积极的态度，以及（三）寻求海外机会。值得注意的是，我发现在大学入学后长达25年的时间里，接触国际学生对就业、收入、创业以及国际同事比例的影响精确估计为零。

title: Geography in Online Capital Allocation: Evidence from Equity-Based Crowdfunding
abstract: Digital investment platforms reduce search costs, yet realized investments can remain geographically concentrated. Such concentration alone cannot distinguish whether local investment reflects initial salience, proximity-related information, prior ties, or nonpecuniary motives such as support for firms in one's home prefecture. We use user-campaign records from Fundinno, Japan's dominant equity-based crowdfunding platform, which link listing exposure, campaign-page views, and investments to user residence and issuer location. For campaigns outside the Tokyo metropolitan area (non-TMA), same-prefecture users are 6.7 percentage points more likely to invest after viewing a campaign page, relative to an other-prefecture investment rate of roughly 10 percent. The corresponding adjacent-prefecture difference is only 0.9 percentage points, and the same-prefecture premium is small for campaigns inside the Tokyo metropolitan area. The premium therefore remains after observed campaign-page access, is much larger than the adjacent-prefecture difference, and is concentrated outside the metropolitan core. These findings show that online access does not make investment demand geographically neutral: for regional issuers, same-prefecture investors remain disproportionately important even after campaign-page access. The data do not identify the underlying motive, but the pattern is difficult to explain by discovery alone or by smooth proximity.
tldr: 利用日本股权众筹平台数据，研究发现即使在线访问后，同县投资者对区域发行人的投资仍显著偏高，表明在线资本配置并非地理中性。
abstract_cn: 数字投资平台降低了搜索成本，然而实际完成的投资在地理上仍可能保持集中。这种集中本身无法区分本地投资究竟源于初始显著性、邻近性相关信息、既有联系，还是非金钱动机（例如对所在都道府县企业的支持）。我们使用了日本领先的股权型众筹平台Fundinno的用户-项目记录，该平台将项目展示、项目页面浏览及投资行为与用户居住地和发行人所在地关联起来。对于东京都市圈以外的项目，同一都道府县的用户在浏览项目页面后投资的可能性高出6.7个百分点，而其他都道府县的投资率约为10%。相应的相邻都道府县差异仅为0.9个百分点，且对于东京都市圈内的项目，同都道府县溢价较小。因此，这一溢价在观察到项目页面访问之后依然存在，远大于相邻都道府县差异，并且集中于都市核心区之外。这些发现表明，线上访问并未使投资需求在地理上趋于中性：对于区域发行人而言，即使在项目页面访问之后，同一都道府县投资者仍然具有不成比例的重要性。数据无法识别背后的动机，但这一模式难以仅用发现机制或平滑的邻近性来解释。

title: Arbitrage and rents in European long-term transmission rights
abstract: Long-term transmission rights (LTTRs) are designed to support hedging in interconnected European electricity markets. LTTR auction prices have historically fallen short of forward market prices, signaling limited arbitrage. This paper studies the interaction of transmission rights and forward markets. Option pricing theory predicts that LTTR holders take short forward positions in importing markets and long forward positions in exporting markets to lock in arbitrage profits. Empirically, I find a corresponding price effect in the German electricity forward market immediately after LTTR auctions, using panel regression on EEX futures contracts traded between 2018 and 2025. This shows that LTTR holders can achieve systematic rents, indicating an inefficient regulatory intervention and a transfer from consumers to LTTR holders.
tldr: 该论文利用2018-2025年德国EEX期货数据，通过面板回归发现长期输电权拍卖后远期市场价格出现系统性变化，表明持有者能获得租金，监管干预低效。
abstract_cn: 长期输电权（LTTRs）旨在支持欧洲互联电力市场中的套期保值。LTTR拍卖价格历来低于远期市场价格，表明套利空间有限。本文研究输电权与远期市场之间的相互作用。期权定价理论预测，LTTR持有者会在进口市场持有远期空头头寸，在出口市场持有远期多头头寸，以锁定套利利润。在实证方面，我利用2018年至2025年间交易的EEX期货合约进行面板回归，发现在LTTR拍卖后，德国电力远期市场立即出现相应的价格效应。这表明LTTR持有者能够获取系统性租金，反映出监管干预的低效以及消费者向LTTR持有者的财富转移。

title: What's in a Queue? An Experimental Study of Job Ordering, Autonomy and Queue Visibility
abstract: Problem Definition: How a queue of jobs is arranged and presented to workers is an important design problem in service operations. This includes choosing the order in which jobs are performed, how much say workers have in setting that order, and how much queue and arrival information workers receive. Methodology/Results: To better understand how queue design (job ordering, autonomy, visibility) affects worker performance (speed, quality), we run a series of pre-registered online experiments. We use a new, real-effort task in which workers fulfill order-picking jobs of varying complexity that arrive dynamically over time. Our results are as follows: (1) When workers choose their own picking order, we reproduce the field finding that Easy First (EF) ordering is associated with worse performance than First-in-first-out (FIFO), and show that this is mainly due to worker self-selection rather than due to the ordering itself; (2) Exogenously imposed EF ordering improves work quality (picking accuracy) relative to both FIFO and discretionary ordering; (3) Imposing an ordering may reduce speed for the most capable workers; (4) Seeing a new job arrival leads to a short-term productivity burst; however, removing job arrival and queue information altogether does not affect performance in the long term. Managerial implications: Our results provide guidance on which queue design works best for a given performance goal (speed or quality) and worker ability level. We also identify personality measures that can help managers screen for error-prone workers.
tldr: 通过在线实验研究队列设计（排序、自主性、可见性）对工人速度和准确性的影响，发现外生排序提高质量但可能降低速度，且工人自选择导致易先排序表现差。
abstract_cn: 问题定义：在服务运营中，如何安排和呈现工作队列是一项重要的设计问题。这包括选择执行工作的顺序、工人在设定该顺序时拥有多少自主权，以及工人接收到的队列和到达信息量。方法论/结果：为了更好地理解队列设计（工作排序、自主性、可见性）如何影响工人绩效（速度、质量），我们进行了一系列预注册的在线实验。我们采用了一项新的、真实努力任务，其中工人需要完成随时间动态到达的、复杂度各异的拣选工作。我们的结果如下：（1）当工人自行选择拣选顺序时，我们重现了现场发现，即“先易后难”（EF）排序与“先入先出”（FIFO）相比绩效更差，并表明这主要归因于工人的自我选择，而非排序本身；（2）外生施加的EF排序相对于FIFO和自主排序均能提高工作质量（拣选准确率）；（3）施加排序可能会降低能力最强工人的速度；（4）看到新工作到达会带来短期的生产率提升；然而，完全移除工作到达和队列信息在长期内并不影响绩效。管理启示：我们的结果为在给定绩效目标（速度或质量）和工人能力水平下选择最优队列设计提供了指导。我们还识别了有助于管理者筛选易出错工人的人格测量指标。

title: Optimizing Monetization Strategies for Generative AI Firms: Implications for Search Engagement
abstract: As Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) platforms, such as ChatGPT, have transformed digital search querying behavior, mounting operational costs challenge firms to explore alternative monetization strategies beyond traditional subscription models. However, little is known about how alternative advertising-supported monetization models can help GenAI firms recover costs while maintaining search query engagement. Drawing on the compromise effect and affective primacy theories, we develop a framework wherein the introduction of advertising-supported monetization models influences user upgrading and downgrading decisions, contingent on the number of available monetization options. Across four experiments (N=1063), findings reveal that introducing a single advertising-supported option enhances the compromise effect, encouraging free users to upgrade, but leading paid subscribers to downgrade. However, offering two advertising-supported models mitigates the effect, maintaining subscriber retention while still motivating free users to upgrade. We show that affective and cognitive evaluations serially mediate preference for advertising-supported models, with temporal intrusiveness, but not visual, moderating these effects. We provide actionable insights for GenAI firms on potentially optimizing revenue strategies while balancing user engagement with search queries on their platform.
tldr: 通过四项实验，研究生成式AI平台引入广告支持型变现模式对用户升级和降级决策的影响，发现单一广告选项增强折中效应，而双广告选项可维持订阅者留存。
abstract_cn: 随着生成式人工智能（GenAI）平台（如ChatGPT）改变了数字搜索查询行为，日益攀升的运营成本促使企业探索传统订阅模式之外的替代性变现策略。然而，关于广告支持的替代性变现模式如何帮助GenAI企业回收成本，同时保持搜索查询参与度，目前知之甚少。基于折中效应和情感优先理论，我们构建了一个框架，其中广告支持型变现模式的引入会影响用户的升级与降级决策，且该影响取决于可用变现选项的数量。通过四项实验（N=1063），研究结果表明，引入单一的广告支持选项会增强折中效应，促使免费用户升级，但导致付费订阅用户降级。然而，提供两种广告支持模式则会削弱这一效应，既能维持订阅用户的留存，同时仍能激励免费用户升级。我们进一步证明，情感评价与认知评价在广告支持模式偏好中起序列中介作用，其中时间侵入性（而非视觉侵入性）调节了这些效应。我们为GenAI企业在优化收入策略的同时平衡用户搜索查询参与度提供了可操作的见解。

title: Robust Instrumental Variables: Sharp Rates and Inference under Adversarial Contamination
abstract: Because 2SLS is built from sample averages, a small number of observations can have a disproportionate effect on estimates and inference. We introduce W-2SLS, a simple drop-in robustification that replaces these averages by quantile-winsorized means. We analyze W-2SLS under adversarial contamination, which permits both the identities and the reported values of the contaminated observations to depend on the realized clean sample and therefore accommodates targeted or strategic manipulation. Under finite $m$-th moments, W-2SLS attains the minimax-sharp rate $η_{n}^{1-\frac1m}+n^{-1/2}$, where $η_n$ is the fraction of observations that may be altered. Matching lower bounds identify the exact contamination thresholds for uniform consistency, root-$n$ estimation, and centered Gaussian inference with the same first-order law as clean-sample 2SLS. When $\sqrt{n}η_{n}^{1-\frac1m}\to 0$ robustness is first-order free. We also construct feasible heteroskedasticity-robust inference and a winsorized Anderson--Rubin test valid under weak identification and adversarial contamination. Finally, even without contamination, ordinary 2SLS can have poor uniform finite-sample concentration, whereas W-2SLS admits confidence-calibrated sub-Gaussian deviation guarantees.
tldr: 提出W-2SLS方法，在对抗性污染下实现工具变量估计的稳健推断，并达到极小极大最优速率。
abstract_cn: 由于2SLS建立在样本均值之上，少数观测值可能对估计与推断产生不成比例的影响。我们提出W-2SLS，一种简便的即插即用稳健化方法，用分位数缩尾均值替代这些样本均值。我们在对抗性污染框架下分析W-2SLS，该框架允许受污染观测的身份及其报告值依赖于已实现的干净样本，从而能够涵盖针对性或策略性操纵。在有限$m$阶矩条件下，W-2SLS达到极小极大最优速率$\eta_{n}^{1-\frac1m}+n^{-1/2}$，其中$\eta_n$为可能被篡改的观测比例。匹配的下界确定了均匀一致性、根号$n$估计以及具有与干净样本2SLS相同一阶极限分布的中心化高斯推断的精确污染阈值。当$\sqrt{n}\eta_{n}^{1-\frac1m}\to 0$时，稳健性在一阶意义上无需额外代价。我们还构造了可行的异方差稳健推断，以及一个在弱识别和对抗性污染下有效的缩尾Anderson–Rubin检验。最后，即使在没有污染的情况下，普通2SLS也可能在均匀有限样本集中性方面表现不佳，而W-2SLS则提供了置信校准的次高斯偏差保证。

title: TerraNova: A Foundation Model for the Anthropocene
abstract: A defining problem of the Anthropocene is to model the physical Earth and human societies as one coupled system, yet no learned representation spans their observational breadth. We argue the obstacle is geometric: the physical Earth is measured as continuous fields that ignore political borders, whereas societies are reported for administrative units. Earth-system foundation models serve the first geometry; coupling it to the second has required lossy averaging over borders. We introduce TerraNova, a foundation model trained on 1,024 physical and societal records in their native geometries: 512 gridded Earth-system fields and 512 national indicators. Dedicated encoders represent location, country, time and task, cross-modal transformers fuse them into a shared spatiotemporal state, and a hypernetwork generates a per-query decoder whose evidential head returns a predictive distribution. Two contrastive objectives couple the representation: a population-weighted alignment between each country and coordinates in its territory, and one to pretrained geospatial embeddings carrying image-derived semantics. Read out through that decoder, the representation is competitive with purpose-built geospatial encoders while spanning axes they do not represent (time, oceans and uncertainty) and supporting country-level capabilities. The frozen backbone reconstructs dense fields from sparse observations and adapts to unseen variables in minutes on consumer hardware.
tldr: 提出TerraNova基础模型，通过跨模态变换器融合地球物理和社会经济数据，以统一建模人类世耦合系统。
abstract_cn: 人类世的一个核心问题是将物理地球与人类社会建模为一个耦合系统，然而目前尚无任何学习表示能够覆盖这两者的观测范围。我们认为其障碍在于几何形态：物理地球以连续场的形式被观测，且不受政治边界限制，而社会数据则按行政单元进行报告。地球系统基础模型适用于第一种几何形态；而将其与第二种几何形态耦合，通常需要对边界进行有损平均处理。我们提出了TerraNova，一个在1,024个物理与社会记录上训练的基础模型，这些记录保持其原生几何形态：512个网格化地球系统场和512个国家指标。专用编码器分别表示位置、国家、时间和任务，跨模态变换器将它们融合为一个共享的时空状态，超网络生成逐查询解码器，其证据头返回预测分布。两个对比学习目标用于耦合表示：一是国家与其领土内坐标之间的人口加权对齐，二是与预训练的地理空间嵌入（携带图像派生语义）的对齐。通过该解码器进行读取，该表示在与专用地理空间编码器竞争的同时，还覆盖了后者未表示的维度（时间、海洋和不确定性），并支持国家层面的能力。冻结的主干网络可从稀疏观测中重建密集场，并在消费级硬件上于数分钟内适应未见变量。

title: Conditional projection methods for large-scale Bayesian VARs
abstract: We develop fast methods for conditional forecasting and structural scenario analysis with high-dimensional Bayesian vector autoregressions (VARs). Our general framework features a factor structure on the reduced-form errors, which enables fast and order-invariant equation-by-equation estimation; suitably identified factors admit a structural interpretation. The scenarios are defined through separate distributional restrictions on observables, structural shocks and idiosyncratic components. The computational cost of our proposed algorithm is cubic only in the number of restrictions, while the dimension of the forecasted system enters linearly. In our application with $33$ macroeconomic and financial variables and ten set-identified structural shocks for the US, we compute counterfactual predictions for oil price scenarios in the context of the 2026 closure of the Strait of Hormuz. The same oil price path is consistent with outcomes ranging from a mostly benign episode to pronounced stagflation, depending on which structural and idiosyncratic shocks are allowed to deliver it.
tldr: 提出一种用于高维贝叶斯VAR的条件预测和结构情景分析的高效算法，并以石油价格情景为例进行应用。
abstract_cn: 我们开发了针对高维贝叶斯向量自回归（VAR）模型的条件预测与结构性情景分析的快速方法。我们的通用框架在简化型误差上引入了因子结构，从而实现了快速且与方程顺序无关的逐方程估计；适当识别的因子具有结构性解释。情景通过分别对可观测变量、结构性冲击和特质成分施加分布性约束来定义。我们提出的算法计算成本仅随约束数量呈三次方增长，而预测系统的维度则线性进入计算复杂度。在我们的应用中，使用33个宏观经济与金融变量以及十个针对美国设定的结构性冲击，我们计算了2026年霍尔木兹海峡关闭背景下油价情景的反事实预测。相同的油价路径可以对应从基本温和的事件到显著滞胀的不同结果，具体取决于允许哪些结构性和特质冲击来实现该路径。

title: Distance Profile Embedding for Independence and Conditional Independence Testing of Random Objects
abstract: Testing independence or conditional independence is fundamental to statistical inference, yet existing methods for non-Euclidean random objects often face a difficult trade-off between geometric flexibility and theoretical tractability. We introduce the Distance Profile Embedding (DPE), a novel representation that maps random objects from general metric spaces into a Hilbert space of square-integrable functions. We prove that this mapping is injective and preserves full distributional information without requiring isometric Hilbert embeddings or one-to-one correspondence conditions. Leveraging the DPE, we develop a unified framework for marginal and conditional independence testing of random objects that enjoys a rigorous asymptotic theory for both size and power. Notably, our framework is the first in the literature to accommodate object-valued conditioning variables when testing conditional independence, overcoming the Euclidean or Hilbertian constraints of existing methodologies. We facilitate the calculation of analytic $p$-values using closed-form asymptotic null distributions, which avoids the computational burden of permutation tests common in existing metric-based methods. The numerical properties of our methods are demonstrated through both simulations and two real-world applications involving gut microbiome compositions and global human mortality distributions, respectively.
tldr: 提出距离轮廓嵌入方法，用于一般度量空间随机对象的独立性和条件独立性检验，具有严格的渐近理论，并应用于微生物组和死亡率数据。
abstract_cn: 检验独立性或条件独立性是统计推断的基础，然而现有的针对非欧几里得随机对象的方法往往在几何灵活性与理论可处理性之间面临艰难权衡。我们引入了距离剖面嵌入（Distance Profile Embedding, DPE），这是一种新颖的表示方法，可将一般度量空间中的随机对象映射到平方可积函数的希尔伯特空间。我们证明了该映射是单射的，并且在不要求等距希尔伯特嵌入或一一对应条件的情况下保留了完整的分布信息。借助DPE，我们开发了一个统一的框架，用于随机对象的边际独立性与条件独立性检验，该框架在检验水平和功效两方面均具有严谨的渐近理论。值得注意的是，我们的框架是文献中首个在检验条件独立性时能够容纳对象值条件变量的方法，克服了现有方法对欧几里得或希尔伯特结构的限制。我们利用闭式渐近零分布简化了解析$p$值的计算，从而避免了现有基于度量方法中常见的置换检验所带来的计算负担。我们通过模拟实验以及两个实际应用（分别涉及肠道微生物组组成和全球人类死亡率分布）展示了所提方法的数值性质。
