title: On the Sparsity of Optimal Information Structures
abstract: This paper uncovers general properties of optimal information structures by exploiting a linear-programming formulation of information design. A critical observation is that an optimum can be found as ``sparse,'' i.e., many coordinates of the action-state joint distribution are zero. This implies that, once part of an action-state profile is fixed, there is limited room for the remaining part to fluctuate. As a result, agents' action recommendations are conditionally deterministic in many states, or correlated in a way that allows some agents to infer others' recommendations. The implications of sparsity are illustrated in an adoption problem, where the designer maximizes the number of adopters of an innovation that features network effects. The optimal information structure deterministically recommends full adoption in high states, while it randomizes over nested action profiles in low states, so that whenever an agent is recommended to adopt, she is certain that more optimistic agents also adopt.
tldr: 本文通过线性规划方法证明最优信息结构具有稀疏性，并应用于网络效应下的创新采纳问题，展示了最优信息结构在高低状态下的确定性推荐与随机化特征。
abstract_cn: 本文通过利用信息设计的线性规划形式，揭示了最优信息结构的一般性质。一个关键的观察是，最优解可以呈现“稀疏”特征，即行动-状态联合分布的许多坐标为零。这意味着，一旦行动-状态轮廓的一部分被固定，剩余部分的波动空间便十分有限。因此，在许多状态下，主体的行动建议是条件确定性的，或者以某种方式相关联，使得部分主体能够推断出其他主体的建议。稀疏性的含义在一个采纳问题中得到了说明，在该问题中，设计者最大化采纳一种具有网络效应的创新的主体数量。最优信息结构在高状态下确定性地建议完全采纳，而在低状态下则对嵌套的行动轮廓进行随机化，因此，每当一个主体被建议采纳时，她确信更乐观的主体也会采纳。

title: Exact Budget Balance via Payment-Rule Ambiguity: Incentive Preservation, Transfer Capacity, and Participation
abstract: This paper asks whether the payment side of an incentive-compatible mechanism can be repaired so that every realized settlement balances exactly while the allocation and all report-by-report comparisons under the maintained worst-case evaluation remain unchanged. Before reports, the designer commits to a menu of payment rules and a report-blind selection protocol. A pointwise preservation condition then carries over dominant-strategy incentives. Under a full-support common reference, a precisely known label law permits repair only if the original rule already balances, whereas frequency uncertainty about even one non-worst label makes every non-deficit rule repairable. Under the common residual-ambiguity benchmark, every preserving, exactly balanced finite menu at a positive-surplus state requires more transfer capacity as certified frequency information becomes tighter. In the canonical menu, fixing the transfer cap makes the best attainable balance deteriorate toward the original surplus as ambiguity vanishes. When only the possible labels are certified, two labels suffice. Suitably balanced partitions can also retain the original cap for nonnegative payments and preserve individual rationality under every realized rule. This last guarantee is impossible in positive-revenue Vickrey states when each agent's preserving distribution has full support. Frequency information therefore changes feasibility, liquidity, and realized participation in distinct ways.
tldr: 论文研究在保持激励相容的前提下，通过支付规则的不确定性实现精确预算平衡，并分析转移能力与参与约束，属于机制设计理论。
abstract_cn: 本文探讨的是，激励相容机制中的支付端是否可以被修复，从而在保持分配以及在最坏情况评估下所有逐报告比较结果不变的同时，使每一个已实现的结算恰好平衡。在报告之前，设计者承诺采用一组支付规则和一个与报告无关的选择协议。此时，一个逐点保持条件即可延续占优策略激励。在全支持共同参照下，若原始规则本身已平衡，则一项精确已知的标签法则才允许修复；而即使仅有一个非最坏标签存在频率不确定性，也会使所有非赤字规则均可修复。在共同剩余模糊性基准下，在正盈余状态下，任何保持性的、恰好平衡的有限菜单，随着认证频率信息变得更加精确，都需要更大的转移容量。在典型菜单中，固定转移上限会使可实现的最佳平衡在模糊性消失时向原始盈余恶化。当仅认证可能的标签时，两个标签即已足够。适当平衡的划分还可以在非负支付下保留原始上限，并在每个已实现规则下维持个体理性。当每个代理的保持分布具有全支持时，这一最终保证在正收入维克里状态下是不可能实现的。因此，频率信息以不同方式改变了可行性、流动性和已实现的参与情况。

title: Pure-Strategy Equilibrium in the Generalized First-Price Auction
abstract: We revisit the classic result on the (non-)existence of pure-strategy Nash equilibria in the Generalized First-Price Auction for sponsored search advertising and show that the conclusion may be reversed when ads are ranked based on the product of stochastic quality scores and bid amounts, rather than solely on the bids or on the product of bids and deterministic quality scores. Moreover, the expected revenue in the pure strategy equilibrium of the Generalized First-Price Auction may substantially exceed that of the Generalized Second-Price Auction, although under some conditions the relation may also be reversed.
tldr: 该论文重新审视了广义第一价格拍卖中纯策略纳什均衡的存在性，并发现当广告排名基于随机质量分数与出价的乘积时，均衡可能存在且收入可能高于广义第二价格拍卖。
abstract_cn: 我们重新审视了赞助搜索广告中广义第一价格拍卖纯策略纳什均衡存在性（或不存在性）的经典结论，并表明当广告排名基于随机质量评分与出价金额的乘积，而非仅基于出价或出价与确定性质量评分的乘积时，该结论可能发生逆转。此外，在纯策略均衡下，广义第一价格拍卖的预期收入可能显著高于广义第二价格拍卖，尽管在某些条件下，这一关系也可能发生逆转。

title: Hawkes-Driven OTC Market Making: Volterra-Riccati Approximation
abstract: We formulate an over-the-counter (OTC) market-making problem in which request-for-quote (RFQ) arrivals are modelled by general Hawkes kernels and fills are controlled thinnings of the exogenous request flow. The modelling choice is motivated by spot-FX RFQ data: after filtering and transforming to seasonality-adjusted RFQ activity time, two-way activity in major currency pairs exhibits large fitted branching ratios and multi-scale persistence. For general Hawkes kernels the control problem is path-dependent: the relevant state contains the order-flow history, or equivalently the forward curve of conditional future RFQ intensities. Exact Markovian lifting is available for exponential kernels, but it becomes high-dimensional for mixtures of exponentials and impractical for long-memory kernels. We therefore develop a hierarchy of Volterra-Riccati approximations. The first level replaces random future request flow by its conditional Volterra forecast; the second adds a covariance correction for intensity uncertainty; the third updates the quote rule with the realized Hawkes memory, or equivalently with the post-request conditional forecast curve. The approximation hierarchy is validated in an exponential Hawkes benchmark, where the exact lifted HJB can be solved numerically. The state-feedback Volterra-Riccati policy closely tracks the exact benchmark, especially in directional regimes, while a memory-free Poisson policy suffers substantial regret. We then apply the same state-feedback rule to a power-law-like RFQ memory model. A directional RFQ burst changes the conditional forecast of future flow and is converted by the continuation-value shadow price into a persistent quote skew. The resulting endogenous OTC quote impact inherits the long-memory decay of the RFQ forecast response and improves inventory and P&L risk control relative to a no-conditioning Poisson benchmark.
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Hawkes过程的OTC做市模型，通过Volterra-Riccati近似求解最优报价策略，并验证其在指数核和幂律核下的有效性。
abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个场外交易（OTC）做市问题，其中询价（RFQ）到达过程由一般Hawkes核建模，成交则是对外生请求流的受控细化。这一建模选择受到即期外汇RFQ数据的启发：在过滤并转换为经季节性调整的RFQ活动时间后，主要货币对的双向活动表现出较大的拟合分支比和多尺度持续性。对于一般Hawkes核，控制问题具有路径依赖性：相关状态包含订单流历史，或等价地，条件未来RFQ强度的远期曲线。对于指数核，精确的马尔可夫提升是可行的，但对于指数混合核，其维度会变得过高，而对于长记忆核则不可行。因此，我们发展了一个Volterra-Riccati近似层次结构。第一层用条件Volterra预测替代随机未来请求流；第二层加入强度不确定性的协方差修正；第三层利用已实现的Hawkes记忆（或等价地，请求后的条件预测曲线）更新报价规则。该近似层次结构在指数Hawkes基准中得到了验证，其中精确提升的HJB方程可以数值求解。状态反馈的Volterra-Riccati策略紧密跟踪精确基准，尤其在方向性情景中表现良好，而无记忆的Poisson策略则遭受显著遗憾损失。随后，我们将相同的状态反馈规则应用于幂律型RFQ记忆模型。方向性RFQ爆发改变了未来流的条件预测，并通过延续价值的影子价格转化为持续的报价偏斜。由此产生的内生OTC报价影响继承了RFQ预测响应的长记忆衰减，并且相对于无条件的Poisson基准，改善了库存和损益风险控制。

title: An Information-Geometric Framework for Bayesian Credit Risk Monitoring
abstract:
We propose an information-geometric framework for credit risk monitoring in which a bank's knowledge of a borrower is represented by a posterior distribution over latent dimensions of creditworthiness and financial fragility.
  Under a linear-Gaussian specification, Bayesian updating maps observed behavioural scores into Gaussian posterior beliefs, which form a statistical manifold endowed with the Fisher information metric.
  In the common-covariance case, the induced geometry reduces to the Mahalanobis metric on posterior means, while borrower-specific covariance matrices allow informational distances to account for both expected risk and assessment uncertainty.
  Simulation exercises illustrate how Kullback-Leibler and Jeffreys divergences can be used to compare portfolio segments.
  The framework provides a geometric interpretation of credit monitoring as the evolution of posterior beliefs over borrower risk.
tldr: 提出一个基于信息几何的贝叶斯框架，用于银行信贷风险监测，通过后验分布和Fisher信息度量来刻画借款人风险。
abstract_cn: 我们提出一种用于信用风险监测的信息几何框架，在该框架中，银行对借款人的认知通过一个关于信用资质与财务脆弱性潜在维度的后验分布来表示。在线性-高斯设定下，贝叶斯更新将观测到的行为评分映射为高斯后验信念，这些信念构成一个赋予Fisher信息度量的统计流形。在共同协方差情形下，所诱导的几何结构退化为后验均值上的马氏距离，而借款人特定的协方差矩阵则使信息距离能够同时反映预期风险与评估不确定性。模拟实验展示了如何利用Kullback-Leibler散度与Jeffreys散度对投资组合细分进行比较。该框架为信用监测提供了一种几何解释，将其视为借款人风险后验信念的演化过程。

title: Conformal Kelly: Conformal Prediction Intervals as the Scale in Fractional Kelly Position Sizing
abstract:
Conformal prediction has traditionally been used to quantify prediction uncertainty. We put that uncertainty to a second use, combining a 75% conformal interval with fractional Kelly to size portfolio positions: as the range widens we shrink the position, and as it narrows we grow it. On a six-year development window (2016-2021), with trading costs and strict leverage caps, this compounds at 28.5% annualised net log growth with a Sharpe ratio of 1.34 and a 27.7% maximum drawdown, versus 15.9% for holding the S&P 500 and 21-22% for passive portfolios at the same leverage.
  Our main development-window finding runs against the literature's advice for conformal prediction on time series. Every tweak that adapts the interval faster to market conditions costs 0.7 to 5.3 points of annual growth; the winner is the simplest method: slow, unweighted, per-asset rolling quantiles. When an interval sizes a position rather than describing one forecast, width stability beats local sharpness. It also beats the textbook standard deviation by 2.1 points at matched leverage. We also implement a risk control: when the intervals miss on the downside far more than their historical rate, we cut leverage. On the development window this cut maximum drawdown from 27.7% to 20.3% while raising the Sharpe ratio, beating all 40 placebo timings (rank-based p = 1/41).
  These numbers came from an autonomous LLM-agent search over 200 configurations, so we sealed all data from 2022 onward and pre-registered configurations, benchmarks, and interpretation rules before one evaluation. Calibration held (0.745 coverage against 0.750, weakest through 2022); growth did not: the two configurations earned 8.5% and 7.0% per year, below the passive benchmarks, and a pre-registered hindsight benchmark beat them on raw growth while taking a 46% drawdown. All outcomes are reported as pre-registered.
tldr: 该论文提出将共形预测区间作为分数凯利仓位规模的尺度，通过区间宽度调整仓位，并在开发窗口上表现优异，但预注册评估显示增长不及被动基准。
abstract_cn:
保形预测传统上用于量化预测不确定性。我们将这种不确定性用于第二个用途，将75%的保形区间与分数凯利准则相结合，以确定投资组合的头寸规模：当区间变宽时，我们缩减头寸；当区间变窄时，我们增加头寸。在六年的开发窗口期（2016-2021年）内，考虑交易成本和严格的杠杆上限，该策略实现了28.5%的年化净对数增长，夏普比率为1.34，最大回撤为27.7%，而同期标普500指数的收益为15.9%，同等杠杆下的被动投资组合收益为21-22%。

我们在开发窗口期的主要发现与文献中关于时间序列保形预测的建议相悖。每一个使区间更快适应市场条件的调整，都会导致年化增长损失0.7至5.3个百分点；而胜出的方法是最简单的：缓慢、不加权、逐资产的滚动分位数。当区间用于确定头寸规模而非描述单一预测时，宽度的稳定性优于局部的尖锐性。在匹配杠杆下，该方法还比教科书式的标准差方法高出2.1个百分点。我们还实施了一项风险控制：当区间在下行方向的失配频率远超其历史水平时，我们削减杠杆。在开发窗口期内，这一措施将最大回撤从27.7%降至20.3%，同时提高了夏普比率，优于所有40个安慰剂时点（基于秩的p = 1/41）。

这些数字来自一个自主的LLM代理对200种配置的搜索，因此我们封存了2022年及以后的所有数据，并在一次评估之前预先注册了配置、基准和解释规则。校准性得以保持（覆盖率为0.745，目标为0.750，2022年期间最弱）；但增长未能保持：两种配置的年化收益分别为8.5%和7.0%，低于被动基准，而一个预先注册的事后基准在原始增长上超过了它们，但承担了46%的回撤。所有结果均按预先注册的方式报告。

title: Climate-Dyna Deep Hedging for XVAs: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning, Residual Climate HVA, and Hedge-Instrument Discovery
abstract: For a trading desk, residual climate hedging valuation adjustment (HVA) is the climate cost left after its inherited hedge and any admissible overlay have been taken into account; it therefore cannot be inferred from a stand-alone stress loss. We obtain this residual by comparing paired climate-on and baseline worlds and reoptimizing the overlay for each hedge universe, which also turns hedge-instrument discovery into a valuation problem: an instrument is useful to the extent that it lowers the optimized residual cost. The linear-Gaussian case has an exact finite-horizon Riccati solution; Climate-Dyna starts from that hedge and learns the remaining nonlinear correction from paired world-model rollouts, with an independent gate deciding whether to deploy the update. In a public-data-calibrated semi-synthetic EU ETS study, crediting the inherited hedge lowers the mean climate charge from 1.517 to 0.906, and the learned overlay lowers it to 0.831 against a 0.821 exact floor; residual Dyna cuts regret by 93% relative to replay with one quarter as many trajectories, while adaptation from only 25 target transitions retains 60.7% of the exact-assisted gain.
tldr: 该论文提出Climate-Dyna方法，利用模型强化学习优化气候对冲的剩余估值调整，并在EU ETS数据上验证了其有效性。
abstract_cn: 对于交易台而言，残余气候对冲估值调整（HVA）是指在其既有对冲及任何可允许的叠加策略被纳入考量之后所剩余的气候成本；因此，它无法从独立压力损失中推断得出。我们通过比较成对的气候开启世界与基线世界，并对每个对冲宇宙重新优化叠加策略来获取该残余值，这同时将对冲工具的发现转化为一个估值问题：一项工具的有用性取决于其在多大程度上降低了优化后的残余成本。线性高斯情形具有精确的有限时域Riccati解；Climate-Dyna从该对冲出发，并通过成对世界模型推演学习剩余的非线性修正，同时由一个独立的门控机制决定是否部署该更新。在一项基于公开数据校准的半合成欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）研究中，计入既有对冲使平均气候费用从1.517降至0.906，而学习得到的叠加策略将其进一步降至0.831，对应的精确下限为0.821；残余Dyna方法在仅使用四分之一轨迹数量的情况下，相对于回放方法将遗憾值降低了93%，而仅从25条目标转移中进行自适应仍保留了精确辅助增益的60.7%。

title: Axient: On-Chain Credit and Loss Allocation for Leveraged Event Markets: A Venue-Agnostic Protocol for Traders, Credit Providers, Market Makers, and Liquidation Backstops
abstract: A physically backed leveraged event position requires real credit: if collateral C receives leverage L, the protocol supplies (L-1)C and uses the combined amount to acquire recognized event exposure. This paper develops a venue-agnostic on-chain credit architecture for that capital layer and an endogenous model of its capital market. It separates traders, Senior Credit LPs, market makers, liquidators, and Liquidation Backstop Providers; formalizes pool and debt shares, utilization- and risk-sensitive interest, collateral-locked position accounts, venue capabilities, market-maker commitments, withdrawal queues, isolated pools, non-redeemable reserves, and a deterministic loss waterfall; and models endogenous provider participation, leverage demand, liquidity withdrawal, liquidator entry, reserve replenishment, runs, and common-factor contagion. Formal results establish balanced real- and integer-unit accounting, settlement-confirmed debt priority, trader residual ownership, idempotent partial settlement, non-dilutive share issuance, junior-before-Senior impairment, loss-participating withdrawal queues, utilization-equilibrium conditions, and loss-allocation and contagion bounds. The release preserves 28 exact fixtures and 31,082 deterministic checks and adds fixed-seed agent-based experiments with 70,207,488 scalar invariant evaluations and zero failures. The experiments show that layered protection reduces but does not eliminate Senior loss, that 5x leverage materially increases capital pressure, and that market-maker capacity can raise aggregate shortfall if admission expands too quickly. Results are synthetic mechanism comparisons under author-specified behavior, not forecasts of APY, defaults, venue liquidity, or production safety.
tldr: 该论文提出一个链上杠杆事件市场的信用与损失分配协议，通过形式化模型和模拟实验分析其资本结构、风险分配和稳定性。
abstract_cn: 实物支撑的杠杆事件头寸需要真实信用：若抵押品C获得杠杆率L，协议需提供(L-1)C，并将合并后的金额用于获取已确认的事件敞口。本文为该资本层构建了一种与场所无关的链上信用架构，并建立了其资本市场的内生模型。该模型将交易者、优先信贷流动性提供者、做市商、清算人和清算兜底提供者区分开来；形式化了资金池与债务份额、基于利用率和风险敏感性的利息、抵押锁定头寸账户、场所能力、做市商承诺、提款队列、隔离资金池、不可赎回准备金以及确定性损失瀑布；并对内生参与者参与、杠杆需求、流动性提款、清算人进入、准备金补充、挤兑及共同因子传染进行了建模。形式化结果确立了平衡的真实单位与整数单位记账、结算确认的债务优先级、交易者剩余所有权、幂等部分结算、非稀释性份额发行、次级优先于优先级的减值顺序、损失分担的提款队列、利用率均衡条件，以及损失分配与传染边界。该版本保留了28个精确测试夹具和31,082项确定性检查，并新增了固定随机种子的基于智能体的实验，包含70,207,488次标量不变量评估且零失败。实验表明，分层保护能够降低但无法消除优先级损失；5倍杠杆会显著加大资本压力；若做市商准入扩张过快，其容量反而可能提高总体缺口。研究结果为作者指定行为下的合成机制比较，而非对年化收益率、违约率、场所流动性或生产安全性的预测。

title: Axient: Debt-Free Finality for Leveraged Binary Event Markets
abstract: Leveraged event positions combine a repayable loan with an outcome claim that may become non-tradable before oracle payout is final. This paper specifies Axient, a physically backed margin layer for binary event markets that separates leverage maturity from claim maturity and makes the hard-flat decision under explicit execution uncertainty. The model distinguishes quoted book proceeds, matched proceeds, settled proceeds, and redemption. At decision time, the protocol selects the smallest sale whose lower settled-proceeds envelope covers an upper bound on debt at the settlement horizon plus a buffer. We prove robust ex-ante debt clearing, pathwise debt-extinguishment and debt-free-finality invariants, maximal residual spot exposure, payout-vector and dispute-duration invariance of lender principal after debt extinction, and an impossibility boundary when execution, signer control, settlement, or market closure leave the registered operating set. We also derive a book-dependent leverage envelope, aggregate hard-flat capacity without double-counting shared liquidity, and scenario-conditional reserve bounds. A deterministic verifier covers step books, partial fills, settlement delay, adversarial book transformations, shared-book liquidation, reserve allocation, zero liquidity, and multiple payout vectors. The operating and stress sets are author-specified; empirical calibration is separate. The contribution is a conditional mechanism-design result and reference-implementation boundary, not a production-safety claim.
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为Axient的协议，用于在二元事件市场中实现无债务的最终清算，通过分离杠杆到期和索赔到期，并证明在不确定性下债务清偿的稳健性。
abstract_cn: 杠杆化事件头寸将一笔可偿还贷款与一项结果索赔相结合，而该索赔在预言机最终支付之前可能变得不可交易。本文规范了Axient，一种用于二元事件市场的实物抵押保证金层，它将杠杆到期日与索赔到期日分离，并在明确的执行不确定性下做出硬性平仓决策。该模型区分了报价账面收益、匹配收益、结算收益和赎回。在决策时刻，协议选择最小的卖出量，其较低结算收益包络覆盖结算时点债务的上限加上缓冲。我们证明了稳健的事前债务清算、路径wise债务消除和债务无关终局不变量、最大残余现货敞口、债务消除后贷款人本金的支付向量和争议持续时间不变性，以及当执行、签名者控制、结算或市场关闭使注册操作集失效时的不可能性边界。我们还推导了依赖账本的杠杆包络、不重复计算共享流动性的聚合硬性平仓能力，以及情景条件储备边界。一个确定性验证器覆盖了分步账本、部分成交、结算延迟、对抗性账本变换、共享账本清算、储备分配、零流动性和多种支付向量。操作集和压力集由作者指定；经验校准另行进行。本文的贡献是条件机制设计结果和参考实现边界，而非生产安全性声明。

title: Drawdown Risk Beyond Brownian Motion: A Monte-Carlo Framework, Non-Gaussian Extensions, and Long Memory
abstract: How deep and how long should the drawdowns of a systematic trading strategy run, given its Sharpe ratio and the statistical structure of its returns? Building on the drawdown framework of Rej, Seager and Bouchaud (2017), we develop the answer in three steps. We first reframe their closed-form results as a transparent Monte-Carlo experiment, validate it against their analytic benchmarks, and extend the mapping from drawdowns to four decision-relevant measures: maximum drawdown, maximum loss, final negative time and longest recovery time. We then relax the Gaussian assumption, holding the true Sharpe and volatility fixed while varying skewness, fat tails, volatility clustering and Sharpe-estimation uncertainty across strategy archetypes; the four measures move differently, so a single Gaussian table mis-warns. We finally replace short-memory persistence with fractional Brownian motion and show that the apparent amplification of drawdown risk under persistence is, for maximum-drawdown depth, almost entirely self-similar dispersion scaling (T^(H-1/2)) rather than path geometry: a failure of square-root-of-time calibration, not intrinsic danger. We provide reproducible lookup tables and a practical calibration recipe.
tldr: 该论文通过蒙特卡洛模拟和非高斯扩展，研究交易策略的回撤风险，并探讨长期记忆的影响，为风险管理提供校准方法。
abstract_cn: 给定策略的夏普比率及其收益的统计结构，其回撤应有多深、持续多久？基于Rej、Seager和Bouchaud（2017）的回撤框架，我们分三步展开解答。首先，我们将他们的闭式结果重构为透明的蒙特卡洛实验，并对照其解析基准进行验证，同时将回撤映射扩展至四个与决策相关的指标：最大回撤、最大亏损、最终负收益时间及最长恢复时间。其次，我们放宽高斯假设，在保持真实夏普比率和波动率固定的情况下，跨策略原型变动偏度、肥尾、波动率聚集及夏普估计不确定性；四个指标的变化方向各异，因此单一高斯表格会产生误导性警示。最后，我们用分数布朗运动替代短记忆持续性，并表明在持续性下回撤风险的表观放大，对于最大回撤深度而言，几乎完全源于自相似的离散标度（T^(H-1/2)），而非路径几何形态：这是平方根时间校准的失效，而非内在危险。我们提供可复现的查找表及实用的校准方法。

title: Methodology for Modelling Token Economies and Performing Event Impact Analysis with DeTEcT
abstract:
The objective of this paper is to provide a methodology for applying the DeTEcT framework to modelling token economies, to formalise the configuration of the simulation environment, and to introduce an event analysis framework. A token economy is an economic system that has a unique mechanism for controlling its monetary supply, and a medium, in the form of a token or currency, for the valuation of goods and services, the settlement of transactions, and the storage of value. We show the key decisions that must be made when modelling an economy with the DeTEcT framework and showcase some numerical methods that can be used in conjunction with the framework to perform economic simulations. We also propose a framework for analysing and measuring the impacts of events on an economy, while also developing a procedure to measure the significance of these impacts.
  Throughout the paper, we use Bitcoin as a case study to demonstrate how to apply the frameworks and tools we proposed here. We show how a model of Bitcoin token economy can be set up, and how to measure the impacts of Bitcoin's endogenous policies (i.e., BIPs) on the wealth distribution of its economic participants.
tldr: 提出DeTEcT框架用于建模代币经济和事件影响分析，以比特币为例展示如何设置模型并衡量BIPs对财富分配的影响。
abstract_cn:
本文的目标是提供一种将DeTEcT框架应用于代币经济建模的方法论，以形式化仿真环境的配置，并引入一个事件分析框架。代币经济是一种经济系统，其具有独特的货币供应控制机制，并以代币或货币的形式作为媒介，用于商品和服务的估值、交易结算以及价值储存。我们展示了在使用DeTEcT框架建模经济时必须做出的关键决策，并介绍了一些可与该框架结合使用的数值方法，以执行经济仿真。我们还提出了一个用于分析和衡量事件对经济影响的框架，同时开发了一套程序来度量这些影响的显著性。  
在整篇论文中，我们以比特币作为案例研究，展示如何应用我们在此提出的框架和工具。我们展示了如何建立比特币代币经济的模型，以及如何衡量比特币内生政策（即BIPs）对其经济参与者财富分配的影响。

title: AI and Exchange Rate Predictability
abstract: I revisit the exchange rate disconnect puzzle, first documented by Meese and Rogoff (1983), using generative artificial intelligence (AI) to forecast currency returns based on economic fundamentals. Using ChatGPT and DeepSeek, I analyze a comprehensive dataset of economic data releases for major currency pairs and measure the fundamental strength of each currency. These AI-powered fundamentals exhibit significant cross-sectional predictive power. A simple trading strategy that goes long currencies with strong fundamentals and short currencies with weak fundamentals generates a Sharpe ratio exceeding 0.7 per annum. The excess returns of this strategy remain significant after controlling for traditional currency factors. To mitigate concerns of look-ahead bias, I run multiple exercises to ensure that predictability stems from AI reasoning rather than memorization. Finally, I explore the potential sources of predictability and find evidence that the Taylor rule framework, generally used by central banks to set interest rates, is a key mechanism connecting exchange rates to economic fundamentals.
tldr: 利用生成式AI（ChatGPT和DeepSeek）基于经济基本面预测汇率，发现AI生成的基本面强度具有横截面预测能力，交易策略夏普比率超过0.7，且泰勒规则是重要机制。
abstract_cn: 我重新审视了汇率脱节之谜——这一现象最早由Meese和Rogoff（1983）记录——利用生成式人工智能（AI）基于经济基本面来预测货币收益。通过使用ChatGPT和DeepSeek，我分析了主要货币对的综合经济数据发布数据集，并衡量了每种货币的基本面强度。这些由AI驱动的基本面表现出显著的横截面预测能力。一个简单的交易策略——做多基本面强劲的货币，做空基本面疲弱的货币——产生的年化夏普比率超过0.7。在控制传统货币因子后，该策略的超额收益仍然显著。为缓解前瞻性偏差的担忧，我进行了多项测试，以确保可预测性源于AI的推理能力而非记忆。最后，我探讨了可预测性的潜在来源，并发现证据表明，中央银行通常用于设定利率的泰勒规则框架，是连接汇率与经济基本面的关键机制。

analysis.chinese_title: 人工智能与汇率可预测性
analysis.summary: 本文利用生成式人工智能（ChatGPT和DeepSeek）重新审视汇率与基本面之间的“脱节”难题。作者收集了1996年至2024年间G10货币的544项经济数据发布（包括实际值、前值和预测值），通过结构化提示让AI模型判断每项数据对货币的影响方向（增强、削弱或不确定），并构建了衡量货币基本面强度的AIFX指数。研究发现，该指数具有显著的横截面预测能力，基于该指数的多空策略年化夏普比率超过0.7，且在控制传统货币因子后仍存在显著alpha。作者通过多种测试排除了前瞻偏差的可能，并发现泰勒规则是预测力的重要来源。
innovations: 首次将生成式AI（如ChatGPT）应用于汇率预测，利用其处理大规模结构化数据的能力。
构建了基于AI判断的AIFX指数，该指数能有效预测货币收益。
设计了多种测试（如猜测年份、利用模型知识截止日期差异、纯事后组合）来排除前瞻偏差。
发现泰勒规则是AI预测力的关键机制，为汇率决定理论提供了新证据。
analysis.methodology: 本文使用GPT-4o和DeepSeek-V3对经济数据发布进行分析，通过提示工程获取方向性信号和重要性评分。基于这些信号构建AIFX指数，并采用横截面多空策略、时间序列策略和面板回归评估预测能力。同时，通过多种稳健性检验和前瞻偏差测试确保结果的可靠性。
key_results: AIFX指数具有显著的横截面预测能力，多空策略年化夏普比率超过0.7。
控制传统货币因子后，alpha显著，占平均收益的74%（48个月回看期）。
面板回归显示AIFX指数对下月收益有显著预测力。
GPT-4o和DeepSeek-V3的结果一致，表明结果稳健。
加权AIFX指数进一步提高了策略表现。
时间序列策略也产生经济上有意义的夏普比率，主要由美元AIFX驱动。
前瞻偏差测试表明预测力源于推理而非记忆。
通胀、就业和广泛经济活动指标是最重要的预测因子，支持泰勒规则机制。
strengths: 创新性地将AI应用于汇率预测，拓展了AI在金融领域的应用。
使用了大规模数据集（174,820个数据点），增强了结果的可靠性。
设计了严谨的前瞻偏差测试，提高了结论的可信度。
提供了多种稳健性检验，包括不同AI模型、加权指数和时间序列策略。
机制分析揭示了泰勒规则的重要性，具有理论意义。

title: Data-Driven Measures of High-Frequency Trading
abstract: We introduce data-driven measures of high-frequency trading (HFT) that distinguish between liquidity-supplying and liquidity-demanding strategies. We train machine learning models on a proprietary dataset with observed HFT activity, then apply these models to public intraday data to generate HFT measures across all U.S. stocks during 2010-2023. Our measures outperform conventional proxies, which struggle to capture the temporal dynamics of HFT. Consistent with theory, our measures respond to a quasi-exogenous speed bump introduction and a data feed upgrade. The measures help uncover the differential impact of HFT on information acquisition. Liquidity-supplying HFT improves price informativeness around earnings announcements, while liquidity-demanding HFT impedes it.
tldr: 该论文利用机器学习从公开数据中生成高频交易度量，并研究其对信息获取的影响，发现流动性供给型HFT改善价格信息效率，而流动性需求型HFT则阻碍之。
abstract_cn: 我们引入了区分提供流动性与需求流动性策略的高频交易（HFT）的数据驱动度量指标。我们在一个包含已观测HFT活动的专有数据集上训练机器学习模型，随后将这些模型应用于公开的日内数据，以生成2010—2023年间所有美国股票的HFT度量。我们的度量指标优于传统代理变量，后者难以捕捉HFT的时间动态特征。与理论一致，我们的度量指标对一项准外生的减速带引入和数据源升级做出了响应。这些度量有助于揭示HFT对信息获取的差异化影响。提供流动性的HFT改善了盈余公告期间的价格信息含量，而需求流动性的HFT则阻碍了这一过程。

title: Synthetic supply networks
abstract: A good representation of the population of firms and households is essential for large-scale economic models. While there exist good methods to create synthetic populations of households, creating synthetic populations of firms and, crucially, their supply chain links, is typically much harder. Here, we introduce a flexible method to create synthetic supply networks that match both the known properties of firm-level supply networks and the properties of aggregated input-output tables used in macroeconomic models. Our method is fast, and because it uses only publicly available data, it is fully reproducible and can be easily extended.
tldr: 提出一种基于公开数据快速生成合成供应链网络的方法，以匹配企业级和宏观投入产出表特性。
abstract_cn: 对企业和家庭群体的良好表征对于大规模经济模型至关重要。尽管已有成熟方法可生成合成家庭群体，但生成合成企业群体，尤其是其供应链关联，通常困难得多。在此，我们提出一种灵活的方法，用于构建合成供应链网络，该网络既能匹配企业层面供应链网络的已知特性，又能匹配宏观经济模型中所用汇总投入产出表的属性。我们的方法运行快速，且仅依赖公开可得数据，因此完全可复现，并易于扩展。

title: Preying on Leveraged ETFs
abstract: We argue that the extreme volatility of the Korean market in 2026 was driven by arbitrageurs preying on the closing rebalance of leveraged exchange-traded funds (LETFs). An LETF must trade in the direction of the day's move at a close that also measures it, so its demand rises in price, and arbitrageurs buying ahead of it enlarge the order by trading at the print, then unload into what they manufactured. As predicted, pre-open U.S. news is reversed one day later in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix once their products list, and in no control group. At measured parameters the loop added forty-seven percentage points of annualized volatility and transferred KRW 4 trillion from retail holders in eight weeks. Dispersing the rebalance through the session, Korea's chosen remedy, moves the order but not the reference that sizes it and can raise the toll. Changing the reference works instead: an average of two prints halves what displacing either can manufacture.
tldr: 本文研究套利者如何利用杠杆ETF的收盘再平衡机制加剧市场波动，并通过韩国市场数据验证了该现象，提出了改变参考价格而非分散交易时间的政策建议。
abstract_cn: 我们认为，2026年韩国市场的极端波动性是由套利者利用杠杆交易所交易基金（LETFs）的收盘再平衡机制进行掠夺性交易所致。LETFs必须在收盘时（该收盘价同时用于衡量当日涨跌幅）按照当日走势方向进行交易，因此其需求随价格上涨而增加，而提前买入的套利者通过在成交价上交易放大了订单规模，随后将所制造的涨幅抛售给市场。正如预测所示，盘前美国消息在三星电子和SK海力士产品上市后一天内出现反转，而对照组中则无此现象。在测得的参数下，该循环机制贡献了四十七个百分点的年化波动率，并在八周内从散户持有者手中转移了四万亿韩元。韩国选择的应对方案——将再平衡分散至整个交易时段——只是移动了订单，却未改变决定订单规模的参考价，反而可能提高代价。改变参考价则行之有效：取两次成交价的平均值，可使任一偏移所能制造的涨幅减半。

title: Transnational political violence in African borderlands
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between borderlands and political violence in Africa. Using spatiotemporal data on conflict events from 1997 to 2024 alongside the innovative OECD Spatial Conflict Dynamics indicator (SCDi), it suggests that borderlands see more conflict than non-borderlands. Political violence tends to decrease very rapidly with the distance to borders in Africa. The share of violent events recorded in borderlands varies over time and mirrors the cycles of violence that affect specific regions. It was very high in the early 2000s due to the wars in the Gulf of Guinea and Great Lakes region, declined for less than a decade, and increased substantially in the 2010s. Finally, the paper shows that when conflicts diffuse across borders, they tend to occupy a greater spatial extent, rather than relocate from one side of the border to the other.
tldr: 利用1997-2024年冲突事件数据和OECD空间冲突动态指标，发现非洲边境地区政治暴力更频繁，且跨境冲突扩散时空间范围扩大而非转移。
abstract_cn: 本文考察了非洲边境地区与政治暴力之间的关系。利用1997年至2024年间冲突事件的时空数据，以及创新的经合组织空间冲突动态指标（SCDi），研究表明边境地区的冲突多于非边境地区。在非洲，政治暴力往往随着与边境距离的增加而迅速减少。边境地区记录的暴力事件占比随时间变化，并反映了影响特定区域的暴力周期。21世纪初，由于几内亚湾和大湖地区的战争，这一比例非常高，随后下降了不到十年，在2010年代又大幅上升。最后，本文表明，当冲突跨境扩散时，它们往往占据更大的空间范围，而非从边境一侧转移到另一侧。

title: Cities and political violence in West Africa
abstract: This paper examines how political violence in West Africa is distributed between urban agglomerations and their surrounding areas using spatially disaggregated conflict and population data. Covering seventeen countries from 2012 to mid-2025, the analysis shows that political violence remains clearly tied to cities and their peripheries with the majority of violence occurring within and around urban agglomerations. Large cities record the highest number of incidents within their boundaries, while smaller towns, which are more frequently situated near borders, typically experience higher levels of violence outside their boundaries. However, urban-centric violence has also declined since 2012, indicating a progressive ruralization of conflict. These findings provide important regional context to the urbanization of conflict narrative by showing that West African insurgent movements use both urban and rural environments strategically. They also underscore the ongoing vulnerability of peripheral populations and the need for mobile and community-based security approaches outside major cities. Finally, they highlight the importance of strengthening border infrastructure, transport networks, and civic institutions as tools of both development and security.
tldr: 利用空间分解的冲突和人口数据，分析2012-2025年西非17国政治暴力在城市及周边的分布，发现暴力与城市紧密相关但呈农村化趋势。
abstract_cn: 本文利用空间细化的冲突与人口数据，考察了西非政治暴力在城市群及其周边地区之间的分布情况。分析覆盖2012年至2025年中的十七个国家，结果显示，政治暴力与城市及其边缘地区密切相关，大多数暴力事件发生在城市群内部及其周边。大城市在行政边界内记录的暴力事件数量最多，而较小的城镇——通常更靠近边境——则在行政边界外经历的暴力水平更高。然而，以城市为中心的暴力自2012年以来也有所下降，表明冲突正逐步向农村地区扩散。这些发现为“冲突城市化”的叙事提供了重要的区域背景，表明西非叛乱运动在战略上同时利用城市与农村环境。研究还强调了边缘人口持续面临的脆弱性，以及在主要城市之外采取流动式和社区化安全手段的必要性。最后，研究凸显了加强边境基础设施、交通网络和公民机构建设作为发展与安全双重工具的重要性。

title: Stochastic Choice with Advertising
abstract: We study how advertised products (e.g., Top Picks, Recommended, Featured) affect consumer choice on digital platforms and retail interfaces by extending the Luce (1959) (or multinomial logit) model. A consumer either focuses on the advertised items or considers the full menu, then chooses among the considered alternatives according to the Luce/logit rule. We characterize this model and show that its underlying primitives are uniquely identified from choice data. We also study a managerially important advertisement-design problem, in which a platform or retailer chooses the advertised subset to maximize expected profit, and we derive implementable design rules. We then introduce a richer framework in which advertising can influence both attention and preference. For this more general model, we provide a characterization and show how choice data can be used to separate the attention effect from the preference effect.
tldr: 该论文扩展了Luce/logit模型，研究广告如何影响消费者注意力与偏好，并提供了模型识别和广告设计规则。
abstract_cn: 我们通过扩展Luce（1959）（或多项式Logit）模型，研究广告产品（如“精选推荐”“推荐”“特色”）如何影响数字平台和零售界面上的消费者选择。消费者要么专注于广告商品，要么考虑完整菜单，然后根据Luce/Logit规则在考虑中的备选项中进行选择。我们对该模型进行了刻画，并表明其基本要素可以从选择数据中唯一识别。我们还研究了一个具有管理重要性的广告设计问题，即平台或零售商选择广告子集以最大化预期利润，并推导出可实施的设计规则。随后，我们引入了一个更丰富的框架，其中广告既能影响注意力，也能影响偏好。对于这一更一般的模型，我们提供了特征刻画，并展示了如何利用选择数据将注意力效应与偏好效应分离开来。

title: Digital State Capacity
abstract: Digital State Capacity is the ability of governments to deploy ICT infrastructure and information systems to implement policy. This paper introduces a new measure of government ICT capacity based on an observable stock of deployable public-sector network infrastructure: public IPv4 address space held by government organisations. These address holdings are key inputs into digital administration because they support internet-facing systems, networked information exchange, and coordination across agencies and functions. The core panel covers approximately 150,000 country-entity records classified as government across more than 150 countries from 2019 to 2024 and can be disaggregated by administrative level and government function. In the 2019 to 2024 Admin-1 panel, government IP holdings are observed in 1,681 subnational regions across all years. We validate the measure at the crosscountry and subnational levels and apply it to government tasks related to corruption control and vaccination rollout. In illustrative country-year analysis, higher Digital State Capacity is associated with higher-quality governance and publicservice outcomes in the expected directions, including lower measured corruption and higher vaccination coverage. These associations are descriptive; they demonstrate the empirical relevance of the measure and are not causal estimates.
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于政府公共IPv4地址空间的新指标来衡量数字国家能力，并展示其与治理质量和公共服务结果（如腐败控制和疫苗接种）的关联，但未涉及银行、货币或财政政策。
abstract_cn: 数字国家能力是指政府部署信息通信技术基础设施和信息系统以实施政策的能力。本文基于可观测的公共部门网络基础设施存量——即政府组织持有的公共IPv4地址空间——提出了一种新的政府信息通信技术能力衡量指标。这些地址持有量是数字行政的关键投入，因为它们支撑着面向互联网的系统、网络化信息交换以及跨机构和跨职能的协调。核心面板数据涵盖2019年至2024年间150多个国家中约15万条被归类为政府的国家-实体记录，并可按行政层级和政府职能进行细分。在2019年至2024年的Admin-1面板中，政府IP持有量在所有年份中覆盖了1681个次国家级区域。我们在跨国和次国家层面验证了这一衡量指标，并将其应用于与腐败控制和疫苗接种推广相关的政府任务中。在示例性的国家-年份分析中，较高的数字国家能力与更高质量的治理和公共服务结果呈正相关，且方向符合预期，包括更低的腐败测量值和更高的疫苗接种覆盖率。这些关联是描述性的；它们展示了该衡量指标的经验相关性，并非因果估计。

title: Does the Gender Wage Gap Originate at Labor Market Entry? Evidence from South Korea
abstract: When in the lifecycle does a large gender wage gap emerge? South Korea has the largest gender pay gap in the OECD, 29%. Among recent college graduates the conditional gap is only 4.3% over 2008-2019, falling from 5.0% to 3.0%, and correcting for differential selection into full-time wage employment with semiparametric, machine-learning, and bounds methods leaves it unchanged. Among observed workers what remains sits at the top of the distribution. In Korean panel data the corrected gap widens severalfold across the prime-age workforce, where the selection correction becomes first order. Korea's gender disparity is mostly generated after entry.
tldr: 利用韩国面板数据，通过半参数、机器学习和边界方法校正选择偏差，发现近期大学毕业生性别工资差距较小且下降，但主要差距在职业生涯后期扩大。
abstract_cn: 在生命周期的哪个阶段，性别工资差距会显著出现？韩国的性别薪酬差距在经合组织（OECD）国家中最大，达到29%。在2008年至2019年间，近期大学毕业生的条件性别工资差距仅为4.3%，且从5.0%下降至3.0%；通过半参数方法、机器学习方法以及边界方法对全职带薪就业中的差异性选择进行校正后，该差距保持不变。在可观测的就业者中，剩余的差距主要分布在收入分布的顶端。在韩国面板数据中，经过校正的性别工资差距在黄金工作年龄劳动力群体中扩大数倍，此时选择校正变得至关重要。韩国的性别不平等主要是在进入劳动力市场之后产生的。

title: Preference robust distortion risk measures
abstract: We introduce a framework for preference-robust decision making when preferences over risk are modelled through generalised distortion risk measures. Unlike distributional robustness, our approach addresses ambiguity in the risk functional itself. We construct ambiguity sets on distortion (weight) functions using the Wasserstein distance and Bregman divergences, and derive closed-form expressions for the worst- and best-case distortion risk measures. We further extend the framework to rank-dependent utility, yielding preference-robust behavioural models. In particular, rank-dependent utility appears as a robustification of the expected utility model, yielding a novel way to address the Allais paradox.
tldr: 提出一种偏好稳健的决策框架，通过广义扭曲风险度量处理风险函数本身的模糊性，并扩展到秩依赖效用，为阿莱悖论提供新解释。
abstract_cn: 我们提出一个框架，用于在风险偏好通过广义失真风险度量建模时进行偏好稳健决策。与分布稳健性不同，我们的方法处理的是风险泛函本身的不确定性。我们利用Wasserstein距离和Bregman散度在失真（权重）函数上构造模糊集，并推导出最坏和最佳情形失真风险度量的闭式表达式。我们进一步将该框架扩展到秩依赖效用，从而得到偏好稳健的行为模型。特别地，秩依赖效用表现为期望效用模型的稳健化形式，为处理阿莱悖论提供了一种新颖的途径。

title: Reviving Micro Real Rigidities: The Importance of Demand Shocks
abstract: We revisit micro real rigidities as a source of monetary non-neutrality in a menu-cost model with variable markups, using firm-level evidence to pin down key primitives. We embed a non-CES demand system in a quantitative monetary model and use firm-dynamics evidence to identify demand curvature and firm-level productivity and demand processes. The calibrated model matches untargeted micro pricing moments, the markup distribution, and cost pass-through, while generating comparable non-neutrality. The key innovation is an empirically supported placement of idiosyncratic demand shocks that shifts residual demand, thereby moving desired markups and prices under non-CES demand. The broader implication is that this calibrated model provides a portable framework linking monetary economics with trade and IO evidence.
tldr: 本文通过嵌入非CES需求系统到菜单成本模型，利用企业层面数据校准需求曲率和生产率过程，重新审视微观实际刚性作为货币非中性的来源，并匹配微观定价和成本传导等矩条件。
abstract_cn: 我们重新审视了在可变加成定价的菜单成本模型中，微观实际刚性作为货币非中性的来源，并利用企业层面的证据来确定关键基础参数。我们将非CES需求系统嵌入一个定量货币模型中，并利用企业动态证据来识别需求曲率以及企业层面的生产率和需求过程。校准后的模型能够匹配未作为目标设定的微观定价矩、加成分布和成本传导，同时产生可比的非中性效应。关键创新在于，在经验证据支持下引入异质性需求冲击，该冲击会移动剩余需求，从而在非CES需求下改变期望加成和价格。更广泛的意义在于，这一校准模型提供了一个可移植的框架，将货币经济学与贸易和产业组织领域的证据联系起来。

analysis.chinese_title: 复兴微观真实刚性：需求冲击的重要性
analysis.summary: 本文重新审视微观真实刚性作为货币非中性的来源，在菜单成本模型中引入非CES需求系统，并利用企业层面证据校准关键参数。作者将Kimball需求嵌入定量货币模型，使用Foster等人（2008）的企业动态证据识别需求曲率和企业层面的生产率与需求过程。校准后的模型匹配了未目标化的微观定价矩、加成率分布和成本传导率，同时产生可比的货币非中性。关键创新在于经验支持的特定需求冲击设定，该冲击移动剩余需求，从而在非CES需求下改变合意加成率和价格。更广泛的意义在于，该校准模型为连接货币经济学与贸易和产业组织证据提供了一个可移植的框架。
innovations: 将非CES需求系统（Kimball）引入定量货币经济学模型，并利用企业层面证据校准需求曲率和冲击过程。
识别出需求冲击的设定方式（有效份额vs水平）对价格和加成率的影响，并利用价格-生产率相关性进行判别。
仅以价格调整频率为定价目标，模型能匹配未目标化的定价矩、加成率分布和成本传导率。
展示了校准后的模型产生的货币非中性幅度与宏观层面机制相当。
analysis.methodology: 本文采用理论分析、数值求解和校准方法。理论部分推导了非CES需求下企业定价规则和传导弹性。定量部分构建了包含菜单成本和Kimball需求的动态一般均衡模型，使用Foster等人（2008）的企业层面矩进行校准，并模拟模型以生成未目标化矩。
key_results: 校准得到需求弹性为6.5，超弹性为7.1，成本传导率为43%。
模型匹配了价格调整频率、价格-生产率相关性（-0.54）等目标矩。
未目标化的定价矩（平均调整幅度、上调比例、标准差）与数据一致。
模型生成的加成率分布与Compustat数据相似，均值1.49 vs 1.56。
模型产生的货币非中性比CES模型高约34%。
strengths: 使用企业层面微观数据校准需求参数，增强了模型的可信度。
模型能够同时匹配定价矩、加成率分布和成本传导率，显示其解释力。
理论部分清晰展示了需求冲击设定对价格传导的影响，并提供了识别策略。
模型具有可移植性，可连接货币经济学与贸易、产业组织文献。
limitations: 模型未匹配经验定价危险的初始陡峭下降。
模型生成的加成率分布尾部较窄，未产生极端高或低的加成率。
校准依赖Foster等人（2008）的特定行业数据，可能不具有普遍性。
模型未包含企业进入退出、非高斯冲击等特征，可能限制其匹配极端矩的能力。

title: Raising Rivals' Costs on Hybrid Platforms: The Complementarity of Fees and Self-Preferencing
abstract: Hybrid platforms disadvantage third-party sellers through the platform fee and self-preferencing, and regulators have worried that constraining either instrument may intensify the other. We model a platform that chooses both instruments and find the opposite: single-instrument regulation is effective because the instruments are strategic complements, and regulating either instrument curbs the other. We also find that the two instruments achieve what monopolization achieves, higher prices and reduced consumer welfare, while passing every conventional antitrust test.
tldr: 该论文通过模型分析混合平台如何通过收费和自我优待提高竞争对手成本，并发现这两种工具是战略互补的，单一工具监管即可有效，但会损害消费者福利。
abstract_cn: 混合平台通过平台费用和自我优待使第三方卖家处于不利地位，而监管机构一直担心对其中任一手段的限制可能会加剧另一手段的影响。我们构建了一个同时选择这两种手段的平台模型，并发现了相反的结果：单一手段监管是有效的，因为这两种手段具有战略互补性，对任一手段的监管都会抑制另一种手段。我们还发现，这两种手段实现了与垄断相同的效果，即提高价格并降低消费者福利，同时却能够通过所有常规反垄断测试。

title: Rebuilding Startups: An Empirical Study on Remote Work and Skill Complementarity
abstract: Remote work is a common practice of workplace flexibility enabled by digital infrastructure, yet its implications for firms' talent composition and organizational structure remain underexplored. This question is especially important for startups, which often operate with constraints in accessing talent through local labor markets. We focus on skill complementarity, a dimension of talent composition that is critical to startups' early-stage development. By integrating LinkedIn job postings, worker skills, and worker mobility data, we study the impact of remote work on skill complementarity in startups. We find that higher remote work intensity increases firm-level skill complementarity, primarily by helping startups recruit new workers whose skills better match the firms' hiring needs and diversify from the skill sets of existing employees. We further show that this shift in workforce composition carries organizational consequences: remote work is associated with greater organizational hierarchy through increased skill complementarity. These findings suggest that, for startups, remote work is not merely a flexibility policy but a hiring mechanism that helps young firms assemble complementary talent despite resource constraints. At the same time, this may push startups toward more hierarchical structures, which serve as formalized coordination mechanisms to effectively achieve the value of a more complementary workforce.
tldr: 利用LinkedIn数据，研究发现远程工作强度提高初创企业技能互补性，通过招聘匹配度更高的新员工实现，并导致组织层级增加。
abstract_cn: 远程办公是数字基础设施所支撑的一种常见工作场所灵活性实践，但其对企业人才构成与组织结构的影响仍未得到充分探讨。这一问题对于初创企业尤为重要，因为初创企业往往在通过本地劳动力市场获取人才方面面临约束。我们聚焦于技能互补性——这一对初创企业早期发展至关重要的人才构成维度。通过整合领英（LinkedIn）职位发布、员工技能与员工流动数据，我们研究了远程办公对初创企业技能互补性的影响。研究发现，较高的远程办公强度能够提升企业层面的技能互补性，其主要机制在于帮助初创企业招聘到技能更契合企业用人需求、且与现有员工技能组合更具差异化的新员工。我们进一步表明，这种劳动力构成的转变会带来组织层面的后果：远程办公通过提升技能互补性，与更深的组织层级结构相关联。这些发现表明，对于初创企业而言，远程办公不仅是一种灵活性政策，更是一种招聘机制，帮助年轻企业在资源约束下组建互补性人才团队。与此同时，这可能推动初创企业走向更加层级化的组织结构，以正式化的协调机制有效实现更具互补性劳动力队伍的价值。

title: A New Theory of Value for Post-AGI Economics
abstract: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) may weaken scarcities in labour, expertise, information, and productive capability that underpin established theories of economic value. If cognitive work becomes widely automatable, market price, labour input, revealed preference, profit, and gross output may diverge sharply from human and societal benefit. This paper develops Flourishing Value Theory (FVT) as a foundation for post-AGI economics. FVT defines value as the counterfactual, distribution-sensitive contribution of a system, institution, asset, or intervention to the durable capabilities of persons and communities to flourish within social and planetary constraints. It treats societal value as multidimensional, agency-preserving, regenerative, and non-compensatory at critical thresholds. Drawing on the economics of AI, welfare and capability theory, automation, digital valuation, and ecological economics, the paper distinguishes value creation from value capture and retains price, profit, productivity, and GDP as partial signals rather than final measures of progress. It develops the shifts from scarcity to governed abundance, transaction to transformation, and zero-sum rivalry to positive-sum and infinite-game dynamics, with collective expansion of consciousness as an agency-preserving form of regenerative value. Building on Flourishing Metrics and Return on Flourishing (RoF), it proposes a layered architecture for firms, governments, work transitions, AI governance, and national accounting. The central post-AGI economic problem is not how to maximise output, but how to convert abundant intelligence into durable, fairly distributed human, societal, and planetary flourishing.
tldr: 论文提出繁荣价值理论作为后AGI经济学的基础，重新定义价值为对个人和社区繁荣能力的反事实贡献，并探讨从稀缺到富足、从交易到转型的转变。
abstract_cn: 通用人工智能（AGI）可能削弱支撑既有经济价值理论的劳动、专业知识、信息及生产能力方面的稀缺性。若认知工作被广泛自动化，市场价格、劳动投入、显示性偏好、利润及总产出或将与人类及社会福祉严重背离。本文提出“繁荣价值理论”（Flourishing Value Theory, FVT），作为后AGI时代经济学的基础。FVT将价值界定为某一系统、制度、资产或干预措施，对社会与地球约束下个人及社群持久繁荣能力的反事实性、分配敏感性贡献。该理论将社会价值视为多维度的、尊重主体性的、再生的，并在关键阈值上具有不可补偿性。本文借鉴人工智能经济学、福利与能力理论、自动化、数字估值及生态经济学，区分了价值创造与价值捕获，并将价格、利润、生产率及GDP视为部分信号而非进步的最终衡量标准。文章进一步阐述了从稀缺到受治理的丰裕、从交易到转型、从零和对抗到正和及无限博弈动态的转变，并将集体意识扩展视为一种尊重主体性的再生价值形式。在繁荣度量（Flourishing Metrics）与繁荣回报（Return on Flourishing, RoF）的基础上，本文提出了面向企业、政府、工作转型、人工智能治理及国民核算的分层架构。后AGI时代的核心经济问题并非如何最大化产出，而是如何将充裕的智能转化为持久的、公平分配的人类、社会及地球繁荣。

title: Global coal trade is resilient to maritime chokepoints
abstract: Maritime chokepoints and their potential disruption of global trade in energy find renewed attention. We analyse global trade in coal, and find that trade volumes and prices are highly resilient to maritime chokepoints. Feasible chokepoints do not truly sever supply from the seaborne market. Effects on costs and revenues are further moderated by relatively large potential for re-routing of bilateral trade flows, with countries switching to alternative suppliers or consumers. We assess costs to importers would rise by as little as 0.5 \$/t or less in case of closures of most feasible chokepoints. The exception is a restriction to maritime traffic in the South and East China Sea, which could raise costs by 10 \$/t for China, whilst reducing costs for other importers in the region by similar levels. Maritime chokepoints do create geographical separation of regional markets, with differentiated effects on costs to importers and revenues to exporters in different regions.
tldr: 该论文分析全球煤炭贸易对海上咽喉要道的韧性，发现贸易量和价格对咽喉要道关闭具有高度韧性，成本影响有限，但南中国海和东中国海的限制可能对中国产生较大影响。
abstract_cn: 海上咽喉要道及其对全球能源贸易的潜在干扰再次受到关注。我们分析了全球煤炭贸易，发现贸易量和价格对海上咽喉要道具有高度韧性。可行的咽喉要道并不会真正切断海运市场的供应。由于双边贸易流具有相对较大的改道潜力，各国可转向替代供应商或消费者，这进一步缓和了其对成本和收入的影响。我们评估认为，在大多数可行的咽喉要道关闭的情况下，进口商的成本增幅将低至每吨0.5美元或更少。例外情况是对南海和东海的航运限制，这可能导致中国成本每吨增加10美元，同时使该地区其他进口商的成本降低相近幅度。海上咽喉要道确实会造成区域市场的地理分隔，对不同地区的进口商成本和出口商收入产生差异化影响。

title: Delegated Monitoring in Public-Private Sector Credit Programs: Underinvestment, Overinvestment, and the Design of Subsidized Lending
abstract: This paper studies public-private partnerships that delegate access-to-credit programs to private equity and venture-capital intermediaries. The public sector seeks to relax credit rationing and expand lending to socially valuable firms, while delegated monitors screen applicants, allocate subsidized loans, and bear agency costs. The paper develops a mechanism-design model showing that the same delegated intermediation structure can generate both Stiglitz-Weiss underinvestment and De Meza-Webb overinvestment distortions. When screening is imperfect, interest-rate sorting may exclude creditworthy target firms. When subsidies weaken monitoring and repayment incentives, high-risk firms may obtain excessive credit. The operative distortion is determined by monitoring curvature and subsidy intensity. The model further predicts that the feasible spread between loan contracts narrows as expected risk increases. A sequential extension incorporates credit scoring and Bayesian updating, showing that welfare loss from misclassification is minimized when monitoring resources are allocated according to the marginal effect of borrower characteristics on posterior risk classification. Because granular borrower-level data are unavailable, the empirical component provides descriptive state-year evidence from SBA SBIC reports (2018-2025) and a calibrated simulation illustrating that the model's comparative statics are empirically recoverable. The empirical analysis is presented as design validation rather than as a causal test.
tldr: 本文构建机制设计模型，分析公私合作信贷项目中委托监督导致的投资不足与过度投资扭曲，并利用SBA数据验证模型预测。
abstract_cn: 本文研究将信贷获取项目委托给私募股权和风险投资中介机构的公私合作模式。公共部门旨在缓解信贷配给并扩大对社会有价值企业的贷款，而受委托的监督机构负责筛选申请者、分配贴息贷款并承担代理成本。本文构建了一个机制设计模型，表明相同的委托中介结构既可能产生Stiglitz-Weiss式投资不足扭曲，也可能产生De Meza-Webb式过度投资扭曲。当筛选不完善时，利率排序可能将具有偿债能力的优质目标企业排除在外；当补贴削弱监督与还款激励时，高风险企业可能获得过度信贷。实际起作用的扭曲类型取决于监督曲率和补贴强度。模型进一步预测，随着预期风险上升，贷款合约之间的可行利差将收窄。序贯扩展部分引入了信用评分与贝叶斯更新，表明当监督资源按照借款人特征对后验风险分类的边际效应进行配置时，误分类造成的福利损失最小化。由于缺乏细粒度的借款人层面数据，实证部分提供了来自SBA SBIC报告（2018—2025年）的描述性州—年度证据，并进行了校准模拟，说明模型的比较静态分析结果在经验上是可恢复的。该实证分析被定位为设计验证，而非因果检验。

analysis.chinese_title: 公私部门信贷项目中的委托监督：投资不足、过度投资与补贴贷款设计
analysis.summary: 本文研究公私合作（PPP）中，公共部门将信贷获取项目委托给私募股权和风险投资中介的机制设计问题。公共部门旨在放松信贷配给，扩大对社会有价值企业的贷款，而委托监督者负责筛选申请者、分配补贴贷款并承担代理成本。模型表明，同一委托中介结构既能产生Stiglitz-Weiss式投资不足，也能产生De Meza-Webb式过度投资扭曲。当筛选不完善时，利率排序可能排除有信用的目标企业；当补贴削弱监督和还款激励时，高风险企业可能获得过多信贷。实际扭曲由监督曲率和补贴强度决定。模型还预测，随着预期风险增加，贷款合同之间的可行利差会收窄。序贯扩展引入信用评分和贝叶斯更新，表明当监督资源根据借款人特征对后验风险分类的边际效应分配时，误分类福利损失最小。实证部分使用SBA SBIC报告（2018-2025）的州-年数据提供描述性证据，并通过校准模拟说明模型的比较静态可实证恢复。
innovations: 将信贷配给理论与PPP中的委托监督联系起来，提出公私合作信贷机制可同时嵌入Stiglitz-Weiss投资不足和De Meza-Webb过度投资边际。
识别监督曲率和补贴强度决定实际扭曲，并预测贷款合同利差随预期风险增加而收窄。
将静态机制扩展至序贯合同，纳入信用评分和贝叶斯更新，分析误分类福利损失最小化的条件。
提出参与构成条件（Lemma 1），强调项目善意取决于低风险企业参与比例，而非仅风险类型排序。
提供SBA SBIC数据描述性证据和校准模拟，作为设计验证而非因果检验。
analysis.methodology: 采用机制设计模型，构建公共部门与风险规避的风险投资家之间的委托代理框架。模型包括对称信息基准（第一最优）和非对称信息下的第二最优合同，分析激励相容和个体理性约束。通过连续类型扩展（Proposition 1）和半分离均衡分析，推导利率排序条件（Proposition 2）和过度投资条件（Proposition 3）。序贯扩展引入两期合同，使用贝叶斯更新和信用评分（logit模型）分析误分类福利损失。实证部分使用SBA SBIC报告（2018-2025）的州-年数据，进行描述性统计和校准模拟。
key_results: 同一委托监督结构可同时产生投资不足和过度投资扭曲，取决于监督曲率和补贴强度。
利率排序条件（Proposition 2）与Stiglitz-Weiss定理6功能等价，但通过补贴可避免其定理4的困境。
补贴高风险企业以拉平利率会引发过度投资（Proposition 3）。
贷款范围与监督成本曲率成反比，且独立于企业偏好（Proposition 4）。
序贯模型中，企业参与条件要求剩余贷款大于努力成本（不等式5.4）。
最小化误分类福利损失的必要条件是低风险和高风险企业的努力水平相等（Lemma 2）。

strengths: 理论创新性强，将信贷配给理论与委托监督结合，提出统一框架解释投资不足和过度投资。
模型结构严谨，包含多个命题和引理，推导清晰。

title: Difference-in-differences with "bad controls"
abstract: This paper considers difference-in-differences identification strategies when the parallel trends assumption holds after conditioning on covariates that may themselves be affected by the treatment (often referred to as "bad controls"). We show that common approaches such as simply dropping bad controls are often ill-advised and develop two alternative approaches that allow bad controls to function as genuine controls despite being affected by treatment. First, we derive explicit conditions that rationalize conditioning only on pre-treatment values of the bad control, leading naturally to the Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021) estimator with pre-treatment values as covariates. Second, under a covariate unconfoundedness condition, we develop imputation and double/debiased machine learning estimators that recover the average treatment effect on the treated. We extend these results to staggered treatment adoption, provide pre-tests for the identifying assumptions, and apply the methods to study the effects of job displacement on earnings.
tldr: 本文提出在平行趋势假设依赖于可能受处理影响的协变量时，双重差分法的识别策略，并开发了两种新方法，应用于研究工作流失对收入的影响。

title: Identification and Information after Nuisance Projection
abstract: Empirical work often removes fixed effects, latent factors, or high-dimensional controls before estimating structural relationships. These transformations reduce confounding but may also remove identifying variation. We study linear panel IV after one equation-compatible nuisance projection under two-way dependence. The projected Jacobian determines which structural directions remain visible; the projected-score law determines their precision; and, on Gaussian fixed-rank strata, they combine in a Projected Information Matrix. We derive weak-identification limits with dimension-specific information accumulation, feasible factor-transfer conditions, identification-robust tests, bootstrap procedures for non-Gaussian interaction limits, and inference for the projected spectrum, rank, subspaces, and information matrix. Simulations show that a raw first-stage statistic above 500 can support the wrong sign while projected diagnostics reveal weak valid information. In an international monetary application, common projection substantially attenuates apparent foreign-output persistence, while Gaussian-reference Anderson--Rubin sets remain unbounded. Identification should therefore be assessed after nuisance removal.

title: Testing for Smooth Structural Change in Cointegrated Systems
abstract: This paper develops an econometric framework for analysing smooth structural change in cointegrated systems following a known intervention time. We consider a vector error-correction model in which the cointegration rank and the pre-intervention cointegrating structure are identified from a stable pre-intervention subsample. After the intervention, both the adjustment coefficients and the cointegrating vectors are allowed to evolve smoothly as functions of rescaled time, which are estimated using kernel-weighted local reduced-rank methods. The analysis is formulated directly in a cointegrated VAR/VECM system, which preserves the treatment of long-run relations and short-run error-correction dynamics. By working with the decomposition $Π(δ)=α(δ)β(δ)'$, the method separates changes in the equilibrium relation from those in the speed of adjustment. We also provide two tests for the parameter consistency and the post-intervention parameter smoothness respectively. An empirical application to energy market, foreign-exchange, and gold-market index around the 24 February 2022 Russia's invasion of Ukraine illustrates how the proposed approach distinguishes between a discrete regime shift and smooth post-intervention evolution. The results suggest that cointegrating relation among the price of Brent crude oil, the spot exchange rate (USD/EUR), and the Credit Suisse NASDAQ Gold Price Index has smoothly changed after the outbreak of war, instead of a constant long-run conintegration system in the pre-intervention period.

abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个计量经济学框架，用于分析在已知干预时点后协整系统中发生的平滑结构变化。我们考虑一个向量误差修正模型，其中协整秩和干预前的协整结构由稳定的干预前子样本识别。干预后，调整系数和协整向量均允许作为重标度时间的函数平滑演变，并通过核加权局部降秩方法进行估计。该分析直接在协整VAR/VECM系统中进行，从而保留了对长期关系与短期误差修正动态的处理。通过利用分解式$Π(δ)=α(δ)β(δ)'$，该方法将均衡关系的变化与调整速度的变化区分开来。我们还分别提供了两个检验，分别针对参数一致性和干预后参数平滑性。一项围绕2022年2月24日俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的能源市场、外汇市场及黄金市场指数的实证应用，展示了所提方法如何区分离散的制度转变与平滑的干预后演变。结果表明，布伦特原油价格、即期汇率（美元/欧元）以及瑞士信贷纳斯达克黄金价格指数之间的协整关系在战争爆发后发生了平滑变化，而非干预前时期所呈现的恒定长期协整系统。

title: A fully nonlinear structural vector autoregressive model identified via independent innovation analysis
abstract: We develop a fully nonlinear structural vector autoregressive framework in which the contemporaneous structural mapping may be nonlinear and non-additive. Identification is achieved by exploiting variation in the conditional distributions of the mutually independent structural shocks induced by an observed exogenous variable. Specifically, a general contrastive learning framework that makes use of this variation together with the assumed exponential-family structure is employed to recover the shocks. Existing independent innovation analysis results identify such shocks only up to arbitrary componentwise invertible transformations, which is generally insufficient for structural econometric analysis. We strengthen this result by imposing a structured exponential-family specification for the conditional shock distributions. With the imposed sufficient statistics, the remaining ambiguity is reduced to a one-parameter transformed-scale map for each shock. We then show that, under a logistic specification used for the natural parameters, the identification is further strengthened up to permutation and componentwise sign changes. Once the shocks have been recovered, the fully nonlinear structural vector autoregression can be estimated using feed-forward neural networks, motivated by their universal approximation capabilities. The empirical application studies asymmetries in the responses of U.S. industrial production to the real oil price shock. We find modest asymmetries with respect to the sign of the shock and state of the economy. The accompanying R package iiasvar implements the introduced methods.
tldr: 提出一种完全非线性的结构VAR模型，利用独立创新分析识别冲击，并发现美国工业产出对油价冲击存在适度非对称性。
abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个完全非线性的结构向量自回归框架，其中同期结构映射可以是非线性且非加性的。识别通过利用由观测到的外生变量所引发的相互独立结构冲击的条件分布变化来实现。具体而言，采用一种通用的对比学习框架，结合这一变化以及假定的指数族结构来恢复冲击。现有的独立创新分析结果仅能在任意分量可逆变换的意义下识别此类冲击，这通常不足以进行结构计量分析。我们通过为条件冲击分布施加结构化的指数族设定来强化这一结果。在给定的充分统计量下，剩余的不确定性被缩减为每个冲击的单参数变换尺度映射。随后我们证明，在用于自然参数的逻辑斯蒂设定下，识别进一步被强化至排列和分量符号变化的不确定性。一旦冲击被恢复，完全非线性的结构向量自回归即可利用前馈神经网络进行估计，这得益于其通用逼近能力。实证应用研究了美国工业生产对实际油价冲击响应的非对称性。我们发现，相对于冲击的符号和经济状态，存在适度的非对称性。随附的R软件包iiasvar实现了所介绍的方法。

title: Bandwidth-Free Inference for Recursive Nonlinear Impulse Response Functions
abstract: Recursive nonlinear impulse responses require an estimated innovation law whenever the impact shock is normalized by innovation ranks and future innovations are integrated out. The closest semiparametric recursive construction in the literature estimates the relevant innovation quantile functions smoothly and discusses a direct empirical-residual implementation without developing its complete first-order inference theory. We tackle this gap in a finite-dimensional nonlinear structural autoregression with unrestricted continuous marginal innovation distributions and a fixed normal-rank shock. Our estimator replaces each innovation quantile function with the empirical quantile of generated structural residuals and iterates the same structural transition. For any fixed collection of responses, we establish a joint \sqrt{T} asymptotic linear representation with four components: direct transition estimation, the effect of transition estimation on residual order statistics, ordinary innovation-quantile estimation, and the shifted impact quantile. After projection through the recursion, the quantile terms admit a residual-rank-and-spacing representation, yielding feasible inference without innovation-density estimation or quantile smoothing. We then characterize the propagated bias from smoothing, establish validity of a full recursive residual bootstrap, and derive the additional covariance contribution from a finite number of simulated paths, providing bandwidth-free inference for the empirical-residual version of the same normal-rank response used in the smooth recursive construction.
tldr: 提出一种无需带宽选择的递归非线性脉冲响应函数推断方法，通过经验分位数和残差排序实现可行的联合渐近推断，并验证了bootstrap的有效性。
abstract_cn: 递归非线性脉冲响应要求在冲击通过创新秩进行归一化且未来创新被积分掉时，估计一个创新法则。文献中最接近的半参数递归构造方法平滑地估计相关的创新分位数函数，并讨论了一种直接的经验残差实现，但未发展其完整的一阶推断理论。我们在一类有限维非线性结构自回归中填补了这一空白，该模型具有无约束的连续边际创新分布和固定的正态秩冲击。我们的估计量用生成的结构残差的经验分位数替代每个创新分位数函数，并迭代相同的结构转移。对于任意固定的响应集合，我们建立了联合的\(\sqrt{T}\)渐近线性表示，包含四个组成部分：直接转移估计、转移估计对残差次序统计量的影响、普通创新分位数估计，以及平移后的冲击分位数。经过递归投影后，分位数项具有残差秩与间距表示，从而无需创新密度估计或分位数平滑即可进行可行的推断。随后，我们刻画了平滑引起的传播偏差，建立了完整递归残差自助法的有效性，并推导了有限数量模拟路径带来的额外协方差贡献，从而为平滑递归构造中使用的同一正态秩响应的经验残差版本提供了无需带宽的推断。

title: When Predictions Become Regressors: A Split-Sample Correction for Biases in Downstream Inference
abstract: Prediction-based methods, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and other machine learning techniques, are often used to construct measures of political phenomena that are difficult to quantify directly, such as policy positions in manifestos or emotions expressed on social media. In many applications, these prediction-generated measures are used as explanatory variables in regression models, even though they are measured with error. This leads to biased estimates. In this paper, we propose a simple solution to these biases: instrumental variables constructed from multiple measures created on independent splits of the original data. This approach is theoretically valid, easy to implement, and does not require new data. Through simulations, we show that this approach recovers estimates close to the true values, even in relatively small samples, while the standard approach can produce substantial bias in practice. We illustrate the method by revisiting two applications: whether gendered speech affects legislative outcomes in the German Parliament, and whether political risk influences poverty alleviation programs in China.
tldr: 提出一种基于分割样本的工具变量方法，以纠正预测生成回归变量导致的估计偏差，并通过模拟和两个政治学应用进行验证。
abstract_cn: 基于预测的方法，包括大型语言模型（LLMs）及其他机器学习技术，常被用于构建难以直接量化的政治现象的度量指标，例如宣言中的政策立场或社交媒体上表达的情绪。在许多应用中，这些由预测生成的度量被用作回归模型中的解释变量，尽管它们存在测量误差。这会导致估计偏差。在本文中，我们提出了一种针对这些偏差的简单解决方案：基于对原始数据进行独立分割后生成的多个度量来构造工具变量。该方法在理论上有效，易于实施，且无需新数据。通过模拟研究，我们表明该方法即使在相对较小的样本中也能恢复接近真实值的估计，而标准方法在实践中可能产生显著偏差。我们通过重新审视两个应用案例来展示该方法：一是性别化言论是否影响德国议会的立法结果，二是政治风险是否影响中国的扶贫项目。

title: Microstructural Foundations of Rough Noise
abstract: Recently, it has been proposed to model the microstructure noise in prices by a continuous-time process with continuous sample paths that are rougher than those of a standard Brownian motion. In this paper, we propose a microstructural model for the tick-by-tick price changes that explicitly separates the permanent price changes from the fleeting price changes due to noise. We show how this model converges to a standard semimartingale model for the permanent price process, plus a rough noise term originating from the fleeting price changes on the macro scale. This provides a microstructural foundation for the rough-noise model. We then develop a GMM estimation method applicable to tick-by-tick data, together with a formal test for rough noise. We show that the estimator and test work in finite samples through a simulation study, and apply them to tick-by-tick data on Dow Jones Industrial Average constituents in 2024. Because our estimator is designed for tick-by-tick data, we estimate roughness at the daily level, revealing substantial day-to-day variation. We find that rough noise, while present, is not universal: even when detected, the roughness index is typically close to zero, and it is most pronounced on days dominated by short-run price reversals.

title: Producing Policy Recommendations: from Statistical Decision Theory to Empirical Practice
abstract: Applied research in economics is intrinsically motivated by broad normative objectives. However, it is not obvious how a researcher should direct their efforts to produce evidence toward such objectives. This paper reviews recent theoretical developments on research design for policy choice and provides new tools applied researchers can use to guide their design choices and communicate their policy recommendations. First, I focus on theoretical contributions in econometrics and provide a general framework that nests all the contexts and results reviewed using a coherent notation and narrative. Then, I present two diagrams applied researchers can use to navigate the theoretical literature starting from concrete scenarios to make thoughtful design choices. Finally, I introduce a new R package that produces one table and two figures applied researchers can plug in their `policy implications' section to provide evidence on the performance of different policy recommendations coming out of their study. The use of such tools is illustrated with an example in development economics.
tldr: 该论文综述并扩展了统计决策理论，为应用研究者提供工具（包括R包）以优化政策建议的设计和沟通，并以发展经济学为例说明。
abstract_cn: 经济学中的应用研究本质上是由广泛的规范性目标所驱动的。然而，研究者应如何引导其努力以产生支持这些目标的证据，这一点并不显而易见。本文回顾了近期关于政策选择研究设计的理论进展，并提供了应用研究者可用来指导其设计选择及传达政策建议的新工具。首先，我聚焦于计量经济学中的理论贡献，并构建了一个通用框架，该框架以一致的符号和叙述方式涵盖了所回顾的所有情境与结果。接着，我提出了两个图表，应用研究者可借此从具体场景出发，在理论文献中导航，以做出深思熟虑的设计选择。最后，我介绍了一个新的R软件包，该软件包生成一张表格和两幅图形，应用研究者可将其嵌入其“政策含义”部分，以提供关于其研究所得不同政策建议表现情况的证据。文中通过一个发展经济学中的实例展示了这些工具的使用方法。

title: When Does Party Convergence Persist under Alienation-Based Abstention?
abstract: In the standard Downsian model, two office-seeking parties converge to the median voter. However alienated voters may abstain and turn out only for a party within their tolerance radius. For single-peaked voter distributions, convergence survives but relocates to a central voter, the median of the electorate that participates at the convergent platform. However single-peakedness of the voter distribution is an empirically contested assumption. So we first characterize pure-strategy equilibrium for any continuous voter distribution. For general distributions, pure-strategy equilibrium can fail to exist or be non-unique, and existence of equilibrium need not persist as the tolerance radius of the voters increases. In order to resolve these issues, we propose a fundamental object: \emph{centripetal} structure for which there is a single anchor platform toward which competition always pulls. We show this structure produces convergence at equilibrium under alienation based abstention. Our main result concerns the emergence and persistence of this new structure as the tolerance radius increases. Even though equilibria for office-seeking parties themselves can vanish and reappear as the radius grows, once centripetal structure emerges, it persists as long as the midpoint voter is not alienated. Moreover, the centripetal structure always emerges, and this structure classifies equilibrium completely when parties are policy motivated.
tldr: 该论文通过形式模型分析在选民因疏离而弃权的情况下，政党竞争何时会收敛到中间选民，并引入向心结构概念，证明其出现和持续性。
abstract_cn: 在标准唐斯模型中，两个追求执政的政党会收敛于中位选民。然而，疏离的选民可能弃权，并且只会投票给处于其容忍半径范围内的政党。对于单峰选民分布而言，收敛依然存在，但会移至一个中心选民——即在收敛平台上参与投票的选民群体的中位数。然而，选民分布的单峰性在实证上是一个备受争议的假设。因此，我们首先刻画任意连续选民分布下的纯策略均衡。对于一般分布，纯策略均衡可能不存在或非唯一，并且均衡的存在性不一定会随着选民容忍半径的增大而持续。为解决这些问题，我们提出一个基本对象：\emph{向心}结构，该结构存在一个单一的锚定平台，竞争始终被拉向该平台。我们证明，在基于疏离的弃权机制下，该结构在均衡处产生收敛。我们的主要结果关注随着容忍半径增大，这一新结构的出现与持续性。尽管追求执政的政党的均衡本身可能随半径增大而消失并重新出现，但一旦向心结构出现，只要中点选民未被疏离，该结构就会持续存在。此外，向心结构总是会出现，并且当政党具有政策动机时，该结构能完全对均衡进行分类。

title: Effort without Evidence
abstract: Actions determine not only payoffs but what can be learned. I study communication across successive decision makers when hidden effort governs public evidence and a sender motivates her successor while underweighting effort cost. Common sender rankings can force every message into a Bayes-unavoidable nonidentifying region. If experimentation is costly, strong motivation can make persuasive encouragement incredible and produce inactivity after a confounded failure. If maximal effort is technologically saturated, the same bias can produce universal overexertion after a bad pooled history, which is equally uninformative. At such nodes collapse is monotone: once strong motivation eliminates the identifying action, strengthening it cannot restore information. Moderate motivation instead preserves causal distinctions. In a threshold application, stronger motivation raises measured success yet lowers welfare because society fails to learn that less effort would suffice. A Kullback--Leibler decomposition shows that certification directly adds no information after entry into a fixed recursively nonidentifying region. Whether it prevents entry depends on attribution--selection alignment: do certificate-induced posteriors preserve the identifying action? The corrective action payment changes sign across technologies---subsidize effort when agents do too little, but subsidize restraint when maximal effort is saturated. Motivation selects the costly action, not the informative one.
tldr: 研究隐藏努力如何影响公共证据和决策者间的沟通，发现动机过强会导致信息无法识别，并探讨了纠正性支付的设计。
abstract_cn: 行动不仅决定收益，还决定能够学到什么。我研究在隐藏努力支配公共证据、且发送者在低估努力成本的情况下激励其继任者时，连续决策者之间的沟通。常见的发送者排序可能迫使每一条信息都落入贝叶斯不可避免的不可识别区域。如果实验是有成本的，强烈的激励可能使说服性鼓励变得不可信，并在混杂失败后导致不作为。如果最大努力在技术上已达到饱和，同样的偏差可能在糟糕的混合历史之后产生普遍的过度努力，而这同样不具信息量。在这些节点上，崩溃是单调的：一旦强烈的激励消除了可识别的行动，强化激励无法恢复信息。而适度的激励则能保留因果区分。在一个阈值应用中，更强的激励提高了可观测的成功率，却降低了福利，因为社会未能认识到较少的努力就足够了。Kullback-Leibler分解表明，在进入固定的递归不可识别区域后，认证本身不再增加任何信息。认证是否能阻止进入取决于归因与选择的对齐：认证诱导的后验是否保留了可识别的行动？矫正性行动支付在不同技术下符号相反——当代理人做得太少时补贴努力，但当最大努力饱和时补贴克制。激励选择的是代价高昂的行动，而非信息丰富的行动。

title: Stable Matching with Payoff Guarantees
abstract: We consider a variant of the Assignment Game of Shapley and Shubik (1971), where agents do not observe the assignment or the surplus division of other matched pairs. We propose a set-valued solution concept (Self-Stabilizing Set) and characterize the largest such set. This leads to the formulation of the Stable Payoff Guarantee (SPG) set, which assumes that agents receive at least their payoff guarantees and that this is common knowledge. Our main result is that, for generic surplus matrices, the SPG set consists only of the efficient assignment. The associated payoff vectors are given by the smallest interval that contains the worker-optimal and firm-optimal stable payoffs.
tldr: 该论文研究不完全信息下的稳定匹配问题，提出自稳定集和稳定支付保证集，证明在一般盈余矩阵下SPG集仅包含有效配置。
abstract_cn: 我们考虑Shapley和Shubik（1971）所提出的指派博弈的一种变体，在该变体中，代理人无法观察到其他匹配对的指派结果或盈余分配情况。我们提出了一种集值解概念（自稳定集），并刻画了最大的此类集合。这引出了稳定支付保证（SPG）集的表述，该集合假设代理人至少获得其支付保证，且这一事实是共同知识。我们的主要结果是，对于一般的盈余矩阵，SPG集仅包含有效指派。相应的支付向量由包含工人最优和企业最优稳定支付的最小区间给出。

title: Optimal Liability Design for Medical AI
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into medical decision-making, yet its liability implications remain complex, particularly when physicians differ in diagnostic skills and their quality is unobservable. This paper develops a principal-agent model in which a social planner designs medical liability to regulate a physician with private quality information who chooses between a standard treatment, a personalized judgment-based treatment, or following an imperfect AI recommendation. Our analysis yields several novel insights. First, we show that the optimal mechanism under asymmetric information is surprisingly simple: a uniform, one-size-fits-all liability level for all physician types who deviate from the standard of care. Despite physician heterogeneity, this simple policy often achieves the full-information first-best outcome, particularly when standard care is reliable or AI is highly accurate. Second, the relationship between AI accuracy and optimal liability is non-monotonic. Contrary to common intuition, better AI does not always imply more relaxed liability. As AI accuracy increases, the optimal liability either decreases monotonically or follows an inverted-U pattern, depending on the uncertainty of the standard treatment. Third, asymmetric information does not universally reduce social welfare. Welfare loss arises only when standard care is unreliable and AI accuracy is too low; even then, its magnitude follows an inverted U-shape, initially increasing as AI complicates the regulatory problem, but declining as more accurate AI helps mitigate it. Finally, we find that information asymmetry is a double-edged sword in the presence of AI, and greater transparency does not benefit all stakeholders equally.
tldr: 本文通过委托代理模型研究医疗AI的责任设计，发现统一责任水平在信息不对称下可实现最优，且AI准确性与责任水平呈非单调关系。
abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）正日益融入医疗决策之中，然而其责任归属问题依然复杂，尤其是在医生诊断技能存在差异且其质量不可观测的情况下。本文构建了一个委托—代理模型，在该模型中，社会规划者设计医疗责任机制，以规制拥有私人质量信息、并在标准治疗、基于个人判断的个性化治疗以及遵循不完美AI建议之间进行选择的医生。我们的分析得出了若干新颖的见解。首先，我们证明，在信息不对称条件下，最优机制出乎意料地简单：对所有偏离标准诊疗规范的医生类型，实行统一、一刀切的责任水平。尽管医生存在异质性，但这一简单政策往往能够实现完全信息下的最优结果，尤其是在标准治疗可靠或AI高度准确的情况下。其次，AI准确度与最优责任水平之间的关系是非单调的。与常见直觉相反，更优的AI并不总是意味着更宽松的责任。随着AI准确度的提高，最优责任水平要么单调递减，要么呈现倒U型模式，具体取决于标准治疗的不确定性。第三，信息不对称并不总是降低社会福利。只有当标准治疗不可靠且AI准确度过低时，福利损失才会出现；即便如此，其幅度也呈倒U型，起初随着AI使监管问题复杂化而增大，随后随着更准确的AI有助于缓解这一问题而下降。最后，我们发现，在AI存在的情况下，信息不对称是一把双刃剑，而更高的透明度并不会使所有利益相关者均等受益。

title: Optimising for Flourishing: Flourishing Metrics and Return on Flourishing as Success Criteria for Artificial Intelligence and Post-AGI Economic Systems
abstract: Current evaluation frameworks for artificial intelligence focus mainly on capability, safety, and proxies such as adoption, engagement, efficiency, productivity, and financial return. These criteria are necessary but insufficient because they do not establish whether increasingly powerful systems improve or degrade human and planetary well-being. Through an integrative conceptual synthesis, we argue that human flourishing should serve as a primary success criterion for artificial intelligence, the global race to develop increasingly capable AI systems, and prospective post-AGI economic systems. We make three contributions. First, Flourishing Metrics provides an extensible framework spanning physical, emotional, financial, relational, spiritual, and planetary well-being, combining validated subjective measures with representative behavioural, organisational, community, and environmental indicators. Second, Return on Flourishing (RoF) extends return on investment by evaluating the counterfactual contribution of interventions, policies, and AI systems to flourishing relative to their resources, risks, and opportunity costs. Third, we develop distribution-sensitive safeguards and show how RoF could guide AI-enabled work redesign, institutional appraisal, assurance, and post-deployment monitoring through business pilots. We formalise flourishing as a dynamic system variable while emphasising the need for democratic specification, empirical calibration, independent validation, and protection against unacceptable losses within particular dimensions or stakeholder groups. RoF is proposed not as a universal reward function, but as a value-accounting and decision architecture for assessing whether intelligence, automation, and economic transformation generate durable human and planetary progress.
tldr: 提出以人类繁荣为核心的人工智能和后AGI经济系统评估框架，包括繁荣指标和繁荣回报（RoF），用于指导AI系统设计和经济决策。
abstract_cn: 当前人工智能的评估框架主要聚焦于能力、安全性以及采用率、参与度、效率、生产力和财务回报等代理指标。这些标准虽属必要，但尚不充分，因为它们无法判定日益强大的AI系统究竟是在改善还是损害人类与地球的福祉。通过整合性概念综合，我们认为，人类繁荣应当成为人工智能、全球范围内日益激烈的AI能力竞赛以及未来通用人工智能（AGI）后经济体系的首要成功标准。我们做出三项贡献。第一，提出“繁荣度量”（Flourishing Metrics）框架，涵盖身体、情感、财务、关系、精神与地球福祉等维度，将经过验证的主观测量与具有代表性的行为、组织、社区和环境指标相结合。第二，提出“繁荣回报”（Return on Flourishing, RoF），将投资回报率（ROI）扩展为评估干预措施、政策及AI系统相对于其资源、风险和机会成本对繁荣的反事实贡献。第三，我们开发了具有分配敏感性的保障机制，并展示了RoF如何通过商业试点指导AI赋能的工作再设计、机构评估、保障及部署后监测。我们将繁荣形式化为一个动态系统变量，同时强调民主化定义、经验校准、独立验证以及防止特定维度或利益相关群体遭受不可接受损失的必要性。RoF并非作为通用奖励函数提出，而是作为一种价值核算与决策架构，用于评估智能、自动化及经济转型是否能够带来持久的人类与地球进步。

title: A unifying perspective on the collapse to the mean for law-invariant functionals
abstract: We revisit the ``collapse to the mean'' phenomenon, which refers to mild structural conditions, such as local linearity, that force a law-invariant functional $\ph$ defined on finite-mean random variables to depend solely on the expectation of its argument $X$, and not on any other distributional feature. Starting from a concise characterisation of the convex order, our simplified approach unifies and extends existing results without assuming the functional to be convex or monotone in the almost-sure order, and clarifies the conceptual foundations of the ``collapse to the mean" phenomenon. In addition, we establish a new ``dual collapse'' result for quasi-star-shaped functionals.
tldr: 该论文从凸序的刻画出发，统一并扩展了关于律不变泛函'collapse to the mean'现象的现有结果，并建立了拟星形泛函的对偶collapse结果。
abstract_cn: 我们重新审视“均值坍缩”现象，该现象指的是某些温和的结构条件（如局部线性）会迫使定义在有限均值随机变量上的律不变泛函$\ph$仅依赖于其自变量$X$的期望，而不依赖于任何其他分布特征。从凸序的一个简洁刻画出发，我们提出的简化方法统一并推广了现有结果，且无需假设该泛函在几乎必然序下是凸的或单调的，同时厘清了“均值坍缩”现象的概念基础。此外，我们为拟星形泛函建立了一个新的“对偶坍缩”结果。

tldr: 研究中央银行可信度为何减弱但不崩溃，基于货币政策优先级的转变，属于货币政策领域。

analysis.chinese_title: 中央银行可信度为何削弱而不崩溃？来自货币政策优先级转变的证据
analysis.summary: 本文以土耳其为案例，研究政治主导下中央银行可信度的演变。传统观点认为持续偏离通胀目标会导致可信度近乎完全崩溃，但土耳其经验显示可信度虽大幅恶化但未消失。作者采用多维框架测量可信度，包括基于目标的指标、预期传导、动态锚定、预测不确定性和概率分布指标，发现通胀预期虽偏离官方目标，但并未完全脱离央行沟通，而是系统性地限制在可预测范围内。第二阶段，作者在政治主导框架下解释这些发现，认为货币政策的实际目标从价格稳定转向增长和就业，可信度可能以“可信度下限”形式存在，反映政策制度的可预测性和内部一致性，而非通胀目标锚。论文提供了关于货币政策可信度的新概念视角。
innovations: 提出“可信度下限”概念，解释可信度削弱但不崩溃的现象。
采用多维框架测量可信度，结合目标、传导、不确定性等指标。
区分名义授权与实际授权，强调政治主导下政策目标重加权。
使用央行预测区间与私人预期分布的比较，揭示预期有界性。
将政治主导纳入可信度分析，拓展传统通胀目标制框架。
analysis.methodology: 论文采用两阶段实证策略。第一阶段，使用多种可信度测量方法：基于Bomfim-Rudebusch框架的时变参数模型（状态空间形式，卡尔曼滤波）估计目标权重；基于Jochmann-Koop-Potter方法的滚动VAR估计预期传导系数；比较私人预期分布与央行预测区间；使用调查概率分布数据。第二阶段，通过描述性分析和加权痛苦指数，解释可信度下限与政治主导的关系。
analysis.key_results: 研究发现，土耳其央行可信度在2013年后逐渐下降，2017年后加速，2021年后稳定在较低水平，但未崩溃。基于目标的时变参数估计显示可信度参数稳定在0.6左右。滚动VAR传导系数在2017-2020年上升至0.18，2020-2023年回落至0.10，表明预期传导减弱但未完全脱锚。私人预期在2021年后高于央行预测区间上界，但偏离有限。加权痛苦指数显示2022-2024年高通胀低失业与早期观察相比，失业权重为18倍。

strengths: 提出新颖概念“可信度下限”，丰富可信度理论。
多维测量框架全面，增强结论稳健性。

实证方法严谨，区分测量与解释。

未提供正式统计检验，部分结论基于描述性分析。

title: An Empirical Analysis of the Impact of Non-Performing Loan Ratios on the Profitability of Commercial Banks in Nepal
abstract: This study is aimed at empirically analyzing the effect of non-performing loan (NPL) ratios on the profitability of commercial banks. The non-performing loans are highly considered to be an important causal factor in credit risk and a major menace to the financial stability. The data were gathered with the help of a quantitative research design by analyzing the published annual reports that included ten commercial banks in Nepal during a three-year period (2023-2025). Profitability was calculated through the use of the return on assets (ROA), whereas NPLs ratios became the key independent variable. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, Pearson correlation analysis, and the multiple linear regression in order to define the level and direction of relationship between NPLs and profitability. Both results show a strong negative relationship between NPL ratios and ROA, thus, the increase in the levels of non-performing loans is connected with the decrease in the bank profitability. Regression analysis also affirmed that NPL ratios are a statistically significant predictor of ROA (p < 0.05), which is why we can conclude that effective management of credit risks is an important factor in maintaining the performance of banks. The findings point to the fact that the quality of loans and low default rates will always result in higher and better indicators of profitability in banks. This research adds to the literature by giving empirical data of the commercial banking industry in Nepal and the significance of active credit monitoring, increasing underwriting criteria, and developing of effective recovery systems. The implications of the findings are significant to the bank managers and policymakers who want to improve the financial stability and sustain profitability.

tldr: 该论文通过回归分析尼泊尔十家商业银行2023-2025年数据，发现不良贷款率与资产收益率显著负相关，强调信用风险管理对银行盈利的重要性。
abstract_cn: 本研究旨在实证分析不良贷款率对商业银行盈利能力的影响。不良贷款被广泛认为是信用风险的重要成因，也是对金融稳定的重大威胁。本研究采用定量研究设计，通过分析尼泊尔十家商业银行在三年期间（2023—2025年）发布的年度报告来收集数据。盈利能力通过资产回报率（ROA）来衡量，而不良贷款率则作为关键自变量。研究运用描述性统计、皮尔逊相关分析及多元线性回归对数据进行分析，以确定不良贷款与盈利能力之间关系的强度和方向。两项结果均显示，不良贷款率与资产回报率之间存在显著的负相关关系，即不良贷款水平的上升与银行盈利能力的下降相关联。回归分析进一步证实，不良贷款率是资产回报率的统计显著预测因子（p < 0.05），因此可以得出结论：有效的信用风险管理是维持银行绩效的重要因素。研究结果表明，贷款质量的提升和较低的违约率将始终带来更高、更优的银行盈利指标。本研究通过提供尼泊尔商业银行业的实证数据，以及积极信贷监控、提高承保标准和建立有效回收机制的重要性，为相关文献作出了贡献。研究结论对旨在提升金融稳定性和维持盈利能力的银行管理者及政策制定者具有重要的参考意义。

analysis.chinese_title: 尼泊尔商业银行不良贷款率对盈利能力影响的实证分析
analysis.summary: 本研究旨在实证分析不良贷款率对尼泊尔商业银行盈利能力的影响。研究采用定量研究设计，通过分析2023-2025年尼泊尔十家商业银行的公开年报数据，以资产收益率（ROA）衡量盈利能力，以不良贷款率（NPLR）为主要自变量，并控制资本充足率（CAR）和贷存比（LDR）。研究使用描述性统计、Pearson相关分析和多元线性回归分析。结果显示，不良贷款率与ROA呈显著负相关（r=-0.61, p<0.01），回归分析也证实NPLR是ROA的显著预测因子（β=-0.47, p=0.012），表明不良贷款率上升会显著降低银行盈利能力。研究结论强调有效管理信用风险对维持银行绩效的重要性，并为尼泊尔商业银行的信贷监控、承销标准和回收机制提供了政策建议。
innovations: 聚焦尼泊尔商业银行2023-2025年最新数据，填补了后疫情时期该领域实证研究的空白。
采用描述性统计、相关分析和回归分析相结合的方法，全面揭示不良贷款率与盈利能力的关系。
将资本充足率和贷存比作为控制变量，更准确地分离出不良贷款率的独立影响。
结合图表直观展示不良贷款率与ROA的负相关趋势，增强结论的可视化说服力。
研究结果支持“坏管理假说”和“代理理论”，为理解银行治理与信用风险提供了新证据。
analysis.methodology: 研究采用定量研究设计，通过分析尼泊尔十家商业银行2023-2025年的年度报告和经审计的财务报表收集数据。样本选择采用目的性抽样，兼顾合资和私营机构。盈利能力以资产收益率（ROA）衡量，不良贷款率（NPLR）为主要自变量，资本充足率（CAR）和贷存比（LDR）为控制变量。数据分析使用SPSS 25，包括描述性统计、Pearson相关分析和多元线性回归。回归模型为ROA = β0 + β1*NPLR + β2*CAR + β3*LDR + ε，并检验了正态性、多重共线性和同方差性等假设，显著性水平设为p<0.05。
analysis.key_results: 描述性统计显示，样本银行平均NPLR为3.27%，平均ROA为1.14%，平均CAR为13.45%，平均LDR为80.12%。相关分析表明NPLR与ROA呈显著负相关（r=-0.61, p<0.01），CAR和LDR与ROA的相关性不显著。回归分析显示模型整体显著（F(3,26)=12.46, p<0.001），调整R²为0.52，NPLR的标准化系数β=-0.47（p=0.012），CAR和LDR的系数不显著。图1显示NPLR从2023年的3.5%下降至2025年的3.0%，同期ROA从1.05%上升至1.25%。
strengths: 研究聚焦尼泊尔商业银行，填补了后疫情时期该地区实证研究的空白。
采用多种统计方法，从描述性统计到回归分析，全面揭示变量关系。
使用公开年报数据，透明且可复制。
研究结果与理论（坏管理假说、代理理论）相呼应，增强了理论贡献。
提供了政策建议，对银行管理者和监管者具有实践意义。
limitations: 样本仅包括十家商业银行，可能无法代表整个尼泊尔银行业。
研究时间跨度仅为三年（2023-2025），可能无法捕捉长期趋势。
仅使用ROA作为盈利指标，未考虑其他指标如净资产收益率（ROE）。
控制变量有限，可能遗漏其他影响盈利能力的因素。
数据来源为年报，可能存在报告偏差。
