title: Beyond the Grid: Cost, Carbon, and Capital Requirements of On-Site Power Technologies for AI Data Centers
abstract: Interconnection queues, not electricity prices, now govern where data centers can be built, and the standard levelized-cost comparison answers a question no developer faces: it assumes a load profile, freezes the grid price while modeling the demand that moves it, and quotes busbar costs a facility cannot buy. This paper evaluates nine on-site supply technologies against a delivered grid whose price is endogenous to projected data-center demand, on a complete-site basis that retains standby charges, with measured GPU training load, delivered fuel prices, production-pathway carbon, and statutory 45V and 48E incentive mechanics. Nothing beats the wire: gas combined cycle produces at 47 USD/MWh but costs about 114 USD per megawatt-hour of complete site energy against a 92 USD grid; four-hour storage is physically capped near 18 percent of annual energy and, charged at the margin, dirtier than the grid; hydrogen from grid-priced power fails on cost and carbon together. An investment inversion converts these findings into capital terms: conversion-hardware learning buys nothing, because free hardware still exceeds the grid for every low-carbon arm, while global electrolyser deployment on sited sub-20 USD/MWh power brings PEM hydrogen power to about 2.2 times the grid at 300 billion USD and 1.9 times at 1 trillion USD (2.7 and 2.3 for the hydrogen engine), with a carbon reduction of roughly 85 percent (6.8-fold) against grid-power production. Grid parity is not purchasable at any budget. On-site supply is an access and depth product; most current investment targets the wrong term.
tldr: 该论文评估九种现场供电技术相对于电网的成本、碳排放和资本需求，发现现场供电无法达到电网平价，主要结论是现场供电是接入和深度产品，当前投资目标错误。
abstract_cn: 互联排队，而非电价，如今决定了数据中心可以建在哪里，而标准的平准化成本比较回答的是一个没有开发者会面对的问题：它假设一个负荷曲线，在模拟会改变电网价格的负荷的同时冻结电网价格，并报出设施无法购买到的母线成本。本文基于一个价格随数据中心预测需求内生变动的交付电网，在保留备用收费的完整场址基础上，评估九种现场供电技术，并使用实测GPU训练负荷、交付燃料价格、生产路径碳排放以及法定的45V和48E激励机制。没有任何方案能胜过电网供电：燃气联合循环发电成本为47美元/兆瓦时，但按完整场址能源计算，其成本约为每兆瓦时114美元，而电网为92美元；四小时储能物理上限约为年能源的18%，且按边际充电计算，其碳排放比电网更脏；使用电网电价电力制氢在成本和碳排两方面均不成立。一项投资反转将这些发现转化为资本层面的表述：转换硬件的学习曲线毫无价值，因为即使硬件免费，所有低碳方案仍无法低于电网成本；而在场址上部署全球电解槽、使用低于20美元/兆瓦时的电力，可将PEM氢电成本降至电网的约2.2倍（3000亿美元规模）和1.9倍（1万亿美元规模）（氢发动机则为2.7倍和2.3倍），同时相对于电网电力生产可实现约85%（6.8倍）的碳减排。在任何预算下都无法购买到电网平价。现场供电是一种接入和深度产品；当前大多数投资瞄准了错误的维度。

title: Partial Homogeneity in Staggered Difference-in-Differences
abstract: In staggered difference-in-differences (DiD) designs, units enter treatment at different calendar times, so the treatment effect is not a single number but a set of Cohort-Average Treatment effects on the Treated (CATTs), one per cohort-time cell. Estimating every CATT as its own parameter, as the standard fully flexible estimator does, is unbiased but inefficient when some of these effects are in fact equal, whereas pooling them all into a single two-way fixed effects (TWFE) coefficient is efficient but, whenever the heterogeneity is genuine, biased for the individual effects. We frame the choice between these extremes as a partition-selection problem on the cohort-time cells and address it with a Dirichlet Process (DP) mixture prior on the CATTs. The model favors parsimonious groupings without fixing their number, and a collapsed Gibbs sampler delivers point estimates, credible intervals that marginalize the unknown partition, and co-clustering probabilities for every pair of CATTs. With the error variance held fixed and a pairwise penalty placed on the partition, a maximum a posteriori (MAP) partition reduces to an $\ell_0$-penalized regression, connecting the Bayesian formulation to the homogeneity-pursuit literature. In a calibrated simulation, the model cuts the sampling variance of the cohort-time effects by 26--52\% relative to the fully flexible estimator, without the pooled estimator's bias, provided the distinct effects are separated enough to be recovered, and the posterior delivers near-nominal confidence-interval coverage by averaging over the unknown partition. In two applications the method recovers a precision-improving partial-homogeneity structure in one, where the cohort-time effects are genuinely heterogeneous, and reports that full pooling is adequate in the other, where they are not.
tldr: 提出一种基于Dirichlet过程混合先验的贝叶斯方法，用于在交错差分设计中识别部分同质性，提高估计效率。
abstract_cn: 在交错双重差分（DiD）设计中，各单元在不同日历时间进入处理状态，因此处理效应并非单一数值，而是一组“队列平均处理效应”（Cohort-Average Treatment effects on the Treated, CATTs），每个队列-时间单元格对应一个效应。标准完全灵活估计器将每个CATT作为独立参数进行估计，虽然无偏，但在某些效应实际上相等时效率较低；而将所有效应合并为一个双向固定效应（TWFE）系数则效率较高，但只要异质性真实存在，该估计器对个体效应便会产生偏误。我们将这两种极端之间的选择问题框架化为队列-时间单元格上的划分选择问题，并采用狄利克雷过程（Dirichlet Process, DP）混合先验对CATTs进行建模。该模型倾向于简约的分组结构，且无需预先固定组数；通过折叠吉布斯采样器，可获得点估计、边缘化未知划分的置信区间，以及每对CATT的共聚类概率。在误差方差固定且对划分施加成对惩罚的条件下，最大后验（MAP）划分可简化为$\ell_0$惩罚回归，从而将贝叶斯公式与同质性追踪文献联系起来。在校准模拟中，相对于完全灵活估计器，该模型将队列-时间效应的抽样方差降低了26%–52%，且不引入合并估计器的偏误，前提是不同效应之间的差异足够大以便被识别；同时，通过对未知划分进行平均，后验分布提供了接近名义水平的置信区间覆盖率。在两个实际应用中，该方法在一个案例中恢复了能提升精度的部分同质性结构（其中队列-时间效应确实存在异质性），并在另一个案例中报告完全合并是充分的（其中效应不存在异质性）。

title: A framework for assessing value and heterogeneity, illustrated using an early model of population screening with a multi-cancer early detection test
abstract: Introduction: We present a framework to assess the economic value of healthcare interventions by disaggregating value and examining heterogeneity. We applied it to an early health-economic model of population screening in England with a multi-cancer early detection (MCED) test. Value for such technologies often includes benefits, such as those associated with earlier detection, alongside potential harms from, for example, false positives or overdiagnosis. Value also varies between individuals, including across cancer types and stages. Understanding these components and heterogeneity is crucial for assessing overall value and prioritising future research. Methods: We adapted an existing decision-analytic model to simulate annual Galleri screening in an asymptomatic population, measuring outcomes in Quality Adjusted Life Years (QALYs) from an English NHS perspective (year of 2024). We disaggregate headroom value (assuming no cost to the test) into key components: cancer identification (pre- and post-diagnosis), false positives, overdiagnosis, and misclassification. Post diagnosis value was further disaggregated by cancer type to explore heterogeneity. Results: Our analysis predicts an overall estimated headroom value of 0.135 QALYs per individual. Early cancer identification was a major contributor, driven by health gains rather than cost savings. Cancers of the colon/rectum, lung and ovary were the largest contributors, accounting for 50% of overall value. These results remained robust across scenario analyses. Conclusion: The value disaggregation can guide decision making by clarifying value drivers, assessing plausibility of overall estimates, exploring heterogeneity, and prioritising future model and evidence development activities.
tldr: 该论文提出一个评估医疗干预经济价值并分解异质性的框架，并应用于英格兰多癌种早期检测筛查的卫生经济模型，结果显示早期识别是主要价值来源。
abstract_cn: 引言：我们提出一个框架，通过分解价值并检验异质性来评估医疗干预的经济价值。我们将其应用于英格兰人群筛查的早期卫生经济模型，该模型采用多癌种早期检测（MCED）测试。此类技术的价值通常包括与早期检测相关的获益，同时也涉及假阳性或过度诊断等潜在危害。价值在不同个体之间也存在差异，包括不同癌种和分期之间的差异。理解这些组成部分及其异质性对于评估总体价值和确定未来研究的优先顺序至关重要。方法：我们调整了一个现有的决策分析模型，以模拟无症状人群中每年一次的Galleri筛查，从英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）视角（2024年）以质量调整生命年（QALYs）衡量结局。我们将“无成本上限价值”（假设检测无成本）分解为关键组成部分：癌症识别（诊断前和诊断后）、假阳性、过度诊断和错误分类。诊断后价值进一步按癌种分解以探索异质性。结果：我们的分析预测，每名个体的总体无成本上限价值估计为0.135个QALYs。早期癌症识别是主要贡献因素，主要由健康获益而非成本节省驱动。结肠/直肠癌、肺癌和卵巢癌是最大的贡献者，占总体价值的50%。这些结果在情景分析中保持稳健。结论：价值分解可通过阐明价值驱动因素、评估总体估计的合理性、探索异质性以及确定未来模型和证据开发活动的优先顺序，为决策提供指导。

title: Associative Networks in Decision Making
abstract: We present a model of associative networks that captures how decision makers expand their consideration set through mental associations between alternatives. Our model provides a tractable approach to study how associations shape choice when some alternatives are available and others are merely observable but unavailable. We characterize the model within a random attention framework and demonstrate unique identification of all parameters. This framework delivers a unified account of several prominent choice anomalies, including classic menu effects and their ``phantom'' counterparts. We illustrate how associative links serve as a strategic variable in applications such as branding, imitation, and platform design.

title: Information for nothing and authority for free
abstract: A principal must decide whether to implement a project. She privately knows the cost, an agent privately knows the benefit. Monetary transfers are not available, and compared to the principal, the agent does not fully internalize the cost. We show that the principal-optimal mechanism does not require the agent to report. Instead, it either ignores the agent or endows the agent with free information and full decision authority.

title: Coalitional bargaining with transfers
abstract: We consider the problem of bargaining when transfers between agents are possible. Such situations are typically modelled as coalitional games with transferable utilities. However this model makes a strong implicit assumption: the outcome can only depend on the total surplus that each coalition of agents can achieve, not on which agents within the coalition generate the surplus. Is this assumption justified? We define a richer model in which solutions may depend on who generates the surplus. In this model, the classical axiomatisation of the Shapley value fails: a broad family of solutions satisfy efficiency, anonymity, the dummy property, and additivity. Nevertheless, we obtain an axiomatisation of the Shapley value in the richer model by adding continuity and a strengthening of the dummy property to the original axioms.
tldr: 该论文在允许转移支付的合作博弈中引入更丰富的模型，探讨解是否依赖于联盟内谁创造剩余，并证明在添加连续性和加强哑元性质后，Shapley值仍可被公理化。
abstract_cn: 我们考虑当代理人之间可以进行转移支付时的谈判问题。此类情形通常被建模为具有可转移效用的联盟博弈。然而，该模型隐含了一个强假设：结果只能取决于每个代理人联盟所能实现的总剩余，而不能取决于联盟内部哪些代理人创造了该剩余。这一假设是否合理？我们定义了一个更丰富的模型，在该模型中，解可以依赖于谁创造了剩余。在此模型中，Shapley值的经典公理化不再成立：一个广泛的解族满足效率性、匿名性、哑元性质以及可加性。尽管如此，通过在原始公理基础上增加连续性和对哑元性质的强化，我们在更丰富的模型中获得了Shapley值的一个公理化刻画。

title: Voting Method Synthesis on an Infinite Domain: A Possibility Theorem for Positive Involvement
abstract: A common problem in social choice is to determine whether there is a social choice procedure, such as a voting method, satisfying some desired criteria. Computer-aided methods such as SAT solving can sometimes answer these questions. However, under typical encodings, a SAT solver may only synthesize a voting method on a finite domain, while we may want one on an infinite domain, such as the domain of all preference profiles for a fixed number of candidates but any finite number of voters. In this paper, we use an approach based on reasoning with constrained Horn clauses and computation with polyhedra to synthesize a voting method on an infinite domain. We then use SMT and Lean to verify its properties. Our main result is a possibility theorem about four well-known criteria from voting theory: the Condorcet winner and loser criteria, positive involvement, and resolvability. Previous work has shown that for five or more candidates, there is no voting method satisfying these axioms, and that for four candidates, there is no method satisfying these core axioms plus one more invariance axiom. Here we show that for four candidates, there does exist a method satisfying the core axioms and more.
tldr: 该论文通过约束Horn子句和多面体计算，在无限域上综合了一种满足Condorcet胜者/败者标准、正参与性和可分辨性的投票方法，并利用SMT和Lean验证其性质，证明了四候选人情形下的可能性定理。
abstract_cn: 社会选择中的一个常见问题是，确定是否存在一种社会选择程序（例如投票方法）能够满足某些期望的标准。基于计算机辅助的方法（如SAT求解）有时可以回答这些问题。然而，在典型的编码方式下，SAT求解器可能只能在有限域上综合出一种投票方法，而我们可能希望在无限域上得到这样的方法，例如对于固定数量的候选人和任意有限数量的选民的所有偏好轮廓所构成的域。在本文中，我们采用一种基于约束Horn子句推理和多面体计算的方法，在无限域上综合出一种投票方法。然后，我们使用SMT和Lean来验证其性质。我们的主要结果是一个关于投票理论中四个著名标准的可能性定理：孔多塞赢家与输家标准、正向参与性以及可分辨性。先前的研究表明，对于五个或更多候选人的情况，不存在满足这些公理的投票方法；而对于四个候选人的情况，不存在满足这些核心公理再加上一个不变性公理的方法。在本文中，我们证明对于四个候选人的情况，确实存在一种满足核心公理及其他更多条件的方法。

title: From Product Search to Preference Articulation: The Economics of Agentic Commerce
abstract: Generative AI is shifting digital commerce from browsing toward agentic search, in which consumers delegate product discovery to AI agents. We compare manual search, which accurately evaluates a limited product set, with agentic search, which screens a broad catalog through noisy representations of preferences and products. Preference complexity is the number of satisfaction-relevant dimensions that are difficult to articulate before search but readily evaluated upon inspection. Consumers have finite attention and choose search intensity: products inspected manually or preference-refinement depth with an agent. We obtain three findings. First, manual search collapses beyond a finite complexity threshold: inspection ceases, mismatch reaches the no-search benchmark, and platform revenue falls to zero. Agentic search avoids this collapse. Once refinement becomes worthwhile, it remains worthwhile as complexity rises; mismatch stays below the no-search benchmark and revenue remains positive, although articulation effort and mismatch may increase. Second, platforms rank the regimes by conversion revenue, whereas consumers also bear search expenditure. When manual inspection is sufficiently inexpensive, agentic search becomes revenue-superior before consumers voluntarily adopt it, creating an adoption lag in which consumers rationally continue manual search. Third, conditional on agentic participation, platforms may assign lower fidelity to consumers with larger attention budgets because they can offset noisier representations through additional refinement, yielding an inverted fidelity allocation. Agentic commerce thus shifts scarcity from product inspection to preference articulation, making consumers' willingness and ability to interact central to voluntary use and platform fidelity design.
tldr: 研究生成式AI代理商务中消费者从产品搜索到偏好表达的转变，比较手动搜索与代理搜索的经济效应，发现代理搜索可避免手动搜索的崩溃，但存在采用滞后和保真度分配问题。
abstract_cn: 生成式人工智能正在将数字商务从浏览模式转向代理式搜索，在这一模式中，消费者将产品发现委托给AI代理。我们比较了人工搜索与代理式搜索：前者能够精确评估有限的产品集合，后者则通过对偏好和产品的噪声表征来筛选广泛的产品目录。偏好复杂性是指那些在搜索前难以言明、但在检视时却易于评估的、与满意度相关的维度数量。消费者拥有有限的注意力，并选择搜索强度：即人工检视的产品数量，或与代理进行偏好细化的深度。我们获得三项发现。第一，人工搜索在超过某个有限的复杂性阈值后便会崩溃：检视停止，错配达到无搜索基准水平，平台收入降至零。代理式搜索则避免了这种崩溃。一旦细化变得值得，随着复杂性上升它仍然值得；错配保持在无搜索基准之下，收入保持为正，尽管表达努力和错配可能增加。第二，平台按转化收入对两种模式进行排序，而消费者还需承担搜索支出。当人工检视足够廉价时，代理式搜索在消费者自愿采用之前就已实现收入优势，从而产生一种采用滞后，在这一阶段消费者理性地继续选择人工搜索。第三，在代理参与的条件下，平台可能为注意力预算更大的消费者分配更低的保真度，因为他们可以通过额外的细化来抵消更噪声化的表征，从而形成一种倒置的保真度分配。因此，代理式商务将稀缺性从产品检视转移到偏好表达上，使消费者的互动意愿和能力成为自愿使用与平台保真度设计的核心。

title: Category of strategic games and presheaf corresponding solution concepts or welfare criteria
abstract: We define a category of strategic games in which a morphism is a pair of a map between sets of players and a map between sets of strategy profiles with specific properties, and we show that this category is well-defined. Three cases are considered for the maps between sets of strategy profiles: they may be order-preserving, order-reflecting or order-embedding with respect to each player's preference relation. We define a presheaf on the category of games valued in a category of sets that sends each strategic game to a set of strategy profiles, and we present equivalent conditions for this presheaf to be well-defined. Two cases are considered for the morphisms in the category of sets: they may be relations or maps. We define a presheaf that sends each strategic game to the set of Nash equilibria (resp.\ Pareto efficient strategy profiles), and we show that this presheaf is well-defined if and only if the maps between sets of strategy profiles are order-reflecting or order-embedding (resp.\ the maps between sets of strategy profiles are order-embedding), and the morphisms in the category of sets are relations.
tldr: 该论文定义了战略博弈的范畴，并研究了对应纳什均衡和帕累托效率策略配置的预层良定义条件，属于博弈论基础理论。

title: Learning under Opponent Unawareness in Linear-Quadratic Stochastic Games
abstract: As firms increasingly deploy machine learning for strategic decision-making, understanding algorithmic interactions has become central to operations research and economics. This paper studies learning in infinite-horizon, nonzero-sum linear-quadratic stochastic games under a radically uncoupled information structure, where players are either unaware of opponents or strategically oblivious, observing only a common state and their own action history. Under this minimal information, we analyze an asynchronous decentralized learning process in which each player independently runs a single-agent $ε$-greedy iterated least-squares algorithm. We prove that, despite being unable to identify the system parameters, players' learning dynamics converge almost surely to the complete-information Nash equilibrium and characterize the convergence rate. We then apply the framework to a dynamic Cournot competition with sticky prices. Numerical experiments validate the theoretical results and show that learning under limited information reduces firm profits under both low and high price stickiness, while total surplus declines and market concentration increases when price stickiness is high. Publicly revealing aggregate market output substantially accelerates convergence and mitigates these welfare losses.
tldr: 该论文研究在对手不知情的情况下，线性二次随机博弈中的异步去中心化学习算法，并应用于动态古诺竞争，证明学习动态几乎必然收敛到完全信息纳什均衡。
abstract_cn: 随着企业越来越多地将机器学习应用于战略决策，理解算法交互已成为运筹学与经济学的核心议题。本文研究在无限时域、非零和线性二次随机博弈中，在一种极端非耦合信息结构下的学习问题，其中参与者要么不了解对手，要么在战略上忽视对手，仅观察共同状态及自身行动历史。在此最小信息条件下，我们分析了一种异步去中心化学习过程，其中每个参与者独立运行单智能体ε-贪心迭代最小二乘算法。我们证明，尽管参与者无法识别系统参数，其学习动态几乎必然收敛至完全信息纳什均衡，并刻画了收敛速率。随后，我们将该框架应用于具有价格粘性的动态古诺竞争。数值实验验证了理论结果，并表明在有限信息下学习会降低企业在高、低价格粘性情形下的利润，而在高价格粘性时总剩余下降且市场集中度上升。公开披露总体市场产出能显著加速收敛并缓解这些福利损失。

title: A Fair Objective for Human-Empowerment-Preserving AI: Desiderata, Design, and Likely Behavioral Consequences
abstract: This paper explores the idea of promoting well-being and safety in human-AI interactions by forcing AI agents explicitly to empower humans and to manage the power balance between humans and AI agents in a desirable way. Using a principled, partially axiomatic approach based on desirable properties, we design a parametrizable and decomposable objective function for AI systems that represents an inequality- and risk-averse long-term aggregate of human power. It can take into account models of human bounded rationality and social norms, and crucially, considers a wide variety of possible human goals. We prove how certain desiderata enforce particular functional forms and restrict parameter ranges. We exemplify the consequences of softly maximizing this metric in several paradigmatic situations and describe what instrumental sub-goals it will likely imply.
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于公理设计的、可参数化的目标函数，用于AI系统以增强人类权力并管理权力平衡，并通过理论分析和示例展示其行为后果。
abstract_cn: 本文探讨了通过强制人工智能体明确地赋予人类权力，并以理想方式管理人类与人工智能体之间的权力平衡，来促进人机交互中福祉与安全性的理念。基于合意属性的原则性、部分公理化方法，我们为人工智能系统设计了一个可参数化且可分解的目标函数，该函数表征了人类权力的不平等规避与风险规避的长期聚合。该函数能够考虑人类有限理性与社会规范的模型，并且关键在于，它涵盖了广泛可能的人类目标。我们证明了某些合意属性如何强制特定的函数形式并限制参数范围。我们通过在若干典型情境中软性最大化这一度量的后果进行了例证，并描述了其可能隐含的工具性子目标。

title: College Admissions with Scholarship
abstract: Merit-based scholarships are widely used to attract high-achieving students, but do they guarantee an improvement in the merit of a university's student pool? We study this question in centralized college admissions using a matching with contracts framework. We first introduce the scholarship choice rule, which processes scholarship levels from highest to lowest and selects the highest-merit students at each level. We show that scholarship feasibility, scholarship maximality, and no justified envy uniquely characterize this rule. We further characterize the student-proposing deferred-acceptance mechanism based on this rule as the unique mechanism, up to outcome equivalence, satisfying the extensions of the three axioms, together with individual rationality, and strategy-proofness. We then study the welfare effects of scholarship provision. In general matching markets, a university may be matched with lower-merit students after introducing a scholarship. Finally, when all schools use the scholarship choice rule and every student is eligible for every scholarship level a school offers, we show that a common merit ranking is necessary and sufficient for scholarship provision to guarantee, for every student-preference profile satisfying within-school monotonicity, a weak improvement in the scholarship-providing school's student pool.
tldr: 该论文使用匹配与合同框架研究择优奖学金对大学录取学生质量的影响，提出了奖学金选择规则并刻画了其性质，发现奖学金不一定改善学生质量，并给出了保证改善的充分必要条件。
abstract_cn: 基于功绩的奖学金被广泛用于吸引成绩优异的学生，但它们是否一定能改善大学学生群体的质量？我们在集中式大学录取的背景下，运用带有契约的匹配框架来研究这一问题。我们首先引入奖学金选择规则，该规则从最高到最低处理奖学金等级，并在每个等级上选择功绩最高的学生。我们证明，奖学金可行性、奖学金最大性以及无合理嫉妒性唯一刻画了这一规则。我们进一步刻画了基于该规则的学生提议的延迟接受机制，证明在结果等价的意义上，它是唯一满足上述三个公理的扩展、个体理性以及策略防护性的机制。随后，我们研究了奖学金提供的福利效应。在一般匹配市场中，大学在引入奖学金后可能匹配到功绩较低的学生。最后，当所有学校都采用奖学金选择规则，且每位学生都有资格获得学校提供的每一个奖学金等级时，我们证明，共同的功绩排序是奖学金提供能够保证在满足校内单调性的每个学生偏好分布下，提供奖学金的学校学生群体得到弱改善的必要且充分条件。

title: A Note on Market Segmentation and Bertrand Competition
abstract: In this note, we show that equilibrium profit is zero in Bertrand competition with a finite number of firms and consumers whose willingness to pay are bounded, under any market segmentation profile.
tldr: 本文证明在有限企业和消费者且支付意愿有界的情况下，任何市场细分下Bertrand竞争的均衡利润为零。
abstract_cn: 在本注记中，我们证明，在伯特兰竞争（Bertrand competition）中，若企业数量有限且消费者的支付意愿（willingness to pay）有界，则在任意市场细分（market segmentation）情形下，均衡利润均为零。

title: The Institutional Window: Occupation- and Jurisdiction-Specific Calibration of Liability Signaling for Preserved Human Fallback Capability
abstract:
Problem definition. When generative AI produces expert artifacts clients cannot distinguish from a competent provider's, the classical cost-based quality signal collapses and only outcome-contingent commitments can separate types. Such a commitment certifies an endogenous, perishable asset: the human fallback capability a firm builds by keeping staff engaged with cases the AI handles, eroding otherwise. Prior work is silent on where that mechanism holds. We ask where, across occupations and liability institutions, it remains informative.
  Methodology/results. We introduce an institutional wedge between the liability cap a firm posts and the retained exposure that carries information, generated by four legal primitives: the cost rule, the enforceability of penalty clauses, the displacement of private liability by state liability or pooled indemnity, and mandatory limits on contractual liability. The wedge compresses the separating type space into a signaling window, bounded above by solvency and the penalty doctrine and below where standard-terms control voids caps beneath a threshold. We calibrate five occupations and seven jurisdictions on published evidence. In common-law agreed-damages channels the provability gross-up is unavailable whenever verifiability falls below 1/m, turning a contracting problem into an operational one. Verifiability investment widens the window where the ceiling binds but narrows it where the cap floor binds. In an agent-based market, within the tested policy class, every empty-window cell converges to zero engagement and skill collapse.
  Managerial implications. Liability institutions are a workforce-capability instrument, not merely a risk-allocation device. Firms should target the binding margin in each jurisdiction; cap floors and pooled indemnity each suppress the signal sustaining fallback capacity.
tldr: 研究在生成式AI环境下，企业通过责任信号传递人力回退能力，并分析不同职业和司法管辖区下该信号的有效性窗口。
abstract_cn:
问题定义。当生成式AI产出的专家级成果使客户无法将其与合格服务提供商的成果区分开来时，经典的基于成本的质量信号便失效，唯有基于结果的或有承诺才能区分不同服务类型。此类承诺所认证的是一种内生的、易损耗的资产：企业通过让员工持续参与AI所处理的案例而构建的人力后备能力，这种能力若不加以维持便会逐渐退化。既有研究未阐明该机制在何种条件下成立。我们探究的是，在不同职业与责任制度下，这一机制在哪些情境中仍具有信息传递作用。

方法/结果。我们在企业所设定的责任上限与承载信息量的留存风险敞口之间引入了一个制度性楔子，该楔子由四项法律要素生成：费用承担规则、惩罚性条款的可执行性、国家责任或共同赔偿对私人责任的替代，以及对合同责任的强制性限制。该楔子将可分离的类型空间压缩为一个信号窗口，其上界由偿付能力与惩罚原则决定，下界则受制于标准条款控制下责任上限低于某一阈值即告无效的规则。我们基于公开证据对五种职业和七个法域进行了校准。在普通法系的约定损害赔偿渠道中，当可验证性低于1/m时，可证明性加价机制便不可用，从而将合同问题转化为运营问题。可验证性投资在责任上限约束生效时拓宽信号窗口，但在责任下限约束生效时反而收窄该窗口。在基于主体的市场模拟中，在所测试的政策类别内，所有空窗口单元均收敛至零参与度与技能崩溃。

管理启示。责任制度不仅是风险分配工具，更是劳动力能力管理手段。企业应针对各法域中的约束边际精准施策；责任下限与共同赔偿机制均会抑制维持后备能力所需的信号。

title: The Fallback as Signal: Preserved Human Skill, Liability, and Competence Signaling in Credence-Good Markets under Improving AI
abstract: Firms that deploy improving but imperfect AI must decide how much to keep human workers engaged. Engagement lowers current output yet builds the fallback skill the firm needs when AI fails. We ask what that fallback skill signals to two audiences at once: mobile workers, who sort across firms on the skill trajectory a job builds, and clients, who cannot observe skill in a credence-good market and must infer competence. We embed the engagement-skill dynamics of Singh, Ghosh and Dai (2026) in a signaling game and add a liability commitment. Because a more-skilled provider fails less often precisely in the states where AI is down, the expected cost of a liability pledge is decreasing in fallback skill. This restores Spence-Mirrlees single crossing on a type that is endogenous - built, not drawn - and yields a separating equilibrium in which liability certifies preserved human competence that no artifact can certify once AI writes as well as the expert. We characterize the least-cost separating pledge schedule, show that client stakes shift engagement toward or away from the least-skilled worker depending on the size of the pledge, and derive a stakes threshold above which building skill dominates free-riding on a rival's training - reversing the asymmetric-specialization result of the underlying labor model. Two boundaries close the market from both sides: small tickets cannot fund enforcement, and large tickets exceed the provider's solvency. An agent-based version of the market reproduces the analytical thresholds under noisy beliefs, learning-by-record and worker churn.
tldr: 该论文构建了一个信号博弈模型，研究在AI能力提升但尚不完美时，企业保留人工参与作为技能信号，并通过责任承诺实现分离均衡，以在credence-good市场中传递能力信号。
abstract_cn: 部署了性能不断提升但仍不完美的人工智能的企业，必须决定在多大程度上让人类员工持续参与。参与度会降低当前产出，但能构建企业在AI失效时所需的备用技能。我们探讨这一备用技能同时向两类受众传递了何种信号：一类是流动型员工，他们根据工作所构建的技能轨迹在不同企业间进行选择；另一类是客户，他们在信任品市场中无法直接观察技能，只能推断能力。我们将Singh、Ghosh和Dai（2026）的参与度-技能动态模型嵌入信号博弈，并引入责任承诺机制。由于技能水平更高的服务提供者在AI失效的状态下恰恰更少出现失败，因此责任承诺的预期成本随备用技能的提升而递减。这在一个内生的——即被构建而非先天赋予的——类型上恢复了Spence-Mirrlees单交叉条件，并产生了一个分离均衡，在该均衡中，责任承诺为被保留的人类能力提供了认证，而一旦AI的写作水平与专家相当，任何人工制品都无法对此类能力进行认证。我们刻画了最低成本分离承诺计划，表明客户的风险敞口会根据承诺规模的大小，将参与度导向技能最低的员工或使其偏离该员工，并推导出一个风险敞口阈值，超过该阈值后，构建技能将优于搭竞争对手培训的便车——从而逆转了底层劳动模型中非对称专业化的结论。两个边界从两侧收紧了市场：小额交易无法支撑执行成本，而大额交易则超出了服务提供者的偿付能力。该市场的基于智能体的版本在存在噪声信念、基于记录的學習以及员工流动的情况下，复现了上述分析阈值。

title: Climate-Conditioned Cascade Modeling for Multi-Peril Reinsurance: Analysis and Controlled Numerical Applications
abstract:
Climate perils are linked through event ordering and state-dependent propagation, features not fully captured by joint loss distributions alone. This paper develops a Cascading Climate Risk Network (CCRN) for multi-peril reinsurance that separates calendar-scale climate conditioning from within-event propagation on a directed acyclic graph (DAG). The model combines complementary-log-log triggering hazards with bounded severity activation, mapping physical states to insured losses via a capacity-bounded demand-surge transformation.
  For fixed shocks, the event-scale cascade reaches a unique finite-step closure. Monotone comparative statics provide a pathwise upper-corner loss bound over rectangular stress sets, yielding a transparent contract-level stress-testing guarantee under common aleatory inputs.
  Comprehensive numerical experiments, including copula and Bayesian-network benchmarks, sensitivity analyses, and uncertainty propagation, demonstrate that while central layer prices remain robust across matched-marginal dependence structures, far-tail and high-layer behaviors differ materially. Directional propagation, annual event frequency, and dependence strength emerge as the principal risk drivers. The study provides a controlled synthetic verification of the proposed architecture.
tldr: 本文提出级联气候风险网络（CCRN）模型，用于多灾害再保险定价，通过有向无环图分离气候条件与事件内传播，并给出压力测试保证和数值验证。
abstract_cn:
气候灾害通过事件排序和状态依赖的传播机制相互关联，而这些特征仅靠联合损失分布无法完全捕捉。本文构建了一个用于多灾种再保险的级联气候风险网络（CCRN），该网络在日历尺度上的气候条件作用与有向无环图（DAG）上的事件内传播之间进行了区分。模型将互补对数-对数触发风险函数与有界严重性激活相结合，通过容量受限的需求激增变换将物理状态映射至保险损失。
在固定冲击条件下，事件尺度级联达到唯一的有限步闭合。单调比较静态分析提供了矩形应力集上的路径上界损失约束，从而在共同随机输入下给出了透明的合同级压力测试保证。
全面的数值实验，包括copula和贝叶斯网络基准、敏感性分析以及不确定性传播，表明在匹配边际相依结构下，中心层价格保持稳健，而远尾和高层行为则存在显著差异。方向性传播、年度事件频率和相依强度被识别为主要风险驱动因素。本研究为所提出的架构提供了受控的合成验证。

title: Joint Lyapunov Certificates for K-Agent Generative AI Governance: Stochastic Stability, Emergent Ensemble Risk, and Zero-Knowledge Governance Attestation
abstract:
We develop a rigorous mathematical framework for the governance of systems of K self-adapting generative AI models under the principles of
  Model Risk Management (MRM). When multiple models share a
  meta-learning coupling through an interaction matrix, the
  per-agent Lyapunov analysis that underpins standard MRM is provably insufficient: individual agents can each satisfy their
  declared stability bounds while the joint system is in a
  regime of emergent ensemble-level drift. We formalize this gap through the
  Joint Lyapunov Proof (JLP)---a cryptographic and stochastic
  protocol that attests, without revealing proprietary weights, that the
  aggregate dynamics satisfy MRM Ongoing Monitoring standard at every validation epoch.
  Our main contributions are the following. We give a complete
  characterization of the infinitesimal generator of the joint
  quadratic Lyapunov function. We derive the exact critical coupling threshold
  above which the system loses mean-square stability. We prove a
  Noise-Floor Theorem and identify the correct target for zero-knowledge attestation.
  A per-epoch Succinct Non-Interactive Argument of Knowledge (SNARK) on the live weights is derived. All
  theoretical claims are validated against five numerical studies using a multi-agent softmax system.
tldr: 该论文提出一个数学框架，用于K个自适应性生成式AI模型的治理，通过联合Lyapunov证明和零知识证明确保系统稳定性，并验证了理论结果。
abstract_cn: 我们针对由K个自适应生成式AI模型构成的系统，在模型风险管理（MRM）原则下，建立了一个严格的数学治理框架。当多个模型通过交互矩阵共享元学习耦合时，支撑标准MRM的单个智能体Lyapunov分析被证明是不充分的：每个智能体可能各自满足其声明的稳定性界限，而联合系统却处于一种涌现性的整体层面漂移状态。我们通过联合Lyapunov证明（JLP）——一种密码学与随机性协议——来形式化这一差距，该协议在不泄露专有权重的前提下，证明聚合动态在每个验证周期均满足MRM持续监控标准。我们的主要贡献如下：我们给出了联合二次Lyapunov函数无穷小生成元的完整刻画；推导出系统失去均方稳定性的精确临界耦合阈值；证明了噪声底限定理，并确定了零知识证明的正确目标；推导出基于实时权重的每周期简洁非交互式知识论证（SNARK）。所有理论主张均通过使用多智能体softmax系统的五项数值研究进行了验证。

title: Can Open-Weight Models Compete on Financial Text Comprehension?
abstract: Open-weight language models from Chinese AI labs caught up on benchmarks relative to proprietary frontier models in recent months. Yet their reliability on real-world financial tasks remains largely untested. We updated the Financial Touchstone benchmark, which now has 2,967 question context-answer triplets across 495 international annual reports. We also apply a new set of models on the benchmark, expanding coverage from eleven to twenty models across ten providers, including recent open-weight models such as GLM 4.7, GLM 5, Kimi K2.6, and DeepSeek V3.2, as well as Alibaba's proprietary flagship Qwen3-Max. Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 achieves the highest accuracy (88.4%), while Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro maintains the lowest hallucination rate (0.08%). Notably, the open-weight Kimi K2.6 ranks third in accuracy, and the non-reasoning models GLM 5 and Mistral 3 rank fourth and fifth, challenging the assumption that reasoning architectures or proprietary weights are a prerequisite for strong financial comprehension. Information retrieval remains the primary bottleneck, accounting for 48.9% of all failures. We also document a new finding: geopolitical content filters in Chinese models refuse legitimate financial questions (0.08% of attempts), sometimes without clear reason, and the refusal behavior depends on the access route as much as on the model. The complete dataset and evaluation framework are publicly available.
tldr: 该论文通过更新金融基准测试，比较了多个开源和专有语言模型在金融文本理解上的准确性和幻觉率，发现开源模型表现优异，并识别了信息检索和内容过滤等问题。

title: Self-Explaining Segment Trees: A KPI-Conditioned Segmentation Framework for Business Analytics with Node-Level Explanation via Recursive Subspace Partitioning
abstract: Business users confronted with a moving metric need to know which part of their data moved and why. Existing data-explanation methods typically return predicates: conjunctions of attribute-value conditions that isolate responsible records. Predicates are exact and directly executable as filters, but they describe axis-aligned regions and may not compactly capture segments defined by combinations of continuous tendencies. This paper presents Self-Explaining Segment Trees (SEST), an architecture in which an explanation is a multivariate cluster in a feature subspace selected for relevance to a designated key performance indicator (KPI). SEST selects the subspace once per KPI using Shapley attributions over a decision-tree surrogate, recursively partitions the population while choosing the branching factor independently at each node through mixture-model silhouette search, and attaches to every node a dual explanation payload: standardized effect sizes over numeric features and type-dependent contribution profiles over user-designated dimensions. These explanations are computed from untransformed data so surfaced values retain source units and category labels. A stance layer reduces any depth of the tree to its extremal KPI-suppressing and KPI-amplifying segments. We establish termination and a node-count bound determined by the depth limit and minimum segment size, and characterize per-tree construction cost as quadratic in population size in the degenerate case and geometrically decaying across depth in the balanced case. This is an architecture and methodology paper; we report no predictive-accuracy or validation results and leave outcome validation to future work.
tldr: 提出一种基于KPI的分段树框架，通过递归子空间划分提供节点级解释，用于业务分析中的指标变动归因。
abstract_cn: 面对动态指标的业务用户需要了解其数据中哪些部分发生了变化以及为何发生变化。现有的数据解释方法通常返回谓词，即属性-值条件的合取，用以隔离相关记录。谓词精确且可直接作为过滤器执行，但它们描述的是轴对齐区域，可能无法紧凑地捕捉由连续趋势组合所定义的片段。本文提出自解释分段树（Self-Explaining Segment Trees, SEST），一种解释架构，其中解释是在为特定关键绩效指标（KPI）相关性而选定的特征子空间中的多元聚类。SEST 使用基于决策树替代模型的 Shapley 归因，为每个 KPI 一次性选择子空间；通过混合模型轮廓搜索在每个节点独立选择分支因子，递归划分总体；并为每个节点附加双重解释载荷：数值特征上的标准化效应量以及用户指定维度上的类型依赖贡献概况。这些解释从未转换的数据中计算得出，因此呈现的值保留原始单位和类别标签。一个立场层将树的任意深度缩减为其极端的 KPI 抑制和 KPI 放大片段。我们确立了终止性以及由深度限制和最小片段大小决定的节点数界限，并刻画了每棵树构建成本：在退化情况下与总体规模呈二次关系，在平衡情况下随深度呈几何衰减。这是一篇架构与方法论论文；我们不报告预测准确性或验证结果，并将结果验证留待未来工作。

title: Simple Determinants of Commercial Bank Failures
abstract: This study investigates the internal and macroeconomic determinants of commercial banking failures in the United States spanning 1959 to 2025. Using a logit model and a four-quarter lag, two models are estimated: a comprehensive model (1985–2025) and an extended panel model (1960–2025). Empirical results reveal internal CAMELS metrics are primary determinants of survival; profitability and capital adequacy defends against failures, while asset quality deterioration and management inefficiencies accelerates failure. The “too big to fail” paradigm is empirically validated. Contractionary monetary policy and labor market stress increase failure probabilities. Real GDP growth exhibits a role shift predicting commercial bank failures.

title: Monetary policy and the rigidity of firm employment expectations
abstract: This paper examines how monetary policy announcements affect firms’ employment expectations. Using German survey data, we combine high-frequency monetary policy surprises with survey response dates to identify the immediate and dynamic effects of monetary policy on firm-level expectations and subsequent employment. Contractionary shocks lead firms to revise employment plans downward immediately and persistently, eventually reducing employment growth. Initially, hiring plans are reduced, while layoffs increase later. Production expectations adjust twice as often but revert faster, consistent with greater labour market rigidity. Labour market institutions shape these responses: firms subject to the minimum wage or with lower collective bargaining coverage revise employment expectations more strongly. Financially constrained firms exhibit disproportionately larger downward revisions, indicating that the financial accelerator operates already at the expectation formation stage. Because firms adjust plans well before effects appear in aggregate data, employment expectations provide an early measure of monetary policy transmission to the labour market.
tldr: 利用德国调查数据和高频货币政策意外，研究货币政策冲击对企业就业预期的即时和动态影响，发现紧缩性冲击导致就业预期持续下调，且金融约束企业反应更大。
abstract_cn: 本文考察了货币政策公告如何影响企业的就业预期。利用德国调查数据，我们将高频货币政策意外冲击与调查回复日期相结合，以识别货币政策对企业层面预期及后续就业的即时效应与动态效应。紧缩性冲击导致企业立即且持续地下调就业计划，并最终降低就业增长。起初，招聘计划被削减，而裁员则在之后增加。生产预期的调整频率是就业预期的两倍，但恢复速度也更快，这与劳动力市场刚性较强的特征一致。劳动力市场制度塑造了这些反应：受最低工资约束或集体谈判覆盖率较低的企业，其就业预期的修正幅度更大。面临融资约束的企业表现出不成比例的大幅下调，表明金融加速器机制在预期形成阶段就已发挥作用。由于企业在总体数据显现影响之前就已调整计划，就业预期为货币政策向劳动力市场传导提供了早期度量指标。

title: Understanding the Impact of Multi-Nodal Urban Systems on Thailand's Urban Economies : Insights from a Dynamic Recursive Spatial General Equilibrium Model
abstract: Thailand's transition to high-income status is, at its core, an urban challenge. Bangkok generates nearly half of the national gross domestic product, yet its dominance is increasingly constrained by congestion, environmental stress, and diminishing returns to further concentration. Successive National Spatial Development Strategies have called for a more multi-nodal urban hierarchy, but the analytical basis for evaluating that ambition has remained thin. This paper builds and calibrates a Dynamic Recursive Spatial Quantitative General Equilibrium model for Thailand's urban system from 2025 to 2050, and uses it to evaluate three counterfactual policy portfolios that allocate the same aggregate productivity-investment envelope (roughly 2.3 percent of 2030 urban gross domestic product) across Bangkok and the eleven designated secondary cities in different proportions: a Bangkok-leaning portfolio (80/20), a balanced portfolio (50/50), and a secondary-leaning portfolio (20/80). The Bangkok-leaning portfolio leads through 2045, but the secondary-leaning portfolio overtakes it between 2045 and 2050, delivering a 12.38 percent gain in national gross domestic product per capita above the no-investment baseline against 11.62 percent for the Bangkok-leaning alternative. The balanced portfolio is dominated by both skewed alternatives in 2050, reflecting a threshold property of agglomeration economies. A two-dimensional envelope-by-split sweep shows that the relative ranking is genuinely contingent on the scale and horizon of the commitment: below a certain tipping point, the Bangkok-leaning portfolio dominates; above it, the secondary-leaning portfolio does. A modest, well-allocated spatial-investment program is unlikely to be the engine of Thailand's high-income transition; sufficient scale of commitment is a precondition.

tldr: 该论文构建泰国城市系统的动态递归空间一般均衡模型，评估不同空间投资组合对城市经济的影响，发现投资规模是决定投资组合优劣的关键。
abstract_cn: 泰国向高收入地位的转型，其核心在于城市挑战。曼谷贡献了全国近一半的国内生产总值，但其主导地位日益受到拥堵、环境压力以及进一步集聚的边际收益递减的制约。历次国家空间发展战略均呼吁构建更为多节点的城市层级体系，但评估这一雄心的分析基础仍然薄弱。本文构建并校准了一个适用于2025至2050年泰国城市体系的动态递归空间量化一般均衡模型，并利用该模型评估三套反事实政策组合，这些组合将相同的总生产率投资规模（约为2030年城市国内生产总值的2.3%）以不同比例分配至曼谷与十一个指定次级城市：偏向曼谷的组合（80/20）、均衡组合（50/50）以及偏向次级城市的组合（20/80）。偏向曼谷的组合在2045年之前保持领先，但偏向次级城市的组合在2045至2050年间实现反超，其带来的全国人均国内生产总值较无投资基准情景高出12.38%，而偏向曼谷的替代方案则为11.62%。均衡组合在2050年被两种偏斜方案同时支配，这反映了集聚经济的阈值特性。通过二维的投资规模—分配比例扫描分析表明，相对排序确实取决于承诺的规模与时间跨度：低于某一临界点时，偏向曼谷的组合占优；高于该临界点时，偏向次级城市的组合占优。一个适度且配置合理的空间投资计划不太可能成为泰国高收入转型的引擎；足够的承诺规模是前提条件。

title: A Note on the Identification Step in "A Semistructural Methodology for Policy Counterfactuals"
abstract: The New Keynesian example of Beraja (2023) is not identified at its printed calibration: more than one structure satisfies every condition of its identification step. Two of the paper's six identifying restrictions coincide on equilibrium equations consistent with the printed reduced form, leaving eleven conditions to determine an equation's twelve coefficients. The note derives the rank condition the identification step requires, computable from the reduced form and the restrictions alone. The note also documents and corrects a misprint in the paper's counterfactual display. A one-clause amendment to the paper's Theorem 1 restores its conclusion.
tldr: 本文指出Beraja (2023)的识别步骤在给定校准下不唯一，推导了秩条件并修正了打印错误。
abstract_cn: 贝拉哈（2023）的新凯恩斯主义示例在其印刷校准下未被识别：不止一种结构满足其识别步骤的每一项条件。该论文的六个识别限制中有两个与印刷简化形式一致的均衡方程重合，留下十一个条件来确定一个方程的十二个系数。本注释推导了识别步骤所需的秩条件，该条件仅需从简化形式和限制中计算得出。本注释还记录并纠正了论文反事实展示中的一处印刷错误。对论文定理1的单条款修正恢复了其结论。

title: Mastering Stochastic OLG Models in Continuous Time
abstract: We propose a comprehensive framework for solving overlapping-generations (OLG) models in continuous time with both idiosyncratic and aggregate risk. Our general characterization of equilibrium through the master equation operates on the joint distribution over the continuous idiosyncratic states, age and wealth. Our computational strategy is to take a finite-dimensional representation of this distribution as an input of a neural net which in turn outputs a finite-difference representation of the (conditional) value function. This idea can be applied generally to heterogeneous agent models with aggregate risk, and we call it finite-difference neural operator. Our method combines advantages from modern neural nets and traditional finite-difference methods: It is grid-free in the high-dimensional distribution, and retains control on boundary conditions in low-dimensional state variables. Moreover, our method is able to enforce shape constraints. We showcase its flexibility by solving a continuous-time OLG model with aggregate risk alone where we characterize the distribution by its supporting function; and to an OLG model with both types of risk.
tldr: 提出一种基于有限差分神经算子的方法，用于求解具有异质性和总体风险的连续时间OLG模型，并展示了其在纯总体风险和双重风险模型中的应用。
abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个综合框架，用于求解同时包含异质性风险与总体风险的连续时间世代交叠（OLG）模型。我们通过主方程对均衡的一般刻画，作用于连续异质性状态、年龄与财富的联合分布上。我们的计算策略是，将该分布的有限维表示作为神经网络的输入，而神经网络则输出（条件）价值函数的有限差分表示。这一思想可普遍应用于具有总体风险的异质性主体模型，我们将其称为有限差分神经算子。我们的方法结合了现代神经网络与传统有限差分方法的优势：在高维分布上无需网格，同时在低维状态变量上保持对边界条件的控制。此外，我们的方法能够施加形状约束。我们通过求解一个仅含总体风险的连续时间OLG模型（在该模型中，我们利用支撑函数刻画分布），以及一个同时包含两类风险的OLG模型，展示了该方法的灵活性。

title: Environmental and Economic Implications of Artificial Intelligence Data Centers in the United States
abstract: In this study, we use electricity demand growth, cooling requirements, and backup system operation to evaluate the environmental and economic implications of artificial intelligence data centers in the United States. Our results indicate that impacts are not determined solely by facility design, but by the broader electricity, water, and land-use systems in which these facilities operate. Emissions are primarily driven by electricity consumption and therefore depend on marginal generation mixes, transmission constraints, and the spatial and temporal distribution of demand. Analysis further shows that local effects include pressures on water resources, increased noise exposure, and land-use changes, with outcomes varying across regions and infrastructure conditions. The assessment of technological and operational measures shows that improvements in energy efficiency, cooling configurations, and operational strategies can reduce these impacts, although their effectiveness depends on system-level conditions. Evaluation of regulatory and market structures suggests that existing frameworks may not fully account for location- and time-specific externalities. These findings support the need for integrated policy approaches that align data center deployment and operation with electricity system characteristics, water availability, and land-use planning to improve overall environmental and economic performance.
tldr: 该研究评估美国AI数据中心的电力、水和土地系统影响，发现排放和资源压力取决于系统条件，并提出综合政策建议。
abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们利用电力需求增长、冷却需求以及备用系统运行情况，评估了美国人工智能数据中心的环境与经济影响。结果表明，这些影响并非仅由设施设计决定，还取决于这些设施运行所处的更广泛的电力、水资源和土地利用系统。排放主要由电力消耗驱动，因此取决于边际发电组合、输电约束以及需求的空间和时间分布。分析进一步表明，局部影响包括对水资源造成的压力、噪声暴露增加以及土地利用变化，且不同地区和基础设施条件下的结果存在差异。对技术和运营措施的评估显示，能源效率的提升、冷却配置的优化以及运营策略的改进可以减轻这些影响，但其有效性取决于系统层面的条件。对监管和市场结构的评估表明，现有框架可能未能充分考虑区位特定和时间特定的外部性。这些发现支持采取综合性政策方法的必要性，将数据中心的部署和运行与电力系统特征、水资源可用性以及土地利用规划相协调，以改善整体环境和经济绩效。

title: A Multinomial Probit Model for Asymmetric Choice Responses
abstract: Standard multinomial probit (MNP) models specify symmetric latent utility distributions, implying that choice probabilities respond symmetrically to positive and negative covariate shifts of the same magnitude. This restriction is often implausible in empirical choice settings and can lead to misleading elasticity and substitution predictions. We propose a skewed multinomial probit (SMNP) model that captures asymmetric choice responses by specifying a multivariate skew-normal distribution for the latent utilities. The model preserves the flexible substitution patterns of the MNP framework, introduces alternative-specific skewness parameters, and nests the standard MNP model when skewness is zero. Introducing skewness creates identification and computational challenges because the skewness parameters interact with the MNP scale normalization and disrupt the conditional Gaussian updating structure used in Bayesian MNP estimation. We address these challenges through a covariance reparameterization that enforces identification and positive definiteness by construction, interpretable priors on the identified parameter space, and a double data-augmentation scheme that yields a Metropolis-Hastings within Gibbs sampler. Numerical experiments and applications to consumer choice data show that SMNP recovers asymmetric choice responses, improves probabilistic prediction, and produces economically meaningful differences in price elasticities and substitution patterns.

title: Testing Sign Agreement
abstract: This article considers the problem of testing sign agreement among a finite number of parameters. This problem arises in empirical settings such as detecting treatment effects with opposite signs across subgroups, outcomes, or time periods, and testing instrument validity for local average treatment effects. For the null hypothesis that the parameters are either all non-negative or all non-positive, I propose two novel tests: a least favorable test and a conditional test. The least favorable test uses a worst-case null critical value, while the conditional test first screens components with large positive or negative estimates and then tests the remaining sign-unresolved components conditional on the screening event. Unlike existing sign agreement tests, both procedures accommodate arbitrary dependence among estimators; in the special case of independent estimators, the critical values depend only on the dimension and testing levels. We show that both tests control asymptotic size uniformly over a large class of nonparametric distributions. Local asymptotic power analysis reveals a tradeoff: the least favorable test is more powerful near boundary configurations where sign restrictions bind, whereas the conditional test is more powerful when some components are well separated from zero. Simulation evidence supports these theoretical predictions in finite samples.

abstract_cn: 本文探讨了有限数量参数之间符号一致性的检验问题。该问题出现在多种实证情境中，例如检测不同子组、结果或时间段中处理效应符号相反的情况，以及检验局部平均处理效应的工具变量有效性。针对参数要么全部非负、要么全部非正的零假设，本文提出了两种新颖的检验方法：最不利检验（least favorable test）和条件检验（conditional test）。最不利检验使用最坏情况下的零假设临界值，而条件检验首先筛选出具有较大正估计或负估计的分量，然后在筛选事件条件下对剩余符号未决的分量进行检验。与现有的符号一致性检验不同，这两种方法均能适应估计量之间任意的依赖关系；在估计量相互独立的特殊情形下，临界值仅依赖于维度和检验水平。我们证明，这两种检验在一大类非参数分布上能够一致地控制渐近检验水平。局部渐近功效分析揭示了一种权衡：最不利检验在符号约束起作用的边界配置附近功效更高，而条件检验在部分分量远离零时功效更高。模拟证据在有限样本中支持了这些理论预测。

title: Graph-Laplacian Variance Estimators for Finely Stratified Experiments
abstract: This paper considers design-based inference on the average treatment effect in finely stratified experiments, where uncertainty arises only from the randomized treatment assignment. We focus on settings in which units are first stratified into groups of fixed size according to baseline covariates and, then within each group, exactly one unit is assigned to treatment. In this setting, we introduce a class of graph-Laplacian variance estimators in which strata form the vertices of a weighted graph and edge weights determine how between-stratum comparisons are aggregated. The canonical estimator of Imai (2008) corresponds to a complete graph with edge weights normalized so that each stratum has weighted degree one, while a paired-stratum estimator arises from a perfect matching graph. For the subclass of degree-calibrated graphs, in which each vertex has weighted degree one, we derive an exact bias identity showing that the corresponding estimators are upward-biased, with bias governed by squared differences in the true stratum-level treatment effects across adjacent strata. As a result, any such estimator may be used for valid inference. The identity further suggests that paired-stratum estimators constructed from a covariate-based perfect matching can induce small biases when treatment effects vary smoothly with the covariates. Without such smoothness, however, we show that paired-stratum estimators can exhibit large worst-case bias, and that, within the class of degree-calibrated estimators, the complete-graph estimator is minimax optimal for normalized bias under a weak bound on treatment-effect heterogeneity. Motivated by this contrast, we propose a regularized graph estimator that controls worst-case normalized bias while preserving much of the locality of the paired-stratum estimator. Simulations illustrate the resulting tradeoff between locality and worst-case protection.
tldr: 本文提出一类基于图拉普拉斯的方差估计量用于精细分层实验中的处理效应推断，并分析了其偏差性质与最优性。
abstract_cn: 本文考虑了精细分层实验中平均处理效应的基于设计的推断，其中不确定性仅来源于随机化的处理分配。我们关注这样的设定：首先根据基线协变量将单元分层为固定大小的组，然后在每组内，恰好一个单元被分配到处理组。在此设定下，我们引入了一类图拉普拉斯方差估计量，其中各层构成加权图的顶点，边权重决定了层间比较如何被聚合。Imai（2008）的经典估计量对应于一个完全图，其边权重经过归一化使得每层的加权度为一，而配对层估计量则源于一个完美匹配图。对于度校准图的子类（其中每个顶点的加权度为一），我们推导出一个精确的偏差恒等式，表明相应的估计量存在向上偏差，且偏差由相邻层之间真实层水平处理效应的平方差所决定。因此，任何此类估计量均可用于有效推断。该恒等式进一步表明，当处理效应随协变量平滑变化时，基于协变量的完美匹配所构造的配对层估计量可能产生较小的偏差。然而，在没有这种平滑性的情况下，我们证明配对层估计量可能表现出较大的最坏情况偏差，并且在度校准估计量类别中，在处理效应异质性具有弱约束的条件下，完全图估计量在归一化偏差方面是极小极大最优的。受这一对比的启发，我们提出了一种正则化图估计量，它在控制最坏情况归一化偏差的同时，保留了配对层估计量的大部分局部性。模拟结果展示了局部性与最坏情况保护之间的权衡。

title: Bias-robust causal inference for panel data
abstract: We develop a bias-robust causal inference method for observational panel data settings. Such methods typically impute untreated outcomes, so counterfactual error passes straight into the estimated treatment effect while conventional standard errors ignore it. We adapt bias-aware minimax methods, developed for estimating regression coefficients in factor-model panels, to a causal target: the average effect on the treated, which has to be imputed and may vary across units and periods. The estimator corrects the imputed counterfactual with weighted untreated residuals and reports intervals with an explicit allowance for the error that remains. In simulations the proposed method holds nominal coverage where alternatives such as the generalized synthetic control have almost none, especially when the factor rank is underfitted, at the cost of wider intervals. By applying the developed methodology to real data the estimated effect remains significant for counterfactual errors nearly twice the size that the design's placebos typically exhibit.
tldr: 开发了一种偏差稳健的因果推断方法，用于面板数据，通过加权未处理残差修正反事实预测，并在区间估计中显式考虑反事实误差。

title: Optimal Experimental Design and Estimation when Potential Outcomes are Bounded
abstract: I study the optimal design and analysis of randomized experiments for estimating finite-population average treatment effects when potential outcomes are known to be bounded, as with binary outcomes. Among all assignment mechanisms and a broad class of affine estimators, worst-case mean-squared error (MSE) is minimized by independent random assignment and an unconventional regression of the support-midpoint-centered outcome on the recentered treatment, with no intercept. This contrasts with the usual prescription of balanced complete randomization and difference-in-means estimation: when outcomes are bounded, randomness in the realized treatment share is informative. The worst-case gain over full-sample complete randomization is asymptotically small, but gains can be first-order relative to other designs: complete within-pair randomization and pair-fixed-effect regression have twice the worst-case MSE. I extend the result to allow for arbitrary estimators. Independent random assignment remains optimal, and the generally-nonlinear optimal estimator can meaningfully reduce worst-case MSE.
tldr: 研究有界潜在结果下随机实验的最优设计与估计，提出独立随机分配和特殊回归方法以最小化最坏情况均方误差。
abstract_cn: 我研究了在已知潜在结果有界（如二元结果）的情况下，用于估计有限总体平均处理效应的随机化实验的最优设计与分析。在所有分配机制和一类广泛的仿射估计量中，最坏情况下的均方误差（MSE）通过独立随机分配以及对以支持域中点为中心的结果变量关于重新中心化的处理变量进行无截距的非传统回归而达到最小。这与通常采用的平衡完全随机化和均值差估计的建议形成对比：当结果有界时，实际处理份额中的随机性具有信息量。相对于全样本完全随机化，最坏情况下的增益在渐近意义上是小的，但相对于其他设计，增益可能是一阶的：完全配对随机化和配对固定效应回归的最坏情况MSE是其两倍。我将结果扩展到允许任意估计量。独立随机分配仍然是最优的，而一般非线性的最优估计量能够显著降低最坏情况下的MSE。

title: Pricing Intelligence: Task-Based Learning and Labor Displacement in the AI Economy
abstract: What determines the speed and direction of AI learning? I analyse this question from a microeconomic perspective by studying a model in which AI providers sell access to users who must complete tasks using either AI or labor. Users differ in the share of complex tasks they face. When complex tasks are delegated to AI, it learns to perform them better. In an initial technological state where AI has a comparative advantage at easy tasks, users with many complex tasks have low willingness to pay for access. This gives rise to a tension between profit maximization and complex-task learning. I characterize when this tension gives rise to a convex path of labor displacement or a learning trap in a monopoly benchmark. Competition between AI providers increases the speed of labor displacement if it is intense. Asymmetric competition can increase the speed of labor displacement by promoting endogenous specialization of AI providers.
tldr: 该论文构建微观经济模型，分析AI提供商在利润最大化与复杂任务学习之间的权衡，以及竞争对劳动力替代速度的影响。

title: Two Moments for Risk-Monotone Additive Statistics
abstract: Every statistic on laws with finite pth moment that is additive across independent risks and monotone in mean-preserving spreads depends only on an additive function of the mean when p is strictly less than 2, and only on such a function and a nonnegative multiple of the variance when p is no less than 2.

title: Optimal Sequential Assignment with Capacity Constrained Verification
abstract: A principal seeks to allocate $k$ identical objects among n sequentially arriving, impatient agents. Each agent privately observes her valuation, and the principal's payoff from allocating an object depends on the recipient's valuation. The principal can perfectly verify the valuation of at most $m$ agents, where $m < k$, and commits to a mechanism before any agent arrives. We characterize the class of optimal mechanisms. Our main result establishes that, in states where the number of remaining objects exceeds the number of available verification checks, the optimal mechanism may involve probabilistic verification.

title: Exploration and Stopping
abstract: We study a decision-maker who explores --- dynamically choosing what to learn --- before stopping to act. We first reduce this dynamic control problem to a static one: any exploration-and-stopping strategy is equivalent to a choice of the joint distribution of the stopped state and the stopping time, subject to one information-budget constraint at each date, and we characterize exactly which distributions are attainable. The reduced problem is a convex program with a linear objective; its dual prices information over time, and the optimal policy concavifies the stopping payoff net of these shadow prices. The curvature of the decision-maker's time preference then governs the shape of optimal exploration: convex time preference induces Poisson exploration, concave time preference confines stopping to a window whose length is controlled by the dispersion of the marginal cost of delay --- forcing an initial phase of pure exploration when the window is short --- and the linear case lies at the boundary between them. We apply the framework to real options, to the speed--accuracy tradeoff in information acquisition, and to a continuous-time exploration contest.
tldr: 该论文将探索与停止问题简化为静态凸规划，通过影子价格刻画最优策略，并应用于实物期权、信息获取的速度-准确性权衡和连续时间探索竞赛。
abstract_cn: 我们研究一个决策者，在停止行动之前进行探索——即动态选择要学习什么。我们首先将这个动态控制问题简化为一个静态问题：任何探索与停止策略都等价于对停止状态与停止时间的联合分布的选择，受制于每个日期的一个信息预算约束，并且我们精确刻画了哪些分布是可实现的。简化后的问题是一个具有线性目标的凸规划；其对偶问题为随时间的信息定价，最优策略则是对扣除这些影子价格后的停止收益进行凹化处理。决策者时间偏好的曲率随后决定了最优探索的形状：凸时间偏好引发泊松式探索，凹时间偏好将停止限制在一个窗口内，该窗口的长度由延迟边际成本的离散程度控制——当窗口较短时，强制进入一个纯探索的初始阶段——而线性情形则位于两者之间的边界。我们将该框架应用于实物期权、信息获取中的速度—准确性权衡，以及连续时间探索竞赛。

title: Competitive mediator games and urban CAV routing markets
abstract: Inspired by possible future markets of autonomous routing and driving (ARAD), we introduce competitive mediator games and their equilibria which generalize the (coarse) correlated equilibria, which have become a popular research area recently as they not only can be more socially efficient than Nash equilibria but also are limits of algorithmic no-regret multi-agent learning dynamics. We discuss the basic properties of competitive mediator games and prove that in the generic setting of anonymous congestion(routing) games with market-share maximizing mediators all competitive mediator equilibria are monopolies whenever one of the mediators is weakly preferred to other mediators by all users. We apply and interpret these results in the context of new markets of competing ARAD service providers. We also provide a comprehensive overview of these markets and discuss the future mechanism design thereof.
tldr: 该论文提出竞争性中介博弈模型，分析自动驾驶路由市场中中介的均衡行为，并证明在匿名拥塞博弈中均衡为垄断。
abstract_cn: 受未来自主路由与驾驶（ARAD）潜在市场的启发，我们引入了竞争性中介博弈及其均衡概念，该概念推广了（粗）相关均衡。近年来，（粗）相关均衡已成为一个热门研究领域，因为它们不仅可能比纳什均衡更具社会效率，而且是非遗憾多智能体学习算法的极限。我们讨论了竞争性中介博弈的基本性质，并证明在具有市场份额最大化中介的匿名拥塞（路由）博弈的一般设定中，只要所有用户对某一中介的偏好弱于其他中介，所有竞争性中介均衡均为垄断均衡。我们将这些结果应用于竞争性ARAD服务提供商的新市场情境中，并对其进行了解释。此外，我们还对这些市场进行了全面综述，并讨论了其未来的机制设计问题。

title: Auction Design with a Bit of Information
abstract: Consider a revenue-maximizing seller who can access a binary signal about two bidders` joint values. We explore what kind of information is most valuable to the seller by studying three classes of signals, each capturing a distinct dimension of bidders` values: their overall level (demand), their relative strength (ranking), and their dispersion while preserving bidder anonymity (competitiveness). We characterize the optimal signal and corresponding auction mechanism within each class, and find that competitiveness signals are particularly effective. Under certain regularity conditions, the optimal competitiveness signal yields at least as much revenue as any ranking signal or demand signal. Moreover, for signals that induce a monotone allocation, the optimal competitiveness signal yields at least as much revenue as any other binary signal.
tldr: 研究收入最大化卖家利用二元信号时的最优拍卖设计，发现竞争性信号优于需求或排名信号。
abstract_cn: 考虑一个追求收益最大化的卖方，其能够获取关于两个竞拍者联合价值的二元信号。我们通过研究三类信号来探讨何种信息对卖方最具价值，这三类信号分别捕捉竞拍者价值的不同维度：整体水平（需求）、相对强弱（排序）以及在保持竞拍者匿名性前提下的离散程度（竞争性）。我们在每一类信号中刻画了最优信号及相应的拍卖机制，并发现竞争性信号尤为有效。在一定的正则条件下，最优竞争性信号所产生的收益至少不低于任何排序信号或需求信号。此外，对于能够诱导单调配置的信号，最优竞争性信号所产生的收益至少不低于任何其他二元信号。

title: Efficiency Adjustments Break the Logarithmic Rank Barrier
abstract:
We study the expected average rank achieved by the Efficiency-Adjusted Deferred Acceptance (EADA) mechanism in i.i.d.\ matching markets. While student-proposing Deferred Acceptance gives students an expected average rank of logarithmic order, we prove that EADA's expected average rank is at most $4\log\log n+O(1)$. Therefore, EADA improves the asymptotic order of students' assignments.
  At the cost of a weaker bound, $O((\log\log n)^2)$, we extend this conclusion to a much larger class of mechanisms. Namely, every Pareto-efficient mechanism that weakly Pareto-dominates DA breaks DA's logarithmic barrier. These are the first asymptotic guarantees for the expected average rank of EADA and of the broader class of Pareto-efficient improvements of DA. The conclusions extend to many-to-one markets with bounded quotas and random markets with correlated preferences.
tldr: 该论文证明在i.i.d.匹配市场中，效率调整的延迟接受机制（EADA）的期望平均排名为O(log log n)，打破了DA机制的对数障碍，属于匹配理论中的机制设计研究。
abstract_cn:
我们研究了效率调整延迟接受（Efficiency-Adjusted Deferred Acceptance, EADA）机制在独立同分布匹配市场中的期望平均排名。虽然学生提议的延迟接受（Deferred Acceptance, DA）机制使学生获得的期望平均排名为对数阶，但我们证明EADA的期望平均排名至多为$4\log\log n+O(1)$。因此，EADA改善了学生分配结果的渐近阶数。

在牺牲较弱界（$O((\log\log n)^2)$）的代价下，我们将这一结论推广到更大一类机制。具体而言，每一个弱帕累托支配DA的帕累托有效机制都能突破DA的对数障碍。这些是首次针对EADA以及更广泛的帕累托有效改进DA机制类给出的期望平均排名渐近保证。上述结论还扩展至具有有界配额的多对一市场以及具有相关偏好的随机市场。

title: Defensive Pessimism: Growth, Culture, and the Survival of Evidence
abstract: Growth rewards uniformity. It can also destroy the practice by which a successful society would recognize its own failure. I study a credit economy in which a safeguarded real contract settles outside the dominant monetary network, creates a labelled comparison with it, and trains the people who keep that alternative usable. The comparison informs how far society should revise a possibly unsound standard, so evidence has a welfare value rather than merely a statistical interpretation. The efficient reserve grows in absolute size but vanishes as a population share. This creates a mass--share wedge: the evidence becomes more valuable while the constituency able to protect its source becomes politically negligible. Private cooperation supplies only bounded readiness, and cheap drills displace live comparisons unless diagnosis is valued explicitly. Cultural investment and political survival are mutually reinforcing, producing exposed and protected equilibria. I show why share-indexed protection eventually fails, characterize a service-indexed charter that can survive growth, and derive the least-cost combination of procurement, apprenticeship support, and safe-real collateral that funds replacement after cancellation.
tldr: 该论文构建了一个信贷经济模型，探讨增长如何影响证据的生存和福利价值，并分析保护证据的制度设计，但未涉及具体银行、货币或财政政策。
abstract_cn: 增长奖励统一性。它也可能摧毁一个成功社会赖以识别自身失败的那种实践。我研究了一个信用经济，其中一种受保障的真实合约在主流通货网络之外结算，与之形成一种标签化对照，并训练那些维持该替代方案可用性的人们。这种对照告知社会应在多大程度上修订一个可能不健全的标准，因此证据具有福利价值，而不仅仅是统计意义上的解释。高效储备的绝对规模在增长，但作为人口份额却在缩小。这产生了一种“总量—份额”楔子：证据变得更有价值，而能够保护其来源的群体在政治上却变得无足轻重。私人合作仅能提供有限的准备，而廉价的演练会取代真实的对照，除非诊断被明确地赋予价值。文化投资与政治生存相互强化，产生了暴露型均衡与保护型均衡。我解释了为何以份额为指数的保护最终会失效，刻画了一种能够随增长存续的以服务为指数的章程，并推导出采购、学徒支持与安全真实抵押品的最低成本组合，用以在取消后为替代方案提供资金。

title: The Triadic Stress Index in Financial Markets
abstract:
The Triadic Stress Index (TSI) takes a network index whose four factors were first observed in soil microbiome co-occurrence networks and applies it, without alteration, to the correlation network of financial assets.
  We test it on five markets spanning 2006-2026 (equities including banking crises and the AI sector, cryptocurrencies, commodities, foreign exchange and sovereign debt), against three independent definitions of a crisis episode, at a fixed alarm budget, out of sample, with block-bootstrap intervals and a Holm correction across the family of tests. The benchmarks are the Absorption Ratio, the industry standard used by MSCI and central banks; the effective rank and the Vendi score, the sharpest spectral measures available; Ollivier-Ricci curvature; and the global and local balance indices of signed correlation networks.
  Three comparisons favour the index. It carries a per-node decomposition, diag(A^3), naming which asset is carrying the concentration with no parameter to select, and scores 0.97-0.99 against 0.33-0.84 for the only published per-node alternative, whereas spectral attribution must first choose how many components to read and collapses under a standard but wrong choice. Its alarms are the cleanest of anything tested, 4.0% of them with no matching episode against 14.7% for the effective rank and roughly 59% for the Absorption Ratio. And it beats the Absorption Ratio on detection by 0.273 in F1 out of sample, p<0.0005.
  The remaining comparisons are ties. Against the effective rank and the Vendi score the index ties in every scheme and both samples, and the margin over the Absorption Ratio narrows under the strictest labelling. On real matrices the far simpler node degree reproduces the attribution. A lead-lag analysis puts the peak cross-correlation at zero lag: this is a coincident state index, not a forecast.
tldr: 论文提出并测试了一种基于网络拓扑的金融压力指数（TSI），在多个资产市场中与现有指标比较，发现其具有更清晰的警报和更好的检测性能，但并非针对特定政策领域。
abstract_cn:
三元压力指数（Triadic Stress Index, TSI）采用了一种网络指标，其四个因子最初在土壤微生物共现网络中被观察到，并将其不加修改地应用于金融资产的相关性网络。

我们在五个市场上对其进行了测试，时间跨度涵盖2006年至2026年（包括银行业危机和人工智能板块的股票、加密货币、大宗商品、外汇及主权债务），针对三种独立的危机事件定义，在固定预警预算下，进行样本外测试，采用块自助法（block-bootstrap）区间，并在整个测试族中应用霍尔校正（Holm correction）。基准方法包括：吸收比率（Absorption Ratio），即MSCI和各国央行使用的行业标准；有效秩（effective rank）和Vendi分数，即现有最尖锐的谱度量方法；Ollivier-Ricci曲率；以及带符号相关网络的全局和局部平衡指数。

有三项比较结果有利于该指数。它具备逐节点分解功能，即diag(A^3)，无需选择任何参数即可指出哪个资产承载了集中度，其得分为0.97-0.99，而唯一已发表的逐节点替代方法的得分为0.33-0.84；相比之下，谱归因方法必须首先选择读取多少个分量，并且在标准但错误的选择下会失效。其预警信号是所有测试方法中最干净的，其中4.0%的预警没有对应的事件，而有效秩的这一比例为14.7%，吸收比率则约为59%。在样本外检测中，其F1分数比吸收比率高出0.273，p<0.0005。

其余的比较结果为平局。与有效秩和Vendi分数相比，该指数在每种方案和两个样本中均持平，而在最严格的标注下，其相对于吸收比率的优势有所缩小。在真实矩阵上，远为简单的节点度（node degree）即可复现该归因结果。领先-滞后分析显示峰值互相关出现在零滞后处：这表明该指数是一个同步状态指标，而非预测工具。

title: Nash Peer-to-Peer Insurance Bargaining under Price Fairness and Coalitional Stability
abstract: We study peer-to-peer (P2P) insurance contracting between a risk-averse P2P reinsurer and multiple risk-averse peers in an asymmetric Nash-bargaining framework, where all agents seek to improve expected utility relative to their disagreement points. Consistent with the expected value premium principle, we impose a price-fairness condition requiring each peer's expected contribution to be based on a common loading applied to the peer's expected loss. To justify the bargaining formulation relative to a standard fixed-weight weighted-sum optimization problem, we provide an axiomatic characterization showing that the Nash bargaining solution satisfies properties well suited to voluntary P2P insurance contracting in small pools. We establish the existence and uniqueness of the optimal contract and derive first-order characterizations for the full-, partial-, and zero-reinsurance regimes. To address subgroup formation, we develop computationally tractable sufficient conditions that rule out viable coalitional deviations, both with and without price fairness. Our numerical study investigates the impact of price fairness and pool size on the optimal contract and agents' welfare. Price fairness reduces dispersion in risk allocations and certainty-equivalent loadings among peers. Regarding pool size, welfare need not increase monotonically, highlighting that risk-pool expansion depends not only on diversification but also on the evolution of bargaining power.
tldr: 研究P2P保险合约中基于纳什议价的最优合约设计，考虑价格公平和联盟稳定性，并分析价格公平和池规模对福利的影响。
abstract_cn: 我们研究在非对称纳什谈判框架下，风险规避的P2P再保险人与多个风险规避的同行之间的点对点（P2P）保险合约问题，其中所有代理人旨在相对于其分歧点提高期望效用。与期望值保费原理一致，我们施加了一个价格公平条件，要求每位同行的期望贡献基于对其期望损失施加的统一附加费率。为了证明该谈判公式相对于标准固定权重加权求和优化问题的合理性，我们提供了一个公理化刻画，表明纳什谈判解满足非常适合小规模池中自愿P2P保险合约的性质。我们证明了最优合约的存在性和唯一性，并推导了完全再保险、部分再保险和零再保险情形下的一阶特征。为了解决子群体形成问题，我们开发了计算上易处理的充分条件，以排除可行的联盟偏离，无论是否考虑价格公平。我们的数值研究探讨了价格公平和池规模对最优合约及代理人福利的影响。价格公平降低了同行之间风险分配和确定性等价附加费率的离散程度。关于池规模，福利不一定单调增加，这表明风险池的扩展不仅取决于多样化，还取决于谈判能力的演变。

title: Telemetry and Concealment in Self-Adapting Generative AI: Logging Architecture, Adversarial Model Hiding, and the Limits of Detection
abstract: Model risk management (MRM) guidance assumes a static model lifecycle, in which models are developed, independently validated, and implemented without further autonomous modification. Continually self-adapting generative AI systems --- models that update their own weights during production deployment --- fundamentally violate this assumption and render point-in-time validation inadequate. This paper addresses the resulting governance problem in two parts. Part I develops a rigorous telemetry architecture for such models, operating simultaneously in discrete and continuous time. We establish a Minimal Sufficient Statistic for audit purposes, construct a tamper-evident Merkle chain for discrete weight sequences, derive the appropriate continuous-time generalization via the Ito formula, and propose event-driven logging via KL divergence stopping times that is both computationally tractable and meaningful for validation. Part II asks what happens when the model provider is adversarial. A firm deploying such a model has strong incentives to conceal learning updates that would trigger mandatory validation review. We formalize this as the Model Hiding Problem and provide a systematic taxonomy of six distinct attack strategies against the Part I architecture, spanning discrete and continuous time, with a formal countermeasure for each. Together the two parts establish a dual-regime architecture in which continuous telemetry is necessary but not sufficient, narrowing---but never replacing---periodic invasive audit. The framework is model-architecture-agnostic and is designed to satisfy the three pillars of traditional MRM.
tldr: 论文提出针对持续自适应的生成式AI模型的遥测架构和对抗性隐藏对策，以解决模型风险管理中的治理问题。
abstract_cn: 模型风险管理（MRM）指引假设了一个静态的模型生命周期，在此生命周期中，模型被开发、独立验证并实施，而无需进一步的自主修改。持续自适应的生成式人工智能系统——即在生产部署期间自行更新权重的模型——从根本上违反了这一假设，使得时点验证不再充分。本文分两部分解决由此产生的治理问题。第一部分为这类模型构建了一套严格的遥测架构，使其同时在离散时间和连续时间下运行。我们确立了用于审计目的的最小充分统计量，构建了针对离散权重序列的防篡改默克尔链，通过伊藤公式推导了相应的连续时间推广，并提出了基于KL散度停时的事件驱动日志记录方法，该方法在计算上可行且对验证具有实际意义。第二部分探讨当模型提供方具有对抗性时会发生什么。部署此类模型的企业有强烈动机隐瞒会触发强制验证审查的学习更新。我们将此形式化为“模型隐藏问题”，并针对第一部分架构提供了一套系统的分类体系，涵盖六种不同的攻击策略，横跨离散与连续时间，并为每种策略给出了正式的对策。两部分共同建立了一种双机制架构，其中连续遥测是必要但不充分的，它缩小了——但从未取代——定期侵入式审计的范围。该框架与模型架构无关，旨在满足传统MRM的三大支柱要求。

title: Advancing and Strengthening Interest Rate Risk Management Practices and Priority Areas in Commercial Banking
abstract: This article analyzes the theoretical and practical aspects of improving the practice of interest rate risk management in commercial banks. The volatility of interest rates in global financial markets, inflation processes and macroeconomic uncertainties have a significant impact on banking activities. From this point of view, effective management of interest rate risks is an important factor in ensuring the financial stability of banks. The study examined modern methods of interest rate risk management, including GAP analysis, duration analysis and the possibilities of using derivative financial instruments. Also, the current management system in Uzbek commercial banks was analyzed and practical proposals and recommendations for its improvement were developed. The results of the study are of great importance in developing strategies aimed at strengthening the risk management system in banks, harmonizing assets and liabilities, and minimizing interest rate risks.
tldr: 本文分析商业银行利率风险管理实践，运用GAP分析、久期分析和衍生工具，并提出改进建议，以增强银行财务稳定。
abstract_cn: 本文分析了商业银行利率风险管理实践改进的理论与实践方面。全球金融市场利率的波动、通胀过程以及宏观经济不确定性对银行业务活动产生了显著影响。从这个角度来看，有效管理利率风险是确保银行财务稳定的重要因素。本研究考察了现代利率风险管理方法，包括缺口分析、久期分析以及衍生金融工具的使用可能性。同时，对乌兹别克斯坦商业银行当前的管理体系进行了分析，并提出了改进该体系的实用建议与推荐方案。研究结果对于制定旨在加强银行风险管理体系、协调资产与负债以及最小化利率风险的战略具有重要意义。

analysis.chinese_title: 推进和加强商业银行利率风险管理实践与优先领域
analysis.summary: 本文分析了商业银行利率风险管理实践改进的理论与实践方面。全球金融市场利率波动、通胀过程和宏观经济不确定性对银行业务产生重大影响，因此有效管理利率风险是确保银行财务稳定的重要因素。研究考察了现代利率风险管理方法，包括GAP分析、久期分析以及衍生金融工具的使用可能性。同时，分析了乌兹别克斯坦商业银行当前的管理体系，并提出了改进的实用建议。研究结果对于制定加强银行风险管理体系、协调资产和负债以及最小化利率风险的战略具有重要意义。
innovations: 提出通过股票交易所公开发行商业银行股票并成功实施首次公开募股（IPO）以增加银行资本、增强其在资本市场的活动并加强其对利率风险的抵御能力。
提出在中央银行根据现代银行标准制定的风险管理体系要求框架内，加强商业银行利率风险管理体系的实践发展。
通过GAP分析、久期分析、免疫策略、情景分析和压力测试等多种方法综合评估利率风险。
识别了当前风险管理实践中的主要问题，如过度依赖传统方法、现代金融工具使用有限、风险管理体系数字化水平低等。
提出了改进利率风险管理的优先领域，包括加强资产负债管理（ALM）、引入现代分析方法、使用数字技术、发展衍生金融工具、提高人力资源潜力和适应国际标准。
analysis.methodology: 研究采用综合和系统的方法，结合理论、实证和比较分析。具体方法包括：分析和综合方法用于识别利率风险的经济本质；比较分析用于比较乌兹别克银行与发达国家银行系统的实践；统计分析用于评估银行财务指标；经济数学建模用于评估利率变化的影响；专家评估方法用于识别问题和解决方案。使用的特殊工具包括GAP分析、久期分析、免疫策略、情景分析和压力测试。数据来源包括乌兹别克斯坦中央银行官方数据、商业银行财务报告、国际金融组织报告等。
key_results: 通过IPO实施，银行投资组合在2025年比2024年增长了65%。
通过建立银行风险管理委员会、制定银行环境和社会风险管理政策以及加强风险管理部门的活动，银行信贷组合的质量构成在2025年比2024年提高了45.3%。
久期分析显示，资产久期有时高于负债久期，这可能导致利率上升时银行资本价值下降，且银行未充分使用久期管理策略。
识别了风险管理实践中的主要问题，包括过度依赖传统方法、现代金融工具使用有限、风险管理体系数字化水平低、缺乏合格人员以及压力测试和情景分析使用不足。

title: The Zero-Equity Constraint in Monetary Systems
abstract: Version 5.1.0Refines the monetary settlement relation as the structural primitive of the framework. The Settlement Identity is now derived directly from the complementary claim and settlement-obligation faces of the primitive relation together with closure under composition, rather than from an aggregation-first construction. The Zero-Equity Identity follows immediately as a corollary.Version 5.0.0 (July 2026) This release represents a mature version of the paper, following substantial refinement of both the theoretical framework and its presentation. Major changes since Version 4.1.0 include: Settlement relations established as the primitive ontology, with the Settlement Identity introduced as the primary structural result. Economic value as the settlement substrate expanded and promoted to a dedicated section. New Appendix C extending the framework to commercial banking and heterogeneous credit structures. Comprehensive notation audit and standardisation throughout the manuscript. Expanded figures and geometric illustrations, including simplex-based representations. Strengthened historical context, quotations, references, and discussion of the paper's intellectual lineage. Extensive improvements to exposition, organisation, and internal consistency. Abstract Contemporary monetary analysis treats money primarily in operational terms while leaving its underlying ontological status implicit. The present paper develops an explicit ontology of money. It proposes that fiat-denominated money—whether issued by the state or by private banks—is best understood as a transferable claim for value: an entitlement to real goods, labour, services, and the use of natural resources, rather than a commodity-like asset. From this relational interpretation follows a fundamental structural result. Aggregate financial equity is identically zero among economic agents within the monetary system. Every monetary claim resolves to an obligation borne within that same domain. The monetary authority carries no obligation in real economic settlement, and may properly be excluded from this set. The value anchor of fiat money is clarified as a dispersed and continuous settlement obligation embedded in ordinary economic activity. Taxation functions as the institutional mechanism through which monetary claims are redeemed in real settlement and retired. On this foundation, monetary financial positions are decomposed into equity (net nominal claim position) and credit (the capacity to issue or expand claims). This decomposition applies symmetrically to state-issued fiat and bank-created money, providing a unified ontology for contemporary monetary systems. The exclusion of the monetary authority from the set of economic agents is established mathematically through a family of admissible transformations yielding zero-sum credit representations. This is a preprint. A revised version may be submitted elsewhere.

tldr: 论文提出货币本体论，将货币视为转移性索取权，并推导出零权益恒等式，统一了国家货币和银行货币的框架。
abstract_cn: 版本5.1.0将货币结算关系精炼为框架的结构性基元。结算恒等式现在直接从基元关系的互补性债权与结算义务两个侧面，结合复合运算下的封闭性推导得出，而非采用先聚合后构造的方式。零股权恒等式作为推论直接成立。版本5.0.0（2026年7月）本版本为论文的成熟版本，在理论框架及其表述两方面均经过实质性精炼。自版本4.1.0以来的主要变更包括：将结算关系确立为基元本体论，引入结算恒等式作为首要结构性结果；将经济价值作为结算基质加以扩展并提升为独立章节；新增附录C，将框架延伸至商业银行与异质性信用结构；对全文进行全面的符号审计与标准化；扩充图表与几何图示，包括基于单纯形的表示；强化历史背景、引文、参考文献及论文学术谱系的讨论；在阐述、组织与内部一致性方面进行大量改进。摘要：当代货币分析主要从操作层面处理货币问题，而对其潜在的本体论地位未予明确。本文发展了一种明确的货币本体论。文章提出，法定面额货币——无论由国家还是私人银行发行——应被理解为一种可转让的价值索取权：即对真实商品、劳动、服务及自然资源使用权的权利主张，而非类似商品的资产。从这一关系性解释出发，得出一个基本的结构性结果：在货币体系内的经济主体之间，总金融股权恒等于零。每一笔货币索取权都归结为同一领域内所承担的相应义务。货币当局在真实经济结算中不承担任何义务，因此可合理地将其排除在该集合之外。法定货币的价值锚被阐明为一种嵌入日常经济活动中的分散且连续的结算义务。税收作为制度性机制，使货币索取权在真实结算中被赎回并退出流通。在此基础之上，货币金融头寸被分解为股权（名义净索取权头寸）与信用（发行或扩张索取权的能力）。这一分解对称地适用于国家发行的法定货币与银行创造的货币，为当代货币体系提供了统一的本体论。货币当局从经济主体集合中的排除，通过一族可容许变换在数学上得以确立，该变换产生零和信用表示。本文为预印本，修订版可能另行投稿。

analysis.chinese_title: 货币体系中的零权益约束：法定货币的信用表示
analysis.summary: 本文提出了一种现代法定货币的本体论，认为法定货币（包括国家发行和银行创造的货币）本质上是一种可转让的价值索取权，即对真实商品、劳动、服务和自然资源的权利，而非商品类资产。基于此关系性解释，推导出一个基本结构结果：在货币体系内的经济主体之间，总金融权益恒等于零。每个货币索取权都对应着同一领域内承担的债务。货币当局在真实经济结算中不承担义务，因此应被排除在经济主体集合之外。法定货币的价值锚定被澄清为分散且持续的结算义务，税收是货币索取权在真实结算中赎回和注销的制度机制。在此基础上，货币金融头寸被分解为权益（净名义索取权头寸）和信用（发行或扩张货币索取权的能力），该分解对称地适用于国家发行的法定货币和银行创造的货币。通过数学上允许的变换族，证明了将货币当局从经济主体集合中排除的合理性，从而得到零和信用表示。
innovations: 提出货币作为可转让价值索取权的本体论，区别于商品货币观和纯粹的记账单位观。
推导出零权益恒等式（ZEI），证明封闭货币域内总金融权益恒为零。
通过数学变换将货币当局从经济主体中约化，保留结算恒等式，并给出对称和不对称的信用-权益分解。
将税收解释为货币赎回和注销的机制，澄清了法定货币的价值锚定。
将银行信贷纳入统一框架，认为银行存款通过可兑换为法定货币而继承货币属性。
analysis.methodology: 本文采用理论分析和数学推导的方法。首先建立货币结算关系的本体论，定义货币结算关系及其复合运算，推导出结算恒等式和零权益恒等式。然后通过构造两主体和三主体的原始信用结构，引入对称的信用-权益分解，并推广到不对称结算义务。最后通过附录中的数学变换（约化变换和规范变换）证明货币当局的排除，并扩展至银行信贷。
key_results: 结算恒等式：总货币索取权 ≡ 总货币结算义务。
零权益恒等式：E(A) ≡ 0，即封闭货币域内总金融权益恒为零。
对称分解：c_i = f_i, e_i = f_i - f_bar，其中f_bar为平均货币坐标。
不对称分解：c_i = f_i, e_i = f_i - l_i，其中l_i为分配的结算义务。
货币当局的约化不改变结算恒等式，但改变了权益的归属。
tech_stack: 线性代数（向量空间分解，零和子空间）
图形表示（单纯形、坐标图）
strengths: 提供了货币本质的清晰本体论，统一了法定货币和银行信贷。
数学推导严谨，从基本定义出发得出重要恒等式。
对传统部门合并方法进行了批判性分析，并提出了替代方案。
对税收在货币体系中的作用给出了新颖解释。
附录提供了详细的数学证明和扩展。
limitations: 理论框架较为抽象，缺乏实证检验。
对货币当局的约化可能引发争议，其合理性依赖于本体论假设。
对称分解中的均匀义务分配假设可能不现实，不对称分解虽更一般但未给出具体分配规则。
未讨论开放经济、汇率制度等复杂情况。
